Why This Role Matters

This role leads advanced data science and analytics initiatives within the Agentic AI department, translating business problems into scalable analytical solutions, AI-enabled insights, predictive models, and decision intelligence products. It helps build enterprise capabilities that use trusted data, machine learning, automation, and agentic AI concepts to improve productivity, operational performance, and business decision-making.

What You Will Deliver

Lead Data Science and Analytics Solutions

Translate business priorities, operational challenges, and use cases into clear data science problem statements, analytical approaches, and measurable outcomes.
  
Design and deliver predictive, prescriptive, diagnostic, and exploratory analytics solutions that support decision-making across business and operational domains.
  
Develop machine learning models, statistical analyses, simulations, optimization approaches, and advanced analytics products using enterprise data assets.
  
Ensure analytical outputs are interpretable, actionable, repeatable, and aligned with business value, adoption needs, and governance requirements.
  
Enable Agentic AI and Intelligent Analytics

Support the development of agentic AI use cases by defining data, model, workflow, evaluation, and decision-support requirements.
  
Collaborate with AI engineers, platform teams, data engineers, and business stakeholders to embed analytics and machine learning into autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.
  
Define evaluation approaches for AI-enabled insights, model performance, business impact, human oversight, and continuous improvement.
  
Promote responsible use of agentic AI by ensuring transparency, explainability, control, auditability, and fit-for-purpose model deployment.
  
Advance Data Products and Decision Intelligence

Create reusable analytical assets, data science patterns, feature logic, model components, and decision intelligence products that can scale across business domains.
  
Partner with data platform, governance, and architecture teams to ensure data products are trusted, well-documented, reusable, and operationally maintainable.
  
Integrate analytics into dashboards, workflows, applications, copilots, and AI agents where decision support can improve speed, quality, and productivity.
  
Maintain clear documentation covering assumptions, data sources, model logic, limitations, controls, and expected business usage.

Why This Role Matters

This role leads the design, modeling, and evolution of enterprise data architecture to ensure data products, curated layers, and integration patterns are standardized, scalable, high-quality, and governed. It defines how operational and corporate data should be modeled, aligned, and transformed to support analytics, reporting, AI enablement, and trusted downstream consumption across business domains.

What You Will Deliver

Lead Enterprise Data Modeling

Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise business domains and data architecture principles.
  
Define canonical models, conformed dimensions, master/reference data structures, and reusable modeling patterns for cross-domain consistency.
  
Design data product models and curated layer schemas that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI use cases, and downstream integrations.
  
Ensure models address performance, maintainability, scalability, auditability, lineage, and future reuse across platforms and domains.
  
Define Architecture Standards and Governance

Establish enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, modeling guidelines, reusable templates, and quality expectations for delivery teams.
  
Partner with data governance teams to align business glossary definitions, stewardship ownership, metadata, lineage, and critical data elements.
  
Embed governance-by-design into data models, curated layers, transformation logic, data quality controls, and consumption patterns.
  
Review and approve modeling deliverables from internal teams and external vendors to ensure architectural consistency and quality.
  
Shape Data Product and Curated Layer Architecture

Lead the creation and optimization of data product schemas, curated layers, semantic structures, and consumption-ready models.
  
Define modeling approaches for relational, non-relational, time-series, streaming, lakehouse, warehouse, and analytical platform requirements.
  
Ensure data models support time-variant structures, historical traceability, auditability, semantic consistency, and trusted analytics consumption.
  
Coordinate with data engineering, platform, analytics, AI, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure models are technically feasible and reusable.
  
Enable Integration, Interoperability and Trusted Consumption

**Job Title:** AI Quality Assurance Engineer  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**  
Responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, accuracy, and performance of AI/ML solutions throughout the development lifecycle. The role develops and implements testing strategies for AI models, data pipelines, AI applications, and production deployments while ensuring solutions meet business, technical, security, and regulatory requirements.

* Develop and execute comprehensive QA and testing strategies for AI/ML solutions.
* Validate AI models for accuracy, consistency, robustness, and performance.
* Design test cases for machine learning models, AI applications, APIs, and data pipelines.

* Test AI outputs for accuracy, bias, hallucination, reliability, and consistency where applicable.
* Conduct regression, integration, functional, performance, and automated testing.
* Establish quality gates and acceptance criteria for AI model deployment.
* Monitor model performance and identify model/data drift in production.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Business stakeholders.

* Document defects, test results, risks, and remediation activities.
* Support model governance, auditability, and compliance requirements.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Engineering, or a related field.

* Experience with Python and automated testing frameworks.
* Knowledge of SQL and data validation techniques.
* Experience with APIs, cloud platforms, CI/CD, and version control.
* Understanding of ML model evaluation metrics and model monitoring.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Eurisko is looking for a talented
**Data Scientist**
to join our growing AI & Data Analytics team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, hands-on experience in machine learning and statistical modeling, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

Experience in
**Banking & FinTech**
is a strong plus.

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and predictive analytics models.

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with MLOps, model deployment, and monitoring.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**About Mozn**

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.
  
  
We're a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.
  
  
If you're passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

We are searching for a strategic and inquisitive Data Scientist. As a member of Mozn's Data Science team, you will work with cross-disciplinary teams to identify the problems to be solved, specify the problems in mathematical and statistical terms, scope out the project in collaboration with your team and external stakeholders, and then go about answering the identified questions. * Communicate highly technical results and methods clearly to a wide variety of external clients

* Plan and execute end-to-end data science projects, from data collection and exploration through model development, deployment, and intelligent decision-making
* Engage with stakeholders to identify and define the scope of challenges and propose data-powered solutions
* Staying informed with new frameworks and technological advances to increase Mozn's efficiency and productivity
* Deploy and maintain AI and machine learning models across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments

**Requirements**

* B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or similar quantitative fields
* 3-5 years of relevant experience as a data scientist, or similar fields that require developing ML/AI models
* Programming experience over three years, including data manipulation using Python or other languages
* Good understanding of statistics

**Investment Analyst Job Description**

**Investment Analysis, Research, Financial Modeling & Valuation**

o Conduct financial analysis, due diligence, and valuation for investment opportunities (Public equity, Fixed Income, direct, co-investments, funds) and prepare and reports and memo for the board.

o Perform valuation using comparable, precedent transactions, and sensitivity analysis.

o Support transaction execution, including deal structuring, financial modeling, and investment committee presentations.

o Monitor and manage existing portfolio investments, providing strategic recommendations.

o Assist in market research, industry analysis, and identifying investment trends within KSA and broader GCC markets.

o Ensure investments comply with policies, risk limits, and governance standards.

**Portfolio Execution, Monitoring & Reporting**

o Work closely with senior management and external advisors on investment strategies and portfolio performance.

o Support structuring, negotiations, and transaction documentation through closing.

o On-line trading, management and reporting of GCC (mainly KSA) investments.

o Accounting of investments (mainly public stocks & DPM) operation on Oracle and generating relevant reports.

o Monitoring and recording of dividends and distribution of all the investments

o Prepare periodic performance dashboards and management reports.

o Monitoring the performance of advisory and discretionary mandates with asset managers.

· **Relationships Management, KYC update & Compliance.**

o Engaging with Bank and brokerage house relationship managers.

o Updating of all KYC and compliance documents for all the Banks.

o Yearly Personal Zakat calculation for Board Members every Ramadan

· English & Arabic (writing, reading & speaking) Proficiency is required.

· Bachelor or Master’s Degree Education in Finance, Economics or Business. CFA Candidacy

· 5 Year to 7 Years’ experience at the family office or Asset Management or Brokerage house or Bank.

· Working knowledge of Bloomberg, Refinitiv, etc.

· Knowhow of brokerage trading portals, Oracle/ERP data entry, reporting, & proficiency is excel & memo writing.

· Ability to manage multiple account, entities and deadlines.

· Integrity, confidentiality, and compliance mindset.

· Advanced financial modeling and valuation expertise.

· Clear communication and teamwork skills.

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**

The Inventory & Business Analyst is responsible for optimizing inventory performance and providing business and operational analysis to support effective decision-making. This role focuses on inventory planning, forecasting, KPI management, business reporting, and process improvement initiatives to drive operational efficiency and improve business performance **.**

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

Inventory Planning & Analysis

* Maintain optimal inventory levels across raw materials, work-in-progress (WIP), and finished goods while minimizing stockouts, excess inventory, and obsolescence.
* Analyze inventory trends, aging, slow-moving inventory, excess and obsolete (E&O) stock, and inventory turnover performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve inventory efficiency and working capital performance.
* Support inventory reconciliation activities and inventory performance reviews.

Business & Financial Analysis

* Support inventory-related financial reporting, inventory valuation, provisions, adjustments, and inventory control activities.
* Perform variance analysis against budget, forecast, and POR targets to identify performance gaps and business risks.
* Investigate operational and financial variances and provide meaningful insights to management.
* Collect, validate, and analyze business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and improvement areas.
* Develop analysis and recommendations to support informed business decisions.

Reporting & KPI Management

* Prepare and maintain inventory, operational, and business performance reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators including inventory value, inventory turnover (ITO), inventory accuracy, shortages, aging, and E&O inventory.
* Develop dashboards and management reports using ERP and business data.
* Provide regular updates and business insights to leadership teams.

Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Support

* Identify opportunities to improve reporting, data quality, automation, and operational processes.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory management and business performance.
* Collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to improve operational effectiveness.
Support business planning, forecasting, and operational review processes.  

**Who You Are**

* You use analytical thinking to solve complex business and operational challenges.

Role purpose

Support the Operational Readiness team by collecting and checking workstream information, maintaining accurate trackers and evidence records, and preparing clear progress updates. Under guidance, the Analyst helps identify missing inputs, overdue actions and emerging dependencies so that accountable owners can resolve them before operational activation.

Key responsibilities

* Update readiness plans, checklists, milestone trackers and action logs using inputs from workstream owners; record the source and date of each update.
* Collect and organise evidence for workforce, training, procedures, assets, systems, permits and service mobilisation against agreed readiness criteria.
* Check submissions for completeness and consistency; flag missing evidence, conflicting dates or unassigned actions to the responsible specialist or manager.
* Prepare routine status summaries, dashboards and meeting packs that distinguish verified completion from work still in progress.
* Maintain risk, issue, dependency and decision logs; follow up assigned actions and escalate blockers promptly.
* Support coordination of readiness workshops, site inspections, testing, rehearsals and operational trials, including minutes and action follow-up.
* Assist with reviews of handover documentation, operating procedures and mobilisation plans by recording comments and tracking responses.
* Maintain orderly document control, version history and traceable records for readiness assurance and transition to operations.
* Support post-activation close-out and lessons learned, and suggest practical improvements to templates and reporting.

Key relationships

Internal: Operational Readiness, Operations, Project Delivery, Facilities and Asset Management, HSE, Security, Technology and other workstream owners. External: contractors, consultants, operators and service providers, as directed by the team.

 **Requirements**

Qualifications and experience

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, engineering, operations management, project management or a related discipline.
* Typically 0-2 years of relevant experience; graduates with suitable internships or project experience may be considered.
* Familiarity with project delivery, operations or asset handover is advantageous; professional certification is not required at entry level.

Skills and working approach

* Strong attention to detail, data accuracy and ability to keep an audit trail.
* Working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint

Experience-Rated Underwriting
  
  

* Evaluate, modify and price benefits for large corporate new business and renewal quotations in compliance with underwriting guidelines.
* Build effective relationships with sales and client management partners to win and retain business
* Identify possible areas of improvement in the Large Corporate underwriting workflow.
* Collaborate with underwriters in the other offices on regional opportunities.

Focus on Data Governance and Process Improvements
  
  

* Assess, validate and analyse datasets available for underwriting, with clear understanding of the underlying concepts.
* Ensure data governance and consistency across underwriting data pipelines and reporting tools.
* Drive automation of reporting tools and improve data models for scalable analysis.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting
  
  

* Develop and manage portfolio reporting across key underwriting, portfolio and financial KPIs.
* Conduct variance analysis (actual vs. expected, plan delivery, forecasts) and identify key performance drivers.

Portfolio Management and Optimisation
  
  

* Assess and challenge pricing strategies across business segments and channels.
* Evaluate the impact of pricing thresholds and decisions on growth, profitability and market standing.
* Support and own pricing frameworks and underwriting guidelines, including periodic review.

Business Insights and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Provide analytical input into annual operating plans, forecasts and strategic plans.
* Identify structural performance gaps across segments, channels and locations, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Support cross-functional initiatives with Sales, Strategy Planning, Actuarial, Finance and Operations.

Governance and Control
  
  

* Ensure effective embedded controls to detect inappropriate underwriting practices.
* Ensure underwriting policies, procedures and guidelines are implemented, enforced and periodically reviewed.
* Keep underwriting practices compliant with the latest regulatory requirements and Cigna standards.

Proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work®, we are an AI-native customer experience platform purpose-built for emerging markets. With more than 25 years of conversational AI research and development, we serve over 5,000 enterprises across MENA and are pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through our Agentic Studio platform. Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. * Mentor and develop Product Managers and Product Analysts, helping raise the overall standard of Product within Lendo.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Operations and Commercial teams to deliver products within Lendo's regulated environment.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Finance or a related field.

job_description:
The **BI & Reporting Expert** transforms complex raw enterprise data into actionable visual insights, interactive dashboards, and executive reporting solutions. This role sits between IT infrastructure and business leadership to drive data-informed decision-making across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Dashboard & Report Development:** Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade interactive dashboards and automated reports (Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik).
* **Data Modeling & Architecture:** Build robust star/snowflake schemas, optimize DAX/SQL queries, and manage data models for high performance.
* **ETL & Data Integration:** Collaborate with data engineers to design and maintain automated ETL/ELT pipelines from ERPs, CRMs, and SQL databases into data warehouses.
* **Business Stakeholder Management:** Translate complex business requirements into clear KPI frameworks, executive summaries, and functional dashboard specs.
* **Data Governance & Security:** Enforce row-level security (RLS), data quality standards, and access control policies across all BI platforms.

  
**Requirements**  

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field.
* **BI Tools:** Mastery of Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, or Looker.
* **Database & Querying:** Advanced SQL proficiency (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, procedure optimization).
* **Data Warehousing:** Working experience with Snowflake, AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery, or SQL Server/SSAS.
* **Certifications (Preferred):** Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), Tableau Certified Data Analyst, or ITIL4.

**About the Company**

At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

### **About The Role**

The Senior Analyst, Real Estate will support the origination, underwriting, structuring, and execution of third-party management agreements and acquisitions. The role will evaluate owner and asset opportunities where Flow can operate under its brand and platform, similar to a hotel flag or management model, with a focus on financial analysis, feasibility, commercial terms, due diligence, and deal execution across multifamily and hospitality-led opportunities.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Underwriting: Build and maintain financial models for prospective management agreements, including property performance, management fee streams, ramp-up assumptions, and Flow-level economics. Conduct sensitivities to assess risk and commercial attractiveness.
* Asset & Owner Opportunity Evaluation: Underwrite prospective assets and owner partnerships for operational fit, financial viability, brand suitability, and value creation potential. Analyze operating statements, unit mix, occupancy, pricing, and historical performance where available.
* Market & Feasibility Analysis: Assess supply and demand, rental or room rates, competitive positioning, development pipelines, customer segments, and operating benchmarks. Translate findings into clear recommendations on whether and how Flow should pursue an opportunity.
* Management Agreement Structuring: Support the structuring and negotiation of management agreements, including base and incentive fees, pre-opening or technical service fees, term, performance tests, owner obligations, termination rights, exclusivity, and brand standards.
* Deal Materials & Approvals: Prepare deal summaries, financial analyses, presentations, and approval memora

job_description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Cost Accountant to support accurate product costing, inventory valuation, cost analysis, and financial reporting. The role will be responsible for maintaining cost data, analyzing production and purchase cost variances, monitoring bill of materials and standard costs, and providing timely cost and margin insights to support cost analyst in the operational reporting and commercial decision-making.

 **Requirements**

Product Costing & Standard Costing – Maintain and review product cost structures, including raw material, packaging, labor, manufacturing overhead, and other relevant production costs.

Bill of Materials & Cost Master Data – Review BOMs, costing versions, and related master data to ensure accurate and approved costing information is maintained in the ERP system.

Raw Material & Purchase Cost Analysis – Monitor raw material prices, landed costs, purchase price movements, and their impact on product costs and margins.

Production Cost & Variance Analysis – Analyze material usage, purchase price, production, yield, and other manufacturing variances and identify the key drivers of cost movements.

Inventory Valuation & Reconciliation – Support accurate inventory valuation and reconcile inventory quantities and values between operational records, costing reports, and the general ledger.

Coordinate with the production team and other users who are responsible for recording inventory related entries and ensuring completeness and accuracy in the recording cycle.

Month-End Costing & Closing – Perform costing activities and reconciliations required for month-end closing, including review of production costs, inventory movements, and cost of goods sold.

Stock counts – Conducting monthly stock counts at the locations of the Group companies, reconciling stock records, investigating, resolving and reporting unreconciled variances.

Business Support – Work closely with Production, Procurement, Supply Chain, Sales, and R&D to evaluate the financial impact of recipe/BOM changes, purchase prices, production changes, and new products.

**Minimum Qualifications and Knowledge**

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. CMA, ACCA, CA Intermediate, or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

**Minimum Experience (no. of years)**

Minimum 5- 7 years of relevant experience in cost accounting, management accounting, manufacturing finance, or a similar role.

**Job-specific Skills and Competencies**

### **About Synapse Analytics**

Synapse Analytics builds AI-powered platforms that help financial institutions make faster, better, more transparent decisions. Konan, our decisioning and workflow platform, digitizes credit decisioning end to end inside banks and lenders. Doxter, our document intelligence platform, turns unstructured client documents into structured, usable data. We implement both inside regulated financial institutions across MENA and LATAM, and Saudi Arabia is one of our most important and fastest-growing markets.

### **About the Role**

As Senior Project Manager for Credit & Risk Implementations in KSA, you will be Synapse's senior delivery lead on the ground in the Kingdom. You will own the end-to-end delivery of Konan and Doxter implementations at Saudi banks, finance companies, and lenders: programmes that digitize credit policy, automate underwriting and decisioning, and operate under the oversight of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA).

This is not a generic PM role. Our KSA implementations sit at the point where credit and risk policy, regulatory compliance, client IT and InfoSec, and AI-powered software meet. You will need to hold a credible conversation with a Chief Risk Officer about policy and decisioning, with a CISO about outsourcing and data controls, and with our engineers about integration and deployment, and then turn all of it into one plan the client trusts.

You will run a portfolio of concurrent KSA engagements, lead senior client relationships and steering committees, protect scope and commercial boundaries, and act as the delivery authority for the region. As our presence in the Kingdom grows, you will also help build the local delivery team and the playbook it runs on.

### **Role and Responsibilities**

#### **Credit & Risk Implementation Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Konan and Doxter implementations for Saudi financial institutions, from contract handover and project charter through go-live, hypercare, and handover to Customer Success.
* Own the credit policy digitization workstream: lead policy discovery workshops with client credit and risk teams, and guide the translation of credit policy, eligibility and knockout rules, scorecards, limits, pricing, and approval matrices into Konan configurations alongside our Konan subject matter experts.
* Ensure every configured policy is traceable to the client's approved policy documents, fully tested, and formally signed off by the client's risk owners.
* Lead

Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

The Field Architect role at MinIO is a senior customer-facing technical position focused on defining, validating, and guiding architectures for AI, analytics, cloud-native applications, and large-scale data platforms. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, translating business and application requirements into robust technical designs that deliver measurable outcomes.  
  
You will collaborate closely with the broader MinIO team through technical discovery, architecture design, proof-of-concept (PoC) delivery, production onboarding, performance validation, and long-term expansion. Success in this role requires hands-on expertise across the data stack, strong architecture and communication skills, and ownership of customer technical outcomes.

**What You Will Do:**

**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* **Technical Architecture and Discovery:** Lead technical discovery with customers and partners to understand their business goals, data sources, application requirements, infrastructure constraints, and success criteria. Design end-to-end architectures that address those requirements.
* **Data Platform Architecture:** Design solutions across the full data stack, including ingestion and change data capture (CDC), batch and streaming pipelines, data processing, lakehouse storage and table formats, catalogs, query and analytics engines, orchestration, data quality, governance, and AI integration. Understand how these components work together and guide customers through architecture decisions and tradeoffs.
* **AI and Analytics Workload Design:** Define and validate architectures for AI/ML training and inference, analytics, lakehouse environments, high-performance data pipelines, and modern application data services.
* **Object Storage and S3 Expertise:** Serve as a subject matter expert in AIStor, object storage, S3-compatible architectures, distributed systems, replication, erasure coding, security, performance tuning, and large-scale namespace design.

CodeNinja is a full-stack Sovereign AI delivery company helping Saudi enterprises and government entities build, own, and compound AI and engineering capability permanently, rather than renting it through vendor contracts. job_description:
**Who Are We❓**

We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.

**The Job in a Nutshell**

You will construct agentic AI architecture, leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. Working within a compact engineering team, you will build the core foundational infrastructure, spanning microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and eval harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.

This hands-on backend software engineering position focuses primarily on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is incorporated into the workflow, complex architectural challenges reside within the underlying infrastructure.

We welcome applicants across diverse seniority levels. Given that production-grade agentic engineering remains an emerging discipline, candidates bring varied expertise; candidate capability determines final level placement. Opportunities exist for early-career developers through veteran software architects.

Engineering excellence remains mandatory across all levels. Junior engineers pair directly with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers drive technical standards and architectural vision.

**What You Will Do ❓**

* Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces.
* Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers featuring precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers.
* Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards.
* Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations

**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
At Worley, we’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and can thrive is essential to our mission of delivering sustainable change. We know that diverse and inclusive cultures are safer and more innovative. We encourage applications from candidates from all backgrounds and diversity characteristics and warmly encourage disabled or neurodivergent candidates to apply.

**Position Purpose**  
Provide independent technical leadership and assurance on behalf of the Owner for nuclear safety, radiation protection, environmental compliance, and emergency preparedness throughout the project lifecycle, from site selection and licensing through design, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness.

Ensure compliance with Saudi Arabian regulatory requirements, IAEA Safety Standards, international best practices, and the Owner's Nuclear Safety Policy while independently reviewing and challenging EPC Contractor deliverables.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Nuclear Safety**  
• Lead independent nuclear safety reviews and technical assurance activities.
  
• Review safety case documentation (PSAR, FSAR and supporting analyses).
  
• Ensure implementation of defence-in-depth and ALARA principles.
  
• Support the Owner's Nuclear Safety Management System and promote a strong nuclear safety culture.
  
**Environmental & Radiation Protection**  
• Review Environmental Impact Assessments and environmental compliance programmes.
  
• Oversee radiation protection strategies, environmental monitoring, radioactive waste management, and occupational dose optimisation.
  
• Ensure compliance with applicable environmental and radiation protection regulations.
  
**Emergency Preparedness**  
• Lead development and review of emergency preparedness and response programmes.
  
• Review emergency procedures, severe accident management

**The role:**  
This role takes ownership of product design as a function: the standard, the system, the process and the people, starting with that designer.

This is a hands on role. In a team of two, the lead designs as much as they direct. You will set the bar by doing the work, review everything that ships, and build the design system and practices that let the product move faster without losing coherence.

The role is built for the way product work is changing. Master Works is seeking an **AI Solutions Consultant** to serve as the bridge between enterprise business requirements and modern AI capabilities. This role identifies, qualifies, and architects high-impact AI use cases across business units, then drives the technical implementation using Azure AI infrastructure, Microsoft Foundry, and Copilot Studio. The consultant designs secure, scalable architectures integrating cloud AI models with on-premises enterprise data assets.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to discover, evaluate, and prioritize enterprise AI use cases tied to clear business outcomes.
* Design and implement end-to-end conversational and autonomous AI agents using Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, and Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Configure Azure AI model inference, orchestrating appropriate models (frontier LLMs, SLMs, domain-specific models) within enterprise cost and performance boundaries.
* Manage Azure subscription resources, implementing cost governance, capacity planning, and Pay-As-You-Go (PAYG) vs. provisioned throughput allocation.
* Build enterprise system integrations utilizing Microsoft Power Platform custom and pre-built connectors.
* Architect and secure hybrid connectivity between cloud AI services and local data sources using On-Premises Data Gateways.
* Define responsible AI guardrails, content filtering, prompt engineering standards, and role-based access control (RBAC).

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

* 8+ years of experience in enterprise IT architecture or technical consulting, with at least 2 years dedicated to generative AI, NLP, and agentic workflows.
* Hands-on implementation experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Studio, Azure OpenAI Service, and Copilot Studio.
* Deep knowledge of Azure resource management, subscription billing models, and hybrid networking patterns.
* Strong proficiency in API integrations (REST, JSON, OAuth2) and Microsoft Power Platform administration.
* Proven ability to translate abstract business challenges into functional technical specifications.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600), and Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) certifications are preferred.
* Prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture, Python / C#, Powe

job_description:
**Job Description**
Role Purpose:
  
  
The FWA AI Engineer is responsible for designing, building, testing, and deploying AI solutions that support Fraud, Waste & Abuse (FWA) detection and investigation. The role translates approved business requirements and data science models into scalable production solutions, integrating AI capabilities into operational workflows while ensuring reliability, performance, and business value. Working closely with the FWA Lead, FWA Data Scientist, investigators, and business stakeholders, the role drives the successful implementation and continuous enhancement of FWA AI use cases.
  
  
Key Accountabilities:
  
  
1- FWA Solution Design & Feasibility Assessment;
  
  

* Assess technical feasibility of approved FWA use cases.
* Evaluate data availability, technical requirements, and implementation complexity.
* Define solution approaches for AI-driven FWA detection.
* Develop technical requirements and implementation plans.
* Recommend optimal AI techniques and technologies for delivery.

2- AI Solution Development & Engineering;
  
  

* Build and optimize AI solutions supporting FWA detection and investigation activities.
* Translate models and analytical logic into scalable cloud-native solutions on GCP.
* Implement machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics, and document intelligence solutions.
* Develop APIs, scoring services, and integration components required for operational deployment.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with technical standards.
* Collaborate with the FWA Data Scientist to operationalize validated models.

3- Production Deployment & Integration;
  
  

* Deploy AI solutions into operational environments.
* Integrate AI outputs with internal systems and workflows.
* Coordinate with Data Engineering and TIDES (IT) teams to enable production deployment.
* Support release planning and deployment activities.
* Ensure successful transition from development to production.

4- Testing & Quality Assurance;
  
  

* Conduct technical testing of AI solutions.
* Support user acceptance testing with business stakeholders.
* Validate output accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Identify and resolve implementation issues.
* Ensure solutions meet defined business and technical requirements.

5- Solution Maintenance & Continuous Improvement;
  
  

* Support ongoing enhancement of deployed FWA AI solutions.
* Implement model improvements identified by the Data Science team.
*

**PMO & Real Estate Business Development Manager**

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Reports To:** Chief Investment & Business Development Officer

**Role Summary:**

A leading Real Estate Development company in Saudi Arabia is seeking a high-caliber **PMO Manager** with a strong background in **Real Estate Deal Origination & Investment**. Sitting at the intersection of investment strategy and delivery, this role is responsible for generating and screening new real estate development opportunities, managing the deal pipeline, and establishing robust PMO governance across active and prospective developments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Deal Origination & Sourcing:** Identify, screen, and qualify new real estate development opportunities in coordination with the CIBDO. Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, brokers, and JV partners to generate a consistent pipeline.
* **Pipeline & Feasibility Screening:** Support preliminary feasibility screening and prioritization of new opportunities against investment criteria, tracking deal progress end-to-end.
* **PMO Governance & Analytics:** Establish PMO governance standards (charters, stage-gates, RAID logs) and build Power BI dashboards tracking deal origination, pipeline conversion, and portfolio performance for C-level leadership.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary point of contact between the company and external parties on origination-related matters.

 **Requirements**

**Requirements & Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Real Estate, or Engineering.
* **Certifications:** **PMP Certification** is required.
* **Experience:** 4–5 years of relevant experience combining **Real Estate Development/Investment** with strong PMO discipline. Experience at a major consulting firm (Tier-1) is highly preferred.
* **Technical Skills:** Hands-on expertise in Power BI, Advanced Excel, MS Project, Wrike, and Microsoft 365 tools.

To apply, kindly submit your application through the link or send your updated CV directly to TAJ HR at: **cv@taj-hr.com**

*(Kindly mention* ***"PMO Manager - KSA"*** *in the email subject line).*

**About Octopus by RTG**

Octopus by RTG is the tech hiring and outsourcing arm of **Robusta Technology Group**, dedicated to connecting exceptional tech talent with top-tier organizations across the **MENA, GCC, Europe, the US, and Canada**. We specialize in building strong, long-term partnerships between skilled professionals and innovative companies. Our mission is to empower growth, innovation, and excellence by matching the right talent with the right opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Configure and customize Dynamics 365 entities, forms, views, and business process flows to support the leasing journey: inquiry (RIF/TIF) capture, unit listing sync, offer/negotiation status, indicative terms, and lease sign-off.
* Build and maintain the integration layer (in coordination with the API Developer) that pushes/pulls data between the Portal and Dynamics — e.g., unit availability, agent assignment, inquiry routing, booking confirmations, and lease-status transitions (Prospect Offer Signed Active Renewal/Termination).
* Develop plugins, workflows, Power Automate flows, and custom APIs within Dynamics to automate leasing-team notifications and approval steps (e.g., move-in request approvals,addendum requests, operational date changes).
* Model and maintain the account hierarchy needed for sub-accounts (MHR-03, MUT-16/17) and company profiles (MUT-31) within Dynamics.
* Support renewal and termination workflows by ensuring Dynamics reflects and triggers portal-side renewal notifications (SRR/SRT) and termination/settlement records (FCR/FCT).
* Build reporting/dashboards in Dynamics (or Power BI) for the leasing and community-management teams to track inquiries, conversions, and portal-driven activity.
* Manage security roles, field-level permissions, and data-privacy configuration within Dynamics for portal-originated records.
* Participate in data-mapping and (if scoped as a change request) data-migration exercises between legacy systems and Dynamics.
* Support UAT for all CRM-dependent features and provide production support during hypercare.

 **Requirements**

Required Skills & Experience  

* 4+ years hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / Customer Engagement) development and configuration experience.
* Strong command of the Dynamics customization toolkit: plugins (C#), custom workflows, Power Automate, Dataverse, and the Dynamics Web API / Common Data Service.
* Experience integrating Dynamics with external web/portal applications via REST AP

ASMO is a groundbreaking joint venture between DHL and Saudi Aramco. Inheriting DHL’s logistics excellence and Saudi Aramco’s extensive supply chain ecosystem, we are here to set a new benchmark and redefine the procurement and supply chain landscape, enabling growth.

* Perform variance analysis and investigate significant deviations from planned or expected performance.
* Develop and maintain management dashboards and performance reporting tools using appropriate business intelligence and analytical platforms.
* Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, consistent, timely, and aligned with agreed definitions and reporting standar

About the Job

**Job Title:**
Senior Data Analyst

**Location:**
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Seniority Level:**
Senior Level

**Experience:**
4–7 years

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team and turn complex data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI.
* Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and analyze data.
* Translate business requirements into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
* Monitor key performance indicators and provide regular performance reports.
* Collaborate with business, product, technology, and other teams to understand data requirements.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality across different sources.
* Identify opportunities to improve business performance through data-driven recommendations.
* Present analytical findings and recommendations to management and key stakeholders.
* Support the development and improvement of data analysis processes and reporting standards.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 4–7 years of experience in data analysis or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Microsoft Excel.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources.

job_description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst to transform raw operational and transactional data into actionable insights that support business decisions and improve operational performance.
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, advanced Google Sheets expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into meaningful analysis, reports, and dashboards. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify trends, investigate performance issues, and support data-driven decision-making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Write advanced SQL queries using CTEs, window functions, and multi-table joins to extract, aggregate, and analyze large datasets
* Build and maintain dynamic dashboards, forecasting models, and operational trackers using Google Sheets
* Conduct root-cause analysis, identify trends, and investigate operational performance issues
* Define and monitor KPIs to measure business and operational performance
* Translate business requests into structured data models and actionable insights
* Present analytical findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership
* Develop automated audit checks to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality
* Support continuous improvement through data-driven recommendations

**Requirements**

* 2-3 years of experience in Data Analytics or Business Intelligence
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience writing advanced SQL queries
* Strong SQL knowledge, including CTEs, window functions, and complex joins
* Advanced Google Sheets skills, including QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, and dynamic Pivot Tables
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker Studio or Power BI
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills
* Experience working with databases such as BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Snowflake
* Excellent English communication skills; professional Arabic is strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is preferred

job_description:
**Job Purpose:**

The IT Business Intelligence Manager leads the design, development, governance, and continuous optimization of the organization’s enterprise business intelligence and data platforms. The role owns the end-to-end data lifecycle, from source-system extraction and data integration through semantic modeling, reporting, and executive analytics, ensuring accurate, timely, secure, and scalable delivery of business insights. It also provides leadership for BI platform administration, infrastructure reliability, and cross-functional technical collaboration

**Key Responsibilities:**

2.1 BI Platform Strategy & Data Architecture

* Own the enterprise BI architecture across Power BI, Tableau, and Microsoft Fabric, ensuring alignment with the business intelligence strategy and scalability requirements.
* Lead adoption of Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse integration and Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers), to modernize the enterprise data platform.
* Lead the migration of reporting assets from Tableau to Power BI, including conversion of calculated fields and measures into DAX, and manage the platform phase-down timeline.
* Define data modeling standards for fact and dimension structures, ensuring consistency, performance, and business alignment across semantic models.

2.2 ETL, Data Engineering & Performance Optimization

* Design, manage, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using SSIS for high-volume batch processing.
* Manage Power BI incremental refresh strategies and query-folding techniques for large-scale fact tables.
* Perform SQL Server performance tuning, including query optimization, execution-plan analysis, transaction-log management, and data-compression strategies.
* Diagnose and resolvesemantic-model refresh failures, capacity constraints, and gateway-related connectivity issues.

2.3 Reporting, Analytics & Executive Communication

* Develop advanced DAX measures and analytical solutions for business use cases, including customer credit aging, margin analysis, and demand baselines.
* Translate complex SQL and DAX logic into clear, business-friendly documentation for non-technical stakeholders and process owners.
* Prepare board- and executive-level deliverables, including executive summaries, financial analyses, investment studies, and presentation decks.
* Partner with business units to translate reporting requirements into scalable, governed BI solutions.

2.4 Platform Administration, Security & Governance

job_description:
**MADI International** is looking for a results-driven **Account** **Executive** to join our team in Riyadh. If you have a passion for sales, strong customer relationship skills, and experience in the beauty, cosmetics, or FMCG industry, we’d love to hear from you!

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales Performance (Sell-In & Sell-Out)**

* Achieve monthly sales targets by customer and brand.
* Drive sell-out performance through regular client follow-ups.
* Monitor stock levels to prevent overstocking and stock shortages.
* Align sales activities with market demand.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients.
* Handle customer inquiries, complaints, and follow-ups.
* Ensure smooth order processing and timely delivery.

**Business Development**

* Identify and acquire new customers within the assigned territory.
* Expand business with existing clients through new SKUs and brands.
* Achieve annual new customer acquisition targets.
* Identify new sales opportunities in the market.

**Collection & Credit Control**

* Achieve collection targets in line with company policies.
* Monitor outstanding balances and customer statements of account.
* Ensure compliance with credit terms and company SOPs.
* Coordinate with the Finance team to ensure timely collections.
* Follow company procedures for customers with overdue payments.

**In-Store Execution & Brand Visibility**

* Ensure strong brand visibility and presence at retail outlets.
* Implement planograms, displays, FSDUs, and gondolas.
* Optimize shelf space and share of shelf.
* Maintain brand standards and merchandising guidelines.

**Forecasting, Market Intelligence & Reporting**

* Prepare accurate sales forecasts and monitor stock availability.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain to ensure product availability.
* Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, and market activities.
* Identify market trends and business opportunities.
* Submit weekly and monthly reports and maintain accurate sales records.
* Plan customer visits and routes efficiently.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Valid driving license is mandatory.**
* 1–3 years of sales experience, preferably in beauty, cosmetics, or FMCG.
* Proven experience as a Sales Executive or in a similar sales role.
* Sales-related certifications are an advantage.

SUMMARY OF THE ROLE

The Senior Sales Executive - Projects, you will be responsible to Support the Area Sales Manager in driving B2B sales of Jotun Decorative products to new, existing and targeted project customers by utilizing Jotun’s sales tools and methodologies, building strong customer relationships, identifying business opportunities and executing sales plans to achieve sales targets, gross margin, DSO (Day Sales Outstanding) and market share targets while driving sustainable profitability.  
  
This position is based at Jeddah and will report to the Area Sales Manager – Project.

**Responsibilities:**

* Promote, introduce, and sell Decorative products to construction projects within the assigned geographical territory through regular customer visits, identifying new projects business opportunities, gathering market insights and competitive intelligence, and building strong customer relationships to achieve sales targets and support sustainable business growth.

  

* Conduct systematic ground mapping and regular area audits of ongoing and upcoming construction and infrastructure projects within the assigned territory to identify decorative painting opportunities ahead of the tender/specification stage and assess market potential.

  

* Build, maintain, and continuously update a qualified sales pipeline in CRM, aligned with sales top-line (STP) and budget targets, ensuring accurate opportunity tracking, stage management, and sales forecasting.

  

* Monitor awarded projects throughout execution to maintain Jotun's position, defend the agreed project scope against competitor penetration, and ensure project requirements are met.

  

* Proactively manage assigned accounts through diligent follow-up, reconciliation, and documentation to ensure adherence to credit terms and achievement of DSO targets.

  

* Collaborate with internal departments to ensure timely delivery and excellent customer service, while reading and interpreting project technical documents to provide accurate product recommendations, quotations, and compliance with project specifications, Undertake and regularly update area audits to identify market potential within own designated geographical area together with Supervisor.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR AND WHAT WE OFFER

**We are looking for:**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree. Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Building Materials is preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Project Sales, B2B & Business Development.
*

Sales Executive – Advertising & Influencer Marketing

**GO STUDIOS FOR ADVERTISING AND MARKETING | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**

**We're Hiring: Sales Hunters Who Know How to Close Deals!**

About GO STUDIOS

GO STUDIOS is a creative advertising and influencer marketing agency founded in Kuwait in 2022, specializing in influencer campaigns, content creation, UGC, digital marketing, and creative advertising solutions for brands across the Gulf region.

Since expanding into Saudi Arabia in August 2025, we have been growing our presence in one of the region's most dynamic advertising markets. We are looking for ambitious, commercially driven sales professionals to join our growing team in Riyadh and help us build strong client partnerships across the Kingdom.

The Opportunity

We are looking for **multiple Sales Executives** who are passionate about business development, winning new clients, and closing commercial deals.

This is a sales-driven role for professionals who can identify opportunities, build relationships with decision-makers, pitch marketing solutions, negotiate commercial proposals, and convert prospects into paying clients.

**Your mission is simple: bring in new business, close deals, and grow revenue.**

Key Responsibilities

* **New Business Acquisition:** Proactively identify and acquire new clients across Saudi Arabia, including brands, retailers, restaurants, e-commerce businesses, and corporate accounts.
* **Lead Generation:** Build and manage a strong pipeline through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, networking, referrals, and client meetings.
* **Deal Closing:** Lead sales conversations, present proposals, negotiate pricing, overcome objections, and close deals.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Build long-term relationships with marketing managers, brand managers, business owners, and key decision-makers.
* **Solution Selling:** Understand client objectives and recommend suitable influencer marketing campaigns, UGC production, content creation, and creative advertising solutions.
* **Sales Pipeline Management:** Maintain accurate prospect records, track opportunities, manage follow-ups, and update the CRM.
* **Revenue Growth:** Work toward monthly and quarterly sales targets and consistently contribute to company revenue.
* **Market Intelligence:** Identify new business opportunities, monitor competitors, and stay informed about Saudi Arabia's advertising and digital marketing landscape.
* **Internal Coordination:**

Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

* Organize field visits daily and follow up with B2B Channel in the assigned area to ensure availability of products.
* Report market intelligence (sales analysis, monthly initiative implementations, competitor activities, launches, customer plans, and shopper profiles) to sales management.
* Ensure that the promotional plan is implemented effectively and efficiently in outlets in the assigned area(s)

* From 2 to 5 Years of experience in sales.
* Bachelor Degree in Business or any other related field.
* Driving License and a personal car is a must.
* Demonstrate ability to understand business environment.
* Demonstrate strong communication

**Locations:** Jeddah, Saudi Arabia  
**Employment Type:** One-Year Contract

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a motivated Head of commercial to join our team. The ideal candidate role is to shape how this portfolio goes to market through assortment, pricing, promotions and channel development, and leads the teams that deliver the plan.

This is a senior, visible role with a seat at the management table, combining strategy with close contact with customers and the market across KSA. It suits a commercial leader who wants to build, and to grow a team as much as a business.

**Key responsibilities**

* Set the commercial strategy for Arabian Tires and Lana in line with ATG 2.0, and translate it into an annual plan and budget
* Lead the commercial P&L, from volume and revenue through gross profit to contribution
* Shape the portfolio: assortment, price architecture and promotions
* Build and scale the sales channels, each with its own growth plan
* Lead forecasting and planning, working closely with Procurement and Supply Chain
* Represent ATG in the market and build long term relationships with key partners
* Bring customer and competitor insight into commercial decisions
* Design and build the commercial organization, its processes and its accountability framework
* Lead, develop and grow a high performing team, owning hiring, performance and succession

**Key areas of scope**

**Growth and market share**

* Volume and revenue growth by entity, channel, region, brand and customer segment
* Market share gains nationally and in priority cities
* New customer acquisition and deeper share of wallet with existing customers

**Profitability, pricing and promotions**

* Gross profit and pure product profit by brand, origin, channel and customer tier
* Price architecture and positioning against the market
* Discount, rebate and bonus frameworks within budget and delegated authority
* Promotion planning, execution and return on investment

**Assortment, portfolio and suppliers**

* Assortment across brands, origins, sizes and price tiers, tailored by channel and region
* Portfolio development with Procurement and Category Management, including range reviews and new brand introductions
* Commercial relationships with brand principals and suppliers on terms, volume commitments, rebates and brand plans, together with Procurement
* Healthy stock turn and sell through, in partnership with Supply Chain

نبذة عن الدور

نبحث عن شخص متعدد المهارات وعملي (Hands-on) للمشاركة في تطوير مشروع رقمي جديد، والعمل بشكل مباشر مع الإدارة وفريق التطوير

الدور يجمع بين: تنسيق وإدارة المشروع، الذكاء الصناعي، التصميم، التسويق، الأتمتة، وتطوير وتنظيم العمليات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية

· تنظيم ومتابعة مهام وخطة تطوير المشروع.

· تحويل الأفكار والمتطلبات إلى مهام واضحة ومتابعة فريق البرمجة

· اختبار النظام وتوثيق الملاحظات والأخطاء البرمجية.

· استخدام شات جبي بي تي وأدوات الذكاء الصناعي في البحث، المحتوى، التقارير وتحسين العمل.

· إعداد التصاميم والعروض التقديمية والمواد التسويقية والنماذج الأولية لواجهات المستخدم.

· المساهمة في المحتوى والتسويق وتحليل السوق والمنافسين.

· توثيق الإجراءات وإعداد إجراءات التشغيل القياسية وقوائم التحقق والقوالب

· البحث عن فرص لتحسين وأتمتة العمليات

المؤهلات والمهارات المطلوبة

· لا نشترط عدداً محدداً من سنوات الخبرة. الأهم لدينا

· سرعة التعلم والقدرة على البحث وحل المشكلات

· التنظيم والمتابعة وتحمل المسؤولية

· الاهتمام بالتقنية والذكاء الاصطناعي

· القدرة على استخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي و شات جي بي تي بشكل عملي وفعّال.

· حس جيد في التصميم والعرض البصري

· القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل والتواصل مع فريق التطوير

· إجادة العربية ومستوى جيد في الإنجليزية

· لا يُشترط أن يكون المتقدم مطوّر برمجيات.

التطوير المهني

الدور قابل للتوسع حسب قدرات وأداء الموظف، مع إمكانية التطور تدريجياً إلى مدير المشاريع والنمو

نبحث عن شخص يستطيع يفهم المشكلة ينظمها يبحث عن الحل ينفذ يتابع يوثق ويحسن العملية

الأدوات والمهارات

يفضل معرفة مجموعة من الأدوات والمجالات التالية

· ChatGPT & AI Tools

· Figma / Canva / Adobe

· Google Workspace & Excel

· ClickUp / Notion / Trello

· Digital Marketing & Content Creation

· UI/UX

· Automation / No-Code مثل Make / Zapier / n8n

للتقديم

يرجى إرسال:

· السيرة الذاتية

· ملف أعمال أو نماذج من الأعمال السابقة، إن وجدت.

· أمثلة على استخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي أو شات جي بي تي ، إن وجدت.

· الراتب المتوقع

· التواجد الحالي

· إمكانية العمل في جدة

**Position Summary**  
We are looking for an energetic and persuasive **Inside Sales & Tele-Sales Executive** to drive our outbound B2B appointment-setting initiatives. In this role, you will act as the frontline voice of our company, responsible for cold calling manufacturing plants, fabrication workshops, and industrial facilities across key regional zones (such as Dallah and Al-Khidariyah). **Key Responsibilities**

* **Outbound Cold Calling & Prospecting:**

* Deliver a crisp, professional introduction of our scrap collection, industrial offcut removal, and skip bin waste logistics solutions.
* Effectively communicate our value proposition, addressing common pain points related to factory waste clearance, compliance, and material pickup reliability.

* Secure firm meeting or site-visit appointments for the senior business development team and accurately log all schedules in the CRM/tracking system.

* Professionally handle initial objections, gatekeepers, and pushback, turning hesitant leads into interested prospects by highlighting our competitive pricing and service efficiency.

* Relay valuable market intelligence gathered during calls (such as competitor activity, pricing feedback, or upcoming factory expansions) to management.

job_description:
**About Mozn**

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.  
  
We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.  
  
If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

**About the role**

We are looking for a **Client Onboarding Specialist** to join our team and help deliver a seamless onboarding experience for FOCAL customers. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for clients throughout their onboarding journey, ensuring successful platform implementation, user enablement, and go-live readiness.

**What you'll do**

* Own the end-to-end onboarding journey for FOCAL clients.
* Act as the **primary point** of contact for clients throughout the entire onboarding process, from kickoff to go-live.
* Deliver platform **training sessions** to client teams.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure all workstreams move forward on schedule.
* Track and resolve technical inquiries, feature requests, and configuration issues raised during onboarding, escalating to the right internal owner.
* Maintain accurate **onboarding documentation** and status tracking across all active clients in your portfolio.
* Manage **multiple concurrent client onboardings**, prioritizing effectively across varying timelines and complexity.
* **Hand off** completed onboardings smoothly to the Customer Success team post go-live, with full context transfer.
* Identify recurring onboarding blockers or process gaps and propose improvements.

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years of experience in Client Onboarding, Customer Success, Implementation, Project Coordination, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role.
* Experience managing customer onboarding projects and coordinating multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with customers and internal teams.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills with strong attention to detail.

* Complete assigned sourcing and purchasing activities within agreed timelines.

**Company Overview**

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more. Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. **About the Company**

At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

### **About the Role**

The IT Manager will be the on-site team resource for all multifamily software implementation and maintenance needs. This role will involve various projects, including conducting training sessions, managing vendors during the installation of new systems, as well as troubleshooting down systems. They will also become a subject matter expert for all the company’s multifamily building technology software and integrated hardware. The IT Manager will report directly to the COO.

### **Responsibilities**

* Familiar and comfortable with multifamily software concepts and have the aptitude for quickly mastering new software in the space.
* Knowledge of property specific technology; ensure property staff utilize systems as intended and assist with system upgrades, implementations, integrations and maintenance through validation and testing of proposed resolutions and releases.
* Proactively identify requirements; business and/or residential opportunities that need attention or have gaps in relation to technology.
* Proactively identify pain-points, opportunities, or inefficiencies where technology can bring a value-add solution or increase efficiency.
* Provide technical support and initial troubleshooting to on-site team to ensure consistent access to all the tools.
* Conduct training programs for all in house and vendor products for properties on site teams both in person and via web-conferencing and modify current learning programs.
* Create standard operating procedures for different tools and software that are in use. and serve as a subject matter expert on a variety of building systems.

### **Ideal Background**

* 5-10 years experience in the multifamily residential property

job_description:
We are looking for a Resident Engineer with hands-on experience in Dell Technologies data protection and cyber recovery solutions to support a banking-sector . The ideal candidate should have practical experience with **Dell NetWorker, PowerProtect Data Manager (PPDM), and PowerProtect Cyber Recovery** solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Deploy, configure, administer, and troubleshoot Dell NetWorker backup and recovery solutions.
* Manage and support PowerProtect Data Manager (PPDM) for enterprise data protection and backup operations.
* Implement, maintain, and support PowerProtect Cyber Recovery solutions.
* Monitor backup jobs, investigate failures, and ensure successful backup and recovery operations.
* Perform data recovery, restore testing, and troubleshooting to support business continuity.
* Support data protection infrastructure and resolve technical incidents in line with customer requirements.
* Maintain technical documentation and provide regular service reports.
* Coordinate with the customer's IT, infrastructure, and security teams.
* Follow banking-sector security policies, access controls, and operational procedures.

 **Requirements**  

* Hands-on experience with **Dell NetWorker, PPDM, and Cyber Recovery solutions**.
* Practical experience in enterprise backup, data protection, restoration, and disaster recovery.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident-resolution skills.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers in production environments.
* Ability to work on-site at the customer's premises in Saudi Arabia.
* Experience in the banking or financial services sector is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

* Dell Technologies certifications related to data protection and cyber recovery.
* Experience with enterprise storage, virtualization, and disaster recovery environments.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity controls and secure backup architectures.

job_description:
**About AkzoNobel**

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

Drive continuous improvement of manufacturing processes to improve safety, quality, productivity, equipment effectiveness and cost performance. Identify and eliminate production losses through data analysis, shop-floor observation and improvement projects. Develop and sustain Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), Cleaning, Inspection and Lubrication (CIL), root cause analysis (RCA), standard work and Lean practices in collaboration with Production, Maintenance, Quality and HSE, with guidance appropriate to experience.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

**Process improvement and loss reduction**

* Analyze manufacturing processes, batch cycle times, material flow and equipment utilization to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
* Carry out assigned improvement projects to increase throughput and labor productivity and reduce waiting time, changeover time, waste and manufacturing costs.
* Conduct time studies, capacity assessments and line-balancing exercises to support realistic operating standards.
* Maintain an improvement action plan with clear owners, milestones and measurable benefits; verify that improvements are sustained.
* Conduct improvement projects to drive perfomce in MME ( Material Manufacturing Efficency)

**OEE and performance management**

* Support reliable OEE measurement for relevant equipment using agreed definitions for availability, performance and quality.
* Improve the accuracy of downtime recording, loss classification and production performance data.
* Analyze major losses, including breakdowns, minor stops, reduced operating speed, changeovers and quality losses.
