We are looking for a commercially minded and analytical Social Data & Analytics Specialist to join our Social & Digital team. The role will focus on analysing social media performance, identifying audience and content trends, and translating data into actionable insights that improve our clients' social media strategies, engagement and overall campaign effectiveness.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with a solid understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing and audience behaviour.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor, analyse and report on social media performance across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat and other relevant platforms
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards, reports and KPI tracking frameworks for clients and internal teams
* Analyse audience behaviour, engagement, reach, impressions, follower growth, content performance and conversion metrics
* Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations to improve content strategy and campaign performance
* Conduct competitor benchmarking, social listening and industry trend analysis
* Work closely with Social Media, Creative, Strategy and Account Management teams to support data-driven decision-making
* Measure the effectiveness of organic and paid social campaigns, identifying opportunities for optimisation
* Support campaign planning, client pitches and strategic recommendations with relevant research and data
* Present performance findings and insights to internal stakeholders and clients
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and reporting best practices across accounts

**Requirements**
**What We're Looking For**
Someone who goes beyond producing reports and can explain what the data means, why performance is changing and what we should do next.
  
  
You should be curious, proactive and commercially aware, with the ability to turn social media data into insights that influence creative decisions, strengthen client relationships and deliver measurable results.
  
  

* Minimum 3 years' experience in social media analytics, digital marketing analytics or a similar role, ideally within an agency environment
* Strong knowledge of social media analytics tools such as Sprout Social, Emplifi
* Strong understanding of social media KPIs, audience insights, campaign measurement and performance optimisation
* Ability to interpret large datasets and communicate meaningful insights to non-technical stake

This role is responsible for managing the commercial and contractual aspects of projects from tender stage through to final account, ensuring effective cost control, contract administration, financial reporting, and commercial risk management while maximising project profitability.

job_description:
**Laika is the legal AI for Saudi law, built for work that has to be right.**

The product is live and used by lawyers every day for research, drafting and review, in Arabic and in English, with every output traceable to the source behind it.

This role builds it.

**What you'll do**

* Build and ship the product lawyers use every day, alongside the founders and our Head of AI, on a system that is already live.
* Build the workflows people carry out inside Laika, in Arabic and in English, right to left and left to right, from the first question to the finished document.
* Close the distance between a problem we notice and a fix in production. You ship, you watch how it is used, you change it.

The shape of this role will change as we grow. We are looking for judgement, not a checklist.

**What we're looking for**

* Solid full-stack engineering.
* Care for the details users notice.
* Comfortable working where approximately right is not good enough.
* Able to decide what to build when nobody has written the spec.
* Arabic is an advantage, not a requirement.

**Why this role, now**

This role covers the whole product surface: what a lawyer sees, how they move through it, and what it takes to make that fast and dependable in two languages.

**Practical**

Based in our Riyadh office, with flexibility on remote work. Saudi nationals are strongly encouraged to apply.

job_description:
**BASIC FUNCTION:**

Lead the technical development of
**ERP System**

, a multi-tenant ERP platform encompassing
**Procurement, Accounting, Human Resources (HRM), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Service Operations**

,

and
**third-party API integrations**

. The role is responsible for the full software development lifecycle, from database architecture and backend development to frontend implementation, ensuring high standards of technical quality, performance, scalability, and functional accuracy. It carries end-to-end ownership of feature delivery, including solution design, development, testing, documentation, and release preparation. Production deployments are performed by the Managing Director; the post-holder is responsible for preparing deployment packages, maintaining technical documentation, and conducting a structured handover for each release.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

• Design and build complete features across the stack: database schema, migrations, server API endpoints and Vue user interfaces.

• Design and review changes to a database of approximately 250 tables, 79 views and 89 migrations, ensuring correctness and backward compatibility.

• Safeguard multi-tenant data isolation. Ensure every query is correctly scoped by tenant, company and branch so that no customer can access another customer's data.

• Maintain and extend the role-based permission system, including per-permission levels for read, edit, delete and post, enforced both client-side and server-side.

• Write and optimise SQL, including database views, and diagnose slow queries.

• Prepare release candidates: build, test, document the change and any required database steps, then hand over to the Managing Director for deployment.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation, including setup steps, migration notes and known issues.

• Replace remaining third-party service dependencies (email, SMS, queuing, document storage) following the migration from cloud hosting to on-premise infrastructure.

• Review the Junior Developer's work, explain the reasoning behind corrections, and progressively transfer ownership of modules.

**About Deloitte**
: When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.
  
  
**Our Purpose**

* Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
* Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:

During your tenure as a Consultant - Manager, you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas.
  
  
Conduct vulnerability assessments
  
  

* Networks: plan and run authenticated and unauthenticated assessments across corporate, data-Center, DMZ, wireless, guest-facing and partner-connected networks, including internal and internet-facing perimeter assessments
* Cloud platforms: assess Azure, AWS and GCP environments, covering workloads, configuration and identity settings against CIS benchmarks and NCA CCC, and scan container images and Kubernetes clusters
* Systems: assess Windows and Linux servers, endpoints, databases, virtualisation platforms, and network and security devices, including configuration and hardening checks against approved baselines
* Applications: assess web applications, APIs and mobile app back-ends with authenticated DAST scanning, working with the Application Security team on in-depth testing
* Assess new systems before go-live and after major changes, and run targeted assessments on request
* Produce clear assessment reports with risk-rated findings, evidence and practical remediation steps for each asset owner

Run tooling and coverage
  
  

* Operate and tune scanning platforms (e.g. Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7), including scan policies, credentials, schedules and agents
* Keep scan coverage aligned with the asset inventory and CMDB, and find and close blind spots, including new and unmanaged assets
*

**Job Description**
We are looking for a
**Lead Consultant – FortiGuard Incident Response**
to work in a dynamic and exciting new position reporting to the Director of Operations for FortiGuard Security Consulting Services. The analyst will work directly with members of a world class incident response and forensics team. Our team is comprised of individuals with strong knowledge in malware hunting and analysis, reverse engineering, multiple scripting languages, forensics and threat actors’ TTPs . In this very hands-on customer facing role the consultant’s main objective is to lead and manage the incident response engagements and train/mentor other security consultants. Leveraging your in-depth understanding of the threat actors’ tactics, techniques, procedures and tools as well as our flagship FortiEDR tooling you will need to quickly glean situational awareness to provide guidance to the team members as well as to the client. In addition, from time to time the candidate will help to create threat research work products such as blogs and presentations. To be successful in this role the candidate must be possess strong consulting skills, deep technical skills and able to work under tight timelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead IR engagements and mentoring/training junior analysts
* Serve as the primary contact for clients during investigations, delivering clear technical and executive-level updates.
* Continue to focus on process improvement for the customer facing incident response services
* Conduct host-based analysis and forensic functions on Windows, Linux, and Mac OS X systems
* Review firewall, web, database, and other log sources to identify evidence and artifacts of malicious and compromised activity
* Leverage our FortiEDR Platform to conduct investigations to rapidly detect and analyze security threats

* Contribute to threat intelligence consumption and generation within the FortiGuard threat intelligence ecosystem.
* Perform basic reverse engineering of threat actors’ malicious tools
* Develop complete and informative reports and presentations for both executive and technical audience
* Availability during nights/weekends as needed for IR engagements

**Required Skills:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience interfacing with customers
* Experience with of at least one scripting language: Shell, Ruby, Perl, Python, etc
* Ability to data mine using YARA, Reg

**Job Purpose:**

The role supports the organization's cybersecurity and business continuity objectives by maintaining robust network security controls, managing network-related security incidents, and ensuring the resilience and availability of critical network services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Implement, administer, and monitor network security controls in compliance with ISO 27001 standards.
* Manage firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs, 27001, NCA, wireless security, DNS, DHCP, and remote access solutions.
* Maintain secure network segmentation, access controls, routing policies, and traffic filtering.
* Monitor and respond to network security incidents, perform investigations, and coordinate remediation activities with relevant IT teams.
* Ensure continuous network visibility through log management, SIEM integration, and security monitoring.
* Conduct security reviews, configuration audits, firewall rule assessments, and vulnerability remediation.
* Support secure connectivity for third parties, cloud environments, VPNs, and disaster recovery infrastructure.
* Participate in change management by assessing security impacts of network modifications and deployments.
* Maintain network security documentation, incident records, and audit evidence.
* Collaborate with IT Governance and compliance teams to ensure adherence to security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Network Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network administration and network security operations.
* Strong experience with firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, wireless networks, and secure connectivity.

job_description:
1. التصميم والتخطيط الهندسي

\* إعداد المخططات والرسومات الكهربائية (الكابلات، الإضاءة، القوى، والمآخذ) باستخدام برامج مثل AutoCAD وRevit.

\* تصميم شبكات التوزيع والتغدية الكهربائية، ولوحات التحكم (MDB, SDB).

\* إجراء حسابات الأحمال الكهربائية (Load Calculations)، وحجم القواطع، وهبوط الجهد (Voltage Drop)، وحسابات الشورت سيركت.

\* تحديد مواصفات وأنظمة الحماية والأرضي (Earthing System) ومانعات الصواعق.

2. الإشراف والتنفيذ الميداني

\* الإشراف على أعمال التركيبات الكهربائية في الموقع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمخططات المعتمدة والأكواد الهندسية.

\* مطابقة المواد والتوريدات للمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة في المشروع.

\* التنسيق مع التخصصات الأخرى (مدني، ميكانيك، معماري) لمنع التعارضات في الموقع.

3. التشغيل واختبار الأنظمة (Commissioning & Testing)

\* فحص واختبار المعدات واللوحات قبل التشغيل الفعلي (مثل اختبارات العزل وتحمل الجهد).

\* معايرة الأجهزة وأنظمة التحكم والتأكد من سلامة عمل نظام الحماية والإنذار.

4. الصيانة والدعم الفني

\* وضع خطط الصيانة الوقائية (Preventive Maintenance) والصيانة الدورية للمعدات والمولدات والمحولات.

\* تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية (Troubleshooting) وإصلاحها بشكل سريع لضمان استمرارية العمل.

5. السلامة وإدارة المشاريع

\* تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية (OSHA / معايير الكود المحلي) للحد من مخاطر الصعق والحرائق.

\* إعداد جداول الكميات (BOQ) والتكلفة التقديرية للأعمال الكهربائية.

\* متابعة الجدول الزمني لإنجاز الأعمال وتوثيق التقارير الفنية.

يتولى مهندس الري (Irrigation Engineer) تخطيط وتصميم وإدارة نظم وتطبيقات المياه للمشاريع الزراعية، والحدائق العامة، والمشاريع العمرانية. تهدف مهامه الأساسية إلى كفاءة استخدام المياه وتقليل الهدر وتأمين الاحتياجات المائية للنباتات أو المحاصيل.

تشمل أبرز المهام الوظيفية لمهندس الري ما يلي:

1. التصميم والتخطيط الهندسي

\* حساب الاحتياجات المائية للمحاصيل والنباتات بناءً على نوع التربة والمناخ والمساحة.

\* تصميم شبكات الري (الري بالرش، الري بالتنقيط، الري السطحي) واستخدام برامج الهيدروليك والتصميم مثل AutoCAD و WaterCAD.

\* تحديد المواصفات الفنية للمضخات، الأنابيب، المحابس، أجهزة الفلترة، ووحدات التحكم (Controllers).

2. الإشراف والتنفيذ الميداني

\* الإشراف على أعمال حفر وتمديد أنابيب الري وتركيب المحطات والمضخات في الموقع.

\* مطابقة التنفيذ الميداني مع المخططات الهندسة والمواصفات المعتمدة.

\* اختبار ضغط الشبكات وتقييم كفاءة توزيع المياه قبل التشغيل الفعلي.

3. التشغيل والصيانة

\* وضع جداول الري الإليكترونية أو اليدوية لتتناسب مع الفصول والأحوال الجوية.

\* إعداد برنامج صيانة دورية للمحابس، أجهزة التنقيط، الرشاشات، والمضخات لضمان استمرارية العمل.

\* تشخيص المشكلات الهيدروليكية (مثل انخفاض الضغط أو انسداد المنقطات) وتوفير الحلول السريعة لها.

4. إدارة الموارد وإعداد التقارير

\* تطبيق تقنيات ترشيد استهلاك المياه وتقليل الفاقد النتاجم عن التبخر أو التسرب.

\* إعداد جداول الكميات (BOQ) وحساب التكاليف التقديرية للمشاريع.

\* رفع التقارير الفنية والمالية الدورية لإدارة المشروع حول سير العمل ومعدلات الاستهلاك.

  **IDS/IPS**

  **network segmentation, DMZ architecture, VLANs, and access controls**
  .

* Conduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation activities.
* Monitor security logs and integrate network security devices with
  **SIEM platforms**
  .

  **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**
  .

  .

* Maintain cybersecurity documentation,
  **SOPs, technical procedures, and network security records**
  .
* Support
  **Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity**
  requirements for network security infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot complex network security issues and provide
  **Level 2/3 technical support**
  .
* Coordinate with security vendors and manage technical escalations when required.

**Job Title: Operations Support Engineer**

**Location: Riyadh, Saudi**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an Operations Support Engineer to ensure the smooth, secure, and continuous operation of IT systems in a business-critical live operational environment.The role will provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support across Windows servers, workstations, hardware, applications, and basic network infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting system issues, monitoring logs, performing preventive maintenance, supporting deployments and patching, and coordinating with vendors and internal teams to maintain system availability and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 1 and Level 2 operational and technical support.
* Monitor, identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day system and infrastructure issues.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows Server and Windows Client operating systems.
* Analyze Windows Event Viewer and application logs to identify and resolve technical issues.
* Perform routine system health checks and preventive maintenance.
* Troubleshoot hardware and peripheral devices, including:
* PCs and workstations
* Servers
* Storage devices and power supplies
* Biometric scanners
* Document readers and scanning equipment
* Cameras
* Kiosks
* Printers
* Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, IT, and Security teams for complex incidents and escalations.
* Maintain accurate incident records and update IT service management/ticketing systems.
* Support system patching, software deployments, backups, and system restarts.
* Perform basic MS SQL checks and queries for troubleshooting and validation.
* Follow operational SOPs, security procedures, and data protection standards.
* Participate in shift-based and on-call support rotations to maintain 24x7 operational coverage.
* Ensure system uptime, service reliability, and timely resolution of operational incidents.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in:
* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Electronics
* or a related technical discipline.
* 2–4 years of experience in:
* IT Operations
* Technical Support
* System Administration
* Infrastructure Support
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure in a live, business-critical operational environment.
* Willingness to work in shifts and provide on-call support.
* Required Technical Skills
* Windows & System Administration

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented
**Junior IT Engineer**
to support our IT operations across hospitality, catering, and food & beverage facilities. The ideal candidate will assist with technical support, hardware, software, networks, and daily IT operations while ensuring smooth and reliable technology services.

* Familiarity with Windows, Microsoft Office, and basic networking concepts.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Strong willingness to learn and develop technical skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced hospitality and F&B environment.

****Support and Deployment Engineer****
Azeus Systems Limited is looking for a Support and Deployment Engineer to be part of our growing support team for our product, Azeus Convene. Azeus Convene is a multi-awarded meeting and collaboration solution for Boards and Leadership Teams. Our client base has grown exponentially, and we have extended our global footprint in over 100 countries, which has already been recognized by reputable institutions across the globe.
  
  
Visit azeusconvene.com for more information.
  
  
As a Support and Deployment Engineer, you will deploy and configure systems architectures to ensure security frameworks are properly implemented. You will work closely with systems administrators and project team members to support system configuration, and to set up and maintain cost-effective and efficient hardware and software deployments that satisfy project requirements.
  
  
**Requirements**
You will undergo intensive on-the-job training and mentoring to prepare you for the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Deploy servers with hardening and firewall policies between servers
* Support the deployment of applications developed by Azeus in the cloud (AWS, Azure, KSA cloud, etc.)
* Carry out the deployment of applications developed by Azeus on client premises. You will be prepared to handle server and application software hardening, firewall policy setup, etc
* Identify and analyze system integration problems
* Resolve server issues by identifying the root cause and taking immediate remedial action
* Formulate and implement corrective actions in case a problem re-occurs
* Formulate and implement preventive actions to prevent issues from happening again
* Identify recurring tasks and recommend tools to automate those tasks
* Be on-call for support cases

****What we are looking for:****

* Fast learner with excellent problem-solving skills
* Good organizational skills; able to work well under pressure and time constraints
* Flexible and able to adapt to changing shift schedules, as you may be assigned to work on weekends, holidays, and across different time zones
* Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills

**Job Description**
**Job Title: L2 Application Support Engineer (Integration & Middleware)**
**Core Stack:**
IBM CP4I (ACE, MQ, API Connect), Spring Boot, Red Hat OpenShift.
  
  

* Role Objective

The Integration Support is responsible for the health and reliability of the enterprise middleware layer. the L2 engineers to manage complex data flows between systems, ensuring that
**Spring Boot**
services and
**IBM CP4I**
components (MQ, ACE, APIC) are performant, secure, and highly available.
  
  

* Strategic Technical Leadership
* End-to-End Traceability: tracing transaction flows from the API Gateway (API Connect) through the Enterprise Service Bus (ACE) to the backend Microservices (Spring Boot).
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Spearhead deep-dive investigations into middleware failures, such as message losses in MQ, synchronization errors in ACE, or JVM crashes in Spring Boot.
* Platform Governance: Oversee the stability of integration components running on Red Hat OpenShift, ensuring optimal resource (CPU/Memory) allocation and pod scaling.
* Security Enforcement: Manage and troubleshoot security protocols, including Mutual TLS (mTLS), OAuth2, and JWE/JWS within the integration layer.
* Detailed Technical Responsibilities
* IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I)
* App Connect Enterprise (ACE): Troubleshoot message flows, ESQL logic errors, and adapter connectivity issues (SAP, Database, File).
* IBM MQ: Manage queue managers, resolve channel retries, and investigate dead-letter queues or message persistence issues.
* API Connect: Resolve issues related to API definitions, security policies, and Gateway (DataPower) latency.
* Backend Microservices (Spring Boot)
* Performance Tuning: Analyze JVM thread dumps and heap dumps to resolve memory leaks or high CPU utilization in microservices.
* Connectivity Debugging: Troubleshoot Spring Boot integration with databases (JPA/Hibernate) and external messaging systems (JMS/Kafka).
* Log Aggregation: Utilize ELK/Splunk to correlate logs across multiple microservices to identify points of failure in a distributed architecture.
* Technical Skill Set
* Integration Platforms: Mastery of IBM CP4I (specifically ACE, MQ, and API Connect).
* Development Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Java and Spring Boot (Spring Integration, Spring Cloud).
* Containerization: Expert-level proficiency in Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes.
* Protocols & Standards: Expert understanding of REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, AMQP, and MQTT.
* Monitoring

**Who Are we?**

Al Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company is a public joint-stock company established in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia under a decision from the Council of Ministers and a royal decree as a cooperative insurance company. The company’s paid-up capital is 500 million Saudi Riyals. The company is an extension of United Insurance Company, which was founded in the Kingdom of Bahrain in 1983 as a foreign company to conduct insurance operations in Saudi Arabia. In 2008, the company was listed for public subscription and was registered in the Saudi Stock Exchange (Tadawul) under the symbol 8170.

The company is subject to the supervision and regulation of the Saudi Insurance Authority and is licensed to operate in all types of insurance, including general insurance, medical insurance, motor insurance, and protection & savings insurance.

The company’s experience and commitment to serving its customers have made United one of the pioneers in the insurance industry in the Kingdom. The company also has a wide network of offices and regional outlets to ensure proximity to its customers across the Kingdom. Additionally, the company has a dedicated team that strives to deliver the highest level of service to its clients.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in
  **Actuarial Science only**
  .
* Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Eagerness to learn and develop within the actuarial field.

* Producing dashboards that help the Pricing team track key portfolio metrics
* Assisting the team in preparing Pricing templates and reports for submission to IA

* Implementing Price changes into the system
* Responding to queries from internal stakeholders in relation to Actuarial data
* Learning how to program and automate processes
* Any other duties assigned by the direct manager within the scope of the job.

Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
  
  
**Job Description**
HungerStation is hiring a
**Senior Data Engineer I**
to design, build, and scale our data platform and processing frameworks that power analytics, AI-driven applications, and business intelligence across the organization.
  
  
This role sits at the core of our data ecosystem focusing on
**scalability, reliability, and performance of data systems**
.
  
  
**You Will Be Working On**

* Design, implement, and extend scalable data platforms and architectures
* Build and maintain high-performance data pipelines and data models using BigQuery
* Optimize datasets and workloads for performance and cost efficiency
* Develop analytics-ready data models, semantic layers, and governed metrics
* Build backend services and APIs using Python or Java to support data applications
* Contribute to AI-enabled data use cases (e.g., automated insights, conversational analytics)
* Improve system reliability by addressing technical debt and scaling challenges
* Implement best practices across CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and deployment automation
* Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure supporting the data platform
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality and engineering standards
* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards
* Improve monitoring frameworks and operational resilience of the data platform
* Support initiatives to enhance data quality, reliability, and system stability

**Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of experience in Data Engineering or similar roles
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Master’s or relevant certifications are a plus
* Strong experience building scalable distributed data systems
* Hands-on with GCP (BigQuery preferred)
* Proven experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data modeling
* Experience with modern data stack (Airflow, dbt, Looker)
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of relational data systems
* Experience with Python or Java for backend/data services
* Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred)
* Experience with CI/CD, testing, and monitoring

**Job Title: Fraud Operations Lead**

We are seeking an experienced Fraud Operations Lead with a strong background in fraud prevention and operations, preferably within the Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), digital lending, or installment finance sector. The role focuses on managing fraud detection, monitoring suspicious activities, optimizing fraud controls, and ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations across BNPL customer and merchant journeys.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage daily fraud monitoring, detection, and investigations across BNPL customer and merchant activities, ensuring operational SLAs and investigation quality.
* Conduct complex fraud investigations, root cause analysis, and incident escalations.
* Configure, test, and optimize fraud detection rules, decisioning systems, and machine learning (ML) models.
* Analyze transaction patterns, device intelligence, identity signals, and customer behavior to identify emerging fraud risks.
* Monitor fraud trends and recommend preventive measures to minimize fraud losses and improve detection effectiveness.
* Prepare fraud reports and dashboards covering fraud losses, talse positives, investigation outcomes, and operational KPIs.
* Ensure compliance with the SAMA Counter-Fraud Framework, including regulatory reporting, requests, and quarterly meetings.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to implement fraud control improvements and strengthen fraud prevention processes.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 3-5 years of experience in fraud prevention, fraud operations, or fraud investigations.
* Strong preference for candidates with hands-on fraud experience in BNPL, digital lending, or installment finance.
* Hands-on experience with fraud decisioning platforms, case management systems, and fraud rule configuration.
* Knowledge of ML model monitoring, fraud investigations, and incident escalation.
* Familiarity with the SAMA Counter-Fraud Framework and regulatory requirements.
* Saudi nationality is mandatory.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) certification.
* SQL knowledge for data analysis and reporting.
* Experience with financial institutions, payment companies, or e-commerce plattorms.

* Undertake real estate market, demand and supply assessments across relevant asset classes.

At JTI we celebrate differences, and everyone truly belongs. **46,000 people from all over the world** are continuously building their unique success story with us. **83% of employees feel happy** working at JTI.

  

To make a difference with us, all you need to do is bring your **human best.**

  

What will your story be? Apply now!

**Learn more:** **jti.com**

Local applicants welcome

Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

Role: Permanent

  

**Please note that this position is opent to Saudi Nationals only**

**Commercial Planning Associate**

  

**Why does this role exist?**

  

This position supports the market in building a reliable, well-structured commercial data foundation and turning internal and external data into actionable business insights. The role improves data quality, reporting consistency and evidence-based decision-making across sales, distribution, trade activation and route-to-market activities.

  

**Position:**

  

As the Commercial Planning Specialist, you will:

  

* Map available market data sources and support the creation of a structured, documented and scalable commercial database
* Collect and consolidate data from internal systems, distributors, field teams and approved external sources
* Clean, reconcile and validate datasets, identify gaps, duplicates and inconsistencies, and coordinate corrective actions with data owners
* Maintain data dictionaries, source definitions, naming conventions, refresh calendars and basic quality controls
* Build, automate and maintain user-friendly reports and dashboards for sales, distribution, outlet coverage, route-to-market (RTM) and field execution key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Apply descriptive statistics, segmentation and trend analysis to identify performance patterns, market gaps, risks and opportunities
* Support simulations and business cases related to outlet coverage, resource allocation, promotions, incentives and commercial initiatives
* Support the evaluation of trade and consumer activities, including return on investment (ROI) where data is available, and provide practical insights to Sales, Trade Marketing, Marketing and Finance stakeholders
* Partner with business teams and data owners to improve data availability, processes and analytical capabilities

  

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics or a related quantitative field; a relevant master's degree

Overview:

The Test Engineer (Arabic-speaking) is required to support QA Governance activities for Life & Social Insurance applications by designing, executing test cases while ensuring compliance with business, regulatory, and governance standards.

The role involves oversight, domain expertise, and coordination with stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

* Understand Social Insurance business processes including contributions, eligibility validation, benefits processing, and claims workflow.
* Review business requirements and raise functional or regulatory clarifications.
* Prepare test conditions, test cases, and test data aligned with QA Governance standards.
* Incorporate review comments and maintain version control of test artifacts.
* Execute assigned test cases and accurately log pass results and defects.
* Track defect lifecycle including re-raise and closure validation.
* Support Test Lead in preparing governance metrics, dashboards, and status reports.
* Ensure adherence to QA standards, compliance requirements, and documentation controls.

Qualifications:

Bachelors Degree/MCA/BE

Essential skills:

* Arabic-speaking candidate required for onsite support.
* 3–5 years of functional testing experience, preferably within Life or Social Insurance domain.
* Knowledge of benefits administration and contribution-based insurance systems.
* Familiarity with test case design, execution, and defect lifecycle management.
* Experience with test management tools (e.g., JIRA/ALM or equivalent).
* Strong documentation and communication skills.

Experience:

3–5 years of functional testing experience, preferably within Life or Social Insurance domain.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an experience **Senior Design Manager** to join our team! In this role you will get to Serves as Lead Designer for all phases of a project. Provides technical guidance to project design and drafting personnel, and functions as liaison with client, suppliers, and contractors regarding design issues.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Coordinates execution of work assignments with respect to design approach, schedules, standards, budgets, and procedures to meet client scope of work requirements. Provides manpower estimates as required.
* Provides technical guidance to project design team in completing the most complex and difficult designs and layouts for complete systems and components of a project. Assignments typically involve design elements for which there may be no clearly established precedents and require anticipation of problems at the outset in order to provide appropriate solutions.
* Ensures compliance with required specifications, tolerances, safety factors, and industry codes, as well as client requirements and company standards.
* Performs specialized design computations and analysis within a given discipline.
* Performs interdisciplinary reviews and provides coordination of data to ensure a compatible design.
* Provides direction to a team of checking personnel, ensuring the mathematical accuracy of the drawings produced. Participates in checking orthographic (2D) and isometric (3D) drawings prepared by others.
* Understands and applies commonly used company design standards and methods. Provides input to the establishment or revision of guidelines and standards.
* Collaborates with Engineers and other engineering disciplines to ensure quality of design.
* Reviews supplier data and supplier/manufacturer drawings, as required.
* May train lower-level Designers in various procedures.
  

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Architectural or Engineering (or related field) with a strong background in managing the technical design process across multiple work packages.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Material Engineer** - **Electrical** to join our team!

  
  

The Materials Engineer, Electrical will be responsible for managing and providing technical oversight of all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing construction materials, equipment, components, systems approvals, factory testing, and compliance activities across the project lifecycle. The role will ensure that MEP materials and specialized equipment proposed and installed by contractors comply fully with project technical specifications, design drawings, international MEP standards, local codes, and client requirements.

  
  

The MEP Materials Engineer will coordinate closely with Engineering, Quality, Construction Management, Procurement Engineering, Testing Laboratories, Independent Third-Party Inspection Agencies, Consultants, Contractors, and MEP Equipment Manufacturers, Suppliers, and Fabricators to ensure timely technical review, approval, inspection, factory testing, site handling, preservation, and full traceability of all MEP materials and assets.

Dedicated to overseeing all material-related workflows and compliance processes.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Strategic Procurement Review & Tracking: Approved Materials List (AML), Project Approved Materials List (PAML), and Long-Lead Items (LLI) tracking for major MEP equipment and packages (e.g., chillers, transformers, switchgear, generators, pumps, air handling units, piping systems).
* Materials Governance (MQG) Submittals & Planning: Materials Management Plans (MMPs), Quality Plans, Inspection Assignment Packages (IAP), Pre-Inspection Meetings (PIM), Supplier/Manufacturer Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Third-Party Inspector (TPI) CVs, and Contractor’s MEP Materials Staff CV reviews.
* Vendors, Third-Party Testing & Technical Approvals: Prequalification Submittals (PQDs), Material Technical Submittals (MATs), Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) Witnessing Plans, and FAT Procedures (FATPs) for critical electrical and mechanical apparatus.
* Physical Evaluation

* **المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية:**

* قيادة وإدارة عمليات التطبيقات والأنظمة المؤسسية وضمان استقرارها وتوافرها على مدار الساعة.
* وضع الخطط التشغيلية السنوية ومتابعة تنفيذها بما يتوافق مع أهداف الأعمال.
* إدارة فرق دعم التطبيقات وتوزيع المهام ومتابعة الأداء وتطوير القدرات.
* ضمان الالتزام باتفاقيات مستوى الخدمة (
  *SLA*
  ) ومؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (
  *KPI*
  ).
* الإشراف على إدارة الحوادث (
  *Incident Management*
  ) وضمان سرعة الاستجابة والمعالجة والتصعيد عند الحاجة.
* قيادة إدارة المشكلات (
  *Problem Management*
  ) وتحليل الأسباب الجذرية ومنع تكرار الأعطال.
* الإشراف على إدارة التغييرات (
  *Change Management*
  ) وضمان تنفيذها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة.
* إدارة الإصدارات والتحديثات والتأكد من جاهزية البيئات التشغيلية قبل النشر.
* مراقبة أداء التطبيقات بشكل استباقي وتحليل مؤشرات الأداء والسعة.
* ضمان تكامل التطبيقات مع الأنظمة الداخلية والخارجية ومعالجة أي مشكلات تكامل.
* إدارة العلاقة مع الموردين ومزودي الخدمات ومتابعة التزاماتهم التعاقدية والفنية.
* مراجعة واعتماد التصاميم التشغيلية والإجراءات القياسية الخاصة بالتطبيقات.
* قيادة جهود التحسين المستمر وأتمتة العمليات التشغيلية ورفع الكفاءة التشغيلية.
* إعداد التقارير التشغيلية والتنفيذية الدورية ورفعها للإدارة وأصحاب المصلحة.
* إدارة المخاطر التشغيلية المتعلقة بالتطبيقات ووضع خطط المعالجة.
* ضمان جاهزية خطط استمرارية الأعمال والتعافي من الكوارث واختبارها دورياً..
* دعم المبادرات والمشاريع التقنية الجديدة وضمان جاهزيتها للانتقال إلى التشغيل.
* قيادة اجتماعات الحوكمة التشغيلية ومراجعات الأداء الدورية مع الإدارات المعنية والموردين.
* الإشراف على توثيق الأنظمة والإجراءات التشغيلية وقواعد المعرفة وتحديثها بشكل مستمر.
* متابعة رضا المستخدمين وتحليل الملاحظات ووضع خطط لتحسين تجربة المستخدم.
* قيادة وإدارة عمليات نظام تخطيط موارد المؤسسات

  وضمان استقرارها وتوافرها على مدار الساعة.
* إدارة وتشغيل نظام
  *ERP*
  ومراقبة أدائه بشكل مستمر
  *.*
* ضمان استمرارية عمل النظام وتقليل فترات التوقف ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية
  *.*
* التنسيق مع فرق تقنية المعلومات والموردين الخارجيين لحل الأعطال وتحسين الأداء
  *.*
* إدارة صلاحيات المستخدمين وضمان الالتزام بسياسات أمن المعلومات

Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.

We're seeking an
**Engineering Manager II**
to lead a critical area of our engineering organization. In this role, you will be accountable for the delivery and technical strategy across multiple complex and related domains within our product. Drawing on your deep expertise in software development and proven leadership, you will guide the architectural evolution of your team's systems, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and performant. You are a driven, determined, and curious leader, who knows that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges. You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success.

* Leadership & Strategy: Inspire and guide a group of senior engineers, setting a clear direction that aligns with the company vision. Drive alignment between technology goals and product priorities, advocating for long-term technical quality alongside short-term delivery.

* Manage Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Manage TLS certificates and related security configurations.

Elastic ML

+ Outlier Detection
+ Regression
+ Classification

* Utilize the Data Frame Analytics API.

* Work with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
* Perform Linux/Unix system administration.
* Apply networking fundamentals and storage optimization.
* Develop automation and operational tooling using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.

**About Us**
Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As an Agent Engineer Intern, you’ll configure and improve Voice AI agents that hold real conversations with our clients’ customers. Think of it as a client-facing prompt engineering role: you’ll work across a range of client projects, writing and refining prompts, building conversation flows, and testing how agents handle different scenarios. You’ll collaborate closely with our Operations, Engineering, and Product teams, and help deliver Proofs of Concept (POCs) and live agent projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Write and refine prompts and conversation flows that shape how agents speak, respond, and handle requests.
* Help build POCs for new client use cases, from scoping to demo-ready delivery.
* Support the delivery of client projects alongside the team, helping keep timelines and quality on track.
* Work with clients to understand their needs, share progress, and manage expectations.
* Test agents across different scenarios and edge cases to make sure they perform reliably.
* Review real calls and transcripts against our quality rubric, flagging errors, hallucinations, and missed cues.
* Turn findings into prompt and flow improvements, and contribute to weekly quality reports.

**Requirements**

* Fresh graduate, university student requiring co-op training, or final-semester student able to commit to the internship, in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Fluent in Arabic and English, written and spoken.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence working with clients.
* Basic knowledge of LLMs and prompting.
* Familiarity with APIs and JSON is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* Eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up.
* Work in a collaborative, mission-driven culture with hands-on exposure to innovative AI products.
* Take ownership, grow, and make a real impact through real-world challenges.

job_description:
**Not just a job, but a career**

Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries.

Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.

**About the Team**  
Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do.

**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

* **System Application Tuning & Calibration**
  + Install, condition, and optimize packed and capillary GC column sets based on application design specifications.
  + Tune pneumatics, electronic pressure/flow controllers (EPC), valve switching times (backflush, column transfer, heart-cut), and detector settings (FID, TCD, FPD).
  + Run calibration gas and liquid standards to optimize peak resolution, retention times, reproducibility, and detection limits.
  + Configure GC internal software, peak integration gates, baseline drift compensation, and application-specific calculation scripts (e.g., BTU, Calorific Values, physical properties, etc).
* **Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) & Quality Control**
  + Execute formal internal testing and customer-witnessed Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) to verify performance against guaranteed analytical metrics.
  + Troubleshooting hardware, pneumatic, column phase, or baseline stability issues during assembly and integration phases.
  + Document all final tuning parameters, calibration curves, raw Chromatograms, and test results for inclusion in the final project documentation package.

* **Cross-Functional Lab Collaboration**
  + Interface with Lab Technicians to guide hardware wiring, piping, and mechanical preparation prior to tuning.
  + Consult with the Chemist and Application Manager to resolve complex thermodynamic separation challenges or non-standard sample matrix behaviors

Production Engineer – Aluminum & Façade

**Company:** Euro Systems®  
**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia  
**Department:** Production  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** Aluminum | Façade | Glazing | Construction

About Euro Systems®

Euro Systems® is a leading provider of architectural and engineering solutions, specializing in aluminum and façade systems, glazing, architectural metal works, interior fit-out, acoustic solutions, doors and windows, outdoor shading, and smart automation. We deliver high-quality solutions for commercial, hospitality, healthcare, residential, and other major projects.

**Build Your Career with Euro Systems®**

Position Overview

We are seeking a technically skilled and detail-oriented **Production Engineer – Aluminum & Façade** to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating and monitoring production activities for aluminum and façade systems, ensuring efficient manufacturing processes, optimum material utilization, adherence to approved drawings, and timely completion of production targets.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in aluminum fabrication, façade production processes, production planning, quality control, and coordination with design, procurement, and project teams.

Key Responsibilities

**Production Planning & Coordination**

* Plan, schedule, and monitor daily production activities for aluminum and façade systems.
* Coordinate production priorities based on project schedules, material availability, and site installation requirements.
* Ensure production targets and delivery deadlines are achieved.
* Monitor workflow and identify opportunities to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

**Aluminum & Façade Fabrication**

* Supervise and coordinate fabrication activities for curtain walls, aluminum windows and doors, shopfronts, cladding systems, and other façade components.
* Review approved shop drawings, cutting lists, fabrication details, and material specifications before production.
* Ensure fabrication is carried out according to approved drawings, project requirements, and manufacturing standards.
* Coordinate cutting, machining, assembly, glazing, and finishing processes as applicable.

**Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate with design and engineering teams to clarify drawing details and resolve fabrication-related technical issues.
* Verify dimensions, profiles, hardware, accessories, and material requirements

**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Director, Strategic Partnerships & Partner Sales, Saudi ArabiaDirector, Strategic Partnerships & Partner Sales, Saudi Arabia  
  
Build Mastercard's partner-led growth engine in Saudi Arabia and turn strategic relationships into revenue.

Saudi Arabia is one of the world's fastest-moving digital economies, and partnerships are central to how Mastercard will grow there. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially driven leader to build and scale our partner-led business in the Kingdom and support opportunities across West Arabia.  
In this market-facing role, you will create new routes to market and design partnership propositions that bring Mastercard capabilities to new customers. You will be responsible for taking opportunities from the first executive conversation to signed business. You will work with a broad ecosystem that includes AI and digital platforms, cloud and cybersecurity providers, telecommunications companies, system integrators, fintechs, data businesses, and marketing and media organizations.  
  
What you will do  

* Own growth: Lead the Saudi partner-sales strategy and deliver a revenue target through partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities.
* Create opportunities: Identify where Mastercard capabilities can be embedded, co-sold, or distributed through partner platforms and services. Focus areas include AI, cybersecurity, identity, fraud and financial crime, data insights, loyalty, and digital commerce.
* Shape propositions: Turn strategic discussions into clear use cases, target customers, and commercial models such as embedded, co-sell, reseller, referral, or joint-solution partnerships.
* Engage at senior levels: Build trusted relationships with founders, C-suite executives, and senior decision-makers across enterprise, technology, and government ecosystems.
* Drive execution: Lead joint business plans, account mapping, negotiations, and partner enablement to move

  + Perform leak testing on all internal flow paths prior to sys

**Title:**

AFCAP V Saudi Arabia: PSAB Vector/Pest Controller

job_description:
Lead and manage Qiddiya's Third-Party Security Risk Management program to ensure vendors, partners, consultants, and service providers comply with cybersecurity requirements and do not introduce unacceptable risks to Qiddiya's information assets, systems, and operations. The role is responsible for establishing security assessment frameworks, overseeing vendor security reviews, and driving remediation of identified risks. This aligns with industry practices for cybersecurity risk management and third-party oversight.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain the Third-Party Security Risk Management (TPSRM) framework.
* Conduct cybersecurity due diligence and risk assessments for vendors and suppliers.
* Review security requirements during procurement, RFP, and contract stages.
* Assess cloud providers, SaaS platforms, managed service providers, and strategic partners.
* Define vendor security controls aligned with NCA ECC, ISO 27001, NIST, and Qiddiya cybersecurity standards.
* Establish vendor risk classification and assessment methodologies.
* Monitor remediation plans and track closure of identified security gaps.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Risk, and Technology teams.
* Lead periodic reassessments of critical vendors.
* Report third-party cyber risks, trends, and KPIs to senior management.
* Manage external security audits, questionnaires, and assurance activities.
* Lead and develop the Third-Party Security team

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or related field
* 8-12 years of cybersecurity experience.
* Minimum 4 years in Third-Party Security, Vendor Risk Management, Cybersecurity Risk Management, or GRC.
* Experience within large enterprises, giga projects, banking, telecom, government, or critical infrastructure environments.
* Experience managing teams and stakeholder engagement at senior levels

job_description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer’s unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world’s most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  
We are hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in western Saudi Arabia, based in Jeddah. Saudi Arabia is one of the fastest-growing cloud markets in the Middle East, fuelled by Vision 2030 and ambitious national digital transformation programmes across government, healthcare, aviation, retail, and financial services. This role is central to AWS’s growth strategy in the Kingdom — you will serve as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of high-profile enterprise customers, helping them modernise legacy platforms, adopt AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerate their digital agendas.  
Solutions Architects engage with customers to understand their business drivers, assess application portfolios, and design reliable, cost-effective cloud-native architectures. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will partner with Account Managers, Business Development representatives, Professional Services, Specialist SAs, and AWS Service Teams to create solutions that address complex business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. You will also play a key role in competitive displacement engagements, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS.  
You should enjoy thinking strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. The Solutions Architect is a technical role — you must be broadly competent across many areas of technology (Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, data analytics) and deep in at least 2–3 of those areas. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical for our customers’ successful use of AWS. You will spend most of your day interacting with multiple customer stakeholders, including CxOs, VPs, Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers.  
   
   
Key job responsibilities

**& Technical Civil Engineer** to join our Contracting company in Dammam,

job_description:
**Role Purpose**

Design, build, and operate the cloud and delivery foundations that enable the company’s products and engineering teams to scale reliably. Own the automation and operational practices that move software from development to production, while maintaining availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency. Work closely with engineering, QA, and security stakeholders to make releases repeatable, services observable, and incidents manageable.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Build and maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning and environment configuration using appropriate tools.

• Manage cloud services, servers, networking, and development and production environments.

• Monitor system availability and performance, investigate alerts, and resolve operational issues.

• Maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.

• Manage releases, deployments, and rollback procedures.

• Apply security controls, access permissions, secrets management, and system updates in coordination with relevant teams.

• Work with development and QA teams to improve build, test, and deployment workflows.

• Document infrastructure, operational procedures, and incident response processes.

• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, operating costs, and service risks.

**Qualifications and Experience**

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience administering Linux or Windows environments, depending on the company’s technology stack.

• Experience with CI/CD tools and version control systems such as Git.

• Familiarity with containers such as Docker and orchestration platforms where applicable.

• Hands-on experience with Alibaba Cloud and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Understanding of networking, identity and access management, and cloud security fundamentals.

• Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to respond methodically to incidents.

**Job Title: Infrastructure & Cloud Architect**

**Experience:**
12+ years in IT infrastructure, including experience in infrastructure architecture, data centre transformation, hybrid cloud and automation.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an Infrastructure & Cloud Architect to design, modernise and govern enterprise infrastructure across on-premises data centres and cloud environments. The candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in VMware, Nutanix, operating systems, infrastructure automation and at least one major cloud platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

Assess existing infrastructure and develop architecture blueprints, technology roadmaps and modernisation plans aligned with business requirements.

Design highly available, scalable and secure solutions covering compute, virtualisation, storage, networking, backup and disaster recovery.

Lead data centre consolidation, infrastructure refresh, workload migration and hybrid cloud integration initiatives.

Architect and optimise VMware and Nutanix environments, including cluster design, capacity planning, resilience, upgrades and performance tuning.

Design cloud infrastructure covering landing zones, connectivity, identity, security, governance, monitoring and cost optimisation.

Define operating system standards, hardening baselines, patching strategies and lifecycle management for Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows Server.

Develop infrastructure automation using Ansible and scripting for provisioning, configuration management, patching, health checks and remediation.

Establish backup and disaster recovery strategies with defined RPO/RTO requirements and validated recovery procedures.

Produce high-level and low-level designs, bills of materials, implementation plans, migration approaches and operational handover documentation.

Provide technical leadership to delivery teams and support complex incident resolution, root cause analysis and vendor coordination.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

**Data centre infrastructure:**
Enterprise rack and blade servers, hardware sizing, high availability, capacity management and familiarity with power, cooling, rack layout and physical redundancy requirements.

**Virtualisation and HCI:**

Nahil Computers, a leading IT system integrator in Saudi Arabia, is hiring a Backup & Storage Administrator for an enterprise project in the financial sector.

What you'll do:

- Administer enterprise backup platforms: policies, schedules, retention, daily job monitoring and failure resolution.

- Perform regular test restores and take part in DR drills and DR documentation.

- Manage Dell EMC storage: LUN/volume provisioning, snapshots, replication, firmware and health checks.

- Work with Dell and other vendors on support cases, upgrades and patching.

- Apply security controls (encryption, immutable/air-gapped copies, access reviews) and support audits (SAMA, NCA).

- Maintain runbooks, diagrams and asset inventory; take part in an on-call rotation.

What we're looking for:

- Around 10 years of hands-on backup and storage experience.

- Strong skills in at least one of Veeam, Commvault, NetBackup or Dell NetWorker/Data Domain.

- Dell EMC storage and data protection experience (PowerMax, PowerStore, Unity, Data Domain, NetWorker/PowerProtect) is a strong plus.

- SAN switching experience; banking or financial-sector experience and vendor certifications are a plus.

- Currently based in Saudi Arabia.

To apply, click Apply and complete our application form. Only applications submitted through the form will be considered.

job_description:
We are recruiting a Local Talent and Community Programming Manager to join a dedicated, full-time team embedded in our client’s Festival Programming function in Riyadh. The team will support two major events in Saudi Arabia: a flagship event in summer 2027 (July to August) and a further event in November 2027.

You will lead the festival’s local and regional programming, working alongside the international clubs and creators lead. You will bring in:

* Saudi and regional clubs
* Arabic-speaking creators
* Universities
* Grassroots and community tournaments
* Cultural and national moments

You will build this local content into the main programme rather than running it as a side show, so it feels like part of the festival from day one. You will also make sure all local content meets cultural and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on producing role. The grade reflects your seniority and judgement, not the size of a team you supervise. We are looking for a programmer who personally builds the local and regional programme.

**Key Responsibilities**

Local and Regional Programming

* Lead local and regional programming, including Saudi and regional clubs, creators, grassroots and community competitions, Arabic-language and cultural moments, and local talent.
* Build a prioritised list of local content opportunities from national moments, the host-city calendar and community activity.

Programme Integration

* Integrate local content with the international programme rather than running it alongside.
* Work with the international clubs and creators lead so that local and international content feel like one festival.

Partner Coordination

* Coordinate day to day with Saudi and regional clubs, creators, universities, grassroots organisations and agencies.
* Maintain the local partner log so every relationship and commitment is tracked.

Cultural and Regulatory Compliance

* Make sure all local content meets cultural and regulatory requirements.
* Flag and resolve compliance issues early in the planning process.

Audience Insight

* Capture local audience response to inform the programme across both events.

  
**Requirements**  

* At least 8 years of experience in gaming, esports, entertainment or major live events in Saudi Arabia or the region, at Senior Manager level.
* Experience across at least two live event seasons.
* A proven record of personally producing local and regional programming. Only experience where you personally produced the work counts

* Current GCC driving license

job_description:
Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across paid and organic channels to drive qualified traffic, online sales, customer acquisition, and retention. The role manages digital marketing budgets, monitors campaign performance, and continuously optimizes spend based on return and business objectives.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute paid digital campaigns across Google, Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, and other relevant channels.
* Manage and monitor the approved digital marketing budget.
* Track campaign performance including spend, traffic, orders, CPA/CPO, ROAS, and revenue.
* Optimize campaigns regularly based on performance and business objectives.
* Manage SEO activities to improve organic traffic and product visibility.
* Coordinate with the E-Commerce and Creative teams on campaign assets and landing pages.
* Monitor customer acquisition and campaign conversion performance.
* Conduct campaign and audience analysis to identify growth opportunities.
* Prepare weekly and monthly digital marketing performance reports.
* Ensure proper campaign tracking, tagging, and attribution.
* Ensure marketing spend is aligned with sales and profitability objectives.
* KPIs: Sales achievement, ROAS, Cost per order/acquisition, Marketing spend vs. budget, Traffic, Conversion rate, new customers, Organic traffic growth, Campaign ROI

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, or a related field
* Google Ads, Meta, SEO, or other digital marketing certifications. (Preferred)
* 2–3 years in digital marketing, performance marketing, or e-commerce.
* Google Ads, Meta Ads, Snapchat, TikTok, SEO, Google Analytics/GA4, campaign management, budget management, performance analysis, Excel, reporting, optimization, communication, and analytical skills.
* Strong understanding of digital advertising platforms, campaign tracking, attribution, SEO, audience targeting, performance marketing KPIs, and digital analytics.

نبحث عن أخصائي تسويق بالذكاء الاصطناعي يمتلك خبرة في التسويق الرقمي وتوظيف تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي (AI) في تطوير الحملات التسويقية، وتحليل البيانات، وإنشاء المحتوى الإبداعي، وتحسين الأداء التسويقي، بما يسهم في تعزيز الوعي بالعلامة التجارية، وزيادة العملاء المحتملين، وتحقيق المستهدفات التسويقية بكفاءة وابتكار.

المهام والمسؤوليات

* توظيف أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي في تخطيط وتنفيذ الحملات التسويقية الرقمية وتحسين نتائجها.
* إعداد وتطوير المحتوى التسويقي الإبداعي باستخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي، بما يشمل النصوص والصور والفيديوهات.
* إدارة وتحسين الحملات الإعلانية عبر منصات Google Ads وMeta Ads وLinkedIn.
* تحليل بيانات الحملات التسويقية وقياس مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs)، وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين النتائج.
* استخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي في تحليل سلوك العملاء وتحديد الشرائح المستهدفة وتحسين تجربة العملاء.
* تطوير استراتيجيات التسويق بالمحتوى وتحسين محركات البحث (SEO).
* أتمتة العمليات التسويقية المتكررة باستخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي والتسويق الآلي.
* متابعة أحدث التقنيات والاتجاهات في الذكاء الاصطناعي والتسويق الرقمي وتطبيق الحلول المناسبة.
* التنسيق مع فرق المبيعات والتصميم وتطوير الأعمال لتحقيق الأهداف المشتركة.
* إعداد التقارير الدورية حول أداء الحملات، ومعدلات التحويل، وتكلفة اكتساب العملاء.

المؤهلات العلمية

* درجة البكالوريوس في التسويق أو التسويق الرقمي أو تقنية المعلومات أو تخصص ذي صلة.
* يفضل الحصول على دورات أو شهادات احترافية في التسويق الرقمي أو الذكاء الاصطناعي.

الخبرات المطلوبة

* خبرة من 3 إلى 5 سنوات في التسويق الرقمي أو التسويق المدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
* خبرة عملية في استخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي لإنتاج المحتوى وتحليل البيانات وتحسين الحملات.
* خبرة في إدارة الحملات الإعلانية وقياس الأداء وتحسين معدلات التحويل.
* يفضل وجود خبرة في القطاع العقاري والتسويق للمشاريع والمنتجات العقارية.

المهارات التقنية

* إتقان أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي مثل ChatGPT وClaude وGemini.
* معرفة بأدوات إنشاء التصاميم والمحتوى المرئي مثل Canva AI وAdobe Firefly وأدوات إنتاج الفيديو بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
* إجادة استخدام Google Analytics 4 وGoogle Ads وMeta Ads Manager.
* معرفة بأدوات تحسين محركات البحث وتحليل الكلمات المفتاحية.
* القدرة على استخدام أدوات الأتمتة التسويقية مثل Zapier أو Make.
* إجادة إعداد التقارير ولوحات قياس الأداء باستخدام Excel أو Power BI، ويفضل الإلمام بأنظمة CRM.

المهارات الشخصية

* التفكير التحليلي والإبداعي وحل المشكلات.
* القدرة على الابتكار وتطوير أفكار تسويقية جديدة.
* مهارات التواصل والعمل الجماعي وإدارة الوقت.
* القدرة على مواكبة التقنيات الحديثة والتعلم المستمر.
* الاهتمام بالدقة وجودة المحتوى والالتزام بهوية العلامة التجارية.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
This role leads the design, modeling, and evolution of enterprise data architecture to ensure data products, curated layers, and integration patterns are standardized, scalable, high-quality, and governed. It defines how operational and corporate data should be modeled, aligned, and transformed to support analytics, reporting, AI enablement, and trusted downstream consumption across business domains.
  
  
What You Will Deliver
  
  
Lead Enterprise Data Modeling
  
  
Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise business domains and data architecture principles.
  
  
Define canonical models, conformed dimensions, master/reference data structures, and reusable modeling patterns for cross-domain consistency.
  
  
Design data product models and curated layer schemas that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI use cases, and downstream integrations.
  
  
Ensure models address performance, maintainability, scalability, auditability, lineage, and future reuse across platforms and domains.
  
  
Define Architecture Standards and Governance
  
  
Establish enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, modeling guidelines, reusable templates, and quality expectations for delivery teams.
  
  
Partner with data governance teams to align business glossary definitions, stewardship ownership, metadata, lineage, and critical data elements.
  
  
Embed governance-by-design into data models, curated layers, transformation logic, data quality controls, and consumption patterns.
  
  
Review and approve modeling deliverables from internal teams and external vendors to ensure architectural consistency and quality.

Lead the creation and optimization of data product schemas, curated layers, semantic structures, and consumption-ready models.
  
  
Define modeling approaches for relational, non-relational, time-series, streaming, lakehouse, warehouse, and analytical platform requirements.
  
  
Ensure data models support time-variant structures, historical traceability, auditability, semantic consistency, and trusted analytics consumption.

Why Join Us?
  
  
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
  
  
Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
  
  
This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.

What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.

job_description:
**Overview**  

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.

  

As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.

  

We invite you to join us. Why?

  

When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.

  
   
**Responsibilities**  

We envisage success in this role to include;

  

* Evaluate and approve **material submittals** for ELV and ICT systems, including Fire & Life Safety systems, BMS, Data Centers, OSP networks, Fiber Optic cabling (passive & active components), and intelligent unified platform installations.
* Review and provide detailed feedback on **shop drawings** related to ELV and ICT systems.
* Oversee and ensure the correct **installation, implementation, testing, and commissioning** of ELV/ICT systems across the project.
* Provide **technical guidance and supervision** to installation and site teams to ensure adherence to project specifications and international standards.
* Demonstrate deep technical expertise across ICT systems, including Fire & Security, BMS, Data Centers, OSP, Fiber Optics, and integrated smart building platforms.
* Coordinate closely with project teams to ensure **timely delivery** and alignment with project objective

job_description:
This position is for building, deploying and evaluating Client's Arabic AI tutor for mathematics and computer science: preparing Arabic training data, fine-tuning, aligning and evaluating LLMs on Shaheen III and Ibex, and integrating the tutor into the learning platform for a pilot in at least 10 Saudi schools.

The position is part of the RDIA-funded project 5870, "An AI-Powered Arabic Tutoring Platform for STEM Education in the Kingdom." Two engineers will be hired into this role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare Arabic training datasets from educational materials and consented platform interactions.
* Fine-tune, align, and evaluate commercial and open-source LLMs using Shaheen III and Ibex computing platforms.
* Develop Arabic STEM benchmarks, preference-training methods, and student-safety guardrails.
* Integrate AI tutoring capabilities into the learning platform, including Arabic right-to-left interfaces.
* Deploy and optimize models for reliable, low-latency real-time interactions.
* Support school pilot implementation, evaluation, and teacher feedback collection.
* Ensure student data privacy and compliance with Saudi data protection requirements.
* Contribute to research publications, technical reports, and project deliverables.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* MSc in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field; alternatively, a BSc with at least one year of relevant experience.
* Hands-on experience in LLM fine-tuning, evaluation, and AI application deployment.
* Professional proficiency in Arabic and English.
* Experience with RLHF/DPO, educational technology, or mathematics/programming education is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Python and PyTorch.
* Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, and TRL.
* Distributed GPU training using DeepSpeed or FSDP.
* LLM evaluation, reward modeling, and preference optimization.
* Arabic NLP, data pipelines, and OCR.
* Model serving and inference optimization using tools such as vLLM.
* APIs, Docker, Git, CI/CD, and production deployment.
