About Lucid

  

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

  

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

  
  
Position Overview

Functional leader accountable for automation, controls, robotics, vision, SCADA/historian, OT cybersecurity and MES-OT integration across AMP-2 Drive Unit and HV Battery shops. From commissioning through stable high-volume operation to deliver safe, capable and sustainable Powertrain operations while accelerating local technical capability and launch readiness.

• Define PLC/HMI/SCADA/Ignition, safety-control, network, naming, code-library, backup and version-control standards.

  

• Govern Siemens TIA Portal, Rockwell Studio 5000 and Beckhoff TwinCAT populations; establish lifecycle and obsolescence roadmaps.

  

• Own OT cybersecurity governance including segmentation, secure remote access, privilege, backup/recovery and patch coordination.

  
Robotics, vision & digital manufacturing

• Own Robotics like FANUC or ABB standards, safety validation, uptime, recovery, program governance and critical spares.

  

• Govern Cognex/Keyence/other machine-vision applications, inspection integrity, recipe control and traceability.

  

• Sponsor historian, IIoT, digital SPC, condition monitoring and analytics use cases with Data, IT/OT and MES teams.

  
Launch & operational excellence

• Own automation FAT/SAT, controls lists, production-release criteria, run-at-rate support and safe launch escalation.

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a FinOps Lead Technology & Product based in Saudi Arabia.**
As a FinOps Lead, you will connect cloud infrastructure costs, product economics, and business growth to support smarter financial and operational decisions. Acting as a strategic Finance Business Partner to Technology and Product leadership, you will make cloud spending transparent, measurable, and manageable. You will work closely with Finance, Engineering, Product, Data, and HR to optimize infrastructure costs and improve resource allocation. By translating technical usage and architectural decisions into financial insights, you will help teams understand profitability, gross margins, and unit economics. You will also evaluate the financial impact of new products and features, supporting sustainable scaling and informed investment decisions. This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise, financial modeling, and strategic collaboration in a fast-growing technology environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Cloud infrastructure cost management: Develop and maintain cloud cost allocation strategies, tagging frameworks, and dashboards that provide clear visibility into spending across teams, products, and features.
* Cost optimization and governance: Identify optimization opportunities through resource rightsizing, cloud commitment management, waste reduction, and anomaly detection. Establish alerts, regular cost reviews, and continuous improvement processes with Technology and Product teams.
* Financial performance and unit economics: Connect infrastructure spending to revenue and cost of revenue in collaboration with Data and Finance teams, providing reliable insights into gross margin, profitability, and unit economics.
* Infrastructure forecasting: Own rolling cloud infrastructure cost forecasts, incorporating customer growth, product usage, adoption trends, and architectural changes to anticipate future spending.
* Product economics and cost modeling: Partner with Product and Engineering teams early in the development cycle to assess the financial impact of new products, features, and architectures.
* Scalability analysis: Model how infrastructure costs evolve as usage increases, evaluating different growth scenarios and identifying the economic drivers that influence product scalability.
* Business case development: Build pre-launch cost models,

**High-level Job Purpose Statement**
The IT Support Specialist provides Level 1 and Level 2 support for employees using company devices, Microsoft 365 services, approved software, printers, connectivity, and workplace technology. The position owns each assigned ticket from acknowledgement through resolution or correct escalation, maintains accurate records in Freshservice, supports onboarding and offboarding, and helps keep Head Office and branch users productive
  
  
The role does not independently own every network, server, cloud, security, or business application platform. It performs first-line diagnosis, collects evidence, applies approved fixes, communicates with the requester, and routes specialist work to the correct resolver group while retaining follow-up responsibility.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Service Desk and User Support**

* Provide timely Level 1 and Level 2 technical support through Freshservice, telephone, remote-access tools, email, and desk-side assistance
* Acknowledge, classify, prioritize, investigate, update, and resolve assigned incidents and service requests within the applicable service targets
* Maintain ownership of the requester experience even when a ticket is assigned to a specialist team or external vendor
* Troubleshoot Windows devices and provide working-level support for macOS, browsers, Microsoft Office applications, printers, scanners, monitors, docking stations, and standard peripherals
* Confirm the solution with the requester and record meaningful resolution notes before closure

**Microsoft 365 Accounts and Access**

* Support Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Office activation, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and common Microsoft 365 user issues

**Endpoint and Employee Lifecycle Support**

* Complete onboarding activities, including hardware allocation, Microsoft 365 setup, approved software such as Adobe and Chrome, policy synchronization, quality checks, and handover or shipment to the employee's branch
* Process approved transfer, role-change, and offboarding tasks, including access changes, asset return, mailbox or data ownership handover, and completion evidence
* Maintain accurate asset assignment, stock, warranty, configuration, and return records in the approved inventory or ITSM system
* Apply approved endpoint standards, updates, security controls, and software

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, manage project activities, and ensure the delivery of scalable AI solutions.

**KEY REQUIREMENTS:**

**A. Experience (this is what makes the role senior)**

1. At least 8 to 10 years in middle office, product control or treasury operations at a bank or financial institution, with genuine hands-on depth and not only supervisory exposure.
2. Solid command of LCH and OTC derivatives, in particular interest rate swaps and cross-currency swaps. The person should understand mark-to-market, discounting and margin mechanics well enough to validate a valuation independently, not only record what the counterparty sends.
3. Strong knowledge of treasury products across money markets, FX, fixed income and derivatives, including SAIBOR and SOFR based instruments and SAR/USD cross-currency considerations.
4. Working understanding of ISDA and CSA documentation and the margin logic behind it.
5. A track record of identifying and resolving valuation and margin disputes with counterparties.

**B. Core responsibilities**

1. Independent validation of OTC derivative valuations and review of counterparty and valuation agent marks, with the standing to challenge and resolve differences.
2. Independent price verification and valuation of the sukuk and investment portfolio, including profit distributions, redemptions, calls and other corporate actions.
3. Margin call and collateral management under CSA, including verifying calls, agreeing exposures and handling disputes.
4. Validation and attribution of treasury and investment P&L, reconciled against front office and finance.
5. Trade capture and lifecycle controls, confirming that trades are booked correctly and that resets, fixings, distributions and maturities are handled.
6. Oversight of position, cash and valuation reconciliations, with proper investigation and clearance of breaks.
7. Ownership of the middle office control framework, covering limits monitoring, exception reporting, escalation and audit support.

**C. Systems and tools**

1. Core banking experience, Temenos T24 preferred.
2. Bloomberg, with exposure to custodian or valuation agent platforms such as State Street.

1. Works independently, with sound judgement on what to escalate and when.

Chief Surveyor

**Department :**
Engineering- Surveying

**Location :**
Qiddiya / HO

**Reports To :**
Technical Engineering Manager

**Joining Availability :**
Immediately ( Preferred )

**Job Purpose**
:

To lead, supervise, and coordinate all surveying activities for site infrastructure and civil engineering works, ensuring accurate setting-out, establishment and control of benchmarks, levels, and coordinate systems. The Chief Surveyor is responsible for managing survey teams, verifying survey data, maintaining quality and accuracy standards, and ensuring the integration of survey information with Civil 3D and BIM models to support design compliance, construction accuracy, and timely project delivery.

job_description:
نبحث عن قائد تنفيذي يمتلك خبرة واسعة في إدارة وتشغيل المشاريع، والقدرة على قيادة الأداء التشغيلي والتجاري والمالي، وإدارة العلاقة مع العملاء، وتحقيق مستهدفات النمو والجودة والربحية.

نستهدف كفاءات قيادية تجمع بين الحضور التنفيذي، والتفكير التجاري، والفهم المالي، والقدرة على قيادة فرق متعددة التخصصات ومتابعة التنفيذ ميدانيًا.

**المسؤوليات الرئيسية :**

* قيادة العمليات التشغيلية والإشراف على مشاريع التطوير والتحسين المستمر.
* تمثيل الجهة أمام العميل وإدارة الاجتماعات والتوقعات والالتزامات التعاقدية.
* تطوير تجربة الزائر ورفع جودة الخدمات ومستويات الرضا.
* تنمية الإيرادات والمبيعات وتطوير الشراكات والقنوات التجارية.
* إدارة الميزانيات ومتابعة الإيرادات والمصروفات والربحية (P&L) والفوترة والتحصيل.
* قيادة فرق العمل ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية.
* إدارة المخاطر والتحديات التشغيلية والتغييرات في نطاق العمل.
* إعداد التقارير التنفيذية واتخاذ القرارات اللازمة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف.

**المتطلبات والمؤهلات :**

* خبرة إجمالية من 12 إلى 15 سنة، منها 5 سنوات على الأقل في مناصب قيادية.
* خبرة مباشرة في إدارة الأداء المالي والميزانيات والأرباح والخسائر (P&L).
* سجل إنجازات مثبت في إدارة العمليات وتنمية الإيرادات وتحسين الأداء التجاري.
* يفضل وجود خبرة في الوجهات السياحية والترفيهية أو الضيافة أو المعالم أو المنشآت الخدمية ذات الإقبال الجماهيري.
* درجة البكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال أو الضيافة أو السياحة أو الهندسة الصناعية أو تخصص ذي صلة، ويفضل ماجستير إدارة الأعمال (MBA).
* إجادة اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية.
* الاستعداد للعمل والتواجد الميداني في مكة المكرمة.

job_description:
**Job Title**
Site Project Engineer
  
  
**Job Scope**
The Site Project Engineer is responsible for managing, engineering construction projects and ensuring the proper implementation of project deliverables. S/He supervises and provides technical advice to the staff on site to complete the project on time and within budget.
  
  
**Main Duties And Responsibilities**

* Formulate project parameters and ensure technical feasibility and desired quality in coordination with the direct manager
* Coordinate and allocate internal resources to deliver customer outcomes
* Prepare, schedule, coordinate and monitor assigned projects on site
* Cooperate regularly with the direct manager and report updates on budgets, schedules, plans and performance of site projects
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to create more efficient project methods and maintain project’s profitability
* Create a framework to measure the project’s metrics and data collection while recommending improvements
* Establish field test methods, conduct regular quality checks and ensure the project’s compliance with applicable practices, policies, performance standards and specifications
* Conduct regular safety inspections and ensure abidance by occupational health and safety measures
* Prepare site reports and maintain comprehensive project documentation
* Manage changes to the project scope, schedule and cost in coordination with the direct manager

**Position Requirements**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or any other related field
  
  
**Experience**
At least 3 years of relevant experience

job_description:
**Role Purpose**

Prepare high-quality, consistently labeled data that supports the development, evaluation, and improvement of machine learning and AI systems. Apply project guidelines to text, images, audio, video, or other data types, flag unclear or sensitive cases, and work with reviewers and project leads to resolve annotation issues and maintain reliable datasets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**﻿**

• Review project instructions and annotation guidelines before starting each task, and ask for clarification when instructions are unclear or conflicting.

• Label, classify, transcribe, categorize, or otherwise annotate assigned data using the project’s approved tools and standards.

• Apply labels consistently across text, images, audio, video, or other data formats, according to the needs of each project.

• Check completed annotations for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and correct use of the defined labels.

• Flag ambiguous, incomplete, low-quality, or potentially sensitive data for review rather than making unsupported assumptions.

• Incorporate reviewer feedback and update annotations when required.

• Meet project timelines while following documented quality and data-handling procedures.

• Maintain the confidentiality and security of project data, and use it only for authorized work.

• Document recurring questions or guideline gaps and share them with the project lead to support process improvements.

**Qualifications and Experience**

• High school diploma or equivalent; further education is an advantage.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow written instructions consistently.

• Good reading and comprehension skills in the languages required by the project.

• Basic computer skills and confidence using web-based tools, spreadsheets, and annotation platforms.

• Ability to manage repetitive tasks while maintaining focus and accuracy.

• Clear written communication and willingness to receive and apply feedback.

• Previous experience in data annotation, content review, transcription, or quality checking is an advantage.

• Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and follow data protection procedures.

job_description:
DAZZ is seeking a detail-oriented Accountant to support our growing finance and operations teams. This role will manage day-to-day accounting activities, maintain accurate financial records, and help ensure timely reconciliations and compliance with Saudi tax requirements.

The role will work across accounts payable, accounts receivable, VAT, and cash-on-delivery (COD) transactions. Logistics experience is preferred, especially in environments with frequent transactions and delivery-related settlements.

**Key responsibilities**

* Record and maintain accurate financial transactions and supporting documentation in Qoyod.
* Manage accounts payable, including reviewing supplier invoices, tracking due dates, and reconciling vendor balances.
* Manage accounts receivable, monitor outstanding balances, and follow up on collections.
* Reconcile COD collections and settlements against delivery and payment records, and investigate discrepancies.
* Perform regular bank, cash, supplier, customer, and other account reconciliations.
* Support VAT calculations, prepare records for VAT filings, and help maintain compliance with ZATCA requirements.
* Assist with month-end close and prepare routine financial reports.
* Maintain organized records and support audit and financial review requests.
* Identify discrepancies or process issues and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Use Excel to analyze financial data, prepare reconciliations, and produce clear reports.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years of relevant accounting experience.
* Practical knowledge of bookkeeping, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.
* Familiarity with Saudi VAT and ZATCA requirements.
* Hands-on experience with Qoyod.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including working with large data sets, formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
* Proficiency in both Arabic and English.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
* Ability to manage recurring deadlines and resolve discrepancies independently.
* Logistics industry experience preferred.

job_description:
**Shift Charge Engineer Location: Qudra / Qassim, Saudi Arabia**
**Department / Plant**
Operation
  
  
**Reporting To**
Operation Manager
  
  
**Job Summary**
Responsible for overall plant operation activities in shift. Ensure that all the activities in the plant are performed in a safe and efficient manner in accordance with the approved Standard Operating Procedures, quality standards, time schedules, and other operating requirements.
  
  
Responsible for safe startup/shut down of the plant as per the Standard Operating Procedures.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Comply with safety rules and regulations. Be fully aware of the safety hazards in the plant.
* Familiar with plant O&M agreements, P&IDs, SOPs, Work Instructions, Operation and control logics, emergency operation procedures, as well as regulatory requirements and any other related documents.
* Ensure that the plant is operated to the established standards with minimum risk to men, machine and materials, comply with safety and environmental standards.
* Coordinate with all other departments all activities that are related to plant operations during the shift and comply with safety rules and regulations. Have a complete understanding of the permit to work system applied to the plant. Issue and cancel permits to work per authorization. Coordinate activities involving plant chemistry with the Chemist.
* Follow preset operational schedules to fulfill the targeted production availability safely and efficiently. Coordinate all activities or changes in plant status with Operations Manager.
* Make quick, on the spot decisions to correct abnormalities or disturbances. Take corrective actions during a state of emergency. Supervise the start-up checklist, interlock checks, protection tests, non-routine activities like preservation, acid cleaning etc.
* Upon authorization, issue work permits for maintenance section involved. Have a complete understanding of the permit to work system procedure applied to the plant. Issue and cancel permits to work per authorization. Normalize the equipment after release and perform necessary testing to check the equipment or system after maintenance.
* Monitor the overall status of the plant and summarize activities in the log book. Fill daily plant status reports and relay all activities that occurred during the shift.
* Maintain staff evaluation records, vacation schedules etc. Prepare evaluation forms for personnel requirement.
* Prepare incident/accident reports

\* Excellent written and spoken English and Arabic

Responsible for managing the end-to-end Accounts Receivable (AR) function for the global (international) customer base, ensuring accurate and timely invoice delivery, effective collections, strong cash flow, and low bad debt risk while maintaining excellent customer relationships across multiple countries and time zones.

* Maintain audit readiness through proper documentation, support internal and external audits, and implement corrective actions

job_description:
Company Description  

John Crane, a business of Smiths Group, is a global leader in mission-critical flow control solutions for energy and process industries that enable efficient and sustainable operations. Our products include mechanical seals and systems, couplings, filtration systems, and predictive digital monitoring technologies.

  

We have a global network of more than 200 sites in over 50 countries and employ more than 6,000 people worldwide. We partner with our customers to help them keep their operations safe, reduce downtime, improve efficiency, and meet the latest environmental standards.

  

John Crane is part of Smiths Group. For over 170 years, Smiths has been pioneering progress by engineering for a better future. We serve millions of people every year, helping to create a safer, more efficient, productive, and better-connected world across four global markets: energy, security & defence, space & aerospace, and general industrial. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, Smiths employs approximately 16,000 colleagues in over 50 countries.

  
  
Job Description  

**Job Purpose:**

  

* Lead and coordinate dedicated project teams in the delivery of projects, including sales, engineering, procurement, quality, Projects/EPC KAMs, Customers/OEMs, and others.
* Perform project risk evaluation throughout the entire project lifetime; identify issues jeopardizing a successful project completion at an early stage and initiate corrective actions.
* Coordinate the resolution of any technical or commercial conflicts which may arise at any stage.
* Act as John Crane's single point of contact to support the customer for post-order activity through to project delivery. Coordinate any post-delivery issue resolution.
* Maintain communication channels with the client.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Fulfilment of customer contracts (deadlines, costs, objectives) and monitor project budgets closely.
* Creating and maintaining detailed execution schedules for each of the major projects that are your portfolio.
* Agreeing communication channels with the customer in relation to the different Project aspects.
* Managing timely and effective communication with the regional Stakeholders to ensure effective coordination.
* Regularly communicate with the involved parties and keep constant and updated communication with their various senior-level project management.
* Attending clarification/kick-off meetings and preparing and distributing relevant activity reports.
*

* Like working across several use cases at once in a collaborative team

Function: Pricing & Monetization · 1 opening · Riyadh

**About SHIFTER**

SHIFTER is a Saudi B2B delivery orchestration platform. We connect merchants with licensed delivery operators through one platform: a direct technical integration, a prepaid account, transparent pricing, and a service level that is agreed upfront and reported every month. We own no fleet and employ no drivers. We start in Riyadh.

**The role**

You will own how SHIFTER makes money: the products and packages we sell to merchants and delivery operators, the rate card behind them, and the margin on every order. You report to the CEO and work daily with sales, operations and finance.

**What you will do**

* Own the merchant and operator rate cards, including distance bands, extra-kilometre fees and operator payouts, and model the margin impact of every change before it is proposed.
* Design and maintain SHIFTER's packages per merchant segment (restaurants, health and beauty, retail and e-commerce, B2B) with clear inclusions and limits.
* Approve or reject every non-standard discount or commercial offer from sales against a written pricing policy; no off-policy deal is signed without your review.
* Build and run the unit-economics model: revenue, operator cost, payment fees and contribution margin per order, per zone and per account.
* Track price realisation, margin, win/loss and churn by package every month and recommend changes with numbers.
* Benchmark competitor delivery pricing in Riyadh every quarter and brief management on threats and opportunities.
* Work with product and technology to make pricing rules configurable in the platform and auditable.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years in pricing, revenue management, commercial finance or monetisation, with at least 3 years in delivery, logistics, ride-hailing, marketplaces or B2B SaaS.
* You have owned a live rate card or pricing model and can show the margin result of a change you led.
* Expert Excel and financial modelling (scenario and sensitivity models built from scratch); SQL or BI tools are a strong plus.
* Strong commercial judgement: you can say no to sales with data and keep the relationship.
* Fluent English and Arabic, with clear written recommendations for senior management.
* Based in Riyadh.

**What we offer**

* Competitive base salary plus performance-linked incentives.
* A founding role with direct impact on the company's growth and a clear path to leadership.
* Medical insurance and benefits in line with Saudi Labou

**Company Description**
APTWatch is an AI-driven enterprise software company focused on delivering intelligent digital solutions that accelerate business transformation and innovation. The organization builds enterprise software and AI-powered applications that modernize operations across industries. Its products enable organizations to adopt intelligent, data-driven tools for faster, more informed decision-making. By combining advanced AI capabilities with practical business workflows, APTWatch helps companies streamline processes and embrace continuous improvement.

**Role Description**
The Agentic AI Engineer will design, build, and refine AI agents and autonomous workflows that integrate with enterprise software products. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing and testing agentic architectures, creating robust prompts and interaction patterns, and connecting AI systems to data sources and APIs for real-world use cases. The role also involves collaborating with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions, monitoring performance, and iterating based on user feedback and metrics. This is a part-time, remote role that offers flexibility while requiring reliable availability for team collaboration and project milestones.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Python or similar languages used for AI development, with experience building and integrating AI agents or LLM-based applications.
* Knowledge of machine learning concepts, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, custom orchestration tools) for production-grade systems.
* Experience working with APIs, data pipelines, and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) to connect AI systems with enterprise applications.
* Understanding of software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and secure deployment of AI services.
* Ability to analyze business workflows, define AI-driven solutions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams in a remote environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience; prior experience with enterprise or B2B software is a plus.
* Comfort working part time with self-directed project management, clear communication, and a focus on measurable outcomes.

job_description:
Every day, patients, caregivers and doctors talk online about the conditions our clients treat. We're looking for someone who can listen to those conversations, figure out what actually matters, and turn it into a story our account, content and strategy teams can act on.
  
  
You already know pharma and healthcare marketing. You get why a post about a rare disease reads differently than one about allergies, and how MLR shapes what a brand can say. You love social, and data is how you find the insight, not the end goal.
  
  
You'll join a small, talented analytics team and report to our
**Associate Director of Social Analytics.**
**Responsibilities:**

* Listen to online conversations among patients, caregivers and HCPs, and spot the trends, tensions and moments that matter for our healthcare and life sciences brands
* Turn what you find into clear recommendations on messaging, targeting and content, not just a summary of what happened
* Tell the story behind the numbers in a way account and creative teams can use, and present it to clients with confidence
* Track how social and organic content performs across Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, X and beyond, and explain what's working and why
* Report on website and organic performance alongside social, so the full picture is in one place
* Build clean, easy-to-read reports and dashboards for internal teams and clients
* Work side by side with account, content and strategy teams from campaign planning through results
* Help shape where our analytics practice goes next, from testing new tools to potentially launching surveys and research

**Requirements:**

* 2 to 4 years in social media, social insights or marketing analytics, with real experience on pharma or healthcare brands (agency-side is a big plus)
* Hands-on experience with at least one social listening platform, and an example of an insight you found that changed what a team did
* A working understanding of how MLR, compliance and audience sensitivity shape healthcare marketing
* Strong storytelling: you can explain what the data means to people who don't live in spreadsheets
* Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets and a visualization tool like Tableau, Power BI or Looker Studio
* A sharp eye for detail and pride in getting the numbers right

**You might be:**
an agency social analyst, a social strategist or community manager who loves the data side, a health PR or medcomms analyst, or a social insights specialist at a healthcare brand.

**Position Summary:**
Serves as the single senior technical authority for the client internal team. This role mandates specialized technical experience integrating Oracle Cloud with construction tools (Primavera P6, Aconex), executing D365 construction dataset migrations, and building EPC operational reports (OTBI/BIP).

**Key Responsibilities & EPC Specific Duties:**

**·**
**Stream 1:**
Construction Integration Architecture (OIC): Audit TDDs; design and validate REST/SOAP APIs, Web Services, and OIC orchestration pipelines connecting Oracle Fusion with Primavera P6 (schedules/costs), Banking Host-to-Host portals, ZATCA E-Invoicing Gateways, and Document Management (Aconex).

·      
**Stream 2:**
D365 to Oracle Construction Data Migration: Direct extraction of complex EPC data from D365 BYOD / SQL databases; execute ETL scripts transforming D365 data into Oracle FBDI and HDL templates; establish 100% automated reconciliation for WBS line items, open PO commitments, sub-ledger AP/AR, and GL balances across Mock 1, Mock 2, Mock 3, and Cutover.

·      
**Stream 3:**
Construction BI & Operational Reporting: Build OTBI subject area queries, executive dashboards, and pixel-perfect BI Publisher (BIP) printable documents (Purchase Orders, Subcontract Valuation Certificates, Payment Vouchers, Payslips); ensure 100% parity with legacy D365 SSRS reports.

·      
**Technical Environment Governance:**
Oversee Oracle Quarterly Update patch impacts, sandbox refreshes, code deployments, and technical cutover sequencing across all technical streams.

**Required Qualifications & Mandatory EPC Experience:**

**·**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology.

·      
**Mandatory EPC Industry Experience:**
Minimum 6+ years of technical developer / architect experience specifically building integrations, data pipelines, and reports for EPC or heavy construction firms (MANDATORY).

·      
**Overall Technical Experience:**
Minimum 10+ years of enterprise technical development experience in Oracle ERP and database environments.

·      
**Oracle & D365 Technical Mastery:**
4+ years dedicated to Oracle Fusion Cloud, OIC, FBDI/HDL data loaders, and Oracle Analytics (OTBI/BIP), combined with hands-on technical proficiency extracting data from Microsoft Dynamics 365 (F&O / BYOD).

**Required Professional Certifications:**

**·      Oracle Application Integration Cloud (OIC) Specialist Certification (Mandatory)

job_description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a data-driven Performance Marketing Manager to plan, execute, and optimize paid acquisition campaigns across digital channels. You will own the paid media budget, drive efficient customer acquisition, and continuously improve ROAS, CAC, and LTV through testing and analysis.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Campaign Strategy & Execution**

* Develop and manage performance marketing strategy across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, LinkedIn, programmatic, and affiliate channels
* Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across the full funnel (prospecting, retargeting, retention)
* Own monthly and quarterly paid media budgets and allocate spend based on performance

**Optimization & Testing**

* Run structured A/B and multivariate tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, bidding strategies, and offers
* Monitor KPIs daily (CAC, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, LTV) and act quickly on insights
* Improve conversion rates in collaboration with CRO, product, and design teams

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Set up and maintain tracking (GA4, GTM, pixels, conversion APIs, MMPs such as AppsFlyer/Adjust)
* Build dashboards and deliver regular performance reports with clear insights and recommendations
* Apply attribution models and incrementality testing to measure true channel impact

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Work with creative, content, product, and CRM teams to produce high-performing ad assets
* Manage agency partners and freelancers, holding them accountable to targets
* Mentor and guide junior performance marketers or specialists

**Market & Competitive Insight**

* Stay current on platform updates, privacy changes, and industry best practices
* Analyze competitors and market trends to identify new growth opportunities

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, or a related field
* 7 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, including 1–2 years in a managerial or lead role
* Proven track record of managing six- or seven-figure monthly ad budgets with measurable results
* Deep expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and at least one additional paid platform
* Strong command of analytics tools (GA4, Looker Studio, Excel/Google Sheets; SQL is a plus)
* Solid understanding of attribution, funnel metrics, and unit economics
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in e-commerce, SaaS, fintech, or app-bas

Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering comprehensive financial analyses that will inform strategic business decisions and enhance our operational efficiencies.

* Monitor and analyze financial performance metrics, identifying trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement

* Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in financial analysis and reporting

* Strong proficiency in financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data
* Proficient in financial software and advanced Excel; familiarity with ERP systems is an advantage
* Strong communication skills, capable of presenting financial information clearly and concisely to stakeholders
* Self-motivated, with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
  
  
Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
  
  
Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.
  
  
Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

* Strengthen reporting, planning processes, data quality and automation.
* Ensure alignment with financial controls, policies and planning timelines.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field; CP

job_description:
*Hello, we're L'Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it).*
*Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.*
**A Day in the Life**
You ensure the right products reach shelves at the right time, balancing high service rates with optimal inventory levels. Reporting to the Supply Planning Manager, you act as the vital link between commercial demand and physical operations across our global network of 36 plants and 158 fulfillment centres.
  
  

* Build and fine-tune entity supply plans based on validated forecasts, establishing precise inventory parameters for cost, volume, and service targets.
* Anticipate logistical bottlenecks and mitigate shortage risks by partnering closely with manufacturing sites and logistics leads on capacity constraints.
* Monitor weekly KPIs—including out-of-stock rates, service levels, and stock days—taking rapid, proactive action to resolve supply imbalances.
* Manage inventory health by actively reducing obsolete and slow-moving stock, upholding our 'L'Oréal for the Future' waste-reduction targets.
* Drive process improvements and modern planning tools within the team, embedding best practices across the local supply chain community.

**We Are Looking For**
You bring sharp analytical precision, a pragmatic approach to operational challenges, and a clear focus on service excellence. You bring:
  
  

* Supply Chain Planning: Proven track record in building balanced replenishment and supply plans in fast-moving consumer goods or complex retail environments.
* Data & Inventory Optimisation: Practical capability in inventory modeling and planning software to manage stock equations and forecast alignment.
* Operational Agility: Proven ability to resolve supply bottlenecks, challenge supplier lead times, and protect service levels under shifting constraints.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Clear communication skills to rally manufacturing partners, logistics teams, and commercial stakeholders around shared operational priorities.
* Continuous Improvement: Experience applying structured process enhancements or industrial engineering principles to everyday supply flows.

**What's In It For You**

* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you'll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
* Real responsibility from day 1, there's no sitting on the sidelines at L'Oréal
*

job_description:
**COGNNA** is redefining modern cybersecurity with Nexus, our Agentic AI SOC platform, and our Smart MDR services. We help organizations across the region and around the world cut alert noise, respond to incidents faster and stay compliant with frameworks such as SAMA, NCA, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS.

Behind it all: AI-driven triage, deep automation and our elite 24/7 Guardians Team, delivering unified visibility and rapid threat containment across endpoint, cloud and network.

As our **DevOps Engineer Intern**, you will learn by doing. You'll work alongside senior engineers to provision multi-cloud infrastructure, keep Kubernetes environments healthy, configure GitOps pipelines and support cloud security operations.

This is not a shadow-only internship. From your first weeks, your automation, documentation and troubleshooting will directly improve the reliability of the platform our customers rely on.

Responsibilities1. Cloud operations (GCP & Alibaba Cloud)

* Provision infrastructure: help provision and maintain cloud resources following cost-efficiency and security best practices.
* Keep IAM clean: review access requests, update role definitions and manage service-account hygiene under guidance.
* Watch costs: track utilization, spot unused or over-provisioned resources, filter logs and set up budget alerts.
* Learn the network: navigate VPCs, firewall rules and private connectivity; support routine security patching and Vanta compliance tasks.

2. Kubernetes & containers (GKE)

* Monitor cluster health: track status, resource usage and reliability metrics across development and staging clusters.
* Troubleshoot: help investigate pod scheduling issues, container crashes and resource bottlenecks.
* Partner with developers: learn and share containerization best practices, from Dockerfiles to multi-stage builds.
* Shadow upgrades: join senior engineers during Kubernetes upgrades and maintenance windows.

3. CI/CD (ArgoCD & GitHub Actions)

* Onboard services to GitOps: draft ArgoCD Application manifests, sync policies and environment configurations.
* Catch drift: monitor ArgoCD for out-of-sync applications and flag them to the team.
* Improve pipelines: integrate security scanners, linters and tests into GitHub Actions workflows.

4. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

* Shadow migrations: learn how complex manual infrastructure is moved into code.
* Write modules: build and maintain modular Terraform that brings unmanaged resources under version control.

Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Data Engineer**

**Job Title:** Power BI Developer

-----------------

We are seeking a skilled **Power BI Developer** with strong expertise in building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise dashboards and reports. * Optimize report performance using DAX Studio, Performance Analyzer, and best practices for semantic modeling.
* Publish, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot reports within Power BI Report Server (PBIRS).
* Perform data reconciliation, functional testing, regression testing, and production support activities.
* Troubleshoot report issues and ensure data accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Support report migration, source connection updates, and modernization initiatives while preserving existing functionality.
* Maintain technical docume

-----------------

We are looking for a **Data Engineer** to build, configure, and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and consumption workloads on a modern on-premises lakehouse platform. ------------------------

* Design and develop scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines.
* Build, optimize, and maintain Spark-based ETL/ELT workloads.

* Develop secure, governed, and scalable data pipelines aligned with enterprise standards.
* Support batch and near real-time data processing requirements.
* Implement data quality, metadata management, and validation controls.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineers on deployment, integration, and operationalization activities.
* Support migration, testing, and production rollout initiatives.
* Troubleshoot and optimize data pipeline performance, reliability, and scalability.

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala Spark)
* Apache Iceberg
* Informatica Data Integration
* MinIO Object Storage
* Denodo
* SQL and Data Modeling
* Data Warehousing Concepts
* ETL/ELT Development
* Git Version Control

**Good-to-Have Skills**
-----------------------

* Starburst and/or Dremio
* Data Governance and Metadata Management
* Data Quality Frameworks
* CI/CD for Data Pipelines
* Python
* Kafka or Streaming Technologies
* Lakehouse Architecture Patterns

* Performance tuning and optimization of large-scale data workloads

-------------------

The Process Engineer is responsible for developing process engineering deliverables for in house projects, including Process Design Packages (PDP), Front End Engineering Design (FEED), and Detailed Engineering Packages (DEP), while ensuring technical integrity and compliance with SABIC Engineering Standards, licensor requirements, and applicable international standards.

Job Description – Data Engineer

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
**Work Location: KSA**
**Experience Required:**
Hands-on experience with Spark development, Informatica integration solutions, and enterprise data platforms.
  
Years of experience: 5 to 10

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Data Engineer**
to build, configure, and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and consumption workloads on a modern on-premises lakehouse platform. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Spark-based development, enterprise data lake/lakehouse implementations, and Informatica-based integration solutions.

* Design and develop scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines

* Develop and manage data models and datasets using Apache Iceberg tables

* Support migration, testing, and production rollout initiatives
* Troubleshoot and optimize data pipeline performance, reliability, and scalability

Must-Have Skills

* Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala Spark)
* Apache Iceberg
* Informatica Data Integration
* MinIO Object Storage
* Denodo
* SQL and Data Modeling
* Data Warehousing Concepts
* ETL/ELT Development
* Git Version Control

Good-to-Have Skills

* Starburst and/or Dremio
* Data Governance and Metadata Management
* Data Quality Frameworks
* CI/CD for Data Pipelines
* Python
* Kafka or Streaming Technologies
* Lakehouse Architecture Patterns
* Experience with enterprise data lake and lakehouse implementations
* Performance tuning and optimization of large-scale data workloads

**About Accenture**

Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping the world's leading enterprises reinvent — building their digital core, unleashing the power of AI, and creating value at speed and scale. We bring together deep industry expertise, cutting-edge technology, and bold thinking to deliver outcomes that matter.

You'll be on the front line of 24x7 SOC operations protecting enterprise clients against active threats. This isn't a passive monitoring role — you'll be triaging, investigating, and responding to real incidents, working within a high-performing global delivery team where speed, accuracy, and judgment all matter.

* Monitor and analyze security alerts from SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and other security tools to identify potential threats across client environments
* Perform timely triage, validation, and investigation of alerts in line with SLA requirements and prioritization frameworks (P1–P4)
* Execute containment, response, and remediation actions using established SOC runbooks
* Manage incidents through the full case lifecycle — accurate documentation, status updates, and closure in the case management system
* Monitor SOC communication channels and ensure timely response to inquiries, escalations, and stakeholder coordination
* Escalate high-severity and complex incidents in line with SLAs, including immediate notification for potential P1/P2 cases
* Conduct effective shift handovers, ensuring active and critical cases are transferred with full context
* Identify and report operational gaps, anomalies, or delays within the same shift to relevant leads
* Contribute to continuous improvement by surfacing gaps in detection, logging, automation, and case handling processes

  

**What You'll Need**

* Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals — threat types, attack vectors, the CIA triad, and incident response principles
* Working knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux/Unix) and networking concepts (TCP/IP, OSI model, DNS, HTTP/S)

* Ability to analyze logs, network traffic, and endpoint telemetry to identify malicious activity
* Disciplined and process-oriented — able to work effectively in a shift-based, SLA-driven environment
* Clear communicator with strong documentation habits and the ability to coordinate across internal and external stakeholders
* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecuri

Operates in all clinic areas and in-patient areas to conduct echocardiogram (TTE and TEE), stress testing (treadmill, Dobutamine and thallium / Sestamibi with the nuclear imaging), and 24 hour holter (ECG) and BP monitoring procedures. Performs on patients of both sexes and all nationalities, thus ethical and cultural sensitivities are of paramount importance in the way the work is done. Coordinates with the cardiologists and specialists for supervision and reports.  
  
Key Responsibilities and Duties:  
  
1. Echocardiograms Transthoracic Echocardiogram ( TTE ):  
  
Performs 2D echo Doppler studies on adult, pediatric and neonatal patients and writes down the preliminary results.  
Notifies cardiologists of suspected abnormalities necessitating immediate attention (e.g. Pericardial tamponade, cardiac tumors, malfunctioning valve prosthesis and complex congenital heart disease, etc.).  
Prepares reports / videos of patients for official reading of the Consultant Cardiologist.  
Maintains documentation and down-time equipment used in the Echo lab.  
Maintains statistics, patient record and area monthly report.  
Reports to supervisor / department head any staff problems / malfunction of the echo equipment.  
Requests and obtains outpatients charts on all scheduled patients.  
Maintains supplies as needed for the examination room.  
Maintains daily the examination room in a clean and orderly environment for patient care (including changing the bed sheets).  
Maintains daily census record of Echo procedures completed.  
  
2. Trans-esophageal Echocardiogram ( TEE ) if applicable:  
  
Performs pre-procedure equipment preparation and sterilization and acquisition of signed consent form.  
Acquires quick history and physical examination about the nature of the disease.  
Helps the patient to understand what to expect, alleviate anxiety and enhance compliance during TEE examination. Also a brief drug and allergy history or dysphagia or esophageal disease should be elicited.  
line to administer sedation or emergency medications.  
Advises patient to remove dentures and places the mouth piece.  
Instructs the patient to lie on his left lateral position with neck and knee bent forward and swallowing during intubations with nasal breathing.  
Be alert in monitoring vital signs and complications.  
Monitor s the patient after the procedure at least 1-2 hours for potential complication of the procedures, anesthetic or sedative.

job_description:
**About the Role**

We are recruiting an A&D System Manager for a dedicated full-time team delivering accreditation at a major international multi-sport event. The role sits within our client’s Accreditation function. It is based on site in Riyadh, KSA, and runs from ASAP until the end of December 2026, covering system readiness, event time and close-out.

The event will bring together thousands of athletes and team officials from across the region, competing across multiple sports and venues.

You will:

* Run the A&D system provided by the Organising Committee as part of the Event Management System (EMS)
* Make sure the registration and accreditation data of every stakeholder group is accurate and secure
* Get the system tested, validated and fully ready before the event begins
* Keep the system live and supported across all venues during the event

The system covers athletes, team officials, workforce, volunteers, media and other accredited stakeholders, and you will be its operational owner. You will work alongside the Accreditation Manager, delegation management, venue operations, security, the EMS provider and IT teams.

This role is hands-on. You will configure the system, manage permissions, troubleshoot issues and produce the reporting yourself, not just oversee others doing it.

**Key Responsibilities**

*System Management*

* Manage system settings, accreditation categories, user permissions, access privileges and operational workflows in line with approved requirements.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of the accreditation privilege matrix, ensuring correct access rights for each accredited category.

*Data Integrity*

* Oversee the registration and accreditation data of all accredited stakeholder groups.
* Ensure accurate collection, verification, updating and maintenance of accreditation and delegation information.
* Ensure confidentiality, secure handling of personal information and compliance with data protection and accreditation protocols.

*Badge Production and Integration*

* Coordinate with accreditation teams on badge information, printing requirements and system integration for badge production and distribution.

*Testing and Technical Support*

* Conduct system testing, validate workflows and ensure full operational readiness before the event.
* Monitor system performance, identify technical issues and coordinate with the EMS provider and IT teams for timely resolution.

*Event-Time Operations and Reporting*

job_description:
* **Who Are We❓**  
  We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.  
    
  **The Job in a Nutshell**  
  The Receptionist & Administrative Assistant is the first point of contact for visitors and callers, and keeps the office running day to day. The role combines front-desk duties with administrative support to HR and the wider office, including records, supplies, meeting rooms, travel and vendor coordination. The aim is a professional welcome for every guest and an office where employees have what they need, on time.  
    
  **What Will You Do❓**  
    
  **Reception and Front Desk Administrative**
* Welcome visitors, candidates and clients, verify identity, register them in the visitor log and issue visitor badges.
* Notify hosts on arrival and escort guests to meeting rooms when needed.
* Answer and direct incoming calls, take accurate messages and handle general inquiries.
* Receive, log and distribute incoming mail, couriers and deliveries; arrange outgoing shipments.
* Keep the reception and waiting area clean, tidy and presentable at all times.
* Follow building security and access-control procedures and report any security concern immediately.
* Manage meeting room bookings and prepare rooms with refreshments and equipment.
* Monitor office supplies and pantry stock, raise purchase requests and track deliveries.
* Maintain organizing physical and electronic filing for administrative documents.
* Prepare letters, memos and simple reports, and update trackers and spreadsheets.
* Coordinate business travel bookings (flights, hotels, transport) in line with the travel policy.
* Arrange logistics for internal events, meetings and employee engagement activities.
* Prepare the workstation, access card and welcome pack for new joiners in coordination with IT.
* Provide support and assistance to other departments

job_description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

We are currently recruiting for a **HSE Lead** for our project in Tabuk, You will lead health, safety and environmental (HSE) assurance for the Water Pipeline project, ensuring Contractors deliver the works safely and in compliance with contractual HSE requirements, project HSE standards and Saudi regulations.

  
  

Oversee Contractor HSE performance across pipeline corridors, pump stations and associated works, drive a strong safety culture, and support zero harm through effective risk management, assurance, incident management and continuous improvement.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing**

  
  

* Review and approve Contractor HSE deliverables, including HSE Plans, Environmental Management Plans, risk assessments, method statements, emergency response plans and traffic management plans.

* Oversee control of high-risk pipeline activities, including deep excavations, trenching, lifting operations, pipe handling, confined space entry, hot work, hydrotesting, working near live utilities and energisation.

* Monitor implementation of the permit-to-work system, safe systems of work and critical risk controls across pipeline corridors, pump stations and reservoir sites.

* Plan and conduct HSE inspections, audits and site walks, tracking findings and corrective actions through to close-out.

* Lead or support incident reporting and investigation, root cause analysis and the sharing of lessons learned.

* Oversee road and driving safety across long linear pipeline corridors, including journey management, fatigue management, defensive driving and logistics traffic controls.

* Ensure environmental controls are implemented, including waste management, dust, noise, spill prevention, water discharge from hydrotesting, and protection of sensitive habitats.

* Oversee worker welfare, heat stress management and emergency response arrangements for remote linear sites, including drills and medical evacuation.

* Prepare HSE performance reports and KPIs (leading and lagging), and present HSE performance and risks to project leadership.

* Promot

Sales internshipThis role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. Hewlett Packard Enterprise offers university students the opportunity to join a leading IT company and gain invaluable experience through our Internship Program. Hewlett Packard Enterprise offers you a highly dynamic, fast-paced, professional working environment and the chance to develop the skills you have gained at university in a real business environment.

During your internship you will not only apply these skills in the IT industry, but also acquire a range of abilities to contribute to the business whilst working alongside industry professionals. Throughout the program, you'll have regular training and one-to-one meetings with your manager. Working together, you'll set goals and plot your development. And with our open-plan offices and friendly working culture, you'll have the chance to learn from experienced professionals who can help you in your future career.

We are currently looking for College Interns (Coop) in Sales.

After an initial interview and assessment process, you will be matched to a specific role based on your interests, skillset and organization needs.

* Learn basic business and organizational skills that would develop a solid foundation for future employment.
* Shadowing your team and specified groups to increase experience and knowledge.
* Develop awareness of all relevant competitive products on the market.
* Assist the relevant team with day to day operations
* Assist with customer communication, as needed
* Learn to effectively deliver product demos and presentations.

**About Accenture**
Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping the world's leading enterprises reinvent — building their digital core, unleashing the power of AI, and creating value at speed and scale. We bring together deep industry expertise, cutting-edge technology, and bold thinking to deliver outcomes that matter.
  
  
You'll be on the front line of 24x7 SOC operations protecting enterprise clients against active threats. This isn't a passive monitoring role — you'll be triaging, investigating, and responding to real incidents, working within a high-performing global delivery team where speed, accuracy, and judgment all matter.
  
  
  
- Monitor and analyze security alerts from SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and other security tools to identify potential threats across client environments
- Perform timely triage, validation, and investigation of alerts in line with SLA requirements and prioritization frameworks (P1–P4)
- Execute containment, response, and remediation actions using established SOC runbooks
- Manage incidents through the full case lifecycle — accurate documentation, status updates, and closure in the case management system
- Monitor SOC communication channels and ensure timely response to inquiries, escalations, and stakeholder coordination
- Escalate high-severity and complex incidents in line with SLAs, including immediate notification for potential P1/P2 cases
- Conduct effective shift handovers, ensuring active and critical cases are transferred with full context

- Contribute to continuous improvement by surfacing gaps in detection, logging, automation, and case handling processes

- Hands-on experience or familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms, endpoint protection, firewalls, and security monitoring tools
- Ability to analyze logs, network traffic, and endpoint telemetry to identify malicious activity
- Disciplined and process-oriented — able to work effectively in a shift-based, SLA-driven environment
- Clear communicator with strong documentation habits and the ability to coordinate across internal and external stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree in Cybers

job_description:
Who We Are
  
  
At BCG Platinion, we close the gap between strategy and technology. We design and build AI tech strategies, AI solutions, and next-generation platform architectures that turn ambition into execution, turning buzzwords into a true business engine and real competitive advantage.
  
  
Working at the intersection of boardroom strategy and hands-on tech delivery, we help leading organizations tackle their toughest challenges, with access to C-suite leaders and the unmatched resources of BCG.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* You have a degree in computer science, (business) informatics, or a related discipline
* You have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in IT Consulting or software development
* You know that modern technologies such as machine learning, cyber resilience, DevOps, agile methods, AI, and robotics aren't just buzzwords, but essential to sustainable IT architectures
* You have broad technical expertise and interest in technology trends
* You feel particularly comfortable in interdisciplinary teams and global contexts
* You have experience with hyperscalers, with additional certifications from AWS, Azure, GCP, AliCloud, or TencentCloud
* You're good at understanding and communicating complex topics in English, Arabic is a plus
* Flexibility and willingness to travel to our client locations in the Middle East and beyond

What You'll Bring
  
  
Shaping the digital transformation of globally leading companies, ensuring their success by evaluating our clients' digital capabilities and performing feasibility studies
  
  
Managing small, agile development teams in strategic IT implementation programs, establish modern practices like DevOps and CI/CD, and be responsible for the technical implementation of crucial digital requirements such as cyber resilience
  
  
Analyzing, developing, and optimizing cutting-edge, customized IT architectures while applying your comprehensive understanding of legacy IT, enterprise solutions, and current market developments such as cloud computing, microservices and blockchain.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
We make sure you never stop growing. You'll tackle exciting, high-impact challenges every day, supported by a passionate team of talented colleagues who share your drive for excellence and keep connect long after your case wraps up. Our collaborative, open culture gives you the freedom to explore and perfect your strengths, backed by individual learning opportunities and recognized certifications.

وصف الوظيفة:
  
  

**الغرض من الوظيفة**
**:**

الإشراف على التطوير الاستراتيجي وإدارة وصيانة التطبيقات داخل المركز وقيادة تصميم التطبيقات ونشرها وتحسينها, والتأكد من أنها تلبي معايير الجودة، وتتوافق مع أهداف العمل، وأن يتم تسليمها ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة وضمان المراقبة المستمرة لأداء التطبيقات وتحديد الاختناقات والثغرات وضمان اتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة والمتابعة مع المعنيين وتنفيذ استراتيجيات التطوير على التطبيقات وقواعد البيانات لتحسين الكفاءة والموثوقية لنظم وحلول المركز.

**الأدوار والمسؤوليات التخصصية**
**:**

* المساعدة في تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجية التطبيقات بما يتماشى مع استراتيجية المركز والموائمة مع مشاريع ومبادرات الإدارات المعنية بتخطيط المتطلبات وتطوير الحلول وإدارة الإطلاق لموائمة متطلبات تشغيل وإدارة التطبيقات وقواعد البيانات.

* ضمان موائمة وتنفيذ خطط إدارة وتشغيل التطبيقات والتواصل مع أصحاب المصلحة والمعنيين لدعم إدارات وقطاعات المركز لضمان موائمة الحلول والمنتجات على مدى دورة حياتها.
* ضمان التأكد من أن التطبيقات تلبي معايير الجودة ومتطلبات المستخدم ويتم تسليمها ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة.
* الإشراف على عمليات التحديث الدوري للتطبيقات والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة والتحسينات وضمان استمرارية عمليات تخزين واسترجاع البيانات وموائمة المتطلبات الخاصة بها للحفاظ على مستويات الخدمة.
* ضمان المراقبة المستمرة لأداء التطبيقات وتحديد الاختناقات والثغرات وضمان اتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة والمتابعة مع المعنيين وتنفيذ استراتيجيات التطوير على التطبيقات وقواعد البيانات لتحسين الكفاءة والموثوقية لنظم وحلول المركز.
* ﻿﻿الإشراف على إجراء الصيانة الدورية والتحديثات والتصحيحات والاستجابة للحوادث والأعطال لضمان استقرار النظام وأمنها وضمان استمرارية الأعمال والحفاظ على سجلات إدارة التغيير وضمان تحديثها وسهولة الوصول لها لكافة شرائح المستفيدين.
* ﻿﻿ضمان إدارة عمليات التكامل بين التطبيقات المختلفة لضمان الأداء السلس وإدارة التشغيل وضمان اتمتة العمليات المتكررة بشكل يضمن تحسين أعمال الإدارة وتحسين مراقبة وتشغيل التطبيقات وقواعد البيانات.

**المؤهلات والخبرات للوظيفة**
**:**

* درجة البكالوريوس في علوم الحاسب الآلي، نظم المعلومات الإدارية أو ما يعادلها
* 6 سنوات خبرة كحد أدنى في نفس المجال أو المجالات ذات العلاقة
* ﻿﻿ الشهادات المهنية مثل: Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile PMP, CompTIA IT Operations Specialist (ITOps)

Job Description – Platform Engineer

**Job Title:**
Platform Engineer
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
Experienced Required: 5 to 10 years
  
Work Location: KSA

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Platform Engineer**
to support the installation, configuration, integration, and operationalization of an on-premises modern data platform. The role will focus on infrastructure setup, platform administration, security integration, environment management, and platform reliability across Development, QA, and Production environments.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience deploying enterprise data platforms in highly secured environments, with strong troubleshooting, operational support, and infrastructure management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and administer data platform components in an on-premises environment
* Deploy and manage
  **MinIO Object Storage**
  and
  **Apache Iceberg**
  -based data lakehouse architecture
* Install, configure, and optimize
  **Starburst**
  and/or
  **Dremio**
  platforms for data virtualization and querying
* Deploy, administer, and support
  **Apache Spark**
  clusters and processing services
* Install, configure, and manage
  **Informatica**
  components and ensure seamless integration with the platform ecosystem
* Configure and maintain Development, QA, and Production environments
* Integrate platform components with enterprise security services, including:
  + Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  + Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  + Active Directory / LDAP
  + Single Sign-On (SSO) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Implement and support Git-based DevOps and CI/CD practices
* Manage monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and operational readiness processes
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure platform stability, availability, and performance
* Troubleshoot deployment, configuration, integration, and connectivity issues across the platform stack

Must-Have Skills

* MinIO Administration
* Apache Iceberg
* Starburst and/or Dremio Administration
* Apache Spark Administration
* Informatica Administration
* Linux System Administration
* VMware Infrastructure
* Docker and/or Kubernetes
* Git and CI/CD Integration
* IAM/PAM Integration
* Infrastructure Troubleshooting and Operational Support

Good-to-Have Skills

* Data Lakehouse Architecture
* Enterprise Security Architecture
* Performance Tuning and Capacity Planning
*

وصف الوظيفة:
  
  
**الغرض من الوظيفة**

* إعداد استراتيجية ومنهجيات تطوير الحلول والمنتجات بالموائمة مع استراتيجية المركز وإدارة البنية المؤسسية في قطاع الاستراتيجية والتميز المؤسسي وتقديم الدعم اللازم لنشر الوعي حول الآثار المترتبة على منهجيات تطوير الحلول وضمان التنسيق اللازم بين مختلف قطاعات المركز المعنية بإدارة وتطوير الحلول التقنية وضمان الإطلاق وفق المخطط له.

**الأدوار والمسؤوليات التخصصية:**

* إعداد استراتيجية ومنهجيات تطوير الحلول والمنتجات بالموائمة مع منهجيات الأجايل والديف أوبس وبالموائمة مع استراتيجية المركز وإدارة البنية المؤسسية في قطاع الاستراتيجية والتميز المؤسسي.
* رسم خارطة الطريق لتطوير الحلول والمنتجات وإدارتها على مدى دورة الحياة واعتماد المنهجيات والتنسيق مع إدارة البنية المؤسسية ومعمارية الحلول ومتطلبات الأعمال وإدارات الاختبارات لضمان توفر الموارد والمهارات اللازمة والاتفاق على مستويات الخدمة ومتطلبات الجودة والأداء وتحديد المسؤوليات والأدوار.
* البحث في طرق أتمتة عمليات وأنشطة تطوير وإدارة صيانة وتشغيل الحلول والمنتجات على مدى دورة الحياة والبحث عن فرص التطوير في أنشطة تطوير المنتجات.
* تقديم الدعم المساند لتطوير متطلبات الأعمال والمتطلبات التقنية والبيانات لتطوير الحلول وإدارة عمليات اختبارات المستفيدين النهائيين وضمان تحديد وموائمة معايير القبول للمنتجات.
* إدارة عمليات تطوير وإدارة الحلول والمنتجات بمنهجيات AGILE & DevOps وضمان تقديم الحلول التقنية والإدارية اللازمة لضمان موائمة عمليات تطوير وإدارة صيانة تشغيل الحلول والمنتجات.
* تقديم الدعم اللازم لنشر الوعي حول الآثار المترتبة على منهجيات تطوير الحلول وضمان التنسيق اللازم بين مختلف قطاعات المركز المعنية بإدارة وتطوير الحلول التقنية وضمان الإطلاق وفق المخطط له.
* مساندة إدارة الإنجاز في حل المشكلات في تطوير خطط تشغيلية لضمان التقدم وتطوير الحلول وفق المخطط له.
* تشكيل فرق تطوير وإدارة الحلول وتوضيح الأدوار والمسؤوليات وضمان المساءلة في عمليات تطوير وإدارة الحلول بمنهجية أجايل وديف أوبس وضمان تنسيق الاختبارات والإطلاقات مع قطاع العمليات التقنية.
* التنسيق والموائمة مع مدراء المنتجات لضمان تحقيق الحلول التقنية لمستهدفاتها ولضمان حل المشكلات والمعوقات والحفاظ على مسارات مستمرة لضمان تطوير وترابط الحلول والمنتجات.

**المؤهلات والخبرات للوظيفة**
**المؤهل التعليمي:**

* درجة البكالوريوس في علوم الحاسب الآلي، إدارة الأعمال أو ما يعادلها

**الشهادات المهنية/ الإضافية:**

* شهادة الماجستير في علوم الحاسب الآلي إدارة الأعمال أو ما يعادلها

**الشهادات المهنية مثل:**

* الشهادات المهنية مثل: Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile PMP,
* Certified DevOps Leader (DOL)

job_description:
SCADA Automation Technician

**Job Summary**

The SCADA Automation Technician installs, maintains, troubleshoots, and supports SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems and the related field automation equipment. The role helps keep plants, utilities, or facilities monitored and controlled reliably, with minimal downtime. The position reports to the SCADA/Automation Engineer or Maintenance Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and commission SCADA components, including PLCs, RTUs, HMIs, sensors, and field instruments
* Monitor SCADA systems and respond to alarms, faults, and communication failures
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and instrumentation problems and restore operations quickly
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on control panels, instruments, and communication devices
* Calibrate and test sensors, transmitters, actuators, and control loops
* Support the engineer with PLC and HMI programming changes, backups, and updates
* Maintain and troubleshoot industrial communication networks (Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, OPC, fiber, radio)
* Keep documentation current, including as-built drawings, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, and maintenance logs
* Perform data backups and restoration for PLC, HMI, and SCADA servers
* Follow cybersecurity practices and report suspicious system behavior
* Apply HSE procedures, permit-to-work, and lockout/tagout rules during site work
* Prepare incident, maintenance, and shift handover reports

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Control, or Automation Engineering (or equivalent technical qualification)
* 5 years of experience in SCADA, PLC, or industrial automation support
* Relevant certifications are a plus (e.g., vendor PLC/SCADA training, ISA, or cybersecurity awareness for ICS)

**Skills and Competencies**

* Hands-on experience with PLC platforms (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider, ABB) and SCADA software (WinCC, Ignition, iFIX, Wonderware, or similar)
* Ability to read electrical schematics and P&IDs
* Good knowledge of industrial protocols and networking basics
* Proficient with multimeters, loop calibrators, and diagnostic tools
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Clear technical documentation and communication in English (Arabic is a plus)
* Ability to work independently and in a team, including under pressure

job_description:
**Job Purpose**

The SAP FI-CO Consultant is responsible for implementing, configuring, maintaining, and optimizing SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules to support the company's financial operations, cost management, budgeting, and reporting requirements. The role ensures the effective integration of SAP FI-CO with other SAP modules, particularly Materials Management (MM), Sales and Distribution (SD), and Production Planning (PP), to support accurate financial reporting and cost control across the company's cable manufacturing operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SAP FI – Financial Accounting**

* Configure and maintain SAP FI components, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting.
* Support financial closing activities, including month-end and year-end closing processes.
* Ensure accurate financial postings, account reconciliations, and compliance with applicable accounting policies and procedures.
* Support the preparation of financial statements and management reports through SAP.
* Troubleshoot and resolve SAP FI issues and provide ongoing functional support to finance users.

**2. SAP CO – Controlling and Cost Management**

* Configure and maintain SAP CO functionalities, including Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and Product Costing.
* Support standard cost estimates, cost component structures, and product cost calculations for cable manufacturing products.
* Analyze production costs, material consumption, labor costs, manufacturing overhead, and cost variances.
* Support production order costing, work-in-progress (WIP) calculations, and variance analysis.
* Assist in profitability analysis and margin reporting to support management decision-making.
* Support budgeting, cost allocation, and cost planning processes.

**3. SAP S/4HANA and System Integration**

* Support SAP S/4HANA FI-CO configuration, maintenance, enhancements, and process optimization.
* Ensure effective integration between FI-CO and other SAP modules, including MM, SD, and PP.
* Ensure accurate financial impact from procurement, inventory movements, production activities, and sales transactions.
* Support data migration, system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and validation of financial data.
* Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and SAP implementation projects as required.

**4. Business Support and Process Improvement**

*
