job_description:
**Position Summary:**
Oversees internal solution design, testing, and migration across Oracle Fusion Purchasing, Sourcing, Procurement Contracts, Inventory, and Supplier Portal. Requires direct experience in EPC project-driven procurement, site material receiving, long-lead equipment sourcing, and sub-contract agreement management.

**Key Responsibilities & EPC Specific Duties:**

·      
**Project Procurement & Sourcing Design:**
Shadow vendor workshops for Purchase Requisitions, RFQs, Blanket Agreements, and Sourcing rules tailored to site construction bill of quantities (BOQ).

·      
**Site Material & Logistics Flow:**
Validate material issuance to project WBS tasks, direct site receiving routines, warehouse store management, equipment spare parts tracking, and scrap management.

·      
**D365 Construction SCM Migration:**
Direct the extraction, cleansing, and loading of Item Masters, Approved Supplier Lists (ASL), Open Purchase Orders, Subcontract Agreements, and Site Inventory balances from D365.

·      
**Supplier Portal Onboarding:**
Deploy the Oracle Supplier Portal for online vendor bidding, sub-contractor progress submittals, and site material delivery notifications (ASNs).

·      
**Buyer-Furnished Materials (BFM):**
Design and validate inventory control processes for client-supplied and buyer-furnished materials issued to subcontractors.

**Required Qualifications & Mandatory EPC Experience:**

·      
**Education:**
Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Mechanical/Civil Engineering, or Business.

·      
**Mandatory EPC Industry Experience:**
Minimum 5+ years managing supply chain, site procurement, or material logistics directly within an EPC or heavy construction company (MANDATORY).

·      
**Oracle SCM Cloud Expertise:**
Successfully completed at least 2 end-to-end Oracle Fusion SCM Cloud implementations.

·      
**D365 Domain Knowledge:**
Practical experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Trade & Logistics / Supply Chain module data structures.

**Required Professional Certifications:**

·      Oracle Procurement Cloud Implementation Professional (Mandatory)

·      APICS / ASCM Certified in Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) or CPIM (Highly Desirable)

·      Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) (Desirable)

**Position Summary:**
Leads internal functional oversight for Oracle Fusion Financials (GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Assets, and Tax). Mandates deep familiarity with construction financial accounting, joint venture ledgers, subcontractor retainage accounts, and regional tax compliance (ZATCA Phase 2).

**Key Responsibilities & EPC Specific Duties:**

·      
**EPC Chart of Accounts & Joint Venture Design:**
Validate COA and segment structures to support multi-company, multi-project, joint venture (JV), and consortium financial reporting.

·      
**Subcontractor Payables & Retainage Accounting:**
Configure Accounts Payable TO-BE processes to manage subcontractor pay-when-paid clauses, advance payment amortization, retention liability tracking, and tax withholdings.

·      
**ZATCA E-Invoicing & Regional Tax Compliance:**
Ensure full integration and compliance with regional tax authority regulations (e.g., ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing for construction billing, VAT on milestone claims).

·      
**D365 Construction Financial Migration:**
Lead extraction, cleansing, and loading of historical GL balances, active project AP/AR open items, fixed asset registers (heavy machinery/fleet), and bank accounts from D365.

·      
**Month-End Closing & Reporting:**
Establish project-level financial closing runbooks and validate P&L, Balance Sheet, and WIP statements in OTBI and Financial Reporting Web Studio.

**Required Qualifications & Mandatory EPC Experience:**

·      
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce. Professional accounting qualification required.

·      
**Mandatory EPC Industry Experience:**
Minimum 6+ years as a Financial Controller, Lead Project Accountant, or Financial Systems Consultant within an EPC or heavy construction company (MANDATORY).

·      
**Oracle Financials Cloud Experience:**
Minimum 2 full lifecycle Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementations in project-based construction firms.

·      
**D365 Knowledge:**
Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365 General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, and Fixed Asset data entities.

**Required Professional Certifications:**

·      Certified Public Accountant (CPA), ACCA, CA, or CMA (Mandatory)

·      Oracle Financials Cloud Implementation Professional (Mandatory)

·      ZATCA E-Invoicing Specialist / Regional Construction Tax Certification (Asset)

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced IT Business Analyst to support a digital transformation projects.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams to analyze business processes, document requirements, and ensure that the Oracle Fusion solution aligns with business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Conduct workshops and interviews with business stakeholders to understand current processes and future requirements.
* Analyze existing Oracle EBS business processes and identify gaps, improvement opportunities, and transformation requirements.
* Support business process mapping, fit-gap analysis, and requirements traceability.
* Prepare Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), user stories, and process flow diagrams as applicable.
* Coordinate with Oracle Fusion functional and technical teams to validate proposed solutions.
* Support test planning, test case preparation, UAT execution, defect tracking, and business sign-off.
* Assist with data migration validation, change management, and end-user training activities.
* Track requirements, dependencies, issues, and decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience as an IT Business Analyst, preferably in ERP implementation or transformation projects.
* Experience with Oracle ERP systems, preferably Oracle EBS and/or Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Strong knowledge of business process analysis, requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, and process documentation.
* Experience working with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical delivery teams.
* Familiarity with ERP testing, UAT, data migration, and implementation methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* CBAP, PMI-PBA, or relevant business analysis certification is an advantage.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are invited to share their CV through LinkedIn or via email: hr@techvisions.com.sa, mentioning
**IT Business Analyst – Oracle ERP Transformation**
in the subject line.

job_description:
**What We Need**
In this role you will be responsible for accounting and reporting for a number of legal entities in scope of the Oivan Group. On a monthly basis you are in charge of the month-end closing process, ensuring quality and timely reporting of the financial results, ensure accounts are reconciled and key controls are performed. The tasks might also include preparing monthly payrolls for the company’s employees. On an annual basis you support preparation of local financial statements and coordinate with auditors.
  
  
In this role you will be also responsible for finance activities within the Order-to-Cash (OTC) and Purchase-to-Pay (PTP) domains.
  
  
OTC includes handling bank statement postings, allocation of incoming payments, customer refunds and reconciliations. You have an important role in securing the companies’ cashflow by taking ownership of collection activities, aging reporting and bad debt handling. This also includes liaising with key Oivan customers, analyzing the project POs & contracts and deliveries, communicating with customers during the delivery process, monitoring the agreed settlements, sending invoices and following up with customers, revisiting and reminding and keeping record of collection process.
  
  
PTP includes handling purchase invoice processing, payments, query and escalation handling, AP maintenance, month-end closing activities including accruals, reconciliations and internal controls. You support the vendor master data maintenance and also support the local travel & expense process including processing of claims, credit card and corporate travel account administration. You are ultimately responsible that master data (vendors, customer and employees) of your entity is correct and up-to-date in Oivan financial systems.
  
  
You are supported by other members of Oivan finance team and collaborate closely with business stakeholders as well as other internal teams. You have strong excel skills and know how to optimize finance systems and constantly look for continuous improvement of daily activities.
  
  
Further, you play a key role in continuously improving and enhancing our local accounting and reporting processes. You are quickly able to adapt to new processes and tools, can resolve any problem quickly and understand how to optimise our systems and ways of working. The role also includes participation in various finance development projects.
  
  
**What You Have**
Qualifications and requirements:
  
  

*

**Job Title:**
Data Migration & Reconciliation Tester

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Data Migration & Reconciliation Tester to validate data migration processes, ensure source-to-target data accuracy, and verify the completeness and integrity of historical data. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL skills, experience in ETL testing, data reconciliation, and data quality assessment, preferably within financial or banking systems.

Key Responsibilities

* Validate data migration activities to ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across source and target systems.
* Perform source-to-target data reconciliation using SQL queries and other validation techniques.
* Verify historical data accuracy and ensure migrated records comply with business rules and requirements.
* Execute data migration test cases, including record count validation, field-level comparisons, transformation checks, and exception analysis.
* Support mock migrations, migration rehearsals, and cutover validation activities.
* Perform ETL validation to verify data extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
* Identify, document, investigate, and track data discrepancies, defects, and reconciliation issues through resolution.
* Conduct data quality assessments to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or invalid records.
* Validate financial data, including balances, transactions, account information, and other relevant financial records.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, developers, and functional teams to resolve migration-related issues.
* Prepare test reports, reconciliation reports, defect logs, and migration sign-off documentation.
* Support final migration validation and provide evidence to confirm data readiness for production deployment.

Required Skills & Experience

* Hands-on experience in
  **data migration testing, data validation, and source-to-target reconciliation**
  .
* Strong proficiency in
  **SQL**
  for data comparison, complex queries, joins, aggregations, and validation checks.
* Experience in
  **ETL testing and data warehouse validation**

**Job Summary**

Express Food Company (ALBAIK) is looking for a motivated Internal Audit Specialist to join our Restaurant Audit team. You’ll carry out restaurant audit fieldwork across financial, operational and people areas in our restaurants in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. The role protects revenue, stock and Company assets in one of the region’s fastest-growing QSR businesses.

**Purpose**

To carry out the approved restaurant audit plan and record results accurately, keeping internal controls strong across our restaurant network.

**Why Join Us**

At Express Food Company, Internal Audit protects the business as it grows. In this role, you’ll start your audit career in the field, testing the controls that matter most: cash, sales, inventory, POS and people. You’ll get structured on-the-job training and support towards certifications such as CIA. If you’re a detail-oriented Accounting graduate eager to learn, we invite you to join our Internal Audit team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Complete assigned restaurant audit visits in line with the monthly coverage plan.
* Perform cash and safe counts, plus sales and settlement reconciliations across all channels.
* Conduct inventory counts and FIFO, expiry, transfer and wastage testing.
* Test POS access, voids, discounts and overrides, as well as expenses and petty cash.
* Review payroll and people records, and Baladiya and regulatory compliance.
* Gather audit evidence and prepare clear, cross-referenced working papers.
* Draft audit observations and validate closure of agreed corrective actions.

The Assistant Conservator for Collections and Technical Support undertakes conservation and related work on the organizations collections. They are responsible for all health and safety and the maintenance and safe operation of all laboratories, analytical and other associated equipment. They will implement both preventive and remedial conservation services and ensure that these processes and the collection conditions are documented to agreed standards. * Maintenance of laboratory and all associate equipment and services

* Undertake technical support for conservation services
* Undertake conservation work at the direction of line management
* Maintain all documentation related to technical work programs
* Provide support for mounting and display of collection items

**Team Deliverables:**

* Support the Collections Care and other Departments in line with agreed work programs and deliverables

**Research and Scholarship:**

* Support research and scholarship related to the collections.

* Provide support to the department on public engagement and education activities

* Manage internal budget for Laboratory facility

* Provide reports on lab expenditure to Departmental manager

**الموقع - تبوك**

**المسمى الوظيفي:**
مسؤول سلامة

**بالإنجليزية:**
Safety Officer

ميداني / إشرافي

المصانع والمنشآت الصناعية

**الهدف الوظيفي**

**المسؤوليات الرئيسية**

**1. التفتيش والرقابة**

* تنفيذ الجولات التفتيشية الدورية على المصانع.
* التحقق من الالتزام بمتطلبات السلامة والصحة المهنية.
* رصد المخاطر والممارسات غير الآمنة وتوثيقها.
* متابعة اشتراطات مخارج الطوارئ، الإخلاء، النظافة والترتيب، التخزين، الكهرباء والحماية من الحريق.
* التحقق من توفر واستخدام معدات الوقاية الشخصية.

**2. تقييم المخاطر**

* تحديد المخاطر المرتبطة بالعمليات والمعدات والمواد.
* إجراء ومراجعة تقييمات المخاطر.
* اقتراح إجراءات التحكم بالمخاطر وفق التسلسل الهرمي للسيطرة على المخاطر.
* متابعة الأعمال ذات الخطورة العالية.

**3. الحريق والطوارئ**

* التأكد من جاهزية أنظمة ومعدات مكافحة الحريق.
* متابعة أنظمة الإنذار والإطفاء ومخارج ومسارات الإخلاء.
* مراجعة خطط الطوارئ والإخلاء.
* المشاركة في تنفيذ تمارين الإخلاء والطوارئ.
* دعم الاستجابة للحوادث والحرائق والحالات الطارئة.

**4. الحوادث والتحقيق**

* الإبلاغ الفوري عن الحوادث والإصابات والحالات الخطرة.
* المشاركة في التحقيق في الحوادث وتحديد الأسباب الجذرية.
* إعداد تقارير الحوادث والإجراءات التصحيحية والوقائية.
* متابعة الإجراءات لمنع تكرار الحوادث.

**5. المقاولون والأعمال عالية الخطورة**

* متابعة التزام المقاولين بمتطلبات السلامة.
* التحقق من تصاريح العمل عند الحاجة.
* متابعة أعمال الارتفاع، اللحام والقطع، الرفع، الأعمال الكهربائية والأماكن المحصورة.
* رفع التوصيات أو إيقاف العمل عند وجود خطر وشيك وفق الصلاحيات والإجراءات المعتمدة.

**6. التوعية والتدريب**

* تنفيذ برامج التوعية اليومية والأسبوعية بالسلامة.
* المشاركة في برامج التدريب والإخلاء ومكافحة الحريق والإسعافات الأولية.
* تعزيز ثقافة السلامة لدى العاملين والمقاولين.

**7. التقارير وقياس الأداء**

* إعداد التقارير اليومية والأسبوعية والشهرية.
* متابعة إغلاق الملاحظات والمخالفات.
* متابعة مؤشرات مثل نسبة الالتزام، إغلاق الملاحظات، الحوادث، المخاطر عالية الخطورة، والتدريب.

* **NFPA 20 – Fire Pumps**

**Position Title:**
Sr. QC Engineer - Forging
  
  
**Position ID:**
QLTY-016
  
  
**Department:**
Quality
  
  
**Function:**
Quality Control
  
  
**Reports To:**
QC Manager
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To ensure that all forging products meet internal quality standards and customer specifications by implementing and maintaining effective quality control processes. The Quality Control Engineer plays a critical role in minimizing defects, improving production efficiency, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and certifications.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Quality Inspection and Control**

* Drive the QC procedure implementation across the forging shop as per the organization procedure and expectations
* Controlling of non-conforming product within the plant as per the NCR procedure including the internal NCR management
* Preparation of forging ITP and product inspection plan for both internal & external to ensure the product quality
* Perform quality inspections on raw materials, in-process components, and finished products related to forging in accordance with material standards and API 20B requirements
* Record inspection results and analyze quality data to identify trends and issues
* Manage the day-to-day inspection activities in the forging shop floor
* Liaise with third party inspection agencies for the inspection and related activity
* Responsible for final product clearance as per the quality requirements.

**Problem Solving and Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze root causes of defects and establish corrective and preventive actions
* Provide quality feedback to improve production processes.

**Quality System Management**

* Maintain and improve quality management systems such as ISO 9001 and APIQ1
* Manage the customer or third-party audit along with QA.

**Inspection Equipment Management**

* Manage calibration and maintenance of inspection equipment
* Operate equipment to ensure measurement accuracy.

**Requirements**
*Education*

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in quality control within a manufacturing environment, preferably in heavy open die forging
* Experience or knowledge in API Q1 and 20B is preferred.

*Technical Skills*

* Proficiency in using inspection tools (e.g., calipers, micrometers, CMM, ultrasonic testers)
* Familiarity with quality inspection such as visual and NDE methods

Commercial Director | Hygiene & Cleaning Solutions | KSA

Function: Commercial (Sales, Marketing, CRM, Business Development)

Industry: Industrial Hygiene Solutions

Location: Saudi Arabia

Reports To: CEO

Black Tie Consultancy is exclusively partnering with a market-leading hygiene and cleaning solutions company in Saudi Arabia to identify a Commercial Director. This is a senior leadership role for an executive who has built commercial teams before and can bring structure and ambition to a sales organisation in a competitive B2B market.

What you’ll be doing:

You’ll own the full commercial agenda across Sales, Marketing, CRM and Business Development, accountable for revenue growth, market share and how the company goes to market across the Kingdom. That covers commercial strategy, pricing, key accounts and channels, a multi-disciplinary team across several KSA locations, and the rollout of a data-driven CRM culture.

What we’re looking for:

15+ years of commercial leadership, ideally in hygiene, cleaning solutions, chemicals or B2B industrial distribution

A proven record of revenue growth or commercial turnaround in a product and solutions-led B2B business

Experience leading Sales, Marketing and BD together under one mandate

Hands-on CRM leadership: you’ve implemented or transformed one, not just used one

Sector knowledge in one or more of food & beverage, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or poultry processing

You’re the right fit if you:

Have modernised a sales model and built a performance culture, not just inherited one

Make decisions based on pipeline visibility and customer insight

Are comfortable presenting at board level and managing complex client relationships

Want the autonomy to build and execute your own commercial vision

What makes this role different:

You’ll sit at the leadership table of a well-established KSA business with a full commercial mandate, a rare level of autonomy. Food safety and hygiene compliance is a priority across every regulated sector, so the market has real headroom. The package includes base salary, performance-linked bonus and executive benefits.

To apply, send your CV to contact@blacktieconsultancy.com with the subject line “Commercial Director - KSA”. All applications are handled in strict confidence.

**Description**
Tuwaiq Casting & Forging is seeking an organised and operationally focused Internal Logistics Coordinator to join the Production Control Department within the Operations Division. Reporting to the Manager, this role is responsible for managing the movement and staging of materials within the manufacturing facility, ensuring raw materials, components, and finished products are efficiently transferred between warehouses, production shops, packing areas, and storage locations to support uninterrupted manufacturing operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Coordinate the internal flow of products and by-products between departments, including melting, casting, forging, machining, heat treatment, NDE, painting, and packing areas
* Oversee the entire process of receiving, prioritising, and allocating requests for heavy machinery and internal transport equipment
* Ensure timely delivery of products and by-products to workplaces as requested, without delay
* Organise and track internal transport operations including forklifts, trucks, and trailers, ensuring all heavy machinery is operated safely and efficiently
* Prioritise and schedule internal transport in accordance with production urgency
* Monitor and evaluate individual team member performance and ensure proper timekeeping and attendance management
* Schedule and oversee routine and special heavy equipment maintenance; coordinate with external maintenance service providers in the event of major breakdowns
* Track and record all product and by-product transfers using Excel or relevant systems
* Prepare internal logistics documentation and maintain accurate system records
* Identify process improvement opportunities to streamline internal logistics and reduce waste or delays
* Adhere to all company policies and safety standards in all logistics activities.

**Requirements**
Education & Experience
  
  

* High school diploma or equivalent; technical or logistics education is preferred
* Minimum 5 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, or warehouse operations within the manufacturing sector.

Technical Competencies
  
  

* Familiarity with inventory management systems and ERP platforms
* Basic computer skills including Excel and data entry
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Strong leadership and communication skills
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously with high time efficiency

**Job Purpose:**

I&C Technician will carry out maintenance, installation, overhauling and modification activities on plant’s instrumentation and control systems and equipment in accordance with standard maintenance procedures, HSE guidelines and quality standards to attain effective functionality and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**I&C Maintenance**

* Carry out required routine preventative instrumentation and control maintenance work according to set schedule and ACWA NOMAC procedures to facilitate continuous operations.
* Monitor the physical condition of all systems and equipment in assigned plant and report non-conformances to Instrumentation and Control Engineer / Supervisor to facilitate effective maintenance of all ACWA NOMAC facilities as per set Quality/ HSE standards.
* Respond to instrumentation and control failures and implement corrective actions in adherence with procedures and guidelines to reduce downtime and maximize functionality of equipment.
* Troubleshoot using necessary tools and spare parts including diagnosis, dismantling, repair, part change, checking, cleaning and reassembly to validate that all instruments are well calibrated and in good working condition for smooth operations.
* Diagnose causes of malfunction or failure of operational equipment such as control valves, transmitters, etc. and take corrective measures in collaboration with Instrumentation and Control Engineer / Supervisor.
* Read and understand technical manuals, control diagrams and system diagrams and apply the knowledge to carry out maintenance and troubleshooting tasks, to prepare for the instrument and control maintenance to systems and equipment in the assigned area.
* Align, adjust and calibrate systems and equipment according to specifications and to maintain records of repairs, calibrations and tests.

**Documentation**

* Update the maintenance logbook and record details of work carried out including defaults, problems, various findings and conditions of all instrumentation and control systems to ensure timely availability of information and organized referencing.

**Health, Safety, Security & Environment**

* Adhere to all relevant health, safety, security and environmental procedures, instructions and controls so that the safety of employees and environmental compliance can be guaranteed.

**Minimum Qualifications, Experience, Requirements**
:

* Minimum of technical certificate / Associate’s Diploma in Instrument Engineering.
* 3-5 years’

Job Description – Data Engineer

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
**Work Location: KSA**
**Experience Required:**
Hands-on experience with Spark development, Informatica integration solutions, and enterprise data platforms.

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Data Engineer**
to build, configure, and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and consumption workloads on a modern on-premises lakehouse platform. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Spark-based development, enterprise data lake/lakehouse implementations, and Informatica-based integration solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines
* Build, optimize, and maintain Spark-based ETL/ELT workloads
* Develop and manage data models and datasets using Apache Iceberg tables
* Implement and support data integration workflows using Informatica
* Enable analytics and data consumption through Denodo, Starburst, and/or Dremio
* Develop secure, governed, and scalable data pipelines aligned with enterprise standards
* Support batch and near real-time data processing requirements
* Implement data quality, metadata management, and validation controls
* Collaborate with Platform Engineers on deployment, integration, and operationalization activities
* Support migration, testing, and production rollout initiatives
* Troubleshoot and optimize data pipeline performance, reliability, and scalability

Must-Have Skills

* Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala Spark)
* Apache Iceberg
* Informatica Data Integration
* MinIO Object Storage
* Denodo
* SQL and Data Modeling
* Data Warehousing Concepts
* ETL/ELT Development
* Git Version Control

Good-to-Have Skills

* Starburst and/or Dremio
* Data Governance and Metadata Management
* Data Quality Frameworks
* CI/CD for Data Pipelines
* Python
* Kafka or Streaming Technologies
* Lakehouse Architecture Patterns
* Experience with enterprise data lake and lakehouse implementations
* Performance tuning and optimization of large-scale data workloads

We are recruiting an A&D System Manager for a dedicated full-time team delivering accreditation at a major international multi-sport event. The role sits within our client's Accreditation function. It is based on site in Riyadh, KSA, and runs from ASAP until the end of December 2026, covering system readiness, event time and close-out.

* Run the A&D system provided by the Organising Committee as part of the Event Management System (EMS)
* Make sure the registration and accreditation data of every stakeholder group is accurate and secure
* Get the system tested, validated and fully ready before the event begins
* Keep the system live and supported across all venues during the event

The Electrical BIM Engineer will support the development, coordination, review, and management of electrical BIM models and related digital deliverables across design development, IFC readiness, shop drawing production, construction coordination, as-built development, AIM preparation, and digital handover.

The Electrical BIM Engineer will work under the guidance and reporting of the BIM Manager and closely with the Technical Engineering Team to ensure that electrical BIM information is accurate, coordinated, technically aligned, constructible, properly documented, and compliant with the project BIM Execution Plan, Model Development Standard, Level of Information Need, BIM QA/QC procedures, Common Data Environment workflows, and ABCC Technical Engineering requirements.

The Electrical BIM Engineer shall actively support BIM coordination, technical coordination, design coordination, electrical coordination, ELV/interface coordination, ICT package coordination including Building Management systems (BMS) and construction coordination meetings. The role shall present model issues clearly, explain electrical coordination constraints, support issue resolution, follow up assigned actions, and coordinate with relevant project stakeholders until closure.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented Survey Engineer to join our site-based Construction Supervision team on a major landmark development project in Riyadh.

  
  

The project comprises design, enabling, and main works for a large-scale destination development featuring several iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. Delivered under a client governance framework with stringent programme, quality, safety, and sustainability requirements, the Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) is responsible for providing independent, end-to-end supervision and management, ensuring that all works are completed, integrated, tested, commissioned, and handed over to support both successful operations and long-term legacy objectives.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Report to the Resident Engineer/Construction Director and act as the lead surveyor for all site surveying and setting‑out verification activities.
* Supervise and coordinate Parsons’ survey team and review the contractor’s survey work to ensure accuracy and compliance with project requirements.
* Verify the control points, benchmarks, and reference coordinates established by the contractor and ensure they are correctly related to the approved project datum and grid system.
* Check and confirm the contractor’s setting‑out for alignments, levels, coordinates, and dimensions for roads, utilities, structures, hardscape, landscape features, and other works.
* Conduct independent spot checks and surveys to confirm that constructed works are in accordance with approved drawings and tolerances.
* Review and comment on the contractor’s survey reports, layout drawings, as‑built surveys, and topographic surveys, ensuring consistency and completeness.
* Identify and report any discrepancies between design drawings and site conditions, and support the supervision team in resolving setting‑out issues.
* Coordinate survey activities with discipline engineers (roads, structures, wet and dry utilities, hardscape, landscape) to support interface and clash avoidance

* Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, security monitoring, access management, and threat mitigation.

* Ability to work collaboratively and respond effectively to security incidents.

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. **Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented Field Engineer to join our site-based Construction Supervision team on a major landmark development project in Riyadh.

The project comprises the design, enabling, and main works for a large-scale destination development featuring several iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. Delivered under a client governance framework with stringent programme, quality, safety, and sustainability requirements, the Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) is responsible for providing independent, end-to-end supervision and management, ensuring that all works are completed, integrated, tested, commissioned, and handed over to support both successful operations and long-term legacy objectives.

  
  

What You'll Be Doing

* Monitor and supervise construction activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements, and quality standards.
* Conduct regular site inspections and report on construction progress, quality, and safety performance.
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders to resolve technical and construction-related issues.
* Review method statements, inspection requests, material submissions, and work procedures.
* Verify that construction works are carried out in accordance with approved plans and applicable codes and standards.
* Assist in monitoring project schedules and identifying potential delays or risks.
* Maintain accurate site records, daily reports, and inspection documentation.
* Support testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and sustainability requirements.
* Assist the Resident Engineer and Construction Manager in the successful delivery of project objectives.
  

  

What Required Skills You'll Bring

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in construction supervision, inspection, or site engineering on major building or infrastructure projects

Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat (قدرات) and Tahsili (تحصيلي), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. **About Deloitte:**
When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.
  
  
**Our Purpose**
Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
  
  
Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:

* Serve with integrity
* Take care of each other
* Foster inclusion
* Collaborate for measurable impact

**Consultant - Manager,**

* Assess current cybersecurity posture and maturity against NCA ECC-2:2024, NIST CSF 2.0 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and produce the current-state and maturity assessment report
* Define the target state, vision and guiding principles, turning ambiguity into clear options and a recommended path, and author the cybersecurity strategy
* Benchmark against peer organisations of similar scale, regulated KSA entities and global leading practice

Design the operating model
  
  

* Design and document the target operating model: structure, roles, RACI, capability map, and the split between in-house, managed-service and outsourced work
* Define the interfaces between cybersecurity, IT, OT, risk, legal, procurement and the business

* Build the 3–5 years roadmap of costed initiatives, prioritized by risk reduction, regulatory need and cost, and keep it realistic for what the organisation can actually deliver, not a textbook ideal
* Prepare business cases, the investment profile and the annual budget input, linking security spend clearly to business value and risk reduction
* Track roadmap delivery and benefits; re-prioritize as development plan

job_description:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated IT Administrator to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the company's IT infrastructure, providing technical support to employees, maintaining network and system security, and ensuring the smooth operation of all IT systems.

The candidate should have good technical knowledge of hardware, software, networking, and SQL databases, along with strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and maintain computer hardware, software, and IT peripherals.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues.
* Provide technical support to employees and resolve IT-related problems.
* Manage user accounts, access permissions, and IT systems.
* Maintain and troubleshoot company networks, routers, switches, and Wi-Fi connections.
* Ensure the security and integrity of company data and IT infrastructure.
* Implement and manage data backup and disaster recovery procedures.
* Manage and maintain SQL databases, perform basic SQL queries, and assist with database troubleshooting.
* Monitor database performance and support data backup and restoration activities.
* Maintain IT asset records, system documentation, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Train employees on the proper use of IT systems and software.
* Identify potential IT security risks and take appropriate preventive measures.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as an IT Administrator or in a similar IT support role.
* Strong knowledge of computer hardware, software, networking, and IT security.
* Experience with Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL and database management.
* Familiarity with SQL Server, MySQL, or other database systems.
* Knowledge of data backup, recovery, and network troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with team members.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft 365, Windows Server, and user account management.
* Knowledge of Active Directory and network administration.
* Experience managing SQL databases and writing basic SQL queries.
* Ability to handle multiple IT support requests and prioritize tasks effectively.

About Al-Futtaim  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. You will be part of a busy warehouse operations team, working closely with colleagues and different stakeholders to support smooth and efficient day-to-day operations.

**What equips you for the role**  
The ideal candidate will have relevant experience in warehouse administration, logistics, or supply chain operations. You should be organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling documentation

Kazmeh Engineering Specialties Company is seeking an Office Administrator to manage daily office operations at our KSA office. This role is responsible for overseeing administrative functions, coordinating office workflow, and providing support to the contracting and technical services teams. The position reports to the Operations Manager.

* Manage daily office operations including correspondence, filing, and document management
* Maintain organized filing systems for client files, contracts, project documents, and office records

* Schedule appointments, meetings, and coordinate calendars for management and technical staff

* Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for office maintenance and supplies

* Perform general clerical duties including photocopying, scanning, and filing

* High school diploma or equivalent; diploma or certificate in Business Administration or related field is preferred
* Minimum 2 years of experience in an administrative, clerical, or office support role, preferably in a construction, engineering, or technical services environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Arabic is required
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively
* Professional demeanor and ability to maintain confidentiality
* Reliable and punctual with consistent attendance

job_description:
WSP is seeking an experienced Quantity Surveyor (MEP) to join our team on a major infrastructure construction supervision project in Madinah. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing all MEP quantity surveying activities, including measurement, valuation, cost control, payment certification, and variation assessment across a complex infrastructure environment.

Working closely with the Resident Engineer, Construction Supervision Team, Contractors, and Client representatives, the Quantity Surveyor (MEP) will play a key role in ensuring accurate commercial administration and contract compliance throughout the project lifecycle.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and verify MEP-related quantities based on approved drawings and project specifications.
* Perform quantity take-offs, measurements, remeasurements, and quantity verification for infrastructure works.
* Evaluate and assess variations, change orders, claims, and additional works in accordance with contract requirements.
* Review contractors' interim payment applications and provide recommendations for certification.
* Monitor project costs and ensure compliance with approved budgets and contractual provisions.
* Verify completed work on site and coordinate with engineering and supervision teams regarding progress and measurements.
* Review Bills of Quantities (BOQ), specifications, preambles, and contract documents to ensure accurate valuation of works.
* Prepare cost estimates and quantity reports as required by the project.
* Maintain records of measurements, payment certificates, variation orders, and cost reports.
* Assist in the preparation of commercial correspondence and contractual documentation.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to resolve commercial and technical issues related to MEP works.
* Ensure all quantity surveying activities comply with project procedures, contract conditions, and industry best practices.

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7–10 years of Quantity Surveying experience in tunnel and infrastructure projects, preferably on major infrastructure projects.
* Strong multidisciplinary MEP knowledge covering:
  + HVAC Systems
  + Fire Fighting Systems
  + Electrical Systems (HV/MV/LV)
  + ELV Systems
  + Telecommunications
  + SCADA Systems
  + Wet Utilities including Potable Water, Sewerage, Stormwater, and Irrigation Networks.
* Proven experience in q

We are seeking a highly experienced
**Senior Network Engineer (SRv6)**
to join our team of networking subject matter experts. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing complex, carrier-grade network infrastructures, with a strong focus on Segment Routing (SR) and Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) to enhance network scalability, performance, and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and architect end-to-end network solutions leveraging Segment Routing (SR) and SRv6 protocols.
* Lead migration strategies from traditional MPLS architectures to modern SRv6-based environments.
* Oversee the deployment, configuration, and optimization of high-scale routing platforms across multi-vendor environments.
* Analyze network performance, conduct capacity planning, and ensure optimal network reliability and efficiency.
* Troubleshoot complex network latency, path selection, routing, and connectivity issues.
* Implement advanced traffic engineering solutions to optimize network paths and resource utilization.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior network engineers.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex network design and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align network architecture with business and service requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  10+ years of comprehensive experience in advanced network routing and infrastructure.
* **Routing Protocols:**
  Strong expertise in BGP, OSPF, and IS-IS.
* **Segment Routing:**
  Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience implementing, managing, and troubleshooting Segment Routing technologies.
* **SRv6:**
  At least 1 year of dedicated, hands-on experience designing and deploying SRv6 in production environments.
* **Certifications:**
  Must hold a current CCDP (Cisco Certified Design Professional) or CCIE (Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert) certification.
* **Troubleshooting:**
  Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex network performance, latency, pathing, and connectivity issues.
* **Network Architecture:**
  Experience designing and optimizing large-scale, carrier-grade network infrastructures.

**Desired Skills**

* Knowledge of network automation and programmability using Python, Ansible, NETCONF, and YANG.
* Strong understanding of Traffic Engineering (TE) and Network Slicing.
* Experience with multi-vendor routing platforms and next-generation networking technologies.

**About the Role**

Cognitive Force is looking for an experienced Lead Generation Specialist to generate qualified opportunities for Odoo implementation, support, dedicated developers, and Cognitive AI automation solutions. **Key Responsibilities**

* Experience targeting UAE or Saudi Arabian businesses is preferred.
* Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and availability during GCC business hours.

**Description**
We are looking for an Operations Tech SME to support high-growth, technology-enabled operations. In this role, you will act as the bridge between Operations, Product, and Tech teams to ensure smooth launches, stable system workflows, and exceptional customer experience. You will troubleshoot system issues, validate operational accuracy, and support process readiness to enable successful day-one performance for new sites or products.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Lead operational readiness and support launch activities, ensuring workflows, tools, and processes function as expected.
  
  

* Diagnose and troubleshoot system issues by working closely with Tech, Product, and Operations teams.
* Conduct structured testing, validate process accuracy, and identify gaps before launch.
* Support data validation related to operational workflows and customer-facing promises.
* Coordinate with cross-functional partners to resolve defects and ensure readiness for go-live.
* Monitor performance post-launch, escalate issues, and drive timely root-cause resolution.
* Identify recurring patterns, propose long-term fixes, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders, providing timely updates, documentation, and status reports.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration
* 1+ years of technical support work, engineering or operations environment experience
* Experience performing data analysis using MS Excel and other Microsoft Office tools
* Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in technical support work, engineering, or an operations environment
* Understanding of workflow testing, UAT processes, or structured defect validation
* Ability to analyze root causes, identify patterns, and recommend long-term improvements
* Experience working with product, tech, or last-mile/fulfillment teams
* Strong problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership

job_description:
Our Summer Internship Programme is an eight-week internship taking place June through August.
  
  
This programme is designed to provide students with a challenging, meaningful and supportive internship experience that replicates, as closely as possible, the experience of being a full-time BlackRock Analyst. The programme begins with an orientation that offers a thorough overview of the firm and the opportunity to hear from a number of senior leaders.
  
  
Following orientation, interns receive on-the-job training and are given day-to-day responsibilities to contribute to their teams throughout the summer. Programming also features a speaker series, mentoring and various networking opportunities, including activities with our employee networks.
  
  
If you enjoy this programme, you should explore our Full-Time Analyst Programme, which you can consider applying to after your internship.
  
  
**Who can apply:**
Candidates should be in their penultimate year of studies and graduating from an undergraduate or a master’s
  
  
degree program in 2028. We welcome applications from candidates studying any degree subject.
  
  
Please note local language fluency is required to work at our Continental Europe locations. However, only English is required for Budapest or for a position within Private Markets Investing in Zurich
  
  
**Important**
Candidates can apply for
**only one programme**
(e.g., Summer Internship Programme
**or**
Quantitative Master’s Internship Programme) and
**up to two functions within that programme**
(e.g., Investment Research and Analytics & Modeling). You must apply for both opportunities using the same programme application.
  
  
If you withdraw your application, you cannot submit another application this program this year.
  
  
**Next Steps**
Once you submit your application, you will receive an email to complete a pre-interview assessment. You have up to five days to submit your pre-interview assessment; if you fail to do so, your application will be automatically withdrawn.
  
  
**Application Deadlines**

* London - 30 September 2026
* Edinburgh, Milan, Amsterdam, Paris, Zurich – 30 October 2026
* Budapest, Belgrade, Frankfurt, Munich, Copenhagen – 13 November 2026
* Abu Dhabi, Kuwait, Riyadh – 31 January 2027

Opportunities in the following business area will close on 30 October 2026:
  
  

* Financial Markets Advisory - London

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis so we encourage you to apply early.

Who We Are
  
  
At BCG Platinion, we close the gap between strategy and technology. We design and build AI tech strategies, AI solutions, and next-generation platform architectures that turn ambition into execution, turning buzzwords into a true business engine and real competitive advantage.
  
  
Working at the intersection of boardroom strategy and hands-on tech delivery, we help leading organizations tackle their toughest challenges, with access to C-suite leaders and the unmatched resources of BCG.

* Functional knowledge: Solid grasp of typical end-to-end business processes (for example Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Lead-to-Quote, Record-to-Report, Hire-to-Retire) and how they are implemented

1. **Location:**
   Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Company**
**Industry :**
Transportation & Logistics Sector

We are a leading company in the transportation and logistics sector, seeking a seasoned Financial Director with 15+ years of progressive finance experience — ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-intensive industries — to lead our finance function and drive financial strategy across our diversified operations

.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning process

* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management

**Company Description**
LogeMate is a Saudi-born, end-to-end logistics ecosystem that helps growing enterprises, e-commerce brands, and 3PL providers across the Kingdom simplify complex operations and scale effectively. Backed by over 25 years of hands-on operational expertise and closely aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, LogeMate connects strategic advisory, physical infrastructure, and rapid procurement in one integrated platform. The company operates across three core pillars: flexible warehousing and space solutions, logistics advisory and warehouse optimization, and smart e-procurement for mission-critical equipment and materials. By supporting everything from network design and dock-to-stock flow optimization to floor-level tools and technology integration, LogeMate serves as a single accountable partner for building faster, smarter, and more resilient supply chains.

**Role Description**
The Operations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, responsible for overseeing day-to-day logistics and warehousing activities across LogeMate’s operational pillars. This role manages operational workflows, monitors performance metrics, and ensures efficient utilization of warehouse space, equipment, and staffing. The Operations Manager coordinates with internal teams and external partners to optimize processes, resolve operational issues, and maintain high standards of safety, quality, and compliance. Key responsibilities include implementing best practices for inventory management, supervising inbound and outbound flows, supporting technology and systems integration, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The role also involves forecasting operational needs, supporting strategic projects aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, and providing clear reporting and insights to senior leadership.

**Qualifications**

* Strong operations management skills across logistics, warehousing, and supply chain oversight, including hands-on experience in 3PL or e-commerce environments.
* Proficiency in process optimization, performance analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks).
* Experience with logistics technologies and systems, such as Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), and inventory tracking tools.
* Ability to manage cross-functional teams, coordinate with stakeholders, and communicate clearly across operational, technical, and leadership levels.
*

**Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.**

**Total Annual Package:**
Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)

**Location:**
Remote (Global)

**Growth path from here is fluid:**
all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P&L ownership. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

**We've been AI-first since December 2023:**
Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.

**Role Overview:**

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi-million-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.

This role exists to convert a multi-million-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day-to-day executive involvement.

**The Problems You'll Own:**

* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:**
  A multi-million-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.

* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:**
  Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day-to-day executive oversight.

**The Career Accelerator:**

This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.

* **The scope is scarce**
  : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi-million-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:**

Location: Khobar, Saudi Arabia
  
  
Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.
  
  
For over 50 years, Thales has been a trusted partner of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. As a local industrial partner, Thales provides advanced solutions in Defence, Public Security, Civil Aviation, Space, Enterprise, and Cybersecurity across four sites throughout the country. The Saudi Vision 2030 is at the heart of Thales' strategy in the Kingdom, driving the localisation of defence technologies and systems, strengthening local capabilities, developing local talent, and supporting national sovereignty through strategic collaborations. About the Role

Tatal is looking for a DevSecOps / Cloud Engineer to own our production infrastructure and make sure everything we ship is secure, reliable, and properly monitored.

• Design secure cloud architecture, including networking, VPCs, firewalls, and access controls

• Deploy and secure Docker containers

• Enforce IAM and least-privilege access

• Manage secrets and environment variables securely

• Set up logging, monitoring, alerting, and audit trails

• Own backups, disaster recovery, and production reliability

• Integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines

Requirements

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Alibaba Cloud

• Solid experience with Terraform or similar IaC tools

• Experience with Docker and container security

• Strong understanding of cloud networking and IAM

Nice to Have

• Experience with Cloudflare, WAF, and DDoS protection

About the Role

Tatal is looking for an Application Security Engineer to make sure our applications are secure before they reach production. You'll work closely with our engineering teams to build security into every stage of the development lifecycle.

• Perform SAST, DAST, dependency, and vulnerability scanning

• Proven experience securing modern SaaS and web applications

• Hands-on experience with SAST/DAST and dependency scanning tools

• Strong understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT)

• Solid knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and API security best practices

• Ability to work with development teams and explain risks clearly

Nice to Have

• Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines

• Security certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT)**

job_description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.
  
  
**Reimagine What’s Possible**
NEOM Green Hydrogen Project is part of the most complex capital project and a flagship project at scale for Air Products. Air Products is executing a EPC Contract with the customer – NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC). Air Products have the responsibility to design, build and delivery Process Controls / Process Automation System and IT/Digital Technology infrastructure scope. This scope shall comply with the local laws and regulations on cybersecurity, which is a crucial part in the project’s safety, security and overall compliance.
  
  
The incumbent in this position based at project site, as ICS Cyber Security Engineer, plays a key member of a Cybersecurity task force team to undertake the field verification of the cyber assets to comply with the project specifications and the site acceptance criteria.
  
  
The Engineer is also responsible for coordinating with Engineering, Pre-Commissioning, Commissioning and Client operations team related to Cyber Security field verifications.
  
  
The Cyber Security engineer acts as the technical interface between Air Products project execution, commissioning teams and the vendors, during the field verification of cyber assets.
  
  
Experience in supporting large scale construction, pre commissioning, commissioning, startup and handover phases, ensuring cybersecurity controls are implemented without impacting schedule critical activities
  
  
The position is based out of Duba, Tabuk Region, Saudi Arabia working on rotation of 8 Weeks ON / 2 Weeks OFF.
  
  
**The position will be a site-based role with the below duties:**

* Perform the field verification of the design, implementation and testing of the cyber assets to meet the cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements and technologies, processes/procedures and specifications to transition the project assets to commissioning, start-up and final handover to the client.
* Develop, document, and maintain cybersecurity asset register and other key deliverables as guided by the Site Cyb

**MS Dynamics 365 F&O Application Support**
 professional to join our IT team. In this role, you will be responsible for providing functional and technical support for our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment. You will act as the first point of contact for end-users, troubleshooting system issues, managing user access, and ensuring the stability of critical financial and operational processes. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of D365 F&O modules (Finance, Supply Chain, Retail) and excellent problem-solving skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Application Support & Troubleshooting**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for end-users experiencing issues with D365 F&O (Tier 1 & Tier 2 support).

* Manage user access, security roles, and permissions within D365 F&O.
* Perform routine system maintenance tasks, including data integrity checks, configuration updates, and environment refreshes.
* Assist in the deployment of patches, updates, and hotfixes to the D365 F&O environment.
* Maintain and update support documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**Business Process Support**

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional D365 F&O configurations.
* Assist with month-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring system readiness and resolving any related issues.

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement and system optimization.

**Data Management & Reporting**

* Assist with data imports, exports, and migrations using Data Management Framework (DMF) or Excel Add-in.
* Support the creation and maintenance of financial and operational reports (e.g., Power BI, SSRS, Management Reporter).

Parsons is looking for a capable
**Traffic Signal & ITS Field Support Engineer**
to join our team supporting a major traffic management and Intelligent Transportation Systems program in Riyadh. In this role you will
**develop and review the procedures, standards, and documentation that govern how traffic signal and ITS field equipment is installed, maintained, tested, and operated, and you will provide technical support and quality oversight of field activities carried out by contractors and maintenance teams.**

* Reviews monitoring and performance data from central management and dashboard platforms to assess field performance, recurring faults, and maintenance effectiveness.
* Supports planning, coordination, and tracking of field activities and work orders, following up outstanding items to closure and reporting on status and quality.

job_description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Finance Transformation & Procurement Manager to lead procurement and finance transformation engagements for Consulting clients in the public sector.

The role sits within a professional services environment, and the incumbent will be accountable for designing procurement operating models, governance frameworks and finance processes; as well as leading their implementation. The role combines hands-on delivery with client advisory and team leadership.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end finance and procurement transformation engagements, from current-state assessment and target operating model design through to implementation.
* Design and roll out procurement strategies, policies, procedures and governance frameworks aligned with client objectives and applicable.
* Manage the full source-to-contract cycle: procurement planning, RFP/RFQ development, tender evaluation, supplier selection, negotiation and contract award.
* Draft, review and manage contracts, ensuring commercial, legal and financial compliance.
* Build supplier relationship and performance management frameworks, including evaluation criteria and performance-based KPIs.
* Develop KPIs, dashboards and management reporting to track procurement performance, savings and compliance.
* Standardise templates, approval matrices and operating procedures across businesses.
* Identify and mitigate procurement, supplier and contractual risks.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, presenting findings and recommendations to executive leadership.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience and Background**

* 10+ years in procurement, supply chain and/or finance transformation, with at least 3–5 years in a management role.
* Proven experience in a consulting environment.
* Track record of leading large-scale, multi-stakeholder programmes, including procurement for major projects or events.
* Demonstrated results in cost savings, process efficiency and governance implementation.
* Experience across GCC markets is an advantage; knowledge of local procurement regulations is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Engineering, Supply Chain or a related field; a master's degree is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Strategic sourcing, tendering and supplier evaluation.
* Contract management and commercial negotiation; familiarity with standard contract forms is a plus.
* Procurement governance, policy and procedure design.
* Finance process

**Trade & Commercial Operations Specialist**

📍
**Location:**
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

💼
**Experience:**
2+ years

🕒
**Employment Type:**
1 year Extendable contract | 5 days per week

We are looking for a detail-oriented professional to join our client team and support trade operations, supply chain activities, tendering, and commercial operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Supply Chain & Trade Operations**

* Support Supply & Demand Planning activities, including the recording and tracking of related data.
* Manage inventory levels and support Inventory Management processes.
* Manage the Purchase Order (PO) to invoice lifecycle: raising, amending, and tracking POs with distributors, and resolving logistics deviations in documentation such as pricing, batch, and quantity discrepancies.
* Set up and maintain prices and master data.
* Perform deep-dive analysis of information and data to support Trade Operations activities.
* Escalate process or product deviations to the Trade Operations Senior Manager to ensure timely corrective action and mitigation across supply processes, inventory levels, requests for quotations, and returns.
* Record deviations from standard processes in the designated tracker, covering shipping and supply processes, inventory management, product complaints, and returns.
* Drive Operational Excellence and process improvement initiatives across Trade Operations.

**Tendering & Request for Quotations (RFQs)**

* Ensure timely submission of all Requests for Quotation (RFQs).
* Manage tender submissions end to end and track tender performance.

**Commercial Operations Support**

* Support and coordinate activities related to the Senior Director, Commercial Operations, including POs, invoicing, and budget reconciliation.
* Provide administrative and organizational support to the Senior Director, including travel arrangements and presentation preparation.

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in supply chain, trade operations, or operations support is preferred.
* Solid computer skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy when working under high transaction volumes and tight deadlines.
* Detail-oriented with a strong customer service orientation in supply planning.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills to support governance, audit, and archiving requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally and manage stakeholders effectively.

FundRock is a Pan-European leading independent UCITS management company and AIFM (Alternative Investment Fund Manager). Our clients are established blue-chip companies and leaders in their domestic market.
  
  
We invest in our people, enabling you to develop your skills and build on your experience.
  
  
If you like the idea of working for an ambitious and growing company, as part of a multicultural team, we are the place for you.
  
  
**Role Location: KSA**
Department: Fund Services
  
  
Reporting Line: Senior Fund Accountant
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time

* Deliver comprehensive support to Fund Services teams by contributing across different roles, ensuring operational efficiency and meeting dynamic business demands. Reviewing work performed by offshore teams and ensure its accuracy.

* Ensuring all work undertaken complies with the respective fund’s terms and conditions, relevant regulatory requirements and anti-money laundering regulations.

* Strong Educational Background, preferably accounting or Finance.

* Proactive and willing to drive things forward.
* An ability to work to and meet agreed deadlines.
* Flexible in work approach due to nature of the role to meet client deliverables.
* Excellent interpersonal and written communications skills.
* Ability to multi-task and work in a pressurised environment.
* Capacity to problem-solve and ability to deal with complex issues.

**What you will get in return:**

Amana Light, part of RWAZEN Group, is an established provider of comprehensive indoor and outdoor lighting solutions in the Saudi market, operating from its main branch in Riyadh. The company specializes in end-to-end lighting systems, offering products and services tailored to each client’s functional and aesthetic needs. Amana Light focuses on delivering high-quality, reliable, and innovative lighting solutions that enhance built environments and user experiences. Its client-centered approach emphasizes thoughtful design, technical excellence, and long-term service relationships.

**Role Description**

The Senior Lighting Designer will be responsible for leading the design and development of advanced lighting concepts for interior and exterior projects, ensuring alignment with architectural intent and client requirements. Day-to-day tasks include creating detailed lighting plans, specifying fixtures and control systems, producing technical drawings and documentation, and coordinating with architects, interior designers, engineers, and project managers. The role involves reviewing project requirements, conducting lighting calculations and simulations, preparing presentations and visualizations, and providing guidance to junior designers. The Senior Lighting Designer will also participate in design reviews, support client meetings, and contribute to continuous improvement of design standards and best practices. This is a full-time remote role.

* Candidates should possess practical experience in Lighting Control and overall Lighting systems.
* Candidates should possess a solid foundation in Interior Design and its integration with lighting concepts.

* Proficiency with lighting design software and tools (e.g., Dialux, Relux, Revit, AutoCAD) and familiarity with applicable lighting standards and codes.
* Excellent visual, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present design ideas to stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a remote environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Lighting Design, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or a related field; advanced certifications in light

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Plastic Recycling Machine Operator with practical experience operating plastic recycling machinery, particularly LDPE, LLDPE, and HDPE plastic recycling processes. The successful candidate will be responsible for operating production equipment, monitoring production quality, troubleshooting machine issues, and ensuring safe and efficient factory operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Operate and monitor plastic recycling machines and production lines.
* Handle plastic recycling processes, including shredding, crushing, drying, and extrusion/pelletizing.
* Adjust machine settings to maintain production efficiency and product quality.
* Monitor production output and ensure recycled plastic pellets meet quality standards.
* Identify and troubleshoot machine malfunctions and production issues.
* Perform routine machine cleaning, inspections, and preventive maintenance.
* Follow workplace safety procedures and maintain a clean production area.
* Coordinate with the production team to achieve daily production targets.
* Report machine faults, production delays, and material quality issues to the supervisor.

Requirements

* Previous hands-on experience operating plastic recycling machines is required.
* Practical knowledge of LDPE, LLDPE, and HDPE recycling is preferred.
* Experience with plastic extruders, and pelletizing machines is an advantage.
* Ability to identify machine problems and make basic operational adjustments.
* Knowledge of production quality control and industrial safety procedures.
* Ability to work shifts and meet production targets.
* Strong commitment to safety, teamwork, and equipment care.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in industrial plastic recycling factories and recycled plastic pellet production will be given priority.

**To Apply:**
 Please submit your CV detailing your previous experience with plastic recycling machinery and the types of machines you have operated.
