**Job Title CCR Operator**
**Job location (Department/Plant) Operations**
**Reporting to Shift Supervisor/Shift Charge Engineer**
**Job Summary**
- Monitor and control of the Unit/plant Operation parameters and coordinate with the other Operators in regard to all related activities that affect operation.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
1 Comply with safety rules and regulations. Be familiar with the fire equipment in his area.
  
  
2 Familiar with plant P&IDs, SOPs, Work instructions, Operation and control logics as well as the emergency operation procedures and any other related documents.
  
  
3 Monitor all parameters of the unit and enter periodic readings on log sheets. Summarize all activities/events that took place during his shift in the log book.
  
  
4 Follow the instructions of the Shift Charge Engineer and Shift Supervisor and coordinate
  
  
with other Operators in regard to all activities
  
  
5 Be alert and take quick actions during abnormal operating conditions.
  
  
6 Coordinate and ensure Lock Out & Tag Out during the isolation of equipment for maintenance as per the approved Permit To Work procedure. Normalize the equipment after cancellation when instructed to do so.
  
  
7 Inspect the unit and auxiliaries during the shift to make sure that all equipment parameters are within limits. Report abnormalities to the Shift Supervisor/ SCE.
  
  
8 Perform the periodic protection tests under the supervision of SCE/Supervisor and maintain records. Perform equipment change over according to preset schedules.
  
  
9 Raise work requests or defect notes for faulty equipment and follow up for the defect rectification
  
  
10 Assist in the training and familiarization of new operators.
  
  
11 Report near misses and implement prescribed risk controls.
  
  
12 Report deviations in Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Management System.
  
  
13 Ensure proper waste disposal measures.
  
  
14 Perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
**Job Specifications**
**Educational**
Desired Diploma in Engineering is a must.
  
  
**Experience**
Preferred Bachelor of Engineering.
  
  
Minimum 5 years in the same position.
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Generic awareness of Quality, Occupational Health & Safety and Environment Management system principles
* Knowledge of identification, classification and disposal of waste
* Knowledge of Emission Monitoring
* Knowledge of environmental and health impact of chemicals being used in the plant
* Knowledge

job_description:
**Who We Are**
Pronto AI is a global leader in commercializing autonomous vehicle (AV) technology, deploying Autonomous Haulage Systems (AHS) that automate operations in mines, quarries, and construction sites worldwide. While much of the industry remains in R&D, we deliver real, production-ready autonomy that is already operating in the field.
  
  
We are on a mission to make mining operations safer, smarter, and more efficient through cutting-edge technology, and we are building toward becoming the world’s first profitable AV technology company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Pronto is seeking a seasoned mining professional to lead our on-site deployments. As the Mining Engineer, you will be the bridge between Pronto’s cutting-edge technology and the customer’s day-to-day mining operations. You will be responsible for managing a high-performing technical team, ensuring the customer meets their infrastructure commitments, and delivering the project according to strict performance and safety criteria.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Project Delivery & Management**

* Success Criteria: Deliver projects to the agreed-upon performance metrics and success criteria, ensuring the autonomous system is integrated seamlessly into the mine’s production cycle.
* Team Leadership: Manage the local field team, overseeing permitting, scheduling, safety compliance, and overall work performance.
* Customer Management: Hold the customer accountable for their deliverables, including resource commitments, machine availability, and site/route/equipment readiness.

**Strategic Liaison**

* Primary Point of Contact: Act as the central communication hub between the customer site and Pronto HQ, providing regular progress reports and escalating technical or operational blockers.
* Process Integration: Work with customers to set up or modify existing operational processes to accommodate autonomous haulage.
* Handover & Training: Lead the customer training programs on Pronto technology and manage the formal handover of the system to the mine’s operations team.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Experience & Education**

* Mining Expertise: 15+ years of direct mining experience. You must be extremely comfortable and knowledgeable in a mine site environment, understanding the nuances of production and safety.
* Leadership Tenure: 5–10 years in a leadership role (e.g., Site Superintendent, Maintenance Manager, or Fleet Manager).
* Tech Rollout Experience: Proven track record of actively participating

job_description:
**Role Summary:**

The Senior Legal Counsel is responsible for providing strategic and operational legal advice to the 
  
organization on corporate, commercial, governance, compliance, regulatory and contractual matters. The role 
  
safeguards the Company's legal interests through proactive legal risk management, effective legal solutions 
  
and the provision of sound legal counsel that supports business objectives while ensuring compliance with 
  
applicable laws, regulations and governance requirements.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

• Provide independent legal advice and guidance to management and business functions on legal, 
  
commercial, governance, regulatory and operational matters.  
  
• Assess legal implications of strategic initiatives, business transactions, projects and corporate decisions.  
  
• Provide practical, business-oriented legal solutions while ensuring adequate legal risk mitigation. 
  
• Drafting, reviewing, revising and negotiating and execution of complex legal agreements and commercial 
  
transactions including M&A transactions and projects 
  
• Advise on contractual strategies and risk allocation mechanisms to protect the Company's legal and 
  
commercial interests.  
  
• Resolve contractual disputes and contractual interpretation issues. 
  
• Support corporate governance activities across the organization.  
  
• Support governance committees and management bodies by ensuring legal and regulatory compliance in 
  
governance matters.  
  
• Ensure the maintenance and integrity of corporate records and governance documentation. 
  
• Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting the organization and recommend appropriate 
  
actions.  
  
• Lead legal compliance reviews and assessments.  
  
• Support the development, implementation, and enhancement of legal compliance frameworks, policies, 
  
and procedures.  
  
• Identify, assess and manage legal risks associated with business operations, contracts, transactions and 
  
organizational initiatives.

• Support enterprise risk management activities relating to legal and regulatory exposures. 
  
• Manage legal disputes, claims, investigations and litigation matters.  
  
• Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, regulators and other external 
  
parties.  
  
• Promote legal awareness and best practices across the organization. 
  
• Contribute to the development of legal policies, frameworks, standards and procedures.

job_description:
Job Title CCR Operator
  
  
Job location (Department/Plant) Operations
  
  
Reporting to Shift Supervisor/Shift Charge Engineer
  
  
Job Summary - Monitor and control of the Unit/plant Operation parameters and coordinate with the other Operators in regard to all related activities that affect operation.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
1 Comply with safety rules and regulations. Be familiar with the fire equipment in his area.
  
  
2 Familiar with plant P&IDs, SOPs, Work instructions, Operation and control logics as well as the emergency operation procedures and any other related documents.
  
  
3 Monitor all parameters of the unit and enter periodic readings on log sheets. Summarize all activities/events that took place during his shift in the log book.
  
  
4 Follow the instructions of the Shift Charge Engineer and Shift Supervisor and coordinate
  
  
with other Operators in regard to all activities
  
  
5 Be alert and take quick actions during abnormal operating conditions.
  
  
6 Coordinate and ensure Lock Out & Tag Out during the isolation of equipment for maintenance as per the approved Permit To Work procedure. Normalize the equipment after cancellation when instructed to do so.
  
  
7 Inspect the unit and auxiliaries during the shift to make sure that all equipment parameters are within limits. Report abnormalities to the Shift Supervisor/ SCE.
  
  
8 Perform the periodic protection tests under the supervision of SCE/Supervisor and maintain records. Perform equipment change over according to preset schedules.
  
  
9 Raise work requests or defect notes for faulty equipment and follow up for the defect rectification
  
  
10 Assist in the training and familiarization of new operators.
  
  
11 Report near misses and implement prescribed risk controls.
  
  
12 Report deviations in Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Management System.
  
  
13 Ensure proper waste disposal measures.
  
  
14 Perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
**Job Specifications**
**Educational**
1- Desired Diploma in Engineering is a must.
  
  
**Experience**
2- Preferred Bachelor of Engineering.
  
  
Minimum 5 years in the same position.
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Generic awareness of Quality, Occupational Health & Safety and Environment Management system principles
* Knowledge of identification, classification and disposal of waste
* Knowledge of Emission Monitoring
* Knowledge of environmental and health impact of chemicals being used in the plant
* K

Job Purpose

The Lean Transformation Supervisor leads end-to-end process improvement engagements across SRG and its subsidiaries. The role takes real operational problems from definition and root cause through to implemented, controlled solutions, delivering measurable improvements in time, cost and quality. The incumbent designs and documents target-state processes, policies and procedures that the business adopts, embeds sound internal controls, and builds continuous improvement capability within the teams they support.

Key Responsibilities

1. Process Improvement Delivery

* Lead multiple improvement engagements simultaneously, from scoping and charter through to handover and sustainment.
* Apply structured problem solving (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) to diagnose operational issues and quantify their impact in time, cost and quality.
* Conduct root cause analysis using 5 Whys, fishbone, Pareto and FMEA, and apply error-proofing (poka-yoke) to prevent recurrence.
* Build baselines, set measurable targets and track realised benefits against them after implementation.
* Reject short-term workarounds in favour of solutions that hold up in real operations.

2. Process Design & Documentation

* Map current-state and target-state processes using swim-lane, SIPOC and value stream maps (BPMN preferred) in Visio.
* Draft and update SOPs, policies and procedures in English and Arabic, ensuring they are clear, practical and adopted by the business.
* Critically review existing policies, procedures, contracts and system reports to identify gaps, duplication and inefficiencies.
* Align process designs with ERP/HCM system workflows and identify automation and AI opportunities.

3. Internal Controls & Governance

* Design and embed controls within processes, applying the IIA Three Lines Model, COSO and risk and control matrices.
* Support the closure of internal and external audit findings through sustainable process changes.
* Ensure redesigned processes include clear ownership, approval points and performance monitoring.

4. Data Analysis & Reporting

* Extract and analyse data from ERP and other systems using Excel (Power BI preferred) to establish baselines and validate improvements.
* Track engagement progress, benefits and KPIs, and report status and risks to Lean Transformation leadership.
* Use generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, documentation and reporting.

5. Stakeholder Engagement & Change

* Engage process owners and frontline team

job_description:
Autobia is a Saudi technology company founded in Dammam in 2021, building the ecosystem that supports the growth of the traditional retail sector — its most developed vertical to date being the auto parts market.

**We Hire Builders**

We hire builders who see themselves in the decisions, not just the tasks — and right now, we're looking for a
**Supplier Master Data Specialist**

to ensure the accuracy and integrity of our supplier pricing data.

In this role, you'll monitor compliance with agreed quotations, prepare accurate pricing files, and maintain parts and price master data in the system to support Sales and Procurement. You'll report to the Supplier Relations Manager and partner closely with Sales and Procurement to keep pricing clean, compliant, and up to date.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive, review, and format supplier quotations, ensuring they are free of calculation and typing errors before submitting them to the Supplier Relations Manager for approval.
* Conduct daily reviews of system prices against agreed supplier rates, and immediately flag any discrepancies or unapproved price changes.
* Update system prices based on newly approved supplier quotations.
* Upload prices, descriptions, and brand information for new parts into the system.
* Deactivate unavailable parts and keep catalog data complete and consistent.
* Analyze pricing data to identify trends, anomalies, and recurring supplier issues, and share insights with the Supplier Relations Manager.
* Respond to Sales and Procurement inquiries on pricing and part availability.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience in data analysis, master data management, or pricing operations.
* Advanced Excel proficiency (formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data cleansing).
* Experience with ERP systems and master data / catalog management.
* Strong analytical skills for detecting price discrepancies and identifying data patterns.
* High attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work under pressure.
* Fluency in Arabic; good English proficiency for handling part descriptions and brands.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of auto parts or the automotive trade.

Nabeh is looking for an **AI Business, Analyst** to bridge enterprise business needs and AI implementations. JACO is looking for an Senior In-App Events & Campaigns Specialist to develop and manage interactive campaigns, competitions, and events that drive user engagement, participation, and revenue growth. The role involves event planning, coordination with cross-functional teams, launch execution, and performance analysis.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop creative concepts for in-app events and competitions aligned with user interests and business objectives.
* Design event scenarios, participation rules, scoring systems, rewards, timelines, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure smooth implementation and timely launches.
* Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) to verify event functionality, eligibility rules, rankings, and rewards.
* Monitor live events, address operational issues, and coordinate winner announcements and reward distribution.
* Analyze event performance, user engagement, spending, conversion, and revenue impact to identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare event reports and recommend improvements based on performance data and user feedback.
* Leverage AI tools to support event ideation, content creation, data analysis, and operational efficiency.

* At least 2 years of experience in social media applications, digital campaigns, event operations, user engagement, or revenue growth.
* Experience coordinating with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams.
* Understanding of gamification, user behavior, and in-app spending mechanics.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, project tracking tools, and data analysis.
* Ability to prepare operational plans, requirements documents, and performance reports.
* Proficiency in AI tools and the ability to evaluate their outputs effectively.
* Experience in live streaming, digital entertainment, or in-app purchases is preferred.
* A degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Creativity and strong problem-solving skills.
* Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Strong planning, organization, and time management.
* Effective communication and cross-functional coordination.

**Position Title:**
E-commerce Supervisor

**Location:**
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Role:**

Reef Group is seeking a results-driven E-commerce Supervisor to oversee the daily operations of its e-commerce platforms, ensure product and inventory accuracy, streamline order fulfillment, and enhance the online customer experience. The role will collaborate with warehouse, marketing, customer service, technical support, and logistics teams to improve operational efficiency and support online sales growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily e-commerce operations, ensuring product listings, pricing, content, and promotions are accurate and up to date.
* Manage product catalog updates and monitor inventory accuracy across online platforms and warehouse systems.
* Supervise the order lifecycle, from processing to shipment and delivery, ensuring timely fulfillment.
* Coordinate with warehouse teams, logistics partners, and payment providers to resolve operational issues.
* Monitor platform performance, payment functionality, shipment tracking, and order processing.
* Analyze product performance and customer behavior to identify opportunities for operational improvements and sales growth.
* Coordinate with the Marketing team to ensure platform readiness for campaigns, promotions, and seasonal events.

* Support process improvements and e-commerce platform development initiatives.

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in E-commerce, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.

* Knowledge of payment gateways, shipping integrations, ERP, and Order Management Systems (OMS).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.
* Fluency in Arabic and English.

**Required Skills**

* E-commerce Operations and Platform Management
* Product Catalog and Inventory Management
* Order Fulfillment and Logistics Coordination
* Performance Monitoring and Reporting
* Customer Experience Optimization
* ERP and Order Management

**مدير متجر إلكتروني (E-commerce Manager)**

هل لديك خبرة عميقة في التجارة الإلكترونية وسجل مثبت في تحقيق النمو؟

نبحث عن مدير متجر إلكتروني يقود عملياتنا الرقمية ويصنع فرقًا حقيقيًا في الأداء والإيرادات.

**عن الدور**

ستكون مسؤولًا عن قيادة وتشغيل وتطوير المتجر الإلكتروني بشكل متكامل، من العمليات اليومية إلى الاستراتيجيات طويلة المدى، مع تركيز واضح على نمو المبيعات وتحسين تجربة العملاء وتعظيم الكفاءة التشغيلية.

**المسؤوليات الرئيسية**

* إدارة وتشغيل المتجر الإلكتروني بكافة جوانبه (المنتجات، الطلبات، المخزون، الشحن).
* تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات نمو المبيعات وتحسين الأداء التجاري.
* تحليل البيانات واستخلاص رؤى تدعم اتخاذ القرار (Conversion، AOV، CAC، LTV).
* تحسين تجربة المستخدم ورفع معدل التحويل وتقليل التخلي عن السلة.
* الإشراف على قنوات التسويق الرقمي SEO، الإعلانات، وسائل التواصل، البريد الإلكتروني.
* إدارة فريق العمل والشركاء الخارجيين (تقنيين، شركات شحن، بوابات دفع).
* متابعة أداء المنصة وضمان استقرارها وتطويرها المستمر.

**المؤهلات المطلوبة**

* خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في إدارة المتاجر الإلكترونية أو التجارة الرقمية.
* سجل إنجازات مثبت في نمو المبيعات وتحقيق مؤشرات أداء قوية.
* خبرة في منصات التجارة الإلكترونية مثل سله و زد ، شوبيفاي وماجنتو.
* مهارات تحليلية قوية واتخاذ قرارات مبنية على البيانات.
* خبرة في إدارة الحملات التسويقية وتحسين العائد على الاستثمار (ROI).
* مهارات قيادية واتصالية عالية.

**سمات شخصية**

* عقلية قيادية تركز على النتائج.
* شغف بالتجارة الرقمية والتقنيات الحديثة.
* قدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة التغير.
* توجه نحو الابتكار والتحسين المستمر.

**أمثلة على الإنجازات المتوقعة**

* تحقيق نمو ملحوظ في المبيعات خلال فترة قصيرة.
* تحسين معدل التحويل وتجربة المستخدم بشكل ملموس.
* خفض تكلفة اكتساب العملاء وزيادة العائد على الاستثمار.

**طريقة التقديم**

إذا كنت ترى نفسك مناسبًا لهذا الدور وتمتلك الخبرة والإنجازات المطلوبة، يسعدنا استقبال سيرتك الذاتية مع أمثلة واضحة على إنجازاتك في التجارة الإلكترونية.

**انضم إلينا وكن جزءًا من رحلة نمو رقمية تصنع أثرًا حقيقيًا.**

Collaborate with integration, data, platform, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and engineering teams to enable scalable and reusable solutions.

**Overview**
------------

The Quality Engineer - MEP is responsible for ensuring that all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing installation works comply with project specifications, approved drawings, applicable codes and standards, client requirements, and quality management systems. The role supports quality planning, inspections, audits, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle.

**Your role**
-------------

**Quality Assurance & Control**

* Implement project quality plans, inspection and test plans (ITPs), and quality procedures for MEP works.
* Review method statements, material submittals, shop drawings, and technical specifications.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, industry standards, and company quality procedures.
* Monitor MEP installation activities to verify conformity with approved designs and standards.

**Inspection & Testing**

* Conduct inspections of mechanical, electrical, firefighting, HVAC, plumbing, and ELV installations.
* Witness testing and commissioning activities for MEP systems.
* Verify material quality and ensure approved materials are used on-site.
* Coordinate with consultants, clients, and subcontractors for inspections and approvals.

**Quality Documentation**

* Maintain inspection records, NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports), QA/QC reports, and test certificates.
* Prepare quality reports, inspection requests, and closeout documentation.
* Track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure timely resolution of quality issues.
* Assist in project handover documentation and final quality dossiers.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Participate in internal and external quality audits.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and other relevant quality management standards.
* Identify quality risks and recommend corrective measures.
* Promote quality awareness and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Coordination & Communication**

* Work closely with project managers, site engineers, consultants, and subcontractors.
* Support quality training and toolbox talks.
* Resolve technical quality issues and support root-cause analysis.

**About you**
-------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in QA/QC for MEP construction, infrastructure, industrial, or building projects.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, electrical systems, and testing & comm

We are looking for an experienced **Google Mandiant Administrator** with at least 4 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience to manage, operate, configure, and support Google Mandiant security solutions within a banking environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer, configure, monitor, and maintain Google Mandiant security solutions.
* Manage Mandiant Threat Intelligence and Security Validation capabilities.
* Monitor cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, and suspicious activities.
* Support threat detection, investigation, and incident response activities.
* Integrate Mandiant solutions with existing SIEM, SOC, EDR, and other security platforms.
* Perform regular security validation and identify gaps in security controls.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate with Google Mandiant support when required.
* Prepare security reports, operational documentation, and recommendations.
* Ensure compliance with banking security policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, IT, or a related field.
* **Minimum 4 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience.**
* Practical experience administering Google Mandiant solutions.
* Good knowledge of threat intelligence, threat hunting, and incident response.
* Experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, and security monitoring tools.
* Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Experience working in banking or financial services environments is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Google Cloud Security certifications.
* CompTIA Security+, CEH, or equivalent cybersecurity certifications.

**Preferred Candidate**

A technically strong cybersecurity engineer with proven hands-on Google Mandiant administration experience, capable of independently supporting day-to-day security operations in a banking environment.

job_description:
Role Overview
  
  
Lead
**Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Cybersecurity**
consulting engagements, helping clients protect critical industrial environments while maintaining
**safety, availability and operational resilience**
. The role combines deep OT/ICS cybersecurity expertise with consulting leadership, client advisory, delivery management and business development.
  
  
The OT Cybersecurity Manager will lead programs spanning
**OT security strategy, architecture, risk assessment, IT/OT convergence and security implementation**
across complex industrial and critical infrastructure environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  
- Lead end-to-end OT/ICS cybersecurity consulting engagements, from assessment and strategy through architecture, remediation and implementation.
- Assess and secure industrial environments including ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, HMI, engineering workstations, historians, industrial networks and connected IIoT assets.
- Lead OT cybersecurity maturity assessments, risk assessments, gap assessments and site-level security reviews.
- Develop OT cybersecurity strategies, transformation roadmaps, governance models and multi-year remediation programs.
- Design secure OT network architectures, including segmentation, security zones and conduits, industrial DMZs and controlled IT/OT connectivity.
- Advise clients on OT asset discovery and inventory, vulnerability management, secure remote access, privileged access, industrial network monitoring and endpoint protection.
- Lead the design and implementation of cybersecurity controls while ensuring solutions respect production availability, process safety and operational requirements.
- Develop OT incident response, monitoring and cyber-resilience capabilities, including integration between plant environments and enterprise security operations.
- Assess legacy industrial systems and develop practical risk-treatment approaches where patching, upgrading or replacing assets may be operationally constrained.
- Provide leadership on IT/OT convergence, ensuring enterprise cybersecurity controls are appropriately adapted for operational environments.
- Apply OT security standards and frameworks including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST guidance for ICS/OT environments.
- Lead multidisciplinary teams comprising OT security specialists, cybersecurity architects, engineers and consultants, ensuring delivery quality and client outcomes.
- Build trusted relationships with CISOs, CIOs, OT leaders, enginee

**Job Title**
"IT Security Engineer -Makkah Al-Mukarramah "
  
  
**Job Scope**
The IT Security Engineer is accountable for designing, building and enforcing policies and protocols that protect the organization’s computing infrastructure from all forms of threats. S/He provides the organization with advanced solution on cyber threats and helps create strategies to protect network from breaches.
  
  
**Main Duties And Responsibilities**

* 7+ years’ experience in technical support department
* Advanced expertise in configuring, managing, and troubleshooting firewalls (e.g.,Fortinet).
* Management of Web Application Firewalls (WAF) for protecting web applications from attacks (e.g. Forti WAF).
* Administration of enterprise-grade antivirus and endpoint protection solutions.
* Configuration, maintenance, and operation of email security gateways (e.g., FortiMail).
* Implementation and support of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) frameworks.
* Network Access Control (NAC) deployment and integration.
* Administration of centralized authentication systems (e.g., TACACS+, RADIUS).
* Advanced knowledge of intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS).
* Conducting security audits, vulnerability assessments, and compliance reporting.
* Proficient in cloud networking services such as VPN gateways, virtual network peering, and cloud firewalls.
* Preparing and maintaining technical documentation, including architecture diagrams and operational procedures.
* Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) in security
* Additional: certified in Fortinet NSE (5,6,7) and above.

**Position Requirements**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in IT, CE, CIS or related field
  
  
**Experience**
At least 7 years of relevant experience

job_description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.
  
  
**Reimagine What’s Possible**
NEOM Green Hydrogen Project is part of the most complex capital project and a flagship project at scale for Air Products. Air Products is executing a EPC Contract with the customer – NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC). Air Products have the responsibility to design, build and delivery Process Controls / Process Automation System and IT/Digital Technology infrastructure scope. This scope shall comply with the local laws and regulations on cybersecurity, which is a crucial part in the project’s safety, security and overall compliance.
  
  
The Cybersecurity Engineer – Renewable Power Sector is a senior technical competent individual contributor within the Project Cybersecurity Taskforce, responsible for assuring cybersecurity compliance, resilience, and safe operation of power generation and power transmission systems supporting large scale renewable energy assets (Solar PV, Wind Turbines, BESS, HV/MV substations, and grid interfaces).
  
  
The Engineer is also responsible for coordinating with Engineering, Pre-Commissioning, Commissioning and Client operations team related to Cyber Security field verifications.
  
  
The Cyber Security engineer acts as the technical interface between Air Products project execution, commissioning teams and the vendors, during the field verification of cyber assets.
  
  
Experience in supporting large scale construction, pre commissioning, commissioning, startup and handover phases, ensuring cybersecurity controls are implemented without impacting schedule critical activities
  
  
This position based out of Duba, Tabuk Region, Saudi Arabia working on rotation of 8 Weeks ON / 2 Weeks OFF.
  
  
**The position will be a site-based role with below duties:**

* Perform field verification and validation of cybersecurity design and implementation for renewable power generation and transmission assets, ensuring compliance with Saudi and international standards.
* Assure cybersecurity controls for Solar PV plants, Wind Turbine systems, BESS, HV/MV substat

job_description:
We are seeking a motivated
**Cyber Security Analyst**
to support the organization’s cyber security operations and protect systems, networks, applications, and information assets from security threats.

The role will support security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, risk and compliance activities, and implementation of security controls.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Monitor security alerts and identify potential cyber security threats and incidents.
* Support investigation, analysis, containment, and remediation of security incidents.
* Assist in day-to-day
  **SOC and security monitoring**
  activities.
* Perform or support vulnerability assessments and track remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
* Monitor and support security solutions such as
  **SIEM, firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint security/EDR, and antivirus solutions**
  .
* Assist with security risk assessments and identification of security gaps.
* Support implementation and maintenance of cyber security policies, procedures, and controls.
* Participate in internal and external security audits and compliance activities.
* Coordinate with IT, network, infrastructure, and application teams to resolve security issues.
* Maintain incident records, security reports, and vulnerability remediation status.
* Stay updated on emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and security technologies.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in
  **Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering**
  , or a related field.
* Cyber security certifications such as
  **CompTIA Security+, CEH, CCNA, Microsoft Security, or equivalent**
  are preferred.

Experience

* **1–4 years of relevant experience**
  in Cyber Security / Information Security.
* Experience or practical exposure in one or more of the following areas:
* Security Operations Center (SOC)
* SIEM / Security Monitoring
* Incident Response
* Vulnerability Management
* Endpoint Security / EDR
* Network Security
* Information Security Risk & Compliance
* Basic understanding of networking, operating systems, cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and common security controls.
* Fresh or junior professionals with strong hands-on cyber security exposure/certifications may also be considered.

job_description:
**About Deloitte:**
When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.
  
  
**Our Purpose**
Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
  
  
Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:
  
  

* Lead the way
* Serve with integrity
* Take care of each other
* Foster inclusion
* Collaborate for measurable impact

During your tenure as a
**Consultant - Manager,**
you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas.
  
  
**Assess and set direction**

* Assess current cybersecurity posture and maturity against NCA ECC-2:2024, NIST CSF 2.0 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and produce the current-state and maturity assessment report
* Define the target state, vision and guiding principles, turning ambiguity into clear options and a recommended path, and author the cybersecurity strategy
* Benchmark against peer organisations of similar scale, regulated KSA entities and global leading practice

Design the operating model
  
  

* Design and document the target operating model: structure, roles, RACI, capability map, and the split between in-house, managed-service and outsourced work
* Define the interfaces between cybersecurity, IT, OT, risk, legal, procurement and the business

**Build the roadmap and business case**

* Build the 3–5 years roadmap of costed initiatives, prioritized by risk reduction, regulatory need and cost, and keep it realistic for what the organisation can actually deliver, not a textbook ideal
* Prepare business cases, the investment profile and the annual budget input, linking security spend clearly to business value and risk reduction
* Track roadmap delivery and benefits; re-prioritize as development plan

job_description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.
  
  
**Reimagine What’s Possible**
NEOM Green Hydrogen Project is part of the most complex capital project and a flagship project at scale for Air Products. Air Products is executing a EPC Contract with the customer – NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC). Air Products have the responsibility to design, build and delivery Process Controls / Process Automation System and IT/Digital Technology infrastructure scope. This scope shall comply with the local laws and regulations on cybersecurity, which is a crucial part in the project’s safety, security and overall compliance.
  
  
The incumbent in this position based at project site, as ICS Cyber Security Engineer, plays a key member of a Cybersecurity task force team to undertake the field verification of the cyber assets to comply with the project specifications and the site acceptance criteria.
  
  
The Engineer is also responsible for coordinating with Engineering, Pre-Commissioning, Commissioning and Client operations team related to Cyber Security field verifications.
  
  
The Cyber Security engineer acts as the technical interface between Air Products project execution, commissioning teams and the vendors, during the field verification of cyber assets.
  
  
Experience in supporting large scale construction, pre commissioning, commissioning, startup and handover phases, ensuring cybersecurity controls are implemented without impacting schedule critical activities
  
  
The position is based out of Duba, Tabuk Region, Saudi Arabia working on rotation of 8 Weeks ON / 2 Weeks OFF.
  
  
**The position will be a site-based role with the below duties:**

* Perform the field verification of the design, implementation and testing of the cyber assets to meet the cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements and technologies, processes/procedures and specifications to transition the project assets to commissioning, start-up and final handover to the client.
* Develop, document, and maintain cybersecurity asset register and other key deliverables as guided by the Site Cyb

job_description:
**NEOM Green Hydrogen Company Limited (NGHC)**

NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC) is on a mission to make a carbon-free, climate-safe future a reality. We are building the world’s largest plant to produce green ammonia at scale, providing humankind with a cost-efficient solution that will accelerate the worldwide green hydrogen economy. Located in NEOM and supporting Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, NGHC will be integrating up to 4GW of onshore solar and wind energy to supply up to 650 tons of green ammonia per day for transportation globally. Operations will go onstream in 2026. NGHC brings together the technology, operational efficiency and know-how of ACWA Power, Air Products and NEOM in a joint-venture partnership with over 80 years of combined experience in the fields of hydrogen, energy, renewables and global networks.

**Position Title:**
System Dispatcher - EPMS

**Division: Power**
Transmission Operations

**Reports to:**
EPMS Supervisor

**Position Summary:**

The System Dispatcher – EPMS is responsible for the real-time monitoring and operation of the transmission and distribution network through EPMS and SCADA systems to ensure safe, reliable, and stable grid performance. The role supports daily control center operations, disturbance management, and coordination with generation, field, and maintenance teams to maintain uninterrupted power supply.

**Nature of Scope:**

Executes switching operations, responds to system events and emergencies, and takes immediate corrective actions to maintain system operating limits and grid stability. Collaborates with internal and external stakeholders while supporting troubleshooting, reporting, and continuous improvement of control center operations in compliance with applicable standards and regulations.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSBILITIES:**

•Monitor and control the real-time operation of the power system to maintain reliability and stability.

•Coordinate with generation, transmission, and interconnected entities to ensure seamless integration of renewable energy resources.

•Implement corrective actions to mitigate potential system disturbances and maintain grid stability & reliability.

•Coordinate emergency response efforts during system disturbances, outages, or extreme weather events.

•Implement contingency plans to restore system stability and minimize disruptions to electricity supply.

•Collaborate with internal teams, external stakeholders, and regulatory agencies to address emergency situation

We are looking for an experienced Investment Analyst with 5–7 years of experience in a family office, asset management firm, brokerage house, or bank.

Key Responsibilities:

Investment Analysis, Research, Financial Modeling & Valuation

o  Conduct financial analysis, due diligence, and valuation for investment opportunities (Public equity, Fixed Income, direct, co-investments, funds) and prepare and reports and memo for the board.

o  Perform valuation using comparable, precedent transactions, and sensitivity analysis.

o  Support transaction execution, including deal structuring, financial modeling, and investment committee presentations.

o  Monitor and manage existing portfolio investments, providing strategic recommendations.

o  Assist in market research, industry analysis, and identifying investment trends within KSA and broader GCC markets.

o  Ensure investments comply with policies, risk limits, and governance standards.

 

Portfolio Execution, Monitoring & Reporting

o  Work closely with senior management and external advisors on investment strategies and portfolio performance.

o  Support structuring, negotiations, and transaction documentation through closing.

o  On-line trading, management and reporting of GCC (mainly KSA) investments.

o  Accounting of investments (mainly public stocks & DPM) operation on Oracle and generating relevant reports.

o  Monitoring and recording of dividends and distribution of all the investments

o  Prepare periodic performance dashboards and management reports.

o  Monitoring the performance of advisory and discretionary mandates with asset managers.

Relationships Management, KYC update & Compliance.

o  Engaging with Bank and brokerage house relationship managers.

o  Updating of all KYC and compliance documents for all the Banks.

o  
Yearly Personal Zakat calculation for Board Members every Ramadan

 

Educations & Skills:

* English & Arabic (writing, reading & speaking) Proficiency is required.
* Bachelor or Master’s Degree Education in Finance, Economics or Business. CFA Candidacy
* 5 Year to 7 Years’ experience at the family office or Asset Management or Brokerage house or Bank.
* Working knowledge of Bloomberg, Refinitiv, etc.
* Knowhow of brokerage trading portals, Oracle/ERP data entry, reporting, & proficiency is excel & memo writing.
* Ability to manage multiple account, entities and deadlines.
* Integrity, confidentiality, and compliance

The primary role of the Warehouse Assistant includes the receiving and processing of incoming stock and materials, picking and filling orders from stock, packing and shipping orders and managing, organising, and retrieving stock in the warehouse.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Assist with receiving, unloading, counting, and stocking physical inventory in the warehouse.
* Open boxes, crates, and other containers
* Ensure orders are processed efficiently and that the delivery of materials meets customers’ expectations and business timelines.
* Pick items according to the Order form.
* Inspect items to ensure they’re not damaged or faulty and adjust inventory accordingly.
* Pack item according to specified packing guidelines
* Ship and fulfil customer orders in Inventory system, inputting appropriate tracking numbers and links.
* Maintain safe and clean work environment by keeping shelves, inventory space and workstations neat; sweep and vacuum.
* Always organize warehouse and work area for orderliness
* Wear the proper safety equipment.
* Constantly work to improve processes.
* Make suggestions for productivity improvements.
* Communicate and collaborate with other team members.
* Ensure that internal delivery processes are adhered to.
* Sustain the corrective actions to eliminate repeat issues.
* Monitor and maintain stock accuracy by ensuring physical stock is in line with the inventory management system and ensure all stock movements are recorded to ensure accuracy.
* Ability to be resilient, assertive, optimistic, and open to change

**Education/Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
High school degree or equivalent.
  
  
**Experience Required:**
3 Years of Experience.

Nabeh a subsidiary of Master Works, delivers AI-powered solutions that help organizations automate operations, boost efficiency, and drive innovation. Its expertise spans computer vision, LLM applications, speech-to-text, data intelligence, and low-code AI solutions.

Nabeh is looking for an
**AI Sales, Director**
growth for the company's AI products and solutions by building a qualified sales pipeline, winning strategic accounts, and expanding existing customer relationships. Translate customer business challenges into commercially viable AI opportunities while ensuring profitable deals and achievable delivery commitments.

****Key Responsibilities****

**Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth**

* Execute the AI sales strategy across target industries and accounts.
* Own revenue, bookings, and gross margin targets.
* Identify opportunities for AI software, platforms, implementation services, and recurring subscriptions.
* Lead account planning, territory allocation, and sales forecasting.

**Strategic Accounts & Business Development**

* Build relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, IT teams, and procurement stakeholders.
* Position AI solutions around measurable business outcomes, including productivity, cost reduction, service quality, and revenue growth.

* Review unsuccessful opportunities and POCs to improve qualification and resource allocation.

**Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Recruit, coach, and manage the AI sales team.
* Set individual targets and review performance, pipeline quality, and account development.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and reliable sales forecasts.
* Work with Marketing on demand generation and with Product on customer needs and market feedback.
* Ensure complete handovers to Delivery and Customer Success teams.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's

Senior AI Trainer
  
  
**Role Type:**
Contractor, Remote
  
  
**Location:**
North America, Latin America, Europe, UK, Oceania
  
  
We're seeking Senior AI Trainers to support a customer project focused on improving AI systems through expert-level video annotation and data labeling. You'll review robotic-arm footage, create precise annotations, and provide high-quality data to support AI model training. No prior AI experience is required.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Review robotic-arm videos and identify key actions, events, and outcomes.
* Apply detailed guidelines to tag and annotate video events accurately.
* Mark precise start and end timestamps for actions, transitions, and outcomes.
* Verify annotations for timing accuracy and correct inconsistencies or drift.
* Use video annotation tools to create and submit high-quality datasets.
* Collaborate with project teams to resolve ambiguities and maintain annotation consistency.
* Participate in quality reviews and incorporate feedback to maintain standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing visual data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent time management and ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in video annotation, data labeling, or similar projects.
* Familiarity with video annotation and timeline-based labeling tools.
* Experience with frame-level or timecode-based annotation.
* Background in AI training, machine learning data preparation, or robotics is strongly preferred.

Hamim | Mobile Car Wash and Field Services | Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

Lead a business you can build

Hamim is a Saudi technology startup delivering mobile car-wash services to individual customers and corporate fleets. We are hiring a hands-on Managing Director with CEO-level responsibility for P&L, cash flow, operations, people, and profitable growth. Your mandate is to improve unit economics and build a sustainable business across cities.

You will report directly to holding company top management. Goals, business plans, and budgets require their approval; expansion follows plans set by the board and the applicable approval framework. Frequent travel within Saudi Arabia may be required.

What you will own

• Financial performance: Own budgeting, forecasting, pricing, working capital, and cash flow. Improve contribution margin per wash and profitability by service, contract, and city.

• Field operations: Work alongside washers, supervisors, and city teams. Improve workforce utilization, dispatch and scheduling, route density, and average washes per washer per day while protecting safety and wash quality.

• Profitable growth: Improve customer acquisition, retention, subscriptions, and customer payback. Develop commercially sound B2B fleet contracts and manage collections.

• City expansion: Validate demand and launch new cities and markets under approved plans. Own staffing, training, equipment readiness, launch execution, and post-launch performance.

• People and systems: Build accountable teams, practical standard operating procedures, reliable reporting, and effective booking, dispatch, and payment processes.

• Execution and governance: Investigate problems directly, close corrective actions, and report results and risks clearly to holding company management.

What you bring

• Business or business-unit P&L ownership with evidence of improving profitability and cash performance.

• Senior leadership experience in car washing, automotive services, mobile services, field operations, fleet services, logistics, last-mile delivery, or a comparable distributed service business. Direct car-wash experience is valuable; relevant operating capability from adjacent sectors is welcome.

• Practical command of workforce productivity, capacity utilization, service delivery costs, pricing, customer economics, and B2B commercial agreements.

• An owner’s commitment: proactive problem solving, attention to detail, resourcefulness, urgency with discip

job_description:
**TANMIAH Foods Company (TFC)**
, part of Al Dabbagh Group, is a leading manufacturer and distributor in the food and agriculture sector, established in 1962. TFC is committed to maintaining the highest standards of food safety and quality across its operations. Join our team and contribute your microbiological expertise to ensuring product safety, strengthening quality assurance, and driving continuous improvement across our food and agriculture operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct and supervise microbiological testing of raw materials, feed, finished products, water samples, and environmental swabs to ensure product safety and quality.
* Isolate, identify, and enumerate microorganisms, including Salmonella, E. coli, Listeria, and indicator organisms, using culture-based methods, PCR, molecular detection systems, and Vitek 2.
* Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of laboratory test results while maintaining compliance with ISO 17025, GLP, HACCP, GMP, and internal food safety and quality standards.
* Maintain laboratory equipment through regular calibration, validation, and maintenance, and ensure accurate documentation, SOPs, and readiness for internal audits and external inspections.
* Support the development, validation, and improvement of microbiological testing methods and laboratory procedures in line with industry standards and best practices.
* Investigate microbiological deviations, contamination incidents, and out-of-specification (OOS) results, and recommend corrective and preventive actions to minimize food safety risks.
* Monitor microbiological trends, prepare laboratory reports, and collaborate with Quality Assurance and Production teams to support risk mitigation and continuous improvement.
* Support HACCP implementation and critical control point monitoring, while contributing to contamination reduction, shelf-life improvement, and process optimization initiatives.

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Food Science, Biotechnology, or Biological Sciences.
* **Experience:**
  2–5 years of experience in food, poultry, or FMCG microbiology.
* **Technical Skills:**
  Food microbiology, pathogen testing, microbial isolation and identification, PCR, and laboratory equipment handling, including Vitek.
* **Knowledge:**
  ISO 17025, HACCP, GMP, and GLP. Experience in ISO 17025-accredited laboratories is preferred.

**Job Details**

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Workplace Location: Al Majmaa'h**
,Riyadh, Saudi A

job_description:
Position Purpose

To deliver responsive, professional customer service and reliable commercial coordination for the Animal Health Division, ensuring accurate order administration, proactive delivery follow-up, effective communication and timely resolution or escalation of customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Customer relations and service: Act as a primary administrative contact for assigned customers; respond promptly and professionally to calls, emails and enquiries in Arabic and English; record requests, feedback and complaints, and escalate technical or commercial matters to the responsible team.
* Purchase orders and sales coordination: Receive and register customer purchase orders; check completeness and alignment with approved quotations; coordinate order entry and amendments with the sales coordination team; maintain an accurate PO and order-status tracker.
* Order fulfilment and delivery follow-up: Coordinate with sales support, warehouses, logistics and dispatch teams in Jeddah, Riyadh and Khobar to track order readiness, dispatch, delivery dates and exceptions; proactively update customers and escalate delays.
* Delivery confirmation and documentation: Confirm receipt and condition of delivered goods with customers; follow up on Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs), delivery acknowledgements, discrepancies and missing documentation; maintain a clear audit trail.
* Quotations and export support: Prepare draft quotations and proforma invoices (PFIs), including export enquiries, using approved pricing, terms and templates; obtain required approvals before release; maintain quotation registers and follow-up records.
* Customer and product records: Maintain accurate customer contacts, product usage information, correspondence, purchase history and service issues in approved systems; protect confidential commercial and customer information.
* Finance coordination: Coordinate with Finance on invoice copies, customer payment confirmations, statements and outstanding documentation; follow up with customers when requested, without independently approving credit, discounts or payment terms.
* Reporting and management support: Provide regular updates on open POs, overdue deliveries, GRNs, complaints and customer actions; prepare concise reports, support meetings and maintain organized electronic records.
* General administration: Coordinate reasonable office administration and supply requirements and carry out other relevant duties assigned by the Division

**Overview**
------------

We are seeking an experienced AFC Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making within public transportation systems. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in analyzing fare collection data, passenger behavior, revenue performance, and system efficiency, with a strong understanding of transportation operations.

**Your role**
-------------

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

  

* Analyze AFC transaction data (smart cards, mobile tickets, contactless payments) to identify trends in ridership, revenue, and passenger flow.
* Develop dashboards and reports tracking KPIs such as ridership, fare evasion, peak usage, and revenue leakage.
* Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure integrity of AFC datasets.

**Transportation Insights**

  

* Provide insights into passenger travel patterns, route performance, and network utilization.
* Support planning teams with demand forecasting and capacity planning.
* Analyze multimodal integration (bus, metro, tram) using AFC data.

**Advanced Analytics**

  

* Build predictive models for ridership forecasting, fare optimization, and demand analysis.
* Apply statistical techniques and machine learning where applicable.
* Conduct scenario analysis to support policy or fare structure changes.

**System & Data Management**

  

* Work with AFC system vendors and internal IT teams to manage data pipelines and integrations.
* Extract, transform, and load (ETL) large datasets from AFC systems and data warehouses.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

  

* Collaborate with operations, finance, and planning teams to translate data into actionable insights.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership.
* Support audits and regulatory reporting requirements.

**Education**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Transportation Engineering, or related field.

* 10+ years of experience in data analysis, ideally within public transportation or mobility sectors.
* Proven experience working with AFC systems (e.g., Cubic, Thales, Scheidt & Bachmann, etc.).

* Strong proficiency in:SQL (advanced level).Python or R for data analysis.Data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).

##### **Project description**

We are hiring a Sr. Functional Support Analyst – Trade Innovation who will provide functional support across bridge business stakeholders and technology teams on Finastra Trade Innovation implementations, upgrades and enhancements. You will own requirements end to end, from product and configuration changes, business user support, testing.

##### **Responsibilities**

Functional Support & Incident Management:

Provide L2/L3 functional troubleshooting for end-user issues arising during the trade lifecycle.

Analyze and resolve transactional errors, master data configuration mismatches, and failed workflows within the FTI engine.

Replicate production bugs in staging environments, documenting detailed steps, logs, and business impact before escalating to L3 developers or Finastra vendors.

Acknowledge and resolve support tickets within defined SLA limits to minimize operational downtime

##### **Skills**

Must have

7-10 years of total IT experience

Deep Expertise in Finastra Trade Innovation and Trade Finance Operations, deep Trade Innovation functional knowledge.

Finastra Trade Innovation:

At least 3 years of hands-on experience with Finastra Trade Innovation (TI Plus, TI Plus2 or Fusion Trade Innovation), ideally across two or more implementations or upgrades.

Working knowledge of TI modules: Import and Export LCs, Standby LCs, guarantees (issued and received), Import and Export Collections, Shipping Guarantees, Trade Loans/Financing and Bills discounting.

Understanding of TI static data, customer and account setup, charges and tariffs, posting/accounting rules, event and step workflow, and user roles.

Familiarity with TI integration options (web services, message queues, file-based interfaces) and the TI Corporate Portal or bank's own corporate channel.

Trade finance domain:

Strong grasp of the full lifecycle of documentary credits, guarantees, collections and trade financing products.

Working knowledge of ICC rules: UCP 600, ISBP 821, URDG 758, ISP98, URC 522, URR 725, eUCP and Incoterms 2020.

SWIFT Category 4 and 7 messages and MT798; awareness of trade digitisation (MLETR, electronic bills of lading).

Knowledge of supply chain finance (payables, receivables, invoice financing) is an advantage.

Functional Support Specialist ensure the core platform runs smoothly by handling system workflows, resolving transactional blocks, and translating changing trade policies into functional software updates.

📍 Location: Saudi Arabia, Dammam

🕒 Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

Be the primary owner of the online store across operations, marketing, technology, and finance,work closely with the Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Logistics, and Customer Service teams,drive digital sales, improve the customer experience, and increase conversion rates

Key Responsibilities

* Manage day-to-day store operations: products (add, edit, remove), pricing, stock availability, and site performance

* Plan and run A/B tests to increase conversion rates and reduce cart abandonment

* Improve organic search visibility through on-page, technical, and link optimization
* Manage the e-commerce platform backend, coordinate with developers on fixes and updates, and recommend technical improvements
* Monitor competitors and market trends, and bring proactive recommendations to strengthen our competitive edge
* Ensure compliance with local e-commerce, consumer protection, and data privacy regulations
* Contribute to the store's operating plan and budget, and lead and develop team members as needed

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, E-Commerce, Business Administration, Information Technology, or equivalent
* Minimum 3 years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing
* Hands-on experience managing online stores and digital sales platforms

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in analyzing fare collection data, passenger behavior, revenue performance, and system efficiency, with a strong understanding of transportation operations.

* Analyze AFC transaction data (smart cards, mobile tickets, contactless payments) to identify trends in ridership, revenue, and passenger flow.

* Build predictive models for ridership forecasting, fare optimization, and demand analysis.

* Extract, transform, and load (ETL) large datasets from AFC systems and data warehouses.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with operations, finance, and planning teams to translate data into actionable insights.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership.
* Support audits and regulatory reporting requirements.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Transportation Engineering, or related field.

**Location:** Saudi Arabia  
  
**Business:** BYD Commercial Vehicles  
  
**Role Purpose:**  
  
The role is responsible for developing and growing BYD Commercial Vehicles business in the assigned market, with end-to-end ownership of market development, customer relationships, business opportunities and local ecosystem development.  
This is not a conventional sales position focused only on generating quotations and closing individual deals. The role requires a business builder who can develop the market from the ground up, identify strategic opportunities, establish relationships with key stakeholders, create the conditions for sustainable business growth and coordinate internal and external resources to convert opportunities into long-term business.  
The person will act as the commercial owner of the market, representing BYD Commercial Vehicles with customers, government institutions, fleet operators, partners and other relevant stakeholders.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
  
**Market Development & Strategy**  
  
Develop and execute the Commercial Vehicle market-entry and growth strategy for the assigned country.  
Build a clear understanding of the truck and bus market, including market size, segments, applications, customer structure, competitors, pricing and regulatory environment.  
Identify priority market segments and applications where BYD’s electric commercial vehicle portfolio can create a strong value proposition.  
Translate market intelligence into concrete commercial priorities, customer targets and business opportunities.  
Develop annual and medium-term market plans, including sales volumes, pipeline, product requirements and key strategic initiatives.  
Continuously assess market developments, competitor activity and customer requirements.  
  
**Business Development & Sales**  
Build and manage a strong commercial pipeline across buses, light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks according to market opportunities.  
Identify and develop strategic customers, fleet operators, government entities, municipalities, logistics companies and major private-sector accounts.  
Lead customer engagement from initial opportunity identification through product definition, technical evaluation, commercial proposal, negotiation and order closing.  
Drive pilot projects, demonstrations and reference fleet opportunities to accelerate market acceptance.  
Develop account plans for priority customers and ensure continuous engagement with key decision makers.

**Description**
Do you want to directly influence the future of some of the most successful products in cloud computing? Come join Amazon Web Services Finance! Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of enterprise, government and start-up business and organizations in over 190 countries around the world. Launched in 2006, Amazon Web Services officially began offering developer customers access to web services – now widely known as cloud computing – based on Amazon’s own back-end technology platform.
  
  
On the AWS Finance team you will be surrounded by people that are exceptionally talented, bright, and driven, and believe that world class support is critical to customer success. To support this quickly growing business, you must be highly analytical and possess a strong passion for analytics and accountability, setting high standards, and razor-sharp accuracy. We take working hard, having fun, and making history seriously and you should too!
  
  
We provide end-to-end financial support driving AWS to be the low cost provider in Cloud computing and leader in customer experience. This includes supporting business owners in building, operating and innovating our Cloud datacenters. We support operations, business development, and engineering. You should be passionate about producing financial analysis enabling management to make breakthrough decisions, drive cash flow, and ultimately delight our customers.
  
  
We are growing rapidly in existing regions as well as expanding into new regions.
  
  
At Amazon, we believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. **Job Purpose:**
The Cost Control Specialist owns the company's annual OPEX and CAPEX budget cycle and keeps spending on plan. The role builds and maintains the financial models required by lenders, shareholders and the Grantor, tracks every project and department against budget, and flags overruns early with a mitigation plan. It ensures all costs are captured in line with IFRS, SOCPA and regulatory requirements, and gives senior management and the Board clear, timely reporting on cost performance.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead annual OPEX and CAPEX budget preparation with department heads; challenge assumptions and enforce alignment with corporate strategy
* Review and validate financial data from departments to ensure accuracy and completeness
* Develop the budget template, timelines, guidelines and procedures
* Develop the annual traffic forecast in coordination with the Slots Department for budgeting purposes, with external advisors' assistance if necessary
* Develop and update financial models for CAPEX projects in line with lender, shareholder and Grantor requirements
* Work with the Strategy and Treasury departments to develop financial models for new business and investment opportunities; validate assumptions with related departments
* Coordinate with lenders on project finance reporting, budget vs. actual and compliance certificates under the financing agreements and develop the related lender reports
* Monitor cost vs. budget for each OPEX and CAPEX project and each department; flag overruns early and propose mitigation plans
* Analyze cost drivers and identify savings and efficiency opportunities
* Maintain cost control systems in the ERP, ensuring WBS elements, cost centers and internal orders are set up correctly
* Validate all fixed asset capitalization before it is recorded in the ERP
* Drive automation of budget reporting and reduce manual consolidation time
* Work with Operations and project teams to validate scope changes and their budget impact before management approval
* Establish cost control policies, approval matrices and guidelines for project controls
* Partner with Procurement on contract commitments, accruals and PO tracking to prevent budget leakage
* Prepare the Board and Management Pack, including KPI dashboards, cost trends, commitments vs. actuals and forecast outlook
* Ensure all costs are captured in line with IFRS, SOCPA and other regulatory requirements
* Support internal and external audits on budget, accrua

**Overview**
------------

The QA/QC Specialist is responsible for ensuring that products, services, and project deliverables meet established quality standards, client requirements, and regulatory expectations. The role supports the development and implementation of quality assurance and quality control processes to drive compliance and continuous improvement. The QA/QC Specialist works closely with project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to maintain high-quality performance throughout all project phases.

**Your role**
-------------

* Develop, implement, and maintain QA/QC procedures, inspection plans, and quality management systems.
* Monitor project activities to ensure compliance with quality standards, specifications, and contract requirements.
* Conduct inspections, audits, and quality assessments of processes, materials, and deliverables.
* Review quality documentation, including inspection reports, test records, and compliance certificates.
* Identify quality issues, non-conformances, and defects, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and suppliers to resolve quality-related concerns.
* Monitor and track quality KPIs and prepare quality performance reports.
* Support internal and external quality audits and certification processes.
* Verify compliance with applicable industry codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Provide quality awareness training and guidance to project personnel.
* Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure proper documentation and retention of quality records.

**About you**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 10+ years of QA/QC experience in construction projects.
* Strong knowledge of quality management systems and ISO 9001 standards.
* Experience in inspections, audits, testing, and quality documentation.
* Familiarity with industry codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Professional certifications such as ISO 9001 Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor are preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in quality reporting tools and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.

job_description:
**Overview**
------------

AtkinsRéalis is a world-leading design, engineering and project management organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world.

We have a strong presence in the Middle East that enables us to build deep and lasting relationships with our clients. We share their goals and long-term ambitions; we're on the same journey to create places and infrastructure which will support long term sustainable development, healthy living and vibrant communities.

We are seeking for a Risk Manager to be part of our project team based in **Riyadh, KSA**. We are looking for someone with **Rail/Metro experience**.

**Your role**
-------------

  

* Develop and monitor a risk issue and opportunity management process.
* Develop and maintain a risk matrix identifying dependencies and the impacts of not meeting scheduled dates.
* Identify, monitor and managing dependencies, and for resolving related issues.
* Identify opportunities to arrange and co-ordinate any necessary discussions and agreements to realise benefits.
* Monitor projects and ensure that an adequate and robust Risk Management process is under active management.
* Implement Risk Management Plan, Risk Log, and associated governance process.
* Track significant risks to ensure that they are being systematically identified, recorded, evaluated, actively managed and regularly re-evaluated, and communicated across the program.
* Identify, communicate, and manage inter-program or external risks.
* Identify and manage internal program-related risks.
* Review and update Risk Log against Program Status Reports & Meetings
* In addition, the client wishes to achieve the following objectives:
* Provide accurate and timely management information on a regular basis on the status of various projects.
* To monitor progress and drive delivery of individual projects, challenging and accelerating these where appropriate.
* To enable management of risks and opportunities at the programme level.
* To drive commonality and coherence between the various projects.
* To ensure the interdependencies between various projects is understood and managed.
* To ensure appropriate standards are set and adhered to legally and commercially.
* To ensure the client is obtaining value for money through negotiations

**Overview**
------------

AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Commercial Director, in Riyadh, KSA. The Commercial Director will lead and oversee the commercial management of AtkinsRéalis' portfolio of projects in Saudi Arabia. This strategic role ensures that projects are delivered in line with contractual obligations, financial targets, and internal governance standards. The position requires a strong blend of commercial acumen, leadership, and deep understanding of engineering and consultancy services.

**Your role**
-------------

  

* To understand and interpret AtkinsRéalis rights and responsibilities across its portfolio of projects in KSA.
* Overall responsibility for supporting Project Directors in the delivery of projects to the contractual arrangements and the required commercial outcome (including the contracted profit margin) all in accordance with the agreed financial objectives.
* Co-ordinate commercial appointments for services being provided by all parties, including other Atkins Business Sectors and sub-consultants.
* Developing and managing the commercial administration, monitoring and change control system requirements to comply with Atkins internal business processes and systems, inclusive of risk and variation registers.
* Developing commercial understanding and competence within the Project Management and Design delivery staff in KSA.
* Support the Project-based Commercial staff within the Country's live projects.
* Escalation and reporting on claims made against Atkins Professional Indemnity insurance or such circumstances.
* Commercial review and audit of live projects in Country.
* Understanding of and adherence to AtkinsRealis internal Business Management System (BMS) and other processes.
* Monitor compliance of the Service Delivery Process throughout the project delivery phase and respond to queries.
* Review monthly financial reports and review any actions in respect of the Risk Register and project contingency.
* Influence improved risk management to ensure an appropriate approach to risk is considered with an objective of converting contingency to margin for live projects.
* Liaise with finance and project teams on debt management with an aim of converting debt provisions to P&L profit.
* Provide guidance to project teams to ensure a consistent approach to billing in line with contractual arrangements is maintained to maximise positive cash flow.
* Influence behaviours to provide early warnings of risk to projects financial health

In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives.
