job_description:
SOOR, a subsidiary of Master Works, helps organizations stay ahead of evolving cyber threats through advanced cybersecurity and secure infrastructure solutions. SOOR delivers resilient, scalable, and regulation-aligned security across governance, cloud, networks, and managed defense.

SOOR is looking for a highly skilled Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing Engineer, Senior to join our dynamic security services team. In this client-facing role, you will be responsible for leading complex security assessments across various industries. You will act as a subject matter expert, not only identifying critical vulnerabilities but also articulating business risks to stakeholders and guiding remediation efforts.

**Key Responsibilities**

Penetration Testing: Lead and execute end-to-end penetration tests on:

* Web Applications: (OWASP Top 10, API security, Business Logic flaws).
* Network Infrastructure: (Internal/External, Active Directory, Firewalls, Routers, etc).
* Source Code Review: Conduct manual and tool-assisted secure code reviews (SAST) across languages/frameworks, identify injection flaws, and provide developer-focused remediation guidance.
* Mobile Applications: (iOS and Android - static and dynamic analysis).
* Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct comprehensive vulnerability assessments and configuration reviews against industry standards (CIS, NIST).
* Red Teaming (Optional/Nice to Have): Participate in adversary simulation exercises, social engineering, and physical security assessments.
* Cloud Environments (Optional/Nice to Have): (AWS, Azure, GCP configuration reviews and exploitation).
* Tooling: Utilize and refine advanced tooling (Burp Suite Pro, Metasploit, Nmap, Nessus, Bloodhound, etc.) and develop custom scripts/exploits when automated tools fail.
* Client Engagement & Consulting:
* Scoping: Collaborate with clients to define engagement scope, rules of engagement (RoE), and timelines.
* Communication: Serve as the primary technical point of contact during engagements, providing status updates and immediate alerts on critical "showstopper" findings.
* Reporting: Author high-quality, executive-level reports that translate technical vulnerabilities into business risks. Must be able to explain the "So What?" to C-level executives and the "How To Fix It" to system administrators.
* Debriefs: Lead technical read-out sessions and remediation workshops with client stakeholders.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Sci

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

AI Engineer responsible for designing and delivering GenAI solutions on a bespoke, on-premise AI platform (Arthur). The role will focus on building production-ready AI applications and integrating enterprise systems and data with LLM providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop and productionise GenAI/LLM applications and use cases.
* Build RAG, agentic AI and tool-enabled workflows using enterprise data and systems.
* Integrate AI solutions with APIs, databases, applications and external LLM providers.
* Develop effective prompt and context engineering approaches, including structured outputs and guardrails.
* Implement testing, LLM evaluation, monitoring and observability to ensure solution quality and reliability.
* Apply appropriate security, data privacy and Responsible AI controls.
* Collaborate with architects, platform engineers, business SMEs and other delivery teams.
* Contribute reusable components, integration patterns and engineering best practices.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Strong Python and general software engineering experience.
* Hands-on experience developing GenAI/LLM solutions in a production or enterprise environment.
* Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search and enterprise data.
* Experience with agentic AI, tool/function calling and/or MCP.
* Familiarity with multiple LLM providers such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI and Google/Gemini.
* Strong API and enterprise integration skills.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, guardrails, observability and AI security.
* Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and on-premise/private environments is desirable.
* Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* A model-agnostic engineering mindset, with the ability to work across different LLMs rather than being dependent on a specific hyperscaler

job_description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Threat Detection Engineer to design, develop, test, and optimize security detection capabilities across networks, endpoints, and applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in threat detection engineering, threat hunting, threat intelligence, detection-as-code, and security analytics, with the ability to translate adversary tactics and techniques into actionable detection strategies.

The role involves collaborating with Security Operations, Incident Response, and Threat Intelligence teams to improve detection coverage, reduce false positives, and strengthen the organization's overall security posture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Detection Engineering:**
  Design, develop, test, and fine-tune detection rules across networks, endpoints, cloud environments, and applications to identify suspicious activities and potential threats.
* **Threat Intelligence Integration:**
  Translate threat intelligence, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) into actionable detection use cases and proactive threat-hunting strategies.
* **Detection Content Development:**
  Develop, maintain, and optimize detection content using tools and technologies such as Sigma, YARA, Elasticsearch, and Python.
* **Alert Investigation and Optimization:**
  Investigate security alerts to understand attacker behavior, identify detection gaps, improve detection logic, and enhance overall detection effectiveness.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Security Monitoring, and SOC teams to improve detection quality, reduce false positives, and strengthen incident investigation capabilities.
* **Threat Research:**
  Research emerging malware, attack techniques, adversary behaviors, and industry-specific cyber threats to continuously improve detection coverage.
* **MITRE ATT&CK Mapping:**
  Map detection rules, threat-hunting hypotheses, and security use cases to the MITRE ATT&CK framework to measure coverage and identify gaps.
* **Defense-in-Depth Detection:**
  Develop layered detection strategies to identify the same attack techniques across multiple telemetry sources and security controls, ensuring comprehensive visibility and resilience against evasion.
* **Code and Content Reviews:**
  Review team members' detection code, rule logic, test cases, and documentation to maintain high standards of quality, consistency, and reliability.
* **Detection-as-Code:**
  Strength

**Q Mart | Building the Future of Saudi E-Commerce**

**Location:**
Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (On-site)

About Q Mart

At Q Mart, we’re building the next generation of Saudi e-commerce systems; scalable, reliable, and built for growth.

We’re a focused, ambitious team driven by innovation, engineering excellence, and a commitment to building technology that solves real-world challenges. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and creating reliable solutions that make a meaningful impact as our platform grows.

What You’ll Do

* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Go.
* Develop and improve microservices powering orders, payments, logistics, and inventory.
* Build reliable RESTful and gRPC APIs for web and mobile applications.
* Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases and queries.
* Improve system performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Work closely with frontend, mobile, and DevOps teams.
* Contribute to code reviews and backend architecture decisions.

What We’re Looking For

* +4 years of backend development experience.
* Strong proficiency in Go, including concurrency.
* Solid experience with PostgreSQL, microservices, and REST APIs.
* Understanding of distributed systems and message brokers such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and monitoring tools.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a focus on clean, maintainable code.

Why Join Q Mart?

* Solve real-world engineering challenges at scale.
* Make meaningful technical decisions and shape our architecture.
* Work in a collaborative, fast-moving engineering environment.
* Help build the future of e-commerce in Saudi Arabia.

**Interested? Apply now.**

* Find and fix performance issues, UI bugs and crashes before they reach users
* Work closely with product, design and backend engineers to ship end to end
* Write clean, testable code and take part in code reviews
* Flag technical debt and suggest improvements

We're looking for a highly technical Adobe DXP Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise digital experience platforms for large, complex organizations.
  
  
This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and in a technical design review. You'll understand how the business operates, shape the target architecture across the Adobe Experience Cloud, and guide delivery teams through to a production-ready, scalable platform.
  
  
You'll work on enterprise-scale transformation programmes with multiple workstreams, demanding stakeholders, and real accountability for outcomes. ❏ Lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, current-state landscapes, and customer experience requirements.
  
  
❏ Define end-to-end target architectures across Adobe Experience Manager (Sites, Assets, Forms) and Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, Journey Optimizer, Target, Analytics / CJA).
  
  
❏ Translate business and experience requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.
  
  
❏ Make and document key architectural decisions, including AEM as a Cloud Service vs. on-premise/AMS, headless vs. hybrid delivery, and data and identity strategy.
  
  
❏ Design integrations between Adobe products and enterprise platforms such as CRM, commerce, ERP, CDPs, identity providers, and data warehouses, using APIs, event-driven patterns, and middleware.
  
  
❏ Define data models, XDM schemas, identity resolution, and audience segmentation approaches that support personalization and journey orchestration.

❏ Ensure solutions meet performance, security, accessibility, and data privacy requirements, including regional data residency where applicable.
  
  
❏ Contribute to solutioning, estimation, and scoping of new phases and change requests.

**Job Purpose**

Prepare accurate cost estimates and pricing for heavy equipment rental, manpower supply, and oil & gas service contracts, so the company wins tenders at a healthy profit margin.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Study tender documents, scope of work, and client requirements **(RFQ/RFP).**
* **Prepare** detailed **cost estimates** for equipment (cranes, trailers, forklifts, etc.), operators, riggers, and support staff.
* **Calculate equipment costs**: depreciation, fuel, maintenance, spare parts, insurance, mobilization/demobilization.
* **Calculate manpower costs:** salary, allowances, housing, transport, iqama, GOSI, medical, and overheads.
* **Collect and compare quotations** from suppliers and subcontractors.
* **Prepare commercial bids** and price breakdowns for submission.
* Work with Operations, Procurement, HR, and Finance to confirm actual costs.
* **Track actual project costs vs estimates and report** variances.
* Support contract negotiations and rate revisions.
* Keep a database of rates, past estimates, and market prices.
* Make sure estimates follow client standards and company policy.

Requirements

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, or Industrial Engineering (or similar).

**Experience**

* 4–8 years in cost estimation, preferably in heavy equipment, construction, or oil & gas services.
* Experience with tenders for clients like Aramco, SABIC, or MAADEN is a strong plus.

**Skills**

* Strong Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, costing models).
* Good understanding of equipment operating costs and manpower costing.
* Ability to read technical specs and BOQs.
* Good English communication and report writing.
* Attention to detail, and comfortable working under tender deadlines.

**Nice to have**

* Certification such as PMP, CCP, or AACE.
* Knowledge of Saudi labor law and Saudization requirements.
* Experience with ERP or estimation software.

**Success Measures (KPIs)**

* Estimate accuracy (variance from actual cost)
* Tender turnaround time
* Tender win rate
* Profit margin achieved on awarded jobs

Pay: ﷼7,000.00 - ﷼9,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

job_description:
SOOR, a subsidiary of Master Works, helps organizations stay ahead of evolving cyber threats through advanced cybersecurity and secure infrastructure solutions. SOOR delivers resilient, scalable, and regulation-aligned security across governance, cloud, networks, and managed defense.

SOOR is looking for an experienced **Network Security, Senior Engineer** with strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, managing, and troubleshooting enterprise network and cybersecurity solutions. The candidate should be able to handle technical projects, provide professional services, and support customer environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement, configure, and maintain network security solutions.
* Deploy and manage Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Forcepoint and other vendors' security solutions.
* Configure and troubleshoot firewall policies, NAT, IPsec/SSL VPN, SD-WAN, and High Availability (HA).
* Deploy, configure, manage, and troubleshoot EDR, NDR, DLP, Proxy, and email security solutions, including integration with existing security infrastructure.
* Implement and support network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, and wireless networks.
* Perform security assessments, configuration reviews, and security hardening.
* Troubleshoot complex network and security issues.
* Experience with security hardening and vulnerability remediation.
* Perform firmware upgrades, system migrations, and security solution integrations.
* Prepare technical documentation, implementation plans, and as-built documents.
* Coordinate with customers and internal teams to ensure successful project delivery.

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in network security.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple technical tasks.

**Job Summary**
**What the Role Entails**
Tencent Cloud Middle East is looking for a Security Operations Specialist based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. * Assist with the periodic review and upkeep of cybersecurity and privacy policies, procedures, guidelines and compliance evidence, so that documentation stays current and audit-ready.
* Prepare regular operational reports and dashboards on security posture, open risks, remediation progress and compliance status for internal stakeholders.
* Support security awareness activities, internal communications, and the preparation of security documentation and questionnaire responses for customers and partners.

**Who We Look For**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in security operations

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking a highly competent **Quantity Surveyor** **Manager** to support the Cost Manager and the Controls Manager in implementing robust commercial and quantity management practices across a major infrastructure program in Riyadh.

Working within a PMO environment, the role is responsible for BOQ management at pre-contract and post contract stages ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of BOQs, variations, payment applications, and commercial submissions prepared by PMCMs and contractors. The Sr. QS will collaborate closely with the Client, PMCM teams, and contractors to drive strong commercial governance and transparent reporting.

* Review and verify designer-prepared BOQs, ensuring completeness, accuracy, unit-rate logic, and adherence to approved measurement standards.
* Support preparation and validation of project cost estimates and budgets once design packages are issued.
* Participate in tender evaluation processes, providing quantitative and commercial input for technical and commercial assessments.
* Lead and support PMCM QS teams in finalizing BOQ remeasurements across all stages of construction.
* Review Interim Payment Applications (IPAs/IPCs) after PMCM checks, focusing on quantities, measurement rules, valuation logic, and alignment with contractual entitlements.
* Review and quantify Change Orders, variations, and claims, performing quantity take-offs, cost impact assessments, and alignment with baseline budgets.
* Prepare high-level estimates for design changes, urgent requests, confidential client inquiries, and strategic commercial decisions.
* Review significant quantity shifts associated with client-driven changes (e.g., fill, pavement layers, bridge cladding, utilities, landscaping).
* Support development and maintenance of program-level cash flow forecasts in coordination with the planning and cost teams.
* Monitor PMCM compliance with commercial procedures, BOQ structures, measurement rules, and variation workflows.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation, log

job_description:
We are seeking a professional, welcoming, and highly organized **Receptionist** to manage our front desk and serve as the face of our company. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for clients, visitors, and employees. You will balance a mix of customer-facing hospitality and vital clerical tasks, requiring an ability to multitask efficiently while maintaining a calm, friendly demeanor.

Key Responsibilities**Front Desk & Visitor Relations**

* **Greet and welcome** guests warmly as soon as they arrive at the office.
* **Direct visitors** to the appropriate person, department, or meeting room.
* **Maintain office security** by enforcing safety procedures, monitoring the logbook, and issuing visitor badges.
* **Keep the reception area** tidy, organized, and stocked with necessary materials like brochures and forms.

**Communication & Scheduling**

* **Answer, screen, and route** incoming phone calls efficiently while taking accurate messages.
* **Provide accurate information** in-person, over the phone, and via email regarding company services or activities.
* **Manage calendars** and schedule appointments, meetings, or conference room bookings

Skills & Qualifications

**Minimum Requirements:**

* **Education:** High school diploma or equivalent qualification.
* **Experience:** Proven experience as a receptionist, front desk agent, or in a retail customer service role.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a professional phone etiquette.
* **Tech Literacy:** Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and comfortable operating multi-line phone systems.

**Preferred Attributes:**

* **Multitasking:** Solid organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks under pressure.
* **Professionalism:** A dependable, positive attitude with strong interpersonal skills to build quick rapport with clients.
* **Adaptability:** Flexibility to handle unexpected changes in workload or scheduling

Pay: ﷼5,000.00 - ﷼7,500.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Should be Female

Work Location: In person

**Job Purpose:**

Personal Data Protection Officer responsible for overseeing the Personal Data Protection agenda within the entity and monitors compliance with Personal Data Protection Law and applicable regulations. Personal Data Protection officer ensures that personal data is processed in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements, organizational policies and recognized best practices. The PDPO acts as the main point of contact with regulators, individuals, and internal stakeholders on matters relating to personal data protection.

**Key Accountabilities :**

Inform and advise GIB, which acts as Data Controller or Data Processor, and its employees about their obligations to comply with the KSA PDPL and other applicable data protection laws within the organization.

Be the first point of contact for the authorities and for individuals whose personal data is processed (employees, users, etc.). Furthermore, responsible for implementing the provisions of the Saudi Arabia Personal Data Protection Law, the Implementation regulations, and the Regulation of Personal Data – Transfer Outside the Kingdom. As well as, executing the decisions and instructions issued by the Competent Authority.

Maintain and regularly update the Record of Processing Activities (RoPA), as per regulatory requirements. Through identifying, assessing and monitoring risks associated with personal data processing.

Lead and supervise the completion of data protection impact assessments and recommend corrective actions and ensure risk mitigation measures are implemented across GIB's privacy ecosystem.

Support and coordinate with Relevant Stakeholders (including Compliance Unit) to identify, reporting and manage personal data incidents or breaches, as well as ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

Monitor and report to top management on the organization's privacy compliance and current status periodically..

Oversee the resolution of violations and non-compliance across data privacy activities and ensure corrective measures are implemented.

Manage and respond to data subject rights in line with the privacy regulations, whilst collaborating with Business Units to process requests within the regulatory timelines, and maintaining records of all requests.

Work with legal and HR teams to develop appropriate sanctions for failure to comply with the privacy policies and procedures.

Coordinate with Business Units, including procurement, to review and advise on third party data

Lean Technologies is a fast-growing fintech company building the financial data infrastructure for the MENA region. Operating in a highly regulated, security-sensitive environment, we serve mission-critical financial services that demand robust SLAs, strict security controls, and highly scalable systems.

As an
**Internal Auditor,**
you're responsible for independently assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of Lean's governance, risk management, and internal control frameworks across all group entities.

The role executes the annual audit plan, evaluates compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks (including CBUAE, SAMA, ADGM FSRA, and VARA where relevant), and provides assurance to management and the Board/Audit Committee on the organization's control environment.

**About Lean**

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region’s largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region’s pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We’ve processed billions of dollars in transactions. We’re trusted by 350+ clients - from Tabby and Tas’heel to Hungerstation - and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We’re expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn’t exist here before.

**What You’ll Do**

* Plan and execute risk-based internal audits across group entities, covering regulatory compliance, AML/CFT, technology and operations, governance, and financial controls.
* Develop and maintain the annual group audit plan and universe, ensuring appropriate coverage of high-risk areas across all licensed entities.
* Assess design and operating effectiveness of controls; identify control gaps, root causes, and process weaknesses.
* Draft clear, actionable audit findings and reports for management and relevant committees (GLRCC, Audit Committee).
* Track and follow up on remediation of audit findings and management action plans.
* Liaise with external auditors, regulators, and second-line functions (Compliance, Risk) to ensure coordinated assurance coverage and avoid duplication.

job_description:
The Corporate Environment, Health, Safety & Security (EHS&S) Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing corporate EHS&S strategies, policies, and management systems across all manufacturing plants and company facilities.

The role ensures compliance with applicable environmental, occupational health, industrial safety, and security regulations while minimizing operational risks, preventing workplace accidents, protecting company assets, and promoting a strong safety culture across all sites.

**1. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Environmental Management**

* Develop and implement corporate environmental policies and standards across all manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, permits, and applicable requirements.
* Monitor industrial emissions, wastewater discharge, hazardous waste, and other environmental aspects.
* Lead environmental risk assessments and initiatives to reduce pollution, waste generation, and resource consumption.
* Oversee environmental audits, corrective actions, and sustainability improvement programs.

**B. Occupational Health**

* Establish occupational health programs to protect employees from workplace health hazards.
* Assess exposure to chemicals, dust, noise, heat, and other industrial hazards.
* Coordinate occupational health monitoring and medical surveillance programs, where applicable.
* Ensure effective implementation of industrial hygiene and workplace health standards.
* Promote initiatives to prevent occupational illnesses and work-related health issues.

**C. Industrial Health & Safety**

* Develop, implement, and maintain corporate occupational health and safety policies, procedures, and standards.
* Oversee risk assessments, hazard identification, and implementation of appropriate risk control measures.
* Lead investigations into workplace accidents, injuries, near misses, and high-potential incidents.
* Ensure effective implementation of Permit to Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), machine safety, fire prevention, and emergency response procedures.
* Monitor safety performance and drive continuous improvement across manufacturing operations.
* Conduct corporate safety audits and ensure timely closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Promote employee awareness, management accountability, and a strong safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with applicable occupational health and safety regulations and industry standards.

**D. Security Management**

Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help customers and partners use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster , at lower cost? Do you want to be part of history and transform businesses through cloud computing adoption? Do you like to work on-site in a variety of business environments, leading teams through high impact projects that use the newest cloud infrastructure and platform technologies? Would you like a career path that enables you to progress with the rapid adoption of cloud computing?
  
  
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we’re hiring a technical Engagement Manager to lead AWS consultants, partners and client teams. As Engagement Manager you will manage projects independently and also deliver as part of larger teams.

As an Amazonian leader you will embrace and apply the Amazon Leadership Principles, proactively engaging other teams to learn and share, and participating actively in the recruitment and onboarding of future team members.

AWS Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for customers and partners, providing collective AWS customer experience, best practices, and obsessing about strong success for the Customer. Company Profile:

**Al-Obaid Plastic Industries Factory** is one of the leading manufacturing facilities in Saudi Arabia, specializing in producing high-quality plastic pipes, fittings, and sanitary products. The factory is committed to international quality standards and institutional excellence.

**Job Purpose:**

Responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing plastic injection and extrusion molds. Ensuring full operational readiness of molds to maximize production efficiency, minimize downtime, and leverage plastic technology knowledge to improve product quality.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties:**

* **Mold Setup & Installation:** Accurately mount and dismount plastic molds on injection molding or extrusion machines following strict safety guidelines.
* **Preventive & Corrective Maintenance:** Perform routine and emergency maintenance on plastic molds (cleaning, lubrication, cooling channel clearing, and repairing wear and tear).
* **Parameter Adjustments & Trial Runs:** Set up mold parameters with machines (temperatures, injection pressures, cooling times) and conduct trial runs to approve defect-free products.
* **Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve mold-related plastic defects (e.g., shrinkage, flash, short shots, warpage) efficiently.
* **Spare Parts Management:** Monitor mold spare parts inventory (springs, pins, nozzles, cooling fittings) and request reorders when necessary.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Collaborate on modifying and improving existing mold designs to increase lifecycle and reduce cycle time.
* **Safety Compliance:** Strictly enforce occupational health and safety regulations within the workshop and during heavy lifting operations.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* **Education:** Diploma in **Plastic Technology** or a related mechanical/engineering discipline.
* **Experience:** 5 to 10 years of hands-on experience in plastic manufacturing plants (Injection/Extrusion/Mold Maintenance).
* **Technical Skills:**
* Deep understanding of polymer behaviors and plastic characteristics during processing.
* Proficiency in using workshop tools and mold repair equipment.
* Ability to read and interpret 2D and 3D engineering drawings of molds.
* **Soft Skills:**
* High attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced production environment.
* Strong commitment to safety and teamwork.

About Crafton  
Crafton is an award-winning international digital agency specializing in UX/UI design, digital transformation, and custom software development.

With a strong presence in the Middle East, we have delivered digital projects for leading organizations, including NEOM, Public Investment Fund (PIF), Nusuk, and major public and private sector clients across Saudi Arabia.

We are looking for a proactive, ambitious, and results-driven Business Development Specialist to join our team and support our continued growth in the Middle East.

Identify and research potential B2B clients, primarily across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.

Execute outbound sales activities through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, and other channels.

Travel across the Middle East for face-to-face meetings with potential clients.

Establish relationships with decision-makers and schedule qualified business meetings.

Present Crafton's capabilities and services to prospective clients in Arabic and English.

Manage communication with prospects, follow-ups, and sales opportunities throughout the sales cycle.

Support proposal preparation, commercial negotiations, and business development activities.

**Network & Infrastructure Engineer**

The SAP S/4HANA Sales and Order to Cash Functional specialist shapes KAUST’s end-to-end sales, contracting, fulfilment, billing and revenue processes. Working with business process owners across the university, the role sets the functional direction for these capabilities, simplifies legacy practices and turns institutional needs into scalable solutions on KAUST’s SAP platform. The role leads a prioritised functional roadmap, promotes fit-to-standard and clean-core design, and works with enterprise architecture and delivery teams on integration, data, user experience and change. * Facilitate fit-to-standard decisions with stakeholders; challenge duplicate steps and unnecessary customisation, document material deviations and recommend upgrade-safe options under clean-core principles.
* Define business requirements and functional design for integration with Finance, Materials Management, Grants Management, revenue accounting, credit management, point-of-sale and relevant non-SAP platforms, according to KAUST’s approved architecture.
* Partner with data owners to improve customer, product, pricing, contract and transaction data quality, including ownership, controls and reporting definitions.
* Guide the design of role-based SAP Fiori experiences, approvals, workflow and embedded analytics; involve users early and measure whether changes make priority tasks easier and more reliable.

job_description:
**Company Description**
SAP started in 1972 as a team of five colleagues with a desire to do something new. Together, they changed enterprise software and reinvented how business was done. Today, as a market leader in enterprise application software, we remain true to our roots. That’s why we engineer solutions to fuel innovation, foster equality and spread opportunity for our employees and customers across borders and cultures.
  
  
**THE SAP YOUNG PROFESSIONALS PROGRAM**
The SAP Young Professionals Program is a free initiative delivered by the Digital Skills Center of SAP. The program, which lasts for 2 months, is designed to give recent graduates the certifications and soft skills required to begin a career as an SAP Associate Consultant. At the end of the training, SAP will work very closely with the program graduates to introduce them to a host of opportunities with SAP customers and partners to work as an SAP Consultant.
  
  
**SAP CONSULTANTS**
The role of an SAP Consultant can be divided into 2 functions: Functional and Technical.
  
  
The consultant will contribute to blueprinting, design, implementation, operation, optimization, and upgrade phase of a S/4 HANA project, and provide business process as well as functional expertise, and project guidance to our clients to ensure their investment in SAP software and consulting services will make their business the best run business.
  
  
The Consultant is also responsible for maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction in each of their accounts in addition to growing and developing referenceable customers through their investigation, analysis, consulting, coaching, knowledge transfer, and relationship-building efforts.
  
  
**Certificate Information**
**The Generative AI Hub**
, part of SAP AI Foundation, is a centralized platform designed to streamline enterprise AI adoption. It provides a secure environment for businesses to access, orchestrate, and deploy a wide range of Large Language Models (LLMs) while ensuring they are grounded in business-specific data and compliant with enterprise standards.
  
  
**How You Benefit**

* Start your journey to become an SAP Consultant;
* Gain globally-recognised associate-level SAP Certifications;
* Learn directly from SAP experts;
* Experience classroom and workshop-based training in SAP Technologies;
* Develop the soft skills needed to prepare you for successful job applications;
* Benefit from introductions to job opportunities within the SAP Eco

micro1 is engaging

**Operations Manager – Hazardous & Industrial Waste Treatment Facility**

**Location:**
Sudair Industrial City – Riyadh

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is responsible for leading all processing activities across high-temperature thermal destruction units, including rotary kilns and secondary combustion chambers. This position enforces strict Waste Acceptance Criteria (WAC), maintains regulatory emission compliance, optimizes chemical dosing and fuel consumption, and guarantees safe containment and destruction of hazardous, toxic, and complex industrial waste streams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations & Process Management**

• Direct operations of high-temperature incinerators, including rotary kiln, static hearth, and liquid injection systems, and ensure the required destruction and removal efficiency (DRE ≥ 99.99%).

• Oversee Flue Gas Cleaning Systems (FGCS), including dry/semi-dry scrubbers, baghouse fabric filters, and activated carbon, to control acid gases, dioxins, and heavy metals.

• Monitor Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems (CEMS) 24/7 to guarantee zero exceedances for SO₂, NOₓ, HCl, HF, CO, particulate matter, and TOC.

• Optimize burner efficiency, fuel/gas-to-waste blending ratios, and waste feed rates based on calorific value (LHV/HHV), moisture, halogen, and ash content.

**Waste Acceptance, Compatibility & Material Handling**

• Enforce chemical compatibility protocols to prevent exothermic reactions, polymerizations, or hazardous gas evolution (H₂S, HCN, Cl₂) in storage tanks, pits, and blend bays.

• Review incoming waste characterization, analytical profiles, and manifests against plant operating licenses and storage permit limits.

• Manage hazardous residues, including secure collection, handling, and compliant transfer/landfilling of bottom slag and fly ash/Air Pollution Control Residues (APCR).

**Maintenance & Asset Integrity**

• Collaborate with the engineering team to plan and execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for optical sorters, shredders, trommels, conveyors, balers, and thermal boilers.

• Minimize unplanned downtime to preserve overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) and plant availability.

• Oversee critical spare parts inventory and service-level agreements (SLAs) with technology vendors.

**People Leadership**

• Lead shift supervisors, process engineers, plant operators, technicians, and sorting labor across multiple shifts.

**Description**
Tuwaiq Casting & Forging is seeking an experienced and technically proficient Chemical Lab Supervisor to join the Quality Department. Reporting to the Quality Laboratory Senior Engineer, this role is responsible for overseeing the chemical analysis of metals and materials used in casting and forging processes, ensuring all materials meet quality standards and customer specifications through accurate and reliable test results that support production quality and compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Laboratory Operations Management
  
  

* Maintain and calibrate all laboratory equipment to ensure operational accuracy and reliability
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and conduct regular staff training.

Chemical Analysis & Review
  
  

* Perform chemical composition analysis using methods including OES, XRF, and ICP
* Prepare samples and review test results for accuracy and completeness.

Quality Assurance Support
  
  

* Verify chemical conformity of materials throughout the production process
* Conduct tests in accordance with customer requirements and certification body specifications.

Documentation & Reporting
  
  

* Prepare test reports and manage analytical data
* Investigate quality issues and propose corrective actions.

Team Leadership & Training
  
  

* Assign tasks and manage the performance of laboratory personnel
* Train new employees and interns on laboratory procedures and standards.

**Requirements**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Materials Science, Metallurgy, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in the metals industry or quality control
* Proven experience in laboratory management and analytical equipment operation.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Proficiency in operating OES, ICP, XRF, and other analytical instruments
* Familiarity with quality standards including ISO and ASTM
* Experience with quality certifications such as ISO 9001 and ISO 17025 is an advantage.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities
* Effective communication and teamwork skills
* Competence in technical writing and reporting
* Ability to read and understand technical documents in English.

**About Interpay**

**Interpay builds the retail payment software that banks and merchants across Saudi Arabia depend on: POS and SoftPOS acceptance, e-commerce gateways, payment switching and merchant services. Our products handle cardholder data under SAMA regulation and PCI security standards, and they run around the clock.**

**The role**

**Interpay's payment products run around the clock, and so does our support. When a merchant's terminal stops accepting cards, an online payment fails or a monitoring alert fires at 3 a.m., our 24/7 support centre in Riyadh responds first. As a Level 2 Customer Support Specialist, you'll handle the complex, undocumented and multi-system issues, own escalations from Level 1, analyse logs in depth to find the root cause, and act as the senior specialist on shift when the manager is unavailable. You'll report to the Customer Support Manager.**

**What you'll do**

*At Level 2*

* Resolve complex, undocumented and multi-system issues, and own escalations from Level 1
* Analyse logs in depth to isolate root cause, decide the corrective action and spot systemic issues
* Handle complex alerts, correlate events across systems and lead the first response to incidents on your shift
* Produce SLA tracking and operational reports, and highlight trends for management
* Lead customer site visits within Saudi Arabia to resolve issues on location
* Write runbooks and knowledge base articles, coach Level 1 colleagues, and act as senior specialist on shift

*Customer support*

* Answer merchants, banks and partners by phone, email and chat, in Arabic and English
* Log, classify and prioritise every contact in the ticketing system and manage it within SLA
* Troubleshoot POS terminal connectivity and configuration, declined or failed transactions, e-commerce payment errors and merchant portal access
* Walk customers through checks and fixes in plain language, matched to their technical level
* Escalate with a clear description, the steps already taken and the evidence, then follow up until the issue is confirmed resolved

*Monitoring and alerts*

* Watch monitoring alerts and service dashboards throughout the shift
* Triage each alert, assess its impact and take the defined corrective action
* Track every alert to closure, and raise potential incidents from alert patterns before customers report them
* Follow major-incident procedures, including internal escalation and customer communication

*Logs, reporting and knowledge*

**About Lucidya**
Lucidya builds an operating system for Agentic customer experience. Our flagship product line is an agentic platform (Agent Studio) where customers build and run AI agents that resolve real customer experience issues across text and voice channels, in Arabic and English.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The AI Tech Lead is the senior hands-on engineer accountable for the quality, reliability and technical direction of the AI layer of our agentic platform. You will set the technical bar for a team of AI engineers who each own an area, and you will write production code yourself. You will need to wear 2 hats, one is the AI hat and the other is leadership
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Technical direction
  
  

* Own and be accountable for the AI architecture and harness: model selection, prompting patterns, retrieval design, guardrails and voice pipeline
* Make and document technical decisions with clear rationale

Quality, evaluation and reliability
  
  

* Define the evaluation standard and move key work from experimentation to production
* Introduce leading testing frameworks for Agentic development
* Ensure production monitoring and online evals catch quality drops, hallucinations and latency spikes before customers report them

Team leadership and engineering practices
  
  

* Lead the AI team in designing, developing, and delivering our Agentic Platform
* Mentor AI engineers, raise the technical bar through pairing and feedback, and contribute to hiring

Hands-on delivery
  
  

* Lead debugging of critical production incidents involving AI behaviour
* Manage the building of prototypes/experiments to validate new capabilities (new models, agent patterns, voice features) before the team commits to them

Cross-functional partnership

job_description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI and GenAI Inference Optimization**
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff to join our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team. In this customer-facing role, you will work directly with strategic partners and customers as part of the FDE team to enable, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art GenAI inference workloads on AMD data center CPUs and GPUs (Instinct™ family). You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and AMD hardware, driving competitive performance across the full inference stack.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers as part of the FDE team to enable and optimize large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on AMD Instinct GPUs, meeting committed performance and accuracy targets.
* Optimize GenAI inference pipelines on vLLM and SGLang, including PD disaggregation, expert parallelism (EP/wide-EP), tensor/data parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV cache management.
* Develop and tune low-level GPU kernels (Triton, HIP, composable kernels) for attention, MoE, GEMM, quantization, and normalization operations.
* Profile end-to-end workloads, identify bottlenecks across GPU/CPU boundaries, and deliver measurable throughput and latency improvements versus competitive targets.
* Enable advanced data types and techniques (FP8, MXFP4, sparse attention) with a focus on both performance and numerical accuracy.
* Debug complex runtime, stability, and accuracy issues in production environments; partner with core engineering teams to identify root causes and contribute fixes.
* Contribute optimizations back to open-source frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, ATOM, AITER) and internal libraries; document best practices and deliver production-ready artifacts to customers.
* Leverage AI-assisted coding tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, debugging, optimization, and code review across the inference stack

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI and GenAI Inference Optimization**
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Member of Technical Staff to join our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team. In this customer-facing role, you will work directly with strategic partners and customers to enable, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art GenAI inference workloads on AMD data center CPUs and GPUs (Instinct™ family). You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and AMD hardware, driving competitive performance across the full inference stack.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner directly with customers to enable and optimize large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on AMD Instinct GPUs, meeting committed performance and accuracy targets.
* Optimize GenAI inference pipelines on vLLM and SGLang, including PD disaggregation, expert parallelism (EP/wide-EP), tensor/data parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV cache management.
* Develop and tune low-level GPU kernels (Triton, HIP, composable kernels) for attention, MoE, GEMM, quantization, and normalization operations.
* Profile end-to-end workloads, identify bottlenecks across GPU/CPU boundaries, and deliver measurable throughput and latency improvements versus competitive targets.
* Enable advanced data types and techniques (FP8, MXFP4, sparse attention) with a focus on both performance and numerical accuracy.
* Debug complex runtime, stability, and accuracy issues in production environments; partner with core engineering teams to identify root causes and contribute fixes.
* Contribute optimizations back to open-source frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, ATOM, AITER) and internal libraries; document best practices and deliver production-ready artifacts to customers.
* Leverage AI-assisted coding tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, debugging, optimization, and code review across the inference stack.

What You'll Bring

**Job Summary**

The Demand Planning Specialist is responsible for forecasting and analyzing the demand for medical and non-medical supplies across the organization. The role ensures optimal inventory availability, supports procurement planning, and minimizes stock shortages, excess inventory, and wastage through accurate demand forecasting and coordination with hospital departments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain demand forecasts for medical supplies, pharmaceuticals, consumables, and non-medical items based on historical consumption and operational requirements
* Analyze inventory levels, consumption trends, patient volumes, and utilization data to identify future supply requirements
* Coordinate with Procurement, Warehouse, Pharmacy, Nursing, and other hospital departments to ensure accurate demand planning and timely availability of supplies
* Monitor stock movement, reorder levels, lead times, and inventory performance to minimize shortages, overstocking, and expired items
* Prepare demand planning reports, forecasts, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to support management decision-making
* Support procurement planning, budgeting, and inventory optimization initiatives across hospital locations

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in demand planning, supply chain planning, inventory management, or a related function
* Healthcare or hospital supply chain experience is strongly preferred
* Strong knowledge of demand forecasting, inventory planning, consumption analysis, and supply chain processes

**About the Company**

Astek Middle East is part of Astek, a global engineering and technology consulting group founded in France in 1988 and now present on five continents. The Middle East entity delivers IT and technology services across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Jordan, supporting clients in public and government, healthcare, transportation, banking, retail, airlines, and tourism. With 10,000 employees worldwide and revenue of €620 million in 2023, Astek focuses on digital transformation and complex systems engineering for international clients. * Strong hands-on programming experience with Python and SQL.
* Experience building and managing batch and streaming data pipelines.
* Practical experience with ETL/ELT processes.
* Experience working with data lakes and data warehouses.
* Experience with Apache Spark and Kafka.

فرصة وظيفية لدى شركة دير

محلل أسواق مالية وأسهم

نبحث عن محلل يمتلك القدرة على دراسة الأسواق والشركات، وتقييم الفرص والمخاطر، وإعداد تحليلات تدعم قرارات الشركة.

المؤهلات المطلوبة:

\* سعودي الجنسية.

\* بكالوريوس دبلوم خبرات سابقه في المالية أو المحاسبة أو الاقتصاد أو الإحصاء، أو تخصص ذي صلة.

\* إجادة قراءة القوائم المالية وتحليل الأرباح والتدفقات النقدية.

\* فهم تأثير أسعار الفائدة والتضخم والسيولة والسياسة النقدية على الأسواق.

\* إجادة استخدام Excel في التحليل المالي وبناء النماذج.

\* الإلمام بآليات تداول الأسهم وأنواع الأوامر وتكاليف التنفيذ.

\* معرفة بمبادئ إدارة المخاطر وتنويع الاستثمارات.

الخبرات المطلوبة:

\* خبرة عملية في تحليل الأسهم والشركات والقطاعات الاقتصادية.

\* خبرة في تقييم الشركات ومقارنة قيمتها المالية بأسعارها السوقية.

\* القدرة على إعداد التوقعات المالية وتحليل السيناريوهات المختلفة.

\* خبرة في إعداد التقارير وعرض النتائج بوضوح، مع توثيق المصادر والافتراضات.

\* القدرة على مراجعة نتائج التحليلات وتقييم الأداء بموضوعية وانضباط.

يُفضّل الحصول على CFA أو اجتياز أحد مستويات برنامجها، أو امتلاك شهادات CME ذات الصلة بطبيعة الوظيفة.

job_description:
We are looking for a Business Process Excellence Specialist to develop, standardize, and optimize business processes, policies, and procedures across the organization.

The role will focus on process governance, compliance, internal controls, and continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, streamline workflows, and support automation and digital transformation initiatives aligned with the organization's strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, document, and standardize business processes, policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), workflows, and process maps across the organization.
* Conduct periodic process reviews and compliance audits to assess adherence to approved procedures, identify gaps, and evaluate operational effectiveness.
* Analyze existing processes to identify inefficiencies, duplicated activities, unnecessary approvals, and weaknesses in internal controls.
* Lead business process reengineering and optimization initiatives to improve productivity, cost efficiency, and service quality.
* Establish and maintain process governance frameworks, including process ownership, roles and responsibilities, approval authorities, and documentation standards.
* Collaborate with Finance, HR, Procurement, Operations, IT, and other departments to ensure processes align with business objectives and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Review and strengthen internal controls, including segregation of duties, approval workflows, and compliance checkpoints.

* Solid computer skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy when working under high transaction volumes and tight deadlines.
* Detail-oriented with a strong customer service orientation in supply planning.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills to support governance, audit, and archiving requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally and manage stakeholders effectively.

The
**Inventory Controller**
is responsible for maintaining accurate inventory records and ensuring all inventory transactions are processed accurately and timely in the ERP/WMS. The role supports inventory integrity through inventory control, cycle counting, reconciliation, reporting, and compliance with company procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Process inventory transactions in the ERP/WMS, including Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), material issuances, stock transfers, and approved inventory adjustments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with authorized supporting documents
* Plan and conduct periodic cycle counts, coordinate physical inventory counts, and reconcile discrepancies.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies, perform reconciliations, and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor inventory accuracy, stock aging, and slow-moving or obsolete inventory.
* Prepare inventory accuracy reports and KPI dashboards, highlighting inventory discrepancies, adjustment trends, stock aging, and slow-moving or obsolete inventory.
* Ensure compliance with inventory procedures, documentation, and internal controls.
* Support internal and external inventory audits.
* Coordinate with Warehouse, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, and Project teams to resolve inventory-related issues.
* Support ERP/WMS improvements and inventory process optimization.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 4–5 years in Inventory Control, Stock Control, Warehouse Operations, or Materials Management.
* Industry: Systems Integration (SI), ELV, ICT, Security Systems, and Audio-Visual preferred, followed by MEP and Construction.
* ERP: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) is mandatory.
* Technical Experience: GRN posting, material issuance, stock transfers, inventory adjustments, cycle counting, and stock reconciliation in D365.
* Reporting: Strong Excel skills and experience preparing inventory accuracy reports and KPI dashboards.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of inventory management and warehouse operations.
* ERP/WMS proficiency.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

* Inventory Accuracy (%)
* Cycle Count Accuracy (%)
* Inventory Transaction Timeliness (%)
* Inventory Discrepancy Resolution Time
* Inventory Adjustment Accuracy (%)
* Slow-Moving & Obsolete Inventory (Value and SKU Count)

The Lead Cost Engineer owns cost reporting and cost control for the closeout portfolio. Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI and GenAI Inference Optimization**

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff to join our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team. In this customer-facing role, you will work directly with strategic partners and customers as part of the FDE team to enable, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art GenAI inference workloads on AMD data center CPUs and GPUs (Instinct™ family). You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and AMD hardware, driving competitive performance across the full inference stack.

### **Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers as part of the FDE team to enable and optimize large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on AMD Instinct GPUs, meeting committed performance and accuracy targets.
* Optimize GenAI inference pipelines on vLLM and SGLang, including PD disaggregation, expert parallelism (EP/wide-EP), tensor/data parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV cache management.
* Develop and tune low-level GPU kernels (Triton, HIP, composable kernels) for attention, MoE, GEMM, quantization, and normalization operations.

**Role Summary**
----------------

Domain: Math & Quant

Learning Experience Designers own the learning journey for our students. They systematically apply the best of learning science to create outstanding learning experiences for our students. This role will partner with curriculum leads, teachers, product, and engineering to create learner-centred course designs, multimedia learning assets, assessments, and facilitator guides that support measurable student outcomes.

📍 Riyadh-based, office-based, relocation supported

🧭 Part of a new localisation engineering function, built from scratch

Most localisation engineers slot into a pipeline someone else built. This role builds it.

There are hundreds of millions of Arabic-speaking players, and the games industry still treats their language as an afterthought: bolted on late, rendered badly, culturally flat.

One of the biggest names in global gaming is done with that. They’re standing up a dedicated Arabic-first localisation capability from the ground up, and they need the engineer to build it.

We’ve partnered with a fast-growing Riyadh studio, backed by a major global gaming group, to hire their founding Localisation Engineer. You’ll work hand in hand with Unity and the game teams to make Arabic a first-class citizen in their titles, not a patch.

**You’ll own:**

🛠 The localisation engineering stack in Unity, built from zero

🔤 Arabic text done properly: RTL and bidirectional handling, shaping, ligatures, font fallback, text expansion, layout mirroring

⚙️ The pipeline: string extraction and management, integration back into builds, automated checks and pseudo-localisation

🧪 Quality at scale, working closely with QA to catch issues early

🤝 The tooling and standards the game teams build against

This is a hands-on build, not an oversight role.

You’ll be in the code every day. You’ll design the systems, write them, and prove they hold up under real production load. Strong engineering fundamentals and genuine Unity depth are non-negotiable here.

**We’re looking for someone who:**

→ Is a strong Unity and C# engineer with shipped games behind them

→ Writes real, production-grade code and can prove it live, not just whiteboard it

→ Has built or owned localisation, text rendering or tooling systems, RTL and Arabic a major plus

→ Understands text pipelines, build integration, automation and QA collaboration

Arabic language skills and prior MENA localisation experience are a strong plus, not a must.

🏗 A genuine zero-to-one build, your systems, your standards

Role Summary
  
  
Domain: Math & Quant
  
  
Learning Experience Designers own the learning journey for our students. They systematically apply the best of learning science to create outstanding learning experiences for our students. This role will partner with curriculum leads, teachers, product, and engineering to create learner-centred course designs, multimedia learning assets, assessments, and facilitator guides that support measurable student outcomes.
  
  
This role is remote-first and works across time zones to align with our delivery cadence. If you are already based in Riyadh, you are equally welcome to apply and can work from our Riyadh office, full-time or part of the week, whichever suits you.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Design end-to-end learning experiences including scope & sequence, unit plans, lesson plans, assessments, and formative checks aligned to Noon learning outcomes.
* Develop assessment strategies and rubrics that measure mastery and inform iterative improvements to content and instruction.
* Work closely with product and engineering to translate pedagogical designs into scalable digital experiences and to QA learning flows in the platform.
* Ensure learning resources are localised for language and other contextual factors.
* Run rapid prototyping and user testing with students and teachers to validate design decisions and improve engagement and learning gains.
* Train and support teachers and facilitators on new materials, pedagogical approaches, and use of EdTech tools to enable high-fidelity implementation.
* Use data and qualitative feedback to iterate on curriculum and content, driving continuous improvement cycles.

Must-Have Requirements
  
  

* AI is already part of how you design. You use it daily in your own practice - drafting and critiquing materials, generating and stress-testing assessment items, prototyping in hours rather than weeks - and you can show us what you have built with it.
* Bachelor's Degree in STEM, Arts, Education, or a related field.
* Experience designing digital or blended learning experiences for High School grades.
* Passion for Math and helping students learn to love Math.
* Proven experience writing lesson plans, assessments, and facilitator guides informed by learning objectives and evidence-based practices.
* Strong understanding of formative assessment, feedback design, and differentiation strategies for mixed-ability classrooms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English;

**Location:**
Jeddah

We are seeking an experienced ERP Manager to lead Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementation, development, and support across our
**Facility Management and Manpower Services**
operations. The role requires strong functional and technical expertise, with experience connecting business processes across Finance, Supply Chain, HR, and Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end Dynamics 365 implementations, enhancements, and system rollouts across business units.
* Translate business requirements into practical system solutions in collaboration with Finance, HR, Procurement, and Operations.

job_description:
Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
  
  
**About The Role**
Ever wondered what it takes to power truly seamless customer experiences at a world‑class airline?
  
  
In this role, you’ll shape and drive the Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) roadmap, ensuring it supports our ambitions across commercial, loyalty, and customer service.
  
  
You will own the roadmap, driving capabilities across sales, marketing, loyalty, and customer service, ensuring a seamless and personalised guest experience across all touchpoints.
  
  
The role involves defining product requirements, overseeing configurations and integrations, monitoring performance (KPIs such as conversion, NPS, and adoption), and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that enhance customer lifecycle value.
  
  
Central to your success in this role, you'll drive platform configuration and customisation, including workflows, Business Process Flows, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, and AI Builder
  
  
If you’re ready to build, shape, and elevate a world-class platform, then we’d love to hear from you. Let’s create something exceptional, together.
  
  
**About You**
Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 across airline, travel or loyalty driven industries.
  
  
You'll bring hands-on experience in Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service modules, along with a strong understanding of integrations, data, and customer journeys.
  
  
You are analytical, customer-focused, and tech-savvy, with proven experience defining product roadmaps, writing user stories and requirements, and working in Agile environments.
  
  
We'd love to hear from you even more if you have strong experience managing product roadmaps and Agile delivery (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria)
  
  
This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
  
  
Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.
  
  
**This is a full-time, onsite role in Riyadh on a fixed-term contract.

job_description:
**Summary**
The role of
**Anaplan EPM / Planning & Forecasting Architect**
is predominantly focused on establishing and optimizing the finance data model that will underpin future Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), planning, and forecasting initiatives. This position ensures that foundational requirements and integration principles are defined to facilitate subsequent phases.
  
  
Main Responsibilities:
  
  

* Assess current planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes and data structures across affiliates.
* Define planning dimensions, hierarchies, and granularity requirements for the target data model.
* Outline driver-based planning, scenario modeling, and Replacement Cost (RC) margin forecasting considerations for downstream.
* Define conceptual integration principles among ERP/CFIN, EPM, and reporting layers.
* Contribute to EPM readiness actions and dependencies within the foundational roadmap.

Key Requirements:
  
  

* Several end-to-end Anaplan implementations as a Solution Architect or Lead Model Builder.
* Strong understanding of integrated financial and operational planning (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, capex).
* Experience integrating planning platforms with SAP S/4HANA or other ERPs.
* Hands-on experience in downstream Oil & Gas (refining, trading, chemicals, lubricants, retail or integrated value chain) within a multi-entity / multi-affiliate environment.

Nice to Have:
  
  

* Anaplan Certified Solution Architect / Master Anaplanner.
* Knowledge of other Tier-1 EPM platforms (e.g., OneStream, Oracle EPM / Hyperion).
* Experience with predictive forecasting or AI-enabled planning.

Other Details:
  
  

* Location: Dharan, KSA
* Contract Length: 3 months
* Indicative Seniority: Manager / Senior Manager equivalent
* Experience Requirement: 10+ years in EPM; 5+ years in Anaplan
* Phase 1 Workstreams: Finance Data Model, Data & Technology Readiness, Foundational Roadmap & Governance

We are looking for a Master Data Specialist to build and own a golden-record master database of organizations, facilities and distribution partners, and keep it accurate through monthly data releases.

* **Company:** Confidential. A fast-growing B2B data intelligence platform.
* **Location:** Remote, with at least 4 hours' overlap with GMT+4 business hours
* **Reports to:** Founder, with a dotted line to the Data Management Manager
* **Type:** Full-time, immediate start

You will turn raw, inconsistent records from many public and regulatory sources into one trusted record per entity. Each record links to its products, certifications, filings and partners, with a full history of what changed and when. This is a hands-on role across master data management, data stewardship and entity resolution.

**Key responsibilities**

The work runs in three tracks: build the master data foundation, run the monthly stewardship cycle, and keep improving coverage and quality.

1. Build the master data foundation

* Design master tables for each domain with stable unique keys, keeping master, reference and transactional data clearly separated.
* Resolve raw source names into golden records, keeping every name variant in an alias table.
* Define match and survivorship rules: which source wins for each attribute, and why.
* Build hierarchy management: branches and subsidiaries to parent, facilities to owning group.
* Cross-link facility, organization and distributor records that belong to the same group.
* Load dated history for each entity: registrations, certificates, inspections and recalls.

2. Run the monthly stewardship cycle

1. Ingest each new source release and run a delta against the previous month.

2. Match incoming records to golden records using normalized names, standardized addresses, country, web domain and source identifiers.

3. Auto-merge high-confidence matches, route uncertain ones to a manual review queue, and create new entities only after verification.

5. Publish a monthly change log and data-quality scorecard.

**About The Role**
**Role summary:**
Soar is a SAMA-regulated Saudi home-finance platform. We're looking for a hands-on leader to own all of our infrastructure, DevOps operations and data platform. You'll be accountable for reliability, secure and fast delivery to production, and a Snowflake-based data stack the business can trust. You'll report to the CTO and lead the DevOps and data engineering teams across Cairo and Riyadh.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
Infrastructure:
  
  

* Own the cloud architecture (GCP, KSA-resident production), networking, zero-trust access and cost management.
* Set and meet the SLOs for uptime, latency and recovery, and run incident response, on-call and blameless post-mortems.
* Keep infrastructure compliant with SAMA CSF, data-residency and audit requirements, working with Security and GRC.

DevOps:
  
  

* Own the CI/CD and deployment pipelines end to end: build, test gates, release, rollback and environment parity across dev, UAT and prod.
* Standardise infrastructure as code, Kubernetes and Cloud Run practices, secrets management and change control.
* Build observability into everything: logging, metrics, tracing and alerting that cut noise and catch real problems early.

**Summary**
The primary objective of the SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) Lead role is to establish effective governance and structures for product and finance master data. This role is crucial for maintaining data integrity and quality across various entities, ensuring alignment with the target data model.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Assess current product master data, hierarchies, and finance master data quality across affiliates.
* Design a unified product taxonomy, including product hierarchy and material classifications.
* Define data ownership, stewardship, and the master data lifecycle with approval controls.
* Set data quality rules and scorecards, establishing master data governance requirements.
* Define master data readiness actions for CFIN and the roadmap for future EPM.

Key Requirements:
  
  

* Several SAP MDG implementations with a focus on Financials (MDG-F) and Material/Product (MDG-M).
* Experience in designing product hierarchies and classifications in Oil & Gas or chemicals.
* Understanding of hydrocarbon units of measure and conversions.
* Hands-on experience in the downstream Oil & Gas sector within a multi-entity environment.

Nice to Have:
  
  

* Experience with MDG in a CFIN landscape.
* Data quality tooling experience (e.g., SAP Information Steward).
* Knowledge of data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK).

Other Details:
  
  

* Location: Dharan, KSA
* Seniority: Manager/Senior Manager equivalent
* Experience: 10+ years in master data and 5+ years in SAP MDG
* Contract Duration: 3 months, onsite

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Position Type: Full-Time About the

Role We are seeking an experienced and meticulous Compliance Architect (AOR - Architect of Record) to join our Riyadh office.

In this role, you will be responsible for navigating local statutory requirements, municipal codes, and authority approvals, ensuring that our landmark projects fully align with Saudi building codes, urban planning guidelines, and regulatory frameworks.

You will work closely with our design, engineering, and project management teams to bridge visionary design concepts with strict technical compliance and permitting standards across the Kingdom.

Review architectural drawings, specifications, and design packages to ensure 100% compliance with the Saudi Building Code (SBC), local municipal regulations (such as MOMRAH guidelines), and authority-having-jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements.

Authority Approvals & Permitting: Lead the coordination, submission, and follow-up processes with local authorities, municipalities, and utility providers to secure necessary permits and NOCs efficiently.

AOR Documentation & Technical Coordination: Oversee the preparation and finalization of Architect of Record (AOR) documentation packages, bridging concept/schematic designs with local construction detailing and regulatory standards.

Interdisciplinary Quality Control: Collaborate proactively with structural, MEP, and civil engineering teams to resolve clash points and ensure regulatory alignment across all disciplines.

Risk Mitigation: Identify potential regulatory roadblocks or compliance variances early in the design phases and provide actionable, code-compliant solutions.

Authority Liaison: Act as the primary technical point of contact for external municipal reviewers, consultants, and third-party code compliance auditors.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture from an accredited institution. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of professional architectural experience specifically within Saudi Arabia, with a proven track record in regulatory compliance, permitting, and AOR delivery.

Code Expertise: In-depth, practical knowledge of the Saudi Building Code (SBC) and municipal submittal processes in Riyadh or major Saudi municipalities. Software Proficiency: Strong command of Revit, AutoCAD, BIM 360, and standard archit

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant engineering software.

* Customer-facing technical support experience.
* Experience with NETool or equivalent completion modelling software.
* Exposure to mentoring junior engineers and supporting complex completion projects.

JASARA PMC is looking for a talented and highly organized Executive Secretary to join our team. In this role, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to our executive management, facilitating their daily activities and ensuring smooth operational workflow. Your ability to manage time effectively, maintain a strong attention to detail, and communicate effectively will be crucial in ensuring the executive team can focus on strategic initiatives.

  
Key Responsibilities:

* Manage executive calendars, including scheduling meetings and appointments, and ensuring efficient time management.
* Prepare and edit correspondence, reports, and presentations for executive meetings.
* Organize and coordinate travel itineraries, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation.
* Act as the primary point of contact between the executive team and internal/external partners.
* Maintain organized filing systems and ensure the confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Attend meetings, record minutes, and follow up on action items as necessary.
* Facilitate communication and collaboration across departments to ensure projects are completed on time.
* Assist with special projects and perform other administrative duties as assigned.
  

  
  
**Requirements**  

* Proven experience as an Executive Secretary or in a similar administrative role.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Able to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* High level of discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive information.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  

  
  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing organization.
* Make a real impact on Jasara's cybersecurity posture
* Be part of a collaborative and supportive team
