* Strong understanding of cash flow management and financial planning.
* Knowledge of Saudi tax regulations, including VAT and ZATCA requirements.
* Experience in preparing financial statements and coordinating with external auditors.
* Proficiency in accounting systems and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

job_description:
Role Summary

The Director of Operational Excellence is a transformational leader responsible for driving world-class performance across both Factory Operations and Supply Chain Operations. This role is the chief architect of the company's continuous improvement culture, directly accountable for developing smart KPIs, leading digitalization and AI integration, deploying the Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) program, re-engineering core processes, and systematically developing people capabilities. The ultimate objective is to shift the mindset of every employee—from the shop floor to the executive suite—toward zero-loss, high-reliability operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Operational Excellence Strategy (Factory & Supply Chain)

* Lead the design and execution of a unified Operational Excellence strategy across manufacturing plants and supply chain (warehousing, logistics, planning).
* Benchmark internal processes against top-tier industry standards and drive a systematic loss elimination roadmap.
* Partner with Plant Managers and Supply Chain Directors to deploy Lean, Six Sigma, and Agile methodologies.

2. Smart KPIs & Performance Management

* Design, deploy, and govern "Smart KPIs" (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound, and digitally visualized) for all operational functions (Production, Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Warehousing, Transportation).
* Move beyond lagging indicators to implement predictive and real-time leading indicators that drive preventative action.
* Establish a tiered performance cockpit (Daily/Weekly/Monthly) that provides transparency from the executive level to the shop floor.

3. Digitalization & AI Development

* Lead the identification and deployment of digital enablers (MES, WMS, Power BI, IIoT) and Artificial Intelligence (predictive maintenance, demand sensing, computer vision for safety/quality).
* Partner with IT and Data Science teams to create a data architecture that enables automated anomaly detection and root cause analysis.
* Champion a "Digital First" culture, ensuring AI tools augment human decision-making rather than replace it.

4. TPM Program & Mindset Transformation

* Lead the strategic rollout of the Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) program (pillars: Autonomous, Planned, Quality, Focused Improvement, etc.).
* Drive cultural change to instill a Zero-Failure, Zero-Defect, Zero-Accident mindset across all levels—ensuring operators own their equipment and executives sponsor pillar teams.
*

job_description:
The Cluster Director of Finance is a key member of the cluster leadership team, responsible for
  
  
overseeing all finance, accounting, treasury, procurement controls, financial planning, reporting, and
  
  
governance functions across multiple hotels within the portfolio.
  
  
Reporting to the Cluster General Manager, this role serves as a strategic business partner to
  
  
ownership and hotel leadership teams. The Cluster Director of Finance will play a critical role
  
  
throughout the pre-opening, opening, stabilization, and operational phases of the hotels, ensuring
  
  
sound financial management, strong governance, effective cash flow planning, and long-term value
  
  
creation.
  
  
This role combines commercial acumen, financial stewardship, and project finance expertise to
  
  
support a portfolio of hotels with different positioning, customer segments, and operating models.
  
  
The successful candidate will partner closely with ownership and hotel leadership to establish robust
  
  
financial processes, drive profitability, manage risk, and support strategic decision-making across the
  
  
portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Financial Leadership**

* Develop and execute a cluster-wide financial strategy aligned with ownership objectives,

business plans, and brand standard.
  
  

* Serve as a strategic advisor to the Cluster General Manager and hotel leadership teams on

financial opportunities, risks, and business performance.
  
  

* Support business planning, investment decisions, asset enhancement initiatives, and

operational optimization across the portfolio.
  
  

* Establish financial governance frameworks and performance measurement systems for all

properties.
  
  

* Drive a culture of financial accountability, transparency, and commercial awareness

throughout the organization.
  
  
**Pre-Opening Finance Management**

* Lead all finance-related pre-opening activities across the hotel portfolio
* Develop and manage the Finance Pre-Opening Critical Path and readiness plan
* Prepare, review, and manage Pre-Opening Budgets (POB) for all hotels within the cluster
* Monitor pre-opening expenditures to ensure spending remains within approved budgets
* Establish accounting structures, chart of accounts, financial controls, approval matrices, and

reporting frameworks prior to opening.
  
  

* Implement finance systems, purchasing controls, treasury processes, and operational

procedures before opening.

**Shory is a digital platform redefining insurance through technology.**

We simplify complex insurance journeys into seamless, user-friendly experiences, enabling customers to access the right coverage quickly and confidently.

Shory is part of
**First Tech**
, a technology company focused on building and scaling digital platforms across financial services and other industries. First Tech brings deep expertise in product development, engineering, and innovation, enabling the creation of scalable, reliable, and high-impact solutions.

Founded in the UAE in 2021, Shory was created with a vision to redefine insurance through technology. Since launch, it has rapidly evolved into a high-growth digital platform, delivering simple, transparent, and customer-first insurance solutions.

Together, we combine strong technical foundations with a customer-first mindset to deliver modern products that challenge traditional industries and improve everyday experiences. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone is valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

**Finance Manager (مدير مالي) | Steel Manufacturing | Jeddah, Saudi Arabia**

We are a new, large-scale steel manufacturing company in Jeddah, and production starts around January. We are looking for a Finance Manager who can build and run our finance function from the ground up.

**Responsibilities**

* Set up the finance function: chart of accounts, ERP configuration, policies, approval matrix, and internal controls
* Lead the finance department
* Lead cost accounting
* Prepare budgets and forecasts and manage cash flow and working capital
* Track capex and project costs through to plant start-up
* Manage relationships with banks, auditors, suppliers, and government bodies
* Ensure compliance with IFRS and ZATCA requirements (VAT, e-invoicing, withholding tax, and zakat)
* Deliver accurate monthly management reports and KPIs to the CEO and leadership team
* Lead, develop, and coordinate the accounting team (AR, AP, costing, treasury)
* Develop team skills and automate processes.

**Requirements**

* Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
* Bachelors Degree in Accounting Finance or related field
* 8-10 years of finance experience in the manufacturing industry
* Fluent English, spoken and written along with arabic.
* Hands-on ERP experience (SAP)
* Experience leading a finance team
* Based in Jeddah or willing to relocate
* Previous Start Up Experience

**Preferred**

* Start-up, greenfield, or plant ramp-up experience
* Steel, metals, or heavy industry background
* Professional certifications such as CPA, CMA, SOCPA, ACCA, or CA
* Knowledge of Saudi VAT, zakat, and customs
* Arabic language skills

**What we are looking for in you**

You are accurate, highly organized, and a confident communicator. You build strong working relationships with the people around you, and you stay calm and decisive in a fast-moving start-up environment. Great attention to detail and talent within your team. Able to work under pressured environments.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced **Road Civil 3D Coordinator** to join our team on a major infrastructure project in **Qiddiya, Saudi Arabia**.

Working within the project’s design and engineering team, you will be responsible for coordinating **Civil 3D road design activities**, ensuring consistency and quality across models, drawings and deliverables, and supporting effective collaboration between the different engineering disciplines and project stakeholders.

This position is particularly suited to a technically strong Civil 3D professional who combines hands-on modelling expertise with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary road and infrastructure design activities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Civil 3D Coordination**

* Coordinate the production and integration of **Civil 3D models for roads and associated infrastructure**.
* Ensure consistency between alignments, profiles, corridors, surfaces, assemblies and related design information.
* Review Civil 3D models and drawings to identify clashes, inconsistencies and coordination issues.
* Ensure compliance with project modelling standards, naming conventions and agreed workflows.
* Support engineers and designers in resolving complex Civil 3D modelling issues.
* Monitor the quality and consistency of Civil 3D deliverables throughout the design process.

### **Road Design & Multidisciplinary Coordination**

* Coordinate road design interfaces with **earthworks, utilities, drainage, structures, landscape and other infrastructure disciplines**.
* Ensure that road geometry and levels are properly coordinated with surrounding infrastructure.
* Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews and technical coordination meetings.
* Identify design interfaces and potential conflicts at an early stage and coordinate their resolution with the relevant teams.
* Support the integration of design changes into the Civil 3D environment.

### **BIM & Digital Delivery**

Job Req ID: 18302

Description:

**Aramco energizes the world economy.**

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

**Overview**
------------

We are seeking a Process Engineer to join our Downstream Operations Excellence and Compliance Division.

The Downstream Operations Excellence and Compliance Division acts as a performance oversight and advisory body to Aramco Downstream assets and Joint Venture organizations. The division oversees facilities in the Eastern Region Manufacturing, Western Region Manufacturing, Power Systems, Pipelines, Distribution, and Terminals. The organization provides technical guidance and compliance assurance to ensure these critical infrastructure assets operate safely and efficiently.

Your primary role is to ensure robust process safety requirements are met across this diverse downstream portfolio by providing expert oversight, conducting rigorous hazard assessments, and delivering technical advisory services. You will drive continuous improvement in safety culture and integrity management while ensuring all operations comply with corporate policies and regulatory mandates.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  

* Provide strategic oversight and technical guidance on the implementation of Process Safety Management systems across diverse downstream assets, ensuring alignment with corporate safety standards and international best practices

job_description:
We are seeking a highly experienced
**Principal Cloud Operations Engineer**
to serve as the technical authority for our
**Managed Services**
practice. This individual will lead cloud operations architecture, automation strategy, service transitions, operational governance, and engineering excellence across enterprise customer environments.

The successful candidate will combine deep hands-on expertise with cloud-native technologies and operational leadership, helping shape and scale a high-performing cloud operations practice.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical authority for Managed Services cloud operations.
* Define cloud operations standards, reference architectures and operational governance.
* Lead customer onboarding, service transitions and operational readiness assessments.
* Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, automation and platform engineering initiatives.
* Establish and maintain runbooks, operational procedures and escalation frameworks.
* Act as the highest technical escalation point for major incidents and problem management.
* Mentor engineers and help build a world-class cloud operations capability.
* Contribute to solution design, service architecture and managed services growth initiatives.

**Required Experience**

* 12+ years in cloud infrastructure and operations.
* 3-5+ years in a Cloud Architect, Principal Engineer, Practice Lead, or Technical Leadership role.
* Experience building and scaling cloud operations teams and processes.
* Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (GCP preferred).
* Experience operating mission-critical enterprise cloud environments.
* Strong background in cloud automation and Infrastructure-as-Code.

Technical Requirements

* Kubernetes (expert level)
* Terraform (expert level)
* Ansible (expert level)
* CI/CD platforms
* Python and Bash scripting
* Cloud networking, identity and security
* SRE principles, observability and incident management

Certifications

**Required**

* Professional-level GCP cloud certification
* Candidates without GCP certification but able to complete certification upon joining may be considered

**Preferred**

* Professional-level cloud certification in (AWS, Azure or OCI)
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* Additional cloud certifications

**Preferred Background**

* Managed Services
* Cloud Operations
* Site Reliability Engineering
* Enterprise Platform Engineering
* Multi-cloud environments

**Job Title:**
Senior Cloud Engineer – Alibaba Cloud (Professional Services & Managed Services)

**Location:**
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Experience:**
3–7 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer with hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, or other public cloud platforms. Candidates must have strong cloud infrastructure fundamentals and senior-level expertise in at least one specialization:
**VMware VCF & Networking**
or
**DevOps, Kubernetes & Automation**
. Prior Alibaba Cloud experience is not mandatory.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and manage secure cloud infrastructure and landing zones.
* Execute cloud migrations, backup, disaster recovery, and recovery testing.
* Manage cloud networking, security, monitoring, and access controls.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployments or manage VMware environments.
* Handle incidents, changes, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Maintain technical documentation and support customer environments.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, or virtualization.
* Hands-on production experience with at least one public cloud platform.
* Practical experience with cloud deployment, configuration, migration, and disaster recovery.
* Strong Linux administration, Windows Server knowledge, and scripting skills.
* Expertise in at least one of the following:

**Option A – VMware VCF & Networking**

* VMware VCF, vSphere, vCenter, vSAN, and NSX.
* Enterprise networking, hybrid connectivity, and VM migration.
* VMware-based disaster recovery solutions.

**Option B – DevOps & Automation**

* Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/ACK), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Automation using Ansible, Helm, or GitOps tools.

**Certifications**

* Alibaba Cloud ACA Cloud Computing within
  **60 days**
  of joining.
* Alibaba Cloud ACP Cloud Computing within
  **6 months**
  of joining.
* AWS, Azure, VMware, Kubernetes, or Terraform certifications are preferred.

The resource will provide hands-on ServiceNow expertise to plan and execute the application migration from Global ServiceNow to client ServiceNow, working with technical teams, application owners, and the Global ServiceNow team. * Migrate or support migration of ServiceNow application components to the platform.
* Coordinate testing with application owners and technical teams; record and resolve migration issues.
* Support cutover, post-migration validation, and stabilization.
* Document the delivered changes, operational procedures, and handover requirements.
* Follow the security, change-management, and platform-governance requirements.

* Proven experience delivering ServiceNow platform or application migrations.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow configuration and administration, including application components, integrations, and data.
* Experience with migration planning, testing, cutover, issue resolution, and technical documentation.
* Ability to coordinate effectively across platform, infrastructure, security, and business teams.

**Presales Azure Solution Architect**
to design and present innovative Microsoft Azure solutions tailored to client needs. This role blends technical expertise in

job_description:
**Position : L2 Application Support Engineer**

**Job Location : Riyadh, KSA**

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Incident & Problem Management:**

* Take ownership of incidents escalated by Level 1 and lead the investigation until resolution.
* Resolve configuration issues and complex application problems directly in line with the agreed change policy.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for every major incident and produce clear incident reports with preventive actions.
* Escalate genuine code defects to Level 3 (development team), pinpointing the exact defect, logs and evidence.
* Track recurring issues through problem management until the root cause is permanently fixed.

**Release & Change Management:**

* Work with DevOps on every release and validate each change request moving from UAT to production against the release checklist.
* Verify deployments after go-live and support rollback when needed.

**Monitoring & Service Stability:**

* Maintain monitoring dashboards and alerts (Grafana / Prometheus / Loki / Tempo) to detect issues before users are impacted.
* Monitor application performance, APIs, integrations and databases, and act proactively on slowdowns and failures.

**Operations & On-Call:**

* Serve as the Level 2 escalation point in the weekly on-call rotation.
* Meet the agreed SLAs for response and resolution according to incident severity.

**Knowledge & Team Support:**

* Create and maintain runbooks and knowledge-base articles for the supported applications.
* Guide and coach Level 1 engineers and review their escalations.
* Provide regular status updates to the Application Support Leader and stakeholders.

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

* Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent.
* Years of Experience • 3-4+ years’ experience in application support (L2) or supporting backend development, supporting production systems.

**Additional Skills Technical Skills:**

* Good
  **Node.js**
  / Express: reads, debugs and fixes production code.
* Git, GitLab and Jenkins Knowledge; CI/CD pipelines (deployment checks and rollback).
* Strong
  **Linux**
  administration (services, processes, disk, memory, logs) and basic Bash scripting.
* Strong database skills, especially PostgreSQL (complex queries, performance tuning); MySQL / MSSQL a plus.
* Strong knowledge of APIs (REST / SOAP) and system integrations (authentication, timeouts, failures).
* Load balancers, nginx and Redis (caching).
*

**About Deloitte**
: When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.
  
  
**Our Purpose**
Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
  
  
Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:
  
  
During your tenure as a
**Core Banking Architect,**
you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas:
  
  

* Architecture Strategy & Governance

The Case Manager is responsible to coordinate care of patient undergoing surgeries and patient who are admitted and those planed for discharge ensuring the optimum quality of care and patient satisfaction.  
  
Key Responsibilities and Duties:  
  
Ensures patients are adequately prepared for surgery by verifying consent forms, confirming pre-anesthetic assessments, and educating them about the surgical process via direct communication and SMS.  
Provides information about the surgical process and pre-operative preparation to patients and families.  
Conducts comprehensive assessments of patients scheduled for surgery, including medical history, current medications, allergies, and psychosocial factors, and ensure that relevant steps are in place.  
Discusses management plans with the treating physician and ensure that proper booking and diagnostic tests are completed promptly.  
Collaborates with surgical teams, anesthesiologists, and nursing staff to develop and implement individualized perioperative care plans. Ensures that additional referrals, extra payments, and device availability are managed to avoid cancellations.  
Maintains detailed records of patient interactions, care plans, and outcomes to ensure compliance with Fakeeh Care policies and regulatory requirements.  
If delays occur in the operating room, actively resolve the issues by communicating with the concerned parties.  
Evaluates patients thoroughly upon admission, using referrals and unit rounds to identify their needs and determine care requirements for effective care coordination.  
Facilitates regular meetings with healthcare providers from various disciplines (e.g., nursing, pharmacy, social work) to discuss patient care plans, progress, and discharge needs.  
Creates and adjusts individualized care plans based on ongoing assessments and patient feedback, ensuring all aspects of patient care are addressed.  
Starts discharge planning at the time of admission by evaluating potential post-place needs and facilitating a smooth transition to suitable care settings.  
Identifies and coordinates patient resources, including rehabilitation services, home health care, and outpatient follow-up appointments.  
Acts as a patient advocate by addressing concerns, preferences, and barriers to care throughout the place stay.  
Evaluate patients’ needs for discharge by considering medical, functional, and social factors that may impact their post-discharge care.

* Prepare, discuss and finalize IT Consulting reports
* Monitor and ensure the smooth conduct of the IT Consulting engagement.

Employment Details:

Industry: GRC

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Presales / Solution Consultant who enjoys working directly with customers and can translate business and regulatory requirements into effective technology solutions. The ideal candidate will bring experience in enterprise software presales, solution consulting, business analysis, or a related technology role, preferably within GRC, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, BCM, or internal audit.

Key Responsibilities

● Lead technical discussions, product demonstrations, and solution presentations.

● Understand customer business requirements and translate them into effective solutions.

● Develop solution proposals, presentations, RFP/RFQ responses, and technical documentation.

● Conduct product demonstrations and proof-of-concepts (PoCs).

● Work closely with Sales teams to develop proposals and strategies.

● Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design customer solutions.

● Participate in customer workshops and requirement-gathering sessions.

● Support RFPs and tenders from technical and solution perspectives.

● Demonstrate how Solidrange solutions address customer business and regulatory requirements.

● Stay up to date with GRC, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and enterprise technology trends.

Qualifications and Skills:

● Minimum 3 years of experience in Presales, Solution Consulting, Business Analysis, or a related technology role.

● Strong presentation and communication skills.

● Ability to understand complex business requirements.

● Experience in enterprise software presales or solution consulting.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

● Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

● Experience with RFPs, tenders, PoCs, and product demonstrations.

● Strong customer-facing skills.

● Arabic speaker.

Preferred Background:

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

● GRC / Risk Management.

● Cybersecurity.

● Compliance and Regulatory Technology.

● Business Continuity Management (BCM).

●Internal Audit.

If you are passionate about technology, customer engagement, and helping organizations solve complex business and compliance challenges, we would be pleased to hear from you.

**IT Specialist, Saudi Arabia, Dammam, 2nd Industrial City**
**Primary Purpose:**
The purpose of this position is to plan and support the technology infrastructure needs for the Saudi Arabia Team. This support includes manufacturing systems support (hardware and software), laptops, desktops, servers, networks, security, voice, printers, desktop and business software.
  
  
**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
The primary duties consist of the following:
  
  

* Planning of hardware, software assets for a given budget cycle.
* Budget requests will be reviewed by USA IT.
* Support the Musco team regarding daily IT needs for all departments.
* Implement IT standards from USA regarding implementation of new hardware or software.
* Ensure that Musco data stays protected and that can be recovered in the event of a disaster.
* Maintain computer equipment used by Team Members and Production to meet required uptime.
* Adhere to established IT Security requirements and Incident Response procedures.

**Job Specifications**
Knowledge of the following
  
  

* Office 365 Applications
* Citrix XenApp
* Windows Desktop Operating System
* Windows Server 2019, 2022, 2025
* AutoCAD
* Sonicwall Firewall technologies
* 8x8 Cloud Phone System
* Network technologies like Wifi, Ethernet, Cat 6, Single mode fiber, TCP/IP
* Network hardware configuration and support
* Printer support

**Other Special Requirements**

* On occasion may need to support the Musco Gulf Team (i.e. Abu Dhabi, Qatar) which may require travel.
* Ability to speak fluent English in addition to local Arabic language.

**Who Is Musco**
Musco is the world leader in sports and large-area lighting, providing innovative solutions for projects in more than 125 countries. With headquarters in Oskaloosa, Iowa, Musco has more than 1,800 global team members across Iowa, the USA, and the world.
  
  
A privately held company since 1976, our supportive and caring culture is based on relationships and creating value. Musco lighting solutions are found on neighborhood fields, major stadiums and arenas, international airports, rail yards, the Olympic Games, iconic landmarks, and some of the largest ports around the globe.
  
  
**Our Culture And Benefits**
At Musco, we offer opportunities for meaningful work in a company you can truly be proud of. We embrace a team-first culture, fostering continuous learning through hands-on experiences and providing access to a wide range of professional development opportunities.

Qiddiya Investment Company is looking for a dedicated and skilled Manager - CCU Incident Management (DEL5) to be responsible for monitoring, triaging, and managing operational incidents across all Qiddiya city assets. This role ensures that all incidents are detected, escalated, and resolved in a timely and structured manner to minimize disruption to guest experience and city operations

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor real-time incident feeds, alarms, and communications across the City Command Unit's integrated operations platform.
* Triage and classify incidents according to severity levels and escalation protocols, ensuring appropriate response activation.
* Coordinate multi-agency and cross-functional response efforts, liaising with Security, Fire & Life Safety, Medical, Facilities, and asset operators.
* Maintain accurate, real-time incident logs and post-incident documentation to support reporting and continuous improvement.
* Support the development and refinement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for incident response workflows.
* Participate in simulation exercises, tabletop drills, and after-action reviews to strengthen organizational readiness.
* Ensure compliance with Qiddiya's operational readiness standards and regulatory requirements during incident response.

* Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in incident management, emergency operations, or command center environments within large-scale entertainment, hospitality, or urban operations settings.
* Demonstrated experience with integrated command and control systems, CCTV monitoring, and digital incident management platforms.
* Strong situational awareness, decision-making capability under pressure, and effective communication skills.
* Strong understanding of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL.
* Proven track record in managing critical incidents and leading incident response teams.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL certification, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or similar) are preferred.

  
**Benefits**

Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

job_description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Credit & Collections function supports Medtronic’s business in Saudi Arabia by managing customer receivables, following up on payments, resolving account discrepancies, and minimizing credit risk. The team works closely with healthcare customers, Sales, Customer Care, and Finance to maintain accurate accounts and support timely collections. This role is based in Riyadh with a flexible work arrangement.
  
  
As a Credit & Collections Clerk III, you will manage a portfolio of customer accounts, follow up on overdue payments, reconcile balances, and resolve invoice discrepancies. Working with healthcare customers, Sales, Customer Care, and Finance, you will help remove payment barriers and maintain accurate account records. Your work will directly contribute to timely collections, reduced overdue receivables, and stronger customer relationships.  
  
  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and follow up on overdue payments to support timely collections.
* Reconcile customer balances and resolve discrepancies involving invoices, payments, and credit notes.
* Coordinate with Sales, Customer Care, and Finance to resolve disputes and remove payment barriers.
* Monitor payment commitments and escalate overdue accounts or potential credit risks in line with company procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of collection activities, customer communications, and account status.
Prepare accounts receivable updates highlighting overdue balances, collection progress, and required follow-up actions.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with at least two years of experience in accounts receivable or collections.
* Experience in customer account reconciliation, overdue payment follow-up, and invoice discrepancy resolution.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and written and verbal business communication in Arabic and English.  

  

**Preferred Qualification**

**Internal Audit Manager – Construction & Capital Projects**

Seeking an experienced
**Internal Audit Manager**
to join its Group Internal Audit function, based in Saudi Arabia and focused on construction and capital projects across the Kingdom. The role reports to the Senior Internal Audit Manager in Doha and serves as the primary in-country audit lead.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead risk-based audits across construction, EPC, and capital projects in line with applicable IIA standards.

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline; CIA, CPA, CFE, or equivalent certification required or near completion.
* 10+ years of progressive internal audit experience, with substantial exposure to construction, EPC, or capital projects.
* Strong expertise in project commercial controls, cost management, contract administration, claims, variations, and JV governance.
* Proven ability to lead engagements independently, challenge senior stakeholders, and communicate findings effectively.
* Excellent English communication and report-writing skills; Arabic is an advantage.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia, with flexibility for project site visits.

job_description:
**At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.**
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**The opportunity**
EY wavespace Riyadh is a flagship, executive-facing environment designed to host immersive client workshops, leadership engagements, and strategic programmes across government, infrastructure, energy, and enterprise sectors.
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive
**Event Technology Support Specialist**
to lead and manage all aspects of technology support within the wavespace. This role is critical in delivering seamless, high-quality technology experiences and ensuring the success of client engagements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead technology planning and execution for client workshops, leadership sessions, and wavespace programmes
* Configure and prepare the wavespace environment to enable immersive and design thinking experiences

* Operate and maintain AV systems including LED walls, interactive displays, control systems, and Microsoft Teams Rooms
* Ensure technology readiness and perform routine health checks and maintenance
* Act as the primary on-site technology point of contact during workshops and events
* Collaborate with facilitators, account teams, vendors, and global wavespace teams
* Support onboarding and training of additional or backup support personnel
* Proactively identify and implement improvements to enhance client experience and technology reliability
* Ensure compliance with EY security, governance, and risk standards
* Support inspections, audits, and readiness checks for key client engagements

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong troubleshooting skills across AV, hardware, software, and collaboration platforms
* Hands-on experience with enterprise AV systems and Microsoft Teams environments
* Ability to perform effectively in high-pressure, client-facing settings
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Hold AV certifications

The Director, Parking is the asset owner and accountable business lead for all municipal parking assets across Qiddiya. job_description:
**Project description**

We are hiring a Sr. Functional Support Analyst – Trade Innovation who will provide functional support across bridge business stakeholders and technology teams on Finastra Trade Innovation implementations, upgrades and enhancements. You will own requirements end to end, from product and configuration changes, business user support, testing.

**Responsibilities**

Functional Support & Incident Management:

Provide L2/L3 functional troubleshooting for end-user issues arising during the trade lifecycle.

Analyze and resolve transactional errors, master data configuration mismatches, and failed workflows within the FTI engine.

Replicate production bugs in staging environments, documenting detailed steps, logs, and business impact before escalating to L3 developers or Finastra vendors.

Acknowledge and resolve support tickets within defined SLA limits to minimize operational downtime

**Skills**

Must have

7-10 years of total IT experience

Deep Expertise in Finastra Trade Innovation and Trade Finance Operations, deep Trade Innovation functional knowledge.

Finastra Trade Innovation:

At least 3 years of hands-on experience with Finastra Trade Innovation (TI Plus, TI Plus2 or Fusion Trade Innovation), ideally across two or more implementations or upgrades.

Working knowledge of TI modules: Import and Export LCs, Standby LCs, guarantees (issued and received), Import and Export Collections, Shipping Guarantees, Trade Loans/Financing and Bills discounting.

Understanding of TI static data, customer and account setup, charges and tariffs, posting/accounting rules, event and step workflow, and user roles.

Familiarity with TI integration options (web services, message queues, file-based interfaces) and the TI Corporate Portal or bank's own corporate channel.

Trade finance domain:

Strong grasp of the full lifecycle of documentary credits, guarantees, collections and trade financing products.

Working knowledge of ICC rules: UCP 600, ISBP 821, URDG 758, ISP98, URC 522, URR 725, eUCP and Incoterms 2020.

SWIFT Category 4 and 7 messages and MT798; awareness of trade digitisation (MLETR, electronic bills of lading).

Knowledge of supply chain finance (payables, receivables, invoice financing) is an advantage.

Functional Support Specialist ensure the core platform runs smoothly by handling system workflows, resolving transactional blocks, and translating changing trade policies into functional software updates.

Job description:
  
  
Job Purpose

This position exists to oversee and analyze cost expenditures and purchases efficiently, in timely manner and quality standards as per thedefined policies and procedures to achieve departmental operational plans and developments within widerscope.

Functional Responsibilities

Actual Costing:

* Monthly Coordination with production to finalize all actual activities & Closing orders
* Monthly Checking all actual data posted by production & make required adjustment if required.
* Monthly Processing period end closing & posting (WIP, Variances, Un-realizes cost, etc.)
* Monthly posting all costing entries & provisions.
* Monthly Checking & Analyzing for the result of period end closing.
* Monthly checking expenses & make adjustment if required
* Monthly Settlement for investment internal orders to AUC & Cost center
* Design and updating distribution cycle to allocate service & General cost center costs
* General Problem Solving For Costing Issues, Supervising, Supporting, etc.

 Standard Costing:

* Preparing planned costing data with agreed plant activity
* Enter standard cost & standard plant activity in the system and calculate the rate.
* Maintain & Updating activities rate for production work centers
* Regularly Check & adjusting materials master.
* Regularly Check master data (BOM & Routing) & inform planning to make required adjustment.
* Material Costing run, to calculate planned cost.
* Maintain production orders overhead percentage.
* Upload overhead costs to production orders based on that maintained percentage.
* Regularly Analyzing cost for items & coordinating with planning for any correction
* Regularly Release the cost for related items.

 Costing & Controlling Analysis:

* Analyze WIP & provide justification for major orders.
* Analyze Un-realized cost & provide justification for major orders
* Identify and analyzing production, purchasing, and inventory variances
* Controlling on actual time posted by comparing with routing & making proper reporting to management.
* Preparing master consumption report with proper adjustments
* Controlling on actual consumption & monitoring irregularities cost for material & reporting to management

Monthly Controlling ORM & Financial Reports:

* Monthly preparation of consumption & production masters.
* Monthly preparation of costing statement per product type.
* Prepares special costing reports,
* Monitoring actual vs. budget & standard costing reports & variance analysis

**ABYAT**
- Your Gateway to Retail Excellence!

**About us**

Are you ready to be part of the largest retail store in the Middle East?
**ABYAT**
, spanning an impressive 22,000 square meters and offering over 22,000 products, is your one-stop destination for all things home improvement and more. From elegant tiles and captivating wallpapers to state-of-the-art lighting solutions and stylish kitchen fixtures, we pride ourselves on offering a diverse array of top-quality products under one roof.

Established locally with a vision for excellence,
**ABYAT**
has been setting benchmarks since its inception in September 2005. With an unwavering focus on our customers, we've crafted an experience that revolves around their needs, from our meticulously designed store layouts to our unparalleled service offerings.

Expanding beyond our roots in Kuwait,
**ABYAT**
is now making waves in Saudi Arabia and setting our sights on Qatar and the UAE. As we continue to grow, we're seeking passionate individuals to join our dynamic team and contribute to our journey of success.

**Position**
: Supply Chain Planner

**Location**
: KSA – Dammam

**Type**
: Full-time

**Number of Vacancies:**
2

**Role Purpose**

Support business expansion into new areas and markets by ensuring effective material planning, procurement, and logistics coordination. Maintain the required service levels for new kitchens, remodeling projects, and new product categories, including Bedrooms, Wardrobes, Laundry, Coffee Corners, and Wall Cladding.

The role combines material planning with procurement and international logistics responsibilities, with each position having a specific area of expertise.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Material Planning & Inventory Management**

* Review sales demand, forecasts, customer orders, production requirements, and current inventory levels.
* Run and review Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and prepare replenishment plans to ensure timely material availability.
* Maintain accurate planning parameters, supplier lead times, safety stock levels, and delivery dates in SAP.

**The Company:**

Almarai is the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy and the region’s largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Almarai Company is ranked as the #1 FMCG Brand in the MENA region and is a market leader in all its categories across the GCC. Almarai currently employs over 40,000 employees servicing some 220,000 retail outlets across GCC, Egypt and Jordan and has reported net income of SAR 2.31 Billion on sales of SAR 20.97 Billion in 2024
**.”**
. For more details, please visit our website –
www.almarai.com.

An aggressive expansion program together with acquisitions in new vertical markets have created an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic multinational team dedicated to furthering growth plans for the group.

**About the role:**

To plan and control stock levels/availability of all materials and ingredients required for your designated portfolio within the CPP and CHP manufacturing environment, this will be achieved by using SAP and analyzing the required service levels/working capital budget and taking into consideration delivery lead times, seasonal constraints, available storage etc.

* Optimize production utilization by ensuring 100% efficiency of the Blow & Injection Molding facility.
* Develop material and ingredient run-out plans to effectively manage and minimize obsolete inventory.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field.
* At least 1 year of experience in Project Management.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills.
* High Excel proficiency.
* English Fluency.

Almarai offers a competitive package, generous leave, medical coverage, discretionary bonus, training, and development etc.

job_description:
**Senior Commercial Project Manager – Saudi Arabia/Riyadh**
Siemens strongly believes in the value of a Digital Portfolio, hence Smart Infrastructure combines Digital Power Distribution and Digital Building Infrastructure technologies. Our Digital Portfolio will enable our customers to enjoy occupant’s intuitive buildings which are comfortable, safe, secure and energy efficient.
  
  
Smart infrastructure from Siemens intelligently connects energy systems, buildings and industries to adapt and evolve the way we live and work. We work together with customers and partners to build an ecosystem that intuitively responds to the needs of people and helps customers to better use resources. It helps our customers to thrive, communities to progress and supports sustainable development.
  
  
Join our Smart Infrastructure Buildings division as Senior Commercial Project Manager – and help us re-imagine the world by finding solutions and making the world a smarter place for tomorrow.
  
  
**Your Role – International, Challenging And Future-Oriented!**

* Perform Commercial Project Management activities and tasks for the assigned Projects Portfolio.
* Drive end to end commercial execution, business performance planning and ensure alignment of portfolio performance with organization goals.
* Oversight of commercial execution across projects and contracts, ensuring alignment with KPIs (Revenue, Billing Plans, Cashflow and Margins)
* Contract & Claim management with clients and subcontractors
* Driving & monitoring of project KPIs (Revenues, Cashflows, Billing Plans etc.)
* Ongoing project Performance Monitoring (calculation and plan vs actual deviations)
* Ensuring timely cleanup of balance sheet and aging commitments costs
* Evaluation of Risks & Opportunities, risk mitigations and reporting
* Monitoring and evaluation of plan, actual & committed costs, and identification & corrections of discrepancies
* Processing of purchase orders, sales orders, debit & credit notes, and invoicing in SAP
* Bills verification with reference to agreed terms & conditions
* Maintaining progress & payment records of subcontractors
* Follow up of accounts receivable
* Ensuring compliance of policies & procedure of documentation required for smooth processing of subcontractors' payments
* Coordination with treasury for bonds, guarantees, letter of credits etc
* Planning & monitoring of procurements and equipment shipping schedules

**Your Qualifications And Skills – Digital And Solid!**

**Company Description**
Lapp RHQ Saudi Arabia is a newly established local subsidiary of LAPP, based in Riyadh, created to strengthen the company’s presence and offerings in the Saudi market. LAPP has operated in Saudi Arabia for over a decade, supporting large-scale projects such as Qiddiya, an amusement park with an attached Formula 1 racetrack. The new entity enables greater participation in public tenders and supports LAPP’s Strategy 2027, which focuses on growth in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. Lapp RHQ Saudi Arabia operates an office and training center in Riyadh, providing technical training on automation protocols and cable applications tailored to regional standards. The subsidiary’s portfolio is being adapted to local requirements, with a particular focus on Building Management System (BMS) solutions for complex infrastructure and mega-projects across the country.

**Role Description**
The Senior Accountant role is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves managing daily accounting operations, including general ledger entries, account reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, and oversight of month-end and year-end closing activities. The Senior Accountant will prepare and analyze financial statements, support budgeting and forecasting, and ensure compliance with local regulations, internal policies, and applicable accounting standards. The role also includes coordinating with external auditors, supporting tax filings, and implementing process improvements to enhance financial accuracy and efficiency. Collaboration with cross-functional teams and regional stakeholders is essential to provide timely financial insights and support business decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounting & Financial Management**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records in compliance with company policies and Saudi regulations.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports.

The Production Planner will support t department by translating business supply needs into actionable production schedules. This role focuses on continuous improvement across the supply chain, optimizing inventory levels, shortening end‑to‑end lead times, and leading ERP system enhancements to ensure efficient plant operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Input new item organization data, including make/buy lead-time/Planner code etc.

* Review MRP compression and exception messages and resolve conflicts. Including ensuring regular communication with production/project management/procurement and the master scheduler.
* Attend production meetings to ascertain scheduling adherence, focusing on ETA/Demand supply.
* Support production management during the production meetings - communicating to the manufacturing team if the material is available to meet the manufacturing plan or highlighting the risks and leading to issue resolution.
* Reviewing the ERP system daily, making sure the material quantities are available in line with order due dates.

Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
  
  
**Job Description**
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES AND ACTIVITIES**
**Quality Assurance**

* Follow daily operational tasks to ensure seamless work continuity and smooth functioning of the Quality processes.
* Contribute to the timely and accurate preparation of reports related to quality assurance and performance metrics. Ensure these reports meet the required standards, objectives, and goals.
* Monitor and evaluate agent performance on both voice and non-voice transactions using a quality monitoring system. Focus on script adherence, data accuracy, process consistency, and product knowledge.

* Monitor and verify that quality benchmarks are consistently met on both individual and program levels. Take corrective actions when required.
* Conduct coaching / refreshing sessions to existing agents to make sure they are on the right track in implementing the SOP’s.
* Assure that data entered into the system is accurate and follows the defined entry standards.
* Monitor and verify that quality benchmarks are consistently met on both individual and program levels. Take corrective actions when required.

UNIMAC is a leading construction and infrastructure contractor in Saudi Arabia, specializing in roads, highways, civil engineering, and large-scale infrastructure development.

We are looking for experienced
**BIM Modelers**
across multiple engineering disciplines to join our Digital Delivery team and support one of Saudi Arabia's major infrastructure projects.

* **Electrical BIM Modeler:**
  Lighting, LV networks, electrical infrastructure, and telecommunications.
* **Mechanical BIM Modeler:**
  Wet utilities, irrigation, drainage, mechanical piping, and HVAC.
* **Roads BIM Modeler:**
  Road corridors, alignments, grading, earthworks, drainage, and civil infrastructure.

* Develop and maintain accurate 3D BIM models for the assigned discipline.

* Coordinate with engineering teams to identify and resolve clashes.

* Support asset information management, COBie documentation, and project handover.
* Ensure compliance with project BIM standards, BEP, and ISO 19650.

**Requirements**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum

The candidate for this position will be responsible for monitoring the operations of our systems, including quality and compliance. The candidate should also be able to recommend improvements to the process through the tracking of metrics and reporting of data. The candidate should definitely have strong technical abilities in order to succeed in this role.

**Responsibilities**

1. **Process Planning：**
   Lead the development plan of the process department, process technology development plan, formulation of process schemes, compilation of process measures and process documents, and conduct review for all the above‑mentioned deliverables.
2. **New‑Process Research：**
   Prepare implementation plans for new‑process R&D based on new‑process R&D plans. Organize the process team to carry out new‑process project initiation, process tests, trial application, project summary and project acceptance, and supervise the whole R&D process.
3. **Process Training：**
   In accordance with corporate training plans and workshop staff demands, organize departmental training for new workshop operators on basic process knowledge and key operational points. Deliver training on key process points for operators involved in new‑process adoption. Train relevant operators on corrective measures formulated for processes with quality issues. Complete other assigned process‑training tasks.
4. **Process Discipline Management：**
   Strengthen company‑wide management of processes, tooling and material utilization through routine patrol inspections, special process‑discipline inspections and safety‑civilization inspections. Supervise and inspect the implementation of process documents and process discipline within production departments, so as to guarantee safe, reliable and stable operation of product quality and all production & business activities.
5. **Process Document Management：**
   Organize the compilation of new‑product process notices, process specifications and work instructions according to structural features and processing requirements of new products.    Implement staff promotion, recruitment and competency development in line with departmental manpower planning.

**Job Purpose:**

Lead legal and contractual matters throughout the project lifecycle, from tendering and negotiation to financial close, implementation, operations, and compliance, protecting the Company's interests and ensuring effective risk management.

**Responsibilities:**

* Tendering & Development: Review RfQs, RfPs, project agreements, legal risks, qualifications, and contractual deviations.
* Partnerships & Structuring: Draft and negotiate NDAs, MoUs, consortium, JV, shareholder, and SPV agreements.
* Negotiation & Financial Close: Lead legal negotiations of PPP, BOT/BOOT, concession, EPC, O&M, and financing-related agreements.
* Project Implementation: Support contract administration, variations, claims, disputes, contractual amendments, and risk mitigation.
* Compliance & Governance: Ensure regulatory compliance, contractual obligations, corporate governance, and required approvals throughout the project lifecycle.
* Legal Coordination: Manage external legal advisors and provide strategic legal advice to Management and project teams.

**Functional Skills and Knowledge:**

* Strong expertise in infrastructure, PPP, EPC, concession, and O&M contracts.
* Contract drafting, negotiation, project finance, and dispute resolution.
* Knowledge of Saudi legislation, corporate governance, and regulatory compliance.

**Interpersonal Skills:**

* Strong negotiation, analytical, and commercial judgment.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work across multidisciplinary and international teams.

**Qualifications/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Law; LL.M. advantageous.
* Qualified legal professional with 12–15 years of relevant experience.
* Proven experience in infrastructure projects from tendering through implementation and operations.
* Water, wastewater, utilities, and Saudi PPP experience preferred.

فرصة وظيفية | Director of Operations

**شركة محطات ترانزيت | Transit Stations Company**

**تعلن شركة محطات ترانزيت عن توفر فرصة وظيفية قيادية بمسمى مدير إدارة العمليات (Director of Operations)**
للانضمام إلى فريق العمل بمدينة الرياض، لقيادة العمليات التشغيلية للشركة والإشراف على محطات الوقود والمرافق والأنشطة التجارية التابعة لها، بما يضمن تحقيق الكفاءة التشغيلية والربحية وجودة الخدمات.

المهام والمسؤوليات:

* قيادة وإدارة العمليات التشغيلية لجميع محطات الوقود والمرافق والأنشطة التجارية التابعة للشركة.
* الإشراف على الأقسام التابعة لإدارة العمليات، وتشمل: تشغيل المحطات، الأعمال الهندسية، الصيانة، السلامة، النقل والإمداد والتوزيع، والمتاجر.
* إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط والاستراتيجيات التشغيلية بما يتوافق مع أهداف الشركة وخطط التوسع.
* إدارة الميزانيات والمصروفات التشغيلية (OPEX)، ومراقبة التكاليف وتحليل الانحرافات وتحسين الربحية.
* متابعة أداء المحطات ومبيعات الوقود والأنشطة التجارية، وتطوير المبادرات لزيادة الإيرادات ورفع الكفاءة التشغيلية.
* ضمان جاهزية المحطات والمعدات والمرافق من خلال الإشراف على أعمال الصيانة والتطوير الهندسي.
* الإشراف على عمليات نقل الوقود والإمداد والتوزيع وضمان استمرارية التوريد وكفاءة إدارة المخزون.
* ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والجودة وإجراءات التشغيل القياسية (SOPs) في جميع المواقع.
* قيادة مديري الأقسام والفرق التشغيلية وتطوير أدائهم وضمان تحقيق الأهداف المعتمدة.
* الإشراف على خطط افتتاح وتشغيل المحطات الجديدة وضمان جاهزيتها التشغيلية.
* تطوير أنظمة الرقابة التشغيلية ولوحات المتابعة (Dashboards) وإعداد التقارير التنفيذية للإدارة العليا.
* قيادة مبادرات التحسين المستمر ورفع الإنتاجية وخفض التكاليف وتحسين تجربة العملاء.

المؤهلات والمتطلبات:

* بكالوريوس في الهندسة أو إدارة الأعمال أو إدارة العمليات أو تخصص ذي صلة، ويفضل حملة الماجستير.
* خبرة لا تقل عن
  **10 سنوات في إدارة العمليات، منها 5 سنوات على الأقل في مناصب قيادية**
  .
* يفضل بشدة وجود خبرة مباشرة في
  **قطاع محطات الوقود أو سلاسل التجزئة متعددة الفروع**
  .
* خبرة في إدارة العمليات التشغيلية والصيانة والنقل والإمداد والأنشطة التجارية.
* معرفة متقدمة بإدارة الميزانيات التشغيلية (OPEX) وتحليل الربحية وضبط التكاليف.
* خبرة مثبتة في قيادة فرق عمل متعددة التخصصات وإدارة عمليات واسعة النطاق.
* مهارات قيادية وتحليلية عالية والقدرة على التخطيط واتخاذ القرارات وإدارة الأزمات.
* إجادة استخدام أنظمة ERP وأدوات إعداد التقارير والتحليل مثل Excel وPower BI.
* إجادة اللغة العربية والإنجليزية تحدثاً وكتابة.
* الاستعداد للزيارات الميدانية والسفر بين مواقع الشركة عند الحاجة.

**موقع العمل:**
الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية.

**المسمى الوظيفي:**
Director of Operations

job_description:
**Company Description**
Mitwalli Steel Dammam is a steel manufacturing and processing company based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, serving a variety of industrial and construction sectors. The company focuses on delivering reliable steel products and services that meet local and regional market needs. Mitwalli Steel emphasizes operational efficiency, quality standards, and customer satisfaction in all aspects of its work. Team members are encouraged to contribute to continuous improvement and support the company’s growth in the Saudi market.

**Role Description**
The General AR Accountant role is a full-time, on-site position based in Dammam, responsible for managing the accounts receivable cycle for the company. Daily tasks include preparing and issuing customer invoices, recording receipts, reconciling customer accounts, and following up on outstanding balances to ensure timely collection. The role involves monitoring aging reports, resolving discrepancies with customers and internal teams, and supporting month-end and year-end closing activities related to receivables. The General AR Accountant will collaborate closely with the finance and sales departments, maintain accurate documentation, and adhere to internal controls and local regulatory requirements. This position is designated for Saudi nationals only, in line with local employment guidelines.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Accounting and Finance skills, with experience in accounts receivable processes and basic knowledge of financial reporting.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret data, identify discrepancies, and support problem-solving in receivables and reconciliations.
* Candidates should possess practical Invoicing experience, including issuing invoices, recording transactions, and managing aging reports.
* Candidates should possess clear and professional Communication skills to coordinate with customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and familiarity with ERP or accounting software is beneficial.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Knowledge of local accounting standards and Saudi VAT regulations is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Dammam and collaborate effectively
* **3-4 Years of experience minimum in this field**
* **GPA MUST BE MENTIONED IN C

**Company:**
Prima International

**Location:**
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Reports to:**
CEO / COO

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

Prima International is seeking an experienced
**Plant Manager**
to lead its frozen bakery manufacturing facility in Riyadh, with overall accountability for plant performance, food safety, product quality, workforce development, and financial results.

Working through the Operations Manager and plant department heads, the Plant Manager will translate business objectives into manufacturing strategies, establish performance standards, and ensure the facility consistently meets customer requirements. The role requires strong leadership, commercial awareness, and substantial experience in industrial frozen bakery manufacturing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and execute the plant’s annual operating plan, aligning production capacity, workforce requirements, budgets, and improvement priorities with company objectives.
* Lead the Operations Manager and plant department heads, setting clear responsibilities, performance targets, and accountability for results.

* Ensure production capacity and resources support sales forecasts, customer commitments, seasonal demand, and business growth.
* Own the plant’s operating budget, monitor manufacturing costs and financial performance, and deliver sustainable improvements in productivity and profitability.
* Develop capital investment proposals for equipment, automation, infrastructure, and capacity expansion, supported by business cases and expected returns.

* Ensure manufacturing processes consistently meet approved product specifications, with appropriate controls over dough processing, lamination, proofing or baking where applicable, freezing, packaging, and cold storage.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure effective management of workplace hazards, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Hold teams accountable for equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, utilities availability, and the integrity of refrigeration and cold-chain systems.

Strategic Alliances & Institutional Development – Institute Itech

* Full-time position
* On-site (Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
* Travel and meeting expenses will be reimbursed upon approval
* An NDA must be signed

This position may evolve into Head of Strategic Partnerships – MENA or Regional Director – Saudi Arabia, depending on performance and ability to secure high-value institutional partnerships.

**About Institute Itech:**

Institute Itech is a private research, development and technological innovation institute based in Italy with an international vision. It was created to transform scientific knowledge, advanced engineering and emerging technologies into concrete solutions for the environment, health, data intelligence, artificial intelligence, urban systems and technological infrastructure.

The company is built on a multidisciplinary vision structured around six pillars: Education, Technology, Social, Nature, Research and Urban. Through these areas, Institute Itech develops high-impact projects capable of improving quality of life, making cities more sustainable and creating new models of scientific, industrial and social progress.

Its flagship projects include:

* **Memoria**
  – AI-based neuroimaging and cognitive data intelligence
* **Oxyleaf**
  – environmental monitoring and air quality technologies
* **Terra**
  – advanced soil and ecological remediation systems
* **Polaris**

* **Balloon**

* **Biocity**

Institute Itech is seeking a senior, well-connected, and strategically minded
**Strategic Partnership Manager**

**مهندس مدني موقع (تركيب أبراج كهرباء - Transmission Tower Civil Engineer)**

**المتطلبات والمؤهلات:**

* **المؤهل:**
  درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية.
* **الخبرة:**
  **لا تقل عن 5 سنوات**
  خبرة ميدانية في مجال تركيب وإنشاء أبراج نقل الكهرباء (Power Transmission Towers).
* **المهارات الفنية:**
* إشراف كامل على تنشئة وقواعد الأبراج الخرسانية (Tower Foundations) وأعمال التربة والمساحة.
* متابعة وإدارة عمليات تجميع ورفع الهياكل المعدنية للأبراج (Tower Erection) بمختلف أنواعها.
* خبرة في التعامل مع مخططات خطوط الضغط العالي والفيائق (OHTL) واختبارات الجودة (QA/QC).

**المسؤوليات الرئيسية:**

* الإشراف الميداني المباشر على الفرق والمقاولين لضمان تنفيذ الأعمال طبقاً للمواصفات الفنية والجدول الزمني.
* استلام الأعمال المدنية، صب القواعد، وتجميع الهياكل قبل وبعد الرفع.
* رفع التقارير الدورية عن تقدم سير العمل وإدارة أي معوقات في الموقع.

**Company:**
Prima International

**Location:**
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

Prima International is seeking an experienced
**Operations Manager**
to lead operations at its frozen bakery manufacturing facility in Riyadh.

The successful candidate will ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently achieving production, quality, and delivery targets. The role requires strong technical knowledge of industrial bakery manufacturing, frozen product handling, automated production lines, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead daily factory operations, coordinating production, maintenance, sanitation, and warehouse activities in close collaboration with Quality Assurance and Supply Chain.
* Develop and execute production plans aligned with sales forecasts, customer orders, available capacity, and inventory requirements.
* Oversee frozen bakery manufacturing processes, including mixing, dough preparation, lamination, forming, proofing or baking where applicable, freezing, and packaging.
* Maintain process controls for dough temperature, fermentation, product weight, freezing conditions, and finished product consistency.
* Ensure appropriate frozen storage and handling practices to preserve product quality and cold-chain integrity.
* Optimize production line performance, labor utilization, material yield, and equipment availability while reducing waste, downtime, and changeover losses.
* Manage operating budgets and monitor labor, overtime, materials, utilities, and other controllable manufacturing costs.
* Work with the Maintenance team to prioritize preventive maintenance, resolve recurring breakdowns, and improve equipment reliability.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP, GMP, food safety, hygiene, allergen control, traceability, and occupational safety requirements in coordination with Quality Assurance.
* Support audits, investigations, and corrective actions relating to operational performance, product quality, and food safety.
* Lead production trials, new product introductions, equipment commissioning, and capacity expansion projects in collaboration with relevant teams.

job_description:
نبذة عن الوظيفة

تعلن جمعية مكنون لتحفيظ القرآن الكريم بالرياض عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى
**أخصائي استقطاع**
، للعمل على إدارة وتطوير برامج الاستقطاع الشهري الإلكتروني، واستقطاب المتبرعين والمحافظة عليهم، والمساهمة في تنمية الموارد المالية للجمعية وتحقيق مستهدفاتها.

المسؤوليات والمهام

* إدارة برامج الاستقطاع الشهري الإلكتروني وتطويرها.
* استقطاب متبرعين جدد والمحافظة على المتبرعين الحاليين.
* متابعة الإيرادات وتحليل البيانات ورفع التقارير الدورية.
* التنسيق مع البنوك والجهات المالية لضمان استمرارية العمليات.
* الإشراف على مناديب الاستقطاع ودعم تحقيق المستهدفات.
* تنفيذ الحملات التسويقية وتنمية موارد الجمعية.

المؤهلات والمهارات المطلوبة

* درجة البكالوريوس في المالية أو المحاسبة أو التسويق أو إدارة الأعمال.
* خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في الاستقطاع أو تنمية الموارد.
* الإلمام بأنظمة الدفع الإلكتروني وإدارة قواعد البيانات (CRM).
* مهارات عالية في التواصل وبناء العلاقات.
* القدرة على التحليل المالي وإجادة استخدام برنامج Excel بمستوى متقدم.
* مهارات تنظيمية والقدرة على تحقيق المستهدفات.

معلومات الوظيفة

* **المسمى الوظيفي:**
  أخصائي استقطاع.
* **جهة العمل:**
  جمعية مكنون لتحفيظ القرآن الكريم بالرياض.
* **مقر العمل:**
  الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية.
* **نظام العمل:**
  حضوري (من مقر الجمعية).

job_description:
UAT Testing Specialist – Banking APIs & Client IntegrationRole Overview

We are seeking a UAT Testing Specialist to manage end-to-end User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for banking and payment services, working directly with corporate clients and their ERP partners to ensure successful integration, testing, and readiness for production go-live.

The role combines business and technical testing, client integration support, defect management, and cross-functional coordination to ensure a smooth and reliable client implementation experience.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End UAT Management

* Lead the UAT cycle from kickoff and scope confirmation through test planning, test data preparation, execution tracking, and client sign-off.
* Develop, review, and execute test cases covering functional scenarios, business rules, and integration requirements.
* Track testing progress, document results, manage blockers, and ensure outstanding issues are resolved before sign-off.
* Confirm UAT readiness and coordinate the handover to production go-live.

2. Client Integration & Support

* Guide corporate clients and their ERP partners through developer portal setup, including application creation, CIF/CR-UN and account list configuration, product subscriptions, and IP whitelisting.
* Act as the primary point of contact for UAT-related issues, reproducing failures, investigating root causes, and distinguishing client configuration issues from platform defects.
* Explain technical findings and testing outcomes in clear business terms to clients and stakeholders.

* Collaborate with sales and marketing team members on strategic sales approach.
* Consistently master your trade through learning and education across all OPSWAT products as well as the cybersecurity industry.

job_description:
تعلن شركة مشروعات المياه والطاقة للمقاولات الرائدة في قطاع المقاولات وإنشاءات البنية التحتية في المملكة العربية السعودية عن رغبتها في استقطاب كفاءة مميزة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المركز الرئيسي بمدينة **الدمام**  في وظيفة: **مهندس مشتريات بنية تحتية**.

**المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية:**

* **إدارة عمليات الشراء:** دراسة المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات (BOQ) لتحديد الاحتياجات الدقيقة للمشاريع من المواد المدنية، الميكانيكية، والكهربائية (MEP).
* **إدارة الموردين:** استغلال شبكة العلاقات الحالية وتوسيعها لتشمل كبار الموردين والمصنعين للمواد والأنظمة الخاصة بالبنية التحتية (داخل المملكة وخارجها).
* **التفاوض والتعاقد:** إدارة المفاوضات التجارية والفنية مع الموردين، وإبرام العقود والاتفاقيات الإطارية لضمان الحصول على أفضل الأسعار والائتمانات وشروط التوريد.
* **التأهيل الفني:** التنسيق مع قطاعات الاستشارات والجهات الحكومية (مثل أمانات المناطق، وزارة المياه، وشركة الكهرباء، إلخ) لضمان اعتماد المواد والموردين محلياً.
* **إدارة المخاطر وسلاسل الإمداد:** متابعة عمليات الشحن الدولي، التخليص الجمركي، واللوجستيات لضمان وصول المواد دون تأخير في الجدول الزمني للمشروع.
* **تحليل السوق:** مراقبة أسعار المواد الخام عالمياً ومحلياً لتقديم تقديرات مالية دقيقة وتجنب تقلبات الأسعار.

**الشروط والمؤهلات المطلوبة:**

* **التعليم:** درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة (مدنية / ميكانيكية / كهربائية) أو مجال هندسي/تقني ذي صلة.
* **الخبرة:** خبرة لا تقل عن **[5 إلى 10 سنوات]** في مجال مشتريات مشاريع البنية التحتية (شبكات ومحطات المياه والصرف الصحي، الطرق، شبكات الكهرباء والاتصالات).
* **شبكة العلاقات:** **شرط أساسي** وجود شبكة علاقات قوية ونشطة مع موردي ومصنعي المواد (المدنية والميكانيكية والكهربائية) محلياً ودولياً .

**المعرفة والمهارات:**

* معرفة تامة بإجراءات الاعتمادات والمواصفات القياسية للمشاريع الكبرى في السعودية (مثل مواصفات كود البناء السعودي، أرامكو، المشروعات الكبرى).
* مهارات تفاوض استثنائية وقدرة العثور على بدائل وابتكار حلول لتوفير التكاليف (Value Engineering).
* إتقان تام للغتين العربية والإنجليزية (تحدثاً وكتابة) للتعامل مع الموردين الدوليين.
* مهارة عالية في استخدام برامج إدارة الموارد (ERP Systems) مثل SAP أو Oracle.

الراتب المدفوع: ﷼٧٬٠٠٠٫٠٠ لكل شهر

Our Summer Internship Programme is an eight-week internship taking place June through August.
  
  
This programme is designed to provide students with a challenging, meaningful and supportive internship experience that replicates, as closely as possible, the experience of being a full-time BlackRock Analyst. The programme begins with an orientation that offers a thorough overview of the firm and the opportunity to hear from a number of senior leaders.
  
  
Following orientation, interns receive on-the-job training and are given day-to-day responsibilities to contribute to their teams throughout the summer. Programming also features a speaker series, mentoring and various networking opportunities, including activities with our employee networks.
  
  
If you enjoy this programme, you should explore our Full-Time Analyst Programme, which you can consider applying to after your internship.
  
  
**Who can apply:**
Candidates should be in their penultimate year of studies and graduating from an undergraduate or a master’s
  
  
degree program in 2028. We welcome applications from candidates studying any degree subject.
  
  
Please note local language fluency is required to work at our Continental Europe locations. However, only English is required for Budapest or for a position within Private Markets Investing in Zurich
  
  
**Important**
Candidates can apply for
**only one programme**
(e.g., Summer Internship Programme
**or**
Quantitative Master’s Internship Programme) and
**up to two functions within that programme**
(e.g., Investment Research and Analytics & Modeling). You must apply for both opportunities using the same programme application.
  
  
If you withdraw your application, you cannot submit another application this program this year.
