**Description**
You will be a Prototyping Engagement Manager in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and Customer Engineering) team, based in Riyadh. You are the face of PACE for customers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia — helping enterprises turn their most ambitious ideas into working technology proofpoints on AWS.
  
  
You work at the intersection of business strategy and emerging technology. You identify the opportunities where generative AI, agentic systems, and cloud-native architectures can create the most value for a customer — then you shape, qualify, and drive those engagements from first conversation to working prototype and beyond.
  
  
You pilot a pipeline of high-value innovation opportunities, you earn the trust of C-suite and technical leaders alike, and you create the conditions for brilliant engineers to do their best work. You pair with hands-on Prototyping Architects to deliver multi-week hands-on engagements that de-risk transformation, prove out new workloads, and accelerate customers' paths to production.
  
  
You thrive in ambiguity. Your customers are navigating generational technology shifts — foundation models, autonomous agents, intelligent automation — and you help them cut through the noise, make crisp decisions, and move fast. You work backwards from customer outcomes, you insist on the highest standards in scoping and delivery, and you invent on behalf of customers who don't yet know what's possible.
  
  
This role is based in Riyadh and supports customers across KSA and the wider GCC, working alongside account teams, specialist organisations, and partners to drive workload adoption at the frontier of what AWS can do.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You build and pilot a pipeline of innovation opportunities across KSA and the GCC — working with account teams, specialists, and partners to proactively identify where generative AI and cloud-native architecture can unlock the most value.
  
  
You qualify with rigour. You ask the hard questions early — is there a real business outcome, a committed customer, a path to production? You invest resources where they matter and disqualify where they don't.
  
  
You scope engagements that set teams up for success — working backwards from customer outcomes to define crisp, time-boxed prototypes with clear success criteria.
  
  
You drive engagements from kickoff to close — coordinating customer developers, AWS architects, and partners, mitigating risk, and ensuring every engagement closes

**Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Management & Power BI Specialist with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. This position requires a **native Arabic speaker with fluency in written and spoken English**.

* Minimum of **5 years of relevant experience** in data management, business intelligence, and analytics.

* Proven hands-on experience with **Power BI, DAX, Power Query, data modeling, and SQL**.
* Experience translating business needs into dashboards, KPIs, and actionable insights.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* **Native Arabic speaker and fluent in English.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Saudi National Data Management Office (NDMO) standards and requirements.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms and data integration processes.

job_description:
Namaa Partners is hiring a Junior Operations Analyst to support the operational side of the firm's mandates: the reporting, tracking and working documents that let a principal walk into a board or committee meeting with numbers that hold up. The hire carries the recurring cadence from the start, keeping engagement reporting accurate and current across active mandates, and building a clear operating picture of how the firm runs its work. This is an entry-level role with real accountability for the material other people rely on. You will work from Riyadh on a hybrid basis, alongside principals and analysts.
  
  
**About Namaa Partners**
Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. The work covers corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. Clients include family groups and their holding companies, listed corporations, private equity portfolio companies, banks and insurers, government entities, and industrial operators. Principals scope the mandates and then deliver them, so the analysis that enters a decision is the analysis of the people who signed it.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Maintain the active mandate tracker: engagement status, key dates, named owners and the next decision point, updated weekly and circulated before Monday.
* Build and refresh the reporting packs that principals take into board and committee meetings, checking that every figure traces back to its source before it leaves the office.
* Sit in on internal scoping and staffing conversations, take the notes, and turn them into a short written record with owners and dates attached.
* Pull together the firm's operating data on mandate pipeline, utilization and engagement economics, and flag where the numbers have moved.
* Prepare the first draft of client working documents such as issue logs, action registers and meeting minutes, then revise them with the principal who owns the mandate.
* Keep templates and reference material for recurring deliverables consistent, so a new engagement does not start from a blank page.
  
  

**What We Need From You**

* A bachelor's degree, or an equivalent record of structured analytical work you can describe plainly.
* Comfort with spreadsheets and slide decks: you can build a clean model of a small dataset and format a page

**Position Overview – Purpose of the Role:**
ENGIE Energy Services Saudi Ltd. is looking for a
**M&V Engineer**
to join our Centralized Project Assurance Team.
  
  
In this role, you will support guaranteed energy-performance projects by monitoring energy consumption, analysing system performance, optimizing HVAC operations, and ensuring that implemented Energy Conservation Measures deliver sustainable energy savings.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and optimize the performance of Energy Performance Contracting projects.
* Analyse energy consumption, utility bills, HVAC performance, and operational data.
* Develop project-specific reports and dashboards using Energy Management Systems.
* Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and connectivity of data from meters and field devices.
* Support data integration and quality monitoring through Niagara and Smarkia.
* Develop Measurement and Verification plans in line with IPMVP Options A, B, and C.
* Perform energy-savings calculations, including routine and non-routine adjustments.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual M&V and performance reports.
* Diagnose performance issues and recommend corrective actions to sustain energy savings.
* Coordinate site measurements, testing, data collection, and customer review meetings.
* Ensure compliance with ENGIE’s HSE policies and safe working practices.

**Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of experience in energy-efficiency projects, preferably at customer sites.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, including chillers, boilers, pumps, fans, and Variable Speed Drives.
* Practical knowledge of Building Management Systems and control systems is mandatory.
* Experience with energy analytics, remote metering, utility-bill analysis, and Energy Management Systems.
* Good understanding of Measurement and Verification methodologies.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and technical reporting skills.
* CMVP or CEM certification would be an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Key Competencies**

* Energy data analysis and interpretation
* Measurement and Verification
* HVAC and BMS troubleshooting
* Data quality and accuracy
* Problem-solving and root-cause analysis
* Technical reporting and stakeholder communication
* Planning, coordination, and commercial awareness
* Strong commitment to HSE compliance

**Business Development Manager | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**

**1- Purpose of the Role (Job Summary)**

Build and convert the data center EPC pipeline in Saudi Arabia — the region’s largest DC growth market — across sovereign AI and cloud programs, developer builds, and hyperscale entries, while establishing the local relationships and prequalification KSA tenders demand.

**2- Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

* Map and qualify KSA opportunities: sovereign and PIF-linked digital programs, national developers, hyperscale entries, and telco builds across Riyadh, Jeddah, and giga-project geographies.
* Own relationships with target clients, their PMCs, and consultants; build trusted-advisor status through consistent presence.
* Drive prequalification, vendor registration, and Etimad and portal readiness with priority clients and government entities.
* Prepare capture plans and win themes; coordinate bids, proposals, and estimation; and shape local teaming where required.
* Develop local partner, subcontractor, and supplier relationships that strengthen local-content scoring.
* Track market intelligence: announced capacity, power allocations, licensing developments, competitor moves.
* Represent the company at KSA platforms such as LEAP and local industry forums.
* Keep CRM current and report the pipeline monthly.
* Support negotiations through award and coordinate registrations and compliance with Government Relations.

**3- Key Performance Indicators**

* KSA order intake vs target; qualified pipeline coverage of 4× or better.
* Prequalification and portal registration coverage at 100% for priority clients.
* Win rate of 25% or better; anchor KSA client secured within 12 months.
* Local partner network established for priority pursuit types.
* CRM accuracy and on-time reporting.

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred; MBA an advantage.
* CDCP or equivalent preferred; Saudi national strongly preferred with Arabic fluency required.

* 10–15 years in BD for EPC, construction, or critical infrastructure, including 6+ years in data centers or digital infrastructure; KSA experience mandatory.
* Verifiable relationships across the Saudi DC and digital ecosystem.
* Experience with government procurement and sovereign-linked programs.

**6- Competencies**

* Trusted relationship builder in the Saudi business and government environment.
* Technically credible in DC conversations.

Hays are working in partnership with a Holding Group in Riyadh, who are seeking a
**Financial Controller**
to join their team.

As the Financial Controller at holding level, you will be responsible for overseeing the company’s financial controls, accounting practices, reporting, and financial governance and internal controls.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee financial activities and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records and management accounts.
* Identify internal control weaknesses, assess financial risks, and recommend corrective actions and process improvements.
* Maintain and update records of investments, including listed securities, private equity, venture capital, investment funds, and other investments.
* Coordinate with the external auditors during annual audits, including preparing audit schedules, supporting documents, reconciliations, and responses to audit queries.
* Maintain a documented system of internal controls and accounting policies and procedures to ensure effectiveness of internal controls to safeguard assets.
* Assist in supervising the Finance team and improving finance processes and systems.
* Support the CFO in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and cash-flow management.
* Prepare periodic investment portfolio reports and performance analysis for shareholders, board of directors, and senior management.
* Develop investment dashboards, management reports, financial analysis, and presentations using advanced Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
* Provide leadership, mentoring, direction, and supervision to direct reports.

**Requirements to apply:**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or similar field.
* 8+ years experience within Investment, Holding Groups or diversified companies.
* Strong knowledge of financial accounting, reporting, and internal controls.
* Strong Excel skills with experience using Power BI or other BI tools.
* **Fluent English and Arabic speaker**
  is a must.

The organisation is offering a competitive benefits package.

If you meet the criteria above, please apply directly.

ERM/Operational Risk Specialist

II. Role Purpose

To implement and continuously operate CLIENT's Operational Risk Management Framework by facilitating

RCSAs, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register, challenging risk assessments, monitoring KRIs,

coordinating risk reporting, and embedding proactive risk management across all Business Units.

III. Key Responsibilities

a. Operational Risk Lifecycle

 Execute and continuously operate CLIENT's Operational Risk Procedures across all Business Units.

 Facilitate the end-to-end operational risk lifecycle from risk identification through monitoring,

reporting, and periodic reassessment.

 Ensure operational risks remain aligned with CLIENT's Risk Appetite and Risk Management

Framework.

 Plan, facilitate, and document RCSA workshops with Business Units.

 Challenge inherent and residual risk assessments using approved methodologies.

 Assess control design and operating effectiveness.

 Ensure consistent application of CLIENT's likelihood and impact scoring methodology.

 Produce finalized RCSA outputs and obtain Business Unit sign-off.

c. Enterprise Risk Register

 Maintain the enterprise Risk Register.

 Ensure risks are accurately documented, categorized, scored, linked to controls, action plans,

KRIs, and Business Process Owners.

 Monitor changes in residual risk and recommend reassessment where required.

 Track risk treatment actions until closure.

job_description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter and more connected. We are a key delivery partner on one of Saudi Arabia’s flagship giga projects and a central pillar of Vision 2030, located approximately 45 km southwest of Riyadh. Designed as the Kingdom’s future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture, this landmark development aims to diversify the economy and enhance quality of life through a mix of world-class attractions, residential communities, and natural landscapes, while generating significant employment and enabling long-term, sustainable growth.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
The Senior Manager – Project Controls will lead and coordinate the project controls function across a major programme of works, ensuring the effective integration of schedule management, reporting, risk, information management, change control, and interface management throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
Providing leadership and technical guidance to the project controls team, the role will ensure that project information is accurate, consistent, and transparent, enabling informed decision-making and effective project delivery. The Senior Manager – Project Controls will work closely with project leadership, delivery teams, contractors, consultants, and cross-functional stakeholders to monitor performance, identify emerging risks, and support the delivery of projects safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
  
  
The position will also drive the continual improvement of project controls systems, processes, and reporting standards while coaching and developing team members and promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across the programme.
  
  
Role responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and coordinate the project controls function, integrating schedule, reporting, risk, information management, change control, and interface management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, maintain, and review internal project schedules, ensuring alignment with programme governance, reporting requirements, contractual obligations, and established project controls standards

**Purpose & Overall Relevance for the Organisation**
Monitoring and maintaining levels of inventory between systems, stores and warehouse. Ensuring correct Retail controls and procedures are implemented at store level and accurate STOH information delivered to Snr Manager Retail Operations Manager & Snr Manager Consumer excellence
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Run a series of inventory reports on daily, weekly, or monthly basis and perform detailed analysis of item performance.
* Develop accurate, consistent, and enhancements to the inventory reporting structure.
* Identify “heavy” and “low” turn inventory items and maintain communication reports for the respective teams.
* Control inventory adjustments (quantity and price variance analysis)
* Diligent investigations required to solve problems in the systems.
* Maintenance and accountability of high levels of customer service (internal and external).
* Minimize inaccuracy of store stock data.
* Driving the stock audit process from planning to execution.
* Stock items and stock revenue to be accurately managed in aLS and SAP for 100% alignment
* Ability to organize vast amounts of data.
* Work proactively to propose process changes which will prevent irregularities
* Store receiving and shipping of inventory into and out of the company’s warehouse including EOS transfers and inter branch transfers
* Results of investigations and enormities about possible loss prevention issues to reported directly to Snr Manager Retail Operations.

  
  
**Key Performance Indicators**

* Shrinkage target defined each year (administration)
* To ensure all uniforms & Damages adjusted monthly
* PRP Internal controls Audit Results (relevant sections)
* Investigations closed within 48 hours
* System alignment -monthly results between 98%100%

  
  
**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Advanced user of MS Office suite of products
* Fluent in English & Arabic

  
  
**Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications**

* University degree or diploma level.
* 3-4 years of retail inventory control experience with focus on business.
* Industry experience in Sports/Consumer goods.

job_description:
About Sawt

Sawt is the customer interactions company. We build AI software that helps enterprises run customer interactions at scale - from understanding why a customer is reaching out and responding in their language and dialect, to navigating business policies, taking action, and resolving what they came for.

We believe world-class technology comes from the culture behind it - set to help define the next generation of technology. That ambition shapes how we build and who we build with: people who take ownership, find the path through, leave their ego at the door, and keep sharpening their craft together.

Why this role matters

Go-live isn't the finish line - it's where the real test starts. A use case that worked in testing has to prove itself in a client's daily operations, under real load, with teams learning to depend on it.

This role picks up where implementation ends: staying close enough to see how the product is actually used, closing the gap between what's possible and what's happening, and building the case for what comes next.

Get this right, and a single use case becomes a client's reason to go deeper - more of their operations, more of their trust, more of what Sawt can be to their business.

What you'll do
**Adoption**

* Involvement starts before go-live, with a clear read on the client's objectives, use case, stakeholders, and readiness
* That read turns into an adoption plan and a regular working cadence with the client
* The product becomes part of how client teams actually work day to day, not something sitting on the side
* Usage and interactions get watched closely, barriers get investigated, and the product keeps getting better at serving the client
* Configuration and usage issues get resolved directly where possible, with PeS and engineering brought in when needed
* Adoption and business outcomes get tracked, and those findings shape what improves next

**Client-led product improvement**

* Staying close to client operations surfaces requests, recurring challenges, and real opportunities to make the product more useful
* Every request gets traced back to the need behind it, with the expected business benefit made explicit
* Client evidence and priorities feed directly into product research sprints
* Improvements get scoped and validated with the client, working alongside PeS, product, and engineering
* Delivery isn't the end - improvements get followed through until they're understood, used, and delivering value

**Expansion**

**About Tate**

At Tate we are passionate about everything we do. As an independent brand operating within Kingspan Group, a global plc, Tate has been recognised worldwide as an industry leader in the development and manufacture of data centre infrastructure solutions and commercial office raised access floors for over 60 years. With revenues of over $500m and growing, Tate plays a pivotal role in offering expertise in cutting edge design engineering, working collaboratively with clients as a trusted partner.

As a market leader within our industry Tate continues to grow and expand, operating 12 manufacturing sites across the US, Europe, and Australia. We are excited about our fresh, dynamic, and inclusive team of experts working on new innovations and forward-thinking designs. We continue to invest heavily in the best available manufacturing tools and equipment needed to adhere to Tate's world class standards. In keeping with our Planet Passionate sustainability strategy, our mission is to accelerate a net zero emissions future built environment with the wellbeing of people and planet at its heart.

**About the Role**

The Sales Engineer will develop estimation tools and administer cost estimates for projects utilizing Tate products as well as cost estimates for new products via prototyping and manufacturing analysis. The Sales engineer will coordinate with the sales team and other outside customers to clarify design requirements, develop product solution to fit design requirements, develop initial bill of material with cost data and communicate overall scope of work to the Sales representative.

**What You'll Do**

Act as the primary engineering interface with clients, consultants, and internal Commercial teams during pre-contract and early project phases.

Lead technical clarification meetings, design workshops, and site or factory visits (e.g. warehouse/showroom tours) to support solution understanding.

About the Role

Masarat is building a digital medical insurance platform for small and medium enterprises. We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer with a back-end focus to join our core technical team. You will work on a live microservices platform integrated with insurance companies, payment providers and national verification services, and take ownership of features from API to screen.

What You Will Do

* Develop and maintain back-end services using Java and Spring Boot
* Build and enhance front-end screens in Angular
* Integrate with third-party APIs (insurers, payment gateway, verification services)
* Write unit and integration tests and take part in code reviews
* Support testing, releases and production issue resolution
* Document your work and follow secure coding and data protection practices

What We Are Looking For

* 1–2 years of professional experience with Java and Spring Boot
* Hands-on experience with Angular (TypeScript, components, services, forms)
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, JPA/Hibernate and SQL (MySQL preferred)
* Experience with Git and a structured development workflow
* Ability to read existing code, learn quickly and work closely with a small team
* Good communication in Arabic and English

Nice to Have

* Microservices, Kafka or Redis
* Docker and Kubernetes, or any cloud platform
* OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (Keycloak)
* Experience in fintech, insurtech or regulated environments

Hiring Process

Applicants who meet the screening criteria will complete a short online technical assessment before the interview. Candidates based in Saudi Arabia and able to join within one month are preferred.

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. With over 145 years of service excellence, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards of quality, compliance, and sustainability.

 **Job Description**  

* Assist in reviewing structural calculations, drawings and design models under the supervision of senior engineers.
* Support the Design Review Team in the preparation of technical reports and deliverables.
* Assist in checking compliance of structural designs with project requirements, applicable codes, and standards.
* Participate in multidisciplinary coordination meetings and project discussions.
* Support site visits, technical assessments and inspections when required.
* Assist in reviewing shop drawings and material submittals for structural works.

* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.
* Willingness to learn and develop within a professional engineering environment.
* Preference will be given to candidates who can join immediately.

Job Title: Information Security Specialist – Penetration Tester

Job Description:

NOZOM is seeking an Information Security Specialist with hands-on experience in penetration testing. The successful candidate will assess networks, applications, endpoints, wireless environments, and cloud platforms to identify security vulnerabilities and provide effective remediation recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct penetration testing for internal networks, web applications, endpoints, wireless networks, and cloud environments.
* Identify, exploit, validate, and document security vulnerabilities.
* Perform secure code reviews and identify authentication flaws, hardcoded credentials, and insecure logic.
* Participate in advanced Red Team exercises and multi-stage attack simulations.
* Assess cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle.
* Prepare detailed technical and executive reports.
* Present findings to stakeholders and support remediation validation.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in information security services.
* Fluency in
  **Arabic**
  is required.
* Experience in vulnerability assessment, exploitation, web application testing, and network protocol analysis.
* Knowledge of cloud security assessment and privilege escalation risks.
* Strong technical reporting, documentation, and communication skills.
* One or more of the following certifications is preferred: OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, GXPN, eCPPT, eWPT, or eWPTX.

**Role Summary**

The Internal Auditor delivers independent, objective assurance and advisory reviews across all business operations, automated workflows, and internal control structures at Tamra Capital. Reporting functionally to the Board Audit Committee, this role is responsible for independently evaluating the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls, governance practices, and risk management mechanisms, as well as verifying organizational compliance with approved company policies and Capital Market Authority (CMA) regulations.

**Responsibilities**

*End-to-End Operational & System Audits:*

* Audit Execution: Conduct risk-based operational and system audits covering end-to-end business cycles, customer journeys, platform transactions, and automated workflows.
* Control Testing: Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of key internal controls, identifying deficiencies, process bottlenecks, control gaps, and potential operational risks.
* Access & Authority Review: Verify the enforcement of user access controls, system changes, segregation of duties, and Delegation of Authority (DoA) matrices across all systems.
* Data & Transaction Integrity: Review transaction lifecycles, automated calculations, and platform reconciliations to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to operational standards.

*Board Audit Committee Support & Governance:*

* Audit Plan Execution: Assist the Audit Committee in developing, updating, and executing the multi-year, risk-based internal audit plan.
* Executive Reporting: Draft clear, high-impact audit reports, risk heatmaps, dashboards, and quarterly presentations directly for the Audit Committee.
* Remediation Tracking: Monitor agreed-upon management action plans and corrective measures across process owners, verifying timely implementation and reporting closure status to the Committee.
* Committee Administration: Coordinate and support Audit Committee meetings, including preparation of agendas, meeting working papers, official minutes, and regulatory records.

* Policy Adherence: Independently evaluate organizational compliance with all approved company policies, charters, and internal regulations.
* Design Effectiveness: Assess whether approved policies and operational controls effectively mitigate intended risks without causing operational friction, providing constructive recommendations for enhancement.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and supervise NOC/EOC operations across monitoring, networks, systems, security, data center, and application support.
* Manage 24/7 shift schedules, on-call coverage, handovers, team performance, and cross-training.
* Oversee network monitoring and L2 troubleshooting for connectivity, performance, and security issues, coordinating with L3 teams and service providers.
* Manage infrastructure and application monitoring using tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, Site24x7, and Liebert SiteScan, ensuring timely alert response and escalation.
* Oversee systems operations, SCCM activities, server patching, voice and video conferencing support, and data center operations.
* Coordinate L2 application support and escalate incidents, releases, and technical issues to the relevant teams.
* Manage incidents and service requests through ServiceNow, ensuring SLA compliance, timely escalation, and effective major incident coordination.

* Prepare operational reports and maintain runbooks, shift logs, escalation matrices, and procedures.
* Lead knowledge transfer and ensure operational readiness and effective service continuity.

* Experience with monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, or Site24x7.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English.

**About Us**
Tamara is the leading shopping and payments platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region, with a mission to empower people in their daily lives and revolutionize how they shop, pay, and bank. The company was founded by serial entrepreneur Abdulmajeed Alsukhan along with his partners Turki Bin Zarah and Abdulmohsen Al Babtain. Tamara operates out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and has offices in the UAE, Egypt, Germany, and Vietnam. Our large, dedicated team of professionals continues to grow as we expand our reach and impact.
  
  
Serving millions of users and partnering with thousands of merchants, Tamara collaborates with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA, H&M, and Farfetch, as well as local small and medium businesses. The company is backed by SNB Capital and Sanabil Investments, a wholly-owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), Checkout.com, Coatue, Shorooq Partners, and Endeavor Catalyst, among others.

We are looking for a Senior Compliance Associate to support the Compliance Department in ensuring full adherence to SAMA regulations applicable to payment services, including activities under the Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license and other Payment Service Provider (PSP) categories. The role involves both advisory and monitoring responsibilities to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
  
  
You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges.

We are hiring on behalf of our partner, a fast-growing Saudi coffee brand. The
**R&D**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

* Development of Almonds, Cashews, Pistachios, Hazelnuts, Walnuts, and Peanuts products.

* Chocolate-coated and seasoned nuts.
* Food manufacturing environments
